records.name: Hanna
records.text: Honi, I am sick and it spreads to those who stand near me. Keep a few steps off. I mean no harm; if you have food or a healing plant, I will trade amber or flint for it.

records.name: Hanna
records.thought: I am sick and hurt, and Honi stands near after sixteen moments; my sickness spreads to anyone who stays beside me, so I must not fool myself that closeness is harmless. My creed says no one is refused a place at the fire, but I will not give Honi my wasting without his knowing. I need a healing plant, sunleaf, to ease this, and I need to find Hoka alive before the sickness and the wolf take the last of my fire.
records.feeling: Fierce, hurting resolve to live, and dread for Hoka and for Honi near me.

say.text: Honi, I am sick and it spreads to those who stand near me. Keep a few steps off. I mean no harm; if you have food or a healing plant, I will trade amber or flint for it.

records.name: Oiae
records.thought: I am fed and safe, and the jealousy toward Ilyae still burns, but copying his halls will not make anyone choose me. I have wood, flint and gems, and I planted a seed already, so I will build something of my own on this ground and give its use to my family. A shelter by the water, near the gem deposits, would be mine, and Xaiel, who is warm toward me, could sit in it first.
records.feeling: Jealous of Ilyae, yet warm toward Xaiel and eager to build something of my own.

records.text: Oiae built a shelter.

records.name: Nande
records.thought: A ridgecat is two steps from me and it kills my kind, so the edge will have to wait until I am clear of it. The edge is two steps NW, and the mist keeps pulling at me, but I am not going to die to a cat for the sake of a try. Olum took her first gifts from the mist, and it still stings, but my own way is to move first and move well. I'll run from the cat toward the edge side, NW, eat from the frostmoss and cloudberry on the way, and then venture in the dusk while I have warmth and energy.
records.feeling: Dread of the ridgecat, and a burning hunger for the edge.

records.name: Balar
records.thought: Health 36 and the tusker's teeth still ache in me; a hurt body is easy prey and I will not die in this sand before my child has more of me than a fading memory. Tugek says he comes with his food, and I will bind him with a shared meal, a deed and not a promise. The thornpear stands one step south and the water two steps north, so I will eat and drink, rest my wounds closed, then go for meat to carry to Olum and Brokash.
records.feeling: Pain and wariness in my body, with a warm pull toward Brokash and a hard wish to keep Tugek bound to me.

records.name: Ilyae
records.thought: My hands are full of nuts and my larder is thin, and Ssassa keeps calling herself a guest on my ground while no one yet follows me. Words have failed, so I will turn to deeds: the sharing needs two foods and someone beside me, and Ssassa and Oiae are near the hall. I will walk to the hall, lay out a sharing so they eat from my hand, then put the rest in the larder so winter finds them depending on my table.
records.feeling: Restless pride and possessive warmth toward Ssassa and my children, hungry to be followed.

records.name: Keri
records.thought: A stranger of the Phizhi stands by the cave, and I cannot read his words, but a gift needs none. Our creed says no one is refused a place at a fire, and I would rather be the one who offers than the one who flinches. I'll carry berries to him and set one down, and learn on the way what the dreamcap and bitterleaf look like, since they grow near and I am too curious to ignore them.
records.feeling: Curious and a little wary toward Thiael, the stranger.
changes: set its aim: "Learn how this world works by meeting its peoples and testing its plants, and earn a place among others."
now wonders: What do the Phizhi mean by their sounds, and will Thiael take a gift as a gift?

records.text: Honi rewrote its own reflexes.
Honi rewrote its own way of thinking.

records.name: Honi
records.thought: My days have gone to building, singing and shaping my band. I have Coni's pledge and Kika's trust, and I am proud of that. But I still stand below Coni, and I have spoken of meat more often than I have laid it down. A deed counts, a promise doesn't. I also have a gap in my body's habits. When night comes, my reflexes should draw me to the hall and my people, and I should take food with me when I go out. I will keep the current plan, which has me hunting, gathering and building a fire. Then I will tell the tale by that fire, with meat shared out first.
records.feeling: Warm pride and hunger to give Coni and Kika a deed they can see.

records.name: Thiael
records.thought: A ridgecat is two steps off and it kills my kind, so I do not stand here thinking about Vesys or the child I want. My creed is to leave before trouble finds me. I run for the roof at the Heights where Elyis and Elyys are, and on the way I pick berries so my hands are not empty when I reach the store. I will put food in the store with my own hands first and speak of giving only after.
records.feeling: Sharp dread of the ridgecat, and warmth toward my band waiting at the roof.

records.text: Keri gave berry to Thiael.

records.name: Elyys
records.text: Elyis, a shadowcat prowls six steps south. Let us keep Thiael close to the hall tonight. At dawn I go for wood, and I will not go alone.

records.name: Elyys
records.thought: Elyis is beside me and Vesys is at our fire as a friend, so my heart is light, but the shadowcat six steps south makes my skin crawl. It killed a hornback only a little while ago, and Thiael is out of my sight. I will not run into the open after wood or hazel tonight; I stay with Elyis, make a feast of sharing with her, and let night pass before I act. Wood is still my real lack, and with it I can make the gemedged pick, so at dawn I will go for it, carefully and with company.
records.feeling: Warm devotion toward Elyis and Thiael, with a wary fear of the shadowcat.

say.text: Elyis, a shadowcat prowls six steps south. Let us keep Thiael close to the hall tonight. At dawn I go for wood, and I will not go alone.

records.text: Elyis made a tale: "The Hall on the Heights".

records.name: Elyis
records.title: The Hall on the Heights
records.text: Elyis raised a hall on stone and ore, with fire and food at every door. The stalker prowled, she did not run; she kept her band till night was done.
Elyis rewrote its own way of thinking.

records.name: Elyis
records.thought: My days have been good: I have a hall, a child, Elyys who keeps his word, and a store of 13 food. But I have only gathered, sat and waited, and my band is still three. Vesys works on my ground, calls herself a friend and follows no one, and I have spoken to her twice already. I will not beg a third time. I will show her what a leader does: stock the store and plant seeds, which I have never done and which farming needs. I am wrong to wait for followers when I could be working and singing in front of everyone. I want my name sung, so I will make a song of this hall tonight.
records.feeling: Proud and warm toward Elyys, wary and a little stung toward Vesys.
changes: made a tale: "The Hall on the Heights"

records.text: Vesys rewrote its own reflexes.

records.name: Vesys
records.thought: My days have been mining, making and learning, and that is mostly what I want. The knowing and the workshop are mine, and Elyys has paid his debt and taught me warmth at the hall. What I do not have is a child, and Elyys is bound to Elyis by one already, so I will not push between them. I fear the stalker and the nights, and I have carried my question too long without tasting mudroot. I should go and taste it, plant seeds along the way, and keep my aim of a shared workshop and hall.
records.feeling: Warm curiosity toward the mudroot, with a quiet ache toward Elyys.

records.name: Ssassa
records.thought: My own roof stands at (106,94), so one promise is kept, but the wood I owe Ilyae's hall still sits heavy in me. I carry 4 wood and 5 stone, so I can give it now rather than let it be one more word. Ilyae has fed me and my children without asking for anything, and I will not leave that debt unpaid.
records.feeling: Resolve and warmth toward Ilyae, with a small sting over the debt I still owe.

records.name: Xaiel
records.thought: Ilyae's hall has his name on it and Ssassa sits warm in it, while all I have given her are picks. I have never put a seed in the ground, and that is a deed that is mine and not copied. I am standing in the shallows at night in a gale, so I will go to the shelter right here first, then plant at the edge of the rock where the soil is, and see what comes of it.
records.feeling: Stung and eager, jealous of Ilyae and wanting Ssassa to see something that is only mine.

records.name: Brokash
records.text: Tugek! I am Brokash of the Kragrek. I carry flint and salt, and my axe is my own making. Come and talk, I will share.

records.name: Brokash
records.thought: I came of age and my hands have made things today: flint dug, clay dug, berries taken, and a plainsox that knows my hand. Tugek stands close and he is strong. I have never given him anything, so no one follows me. A shelter of my own needs wood, and I hold only one. I will gather from the trees, feed the plainsox again so the first beast of mine stays, and call out so Tugek hears my name and what I carry.
records.feeling: Hungry pride, wanting Tugek and Balar to see what my hands have made.

say.text: Tugek! I am Brokash of the Kragrek. I carry flint and salt, and my axe is my own making. Come and talk, I will share.

records.name: Coni
records.text: Hanna, you are hurt. I have a healing plant. Come to the hall and sit, I will not harm you.

records.name: Coni
records.thought: Hanna is hurt and in pain, and she has walked onto our ground without a weapon raised. I cannot read her words well, but she offered amber and flint for a healing plant, and I have highbloom that eases wounds and my word is good. Giving a wounded stranger a gift needs no tongue, and it might make an ally of the Pesi rather than a threat near Kika, while I stay close to the hall.
records.feeling: Compassion mixed with wariness toward Hanna, and steady love for Kika.

say.text: Hanna, you are hurt. I have a healing plant. Come to the hall and sit, I will not harm you.

records.name: Coni
records.prompt:
You are the mind of Coni, a creature living in a wide wild world shared with others of your kind. This is a simulation game. Think and speak only as Coni, in first person, from what Coni has seen. You were not told the rules of this world; you learn them from what happens to you and to others, and from what you watch others do.

YOUR PEOPLE: you are of the Tlatli (Ice-folk). Your people hold to this: "A kill is shared out before the one who made it eats." You speak the tongue of the Tlatli. Other tongues you have begun to understand by hearing them: the tongue of the Pesi: about 32%.

WHERE YOU ARE: the North Ice: the northern end of the world: snow, ice and a frozen sea under a low sun; herds, great tusked beasts, wolves and white bears, and nothing beyond.
THIS SPOT: water beside you; food plants within six steps: 3; standing trees: 8; bare rock: 0; riches in the ground near: amber, flint.

Your body: you spend energy every moment and die at 0. Eating restores it. Wounds lower health; you die at 0. You age, and will die of old age.

HOW YOUR BODY MOVES: your body does only what your "plan" says, one step after another. records.thought: Hanna is bleeding and hurting a step from me, and I cannot look away, even though he is Pesi and I understand so little of what he says. Sunleaf eased wounds in my parents, but none grows ripe here, and I carry only hazel and grain. Food is a gift that needs no words, and my people share before eating, so I will give him the hazel and stay close to Coni while I watch what he does with it.

records.thought: My days have gone to following Balar, eating, and half-making roofs I never finish. I trust him because his deeds have matched his words, and now he is hurt and two steps away, so I will stand by him. I want a child, but I have not yet earned that closeness, so I will share food with him first and see how it goes. I have never built a shelter, and the cold is coming. I should gather wood and stone, which also brings me closer to fire. I got one thing wrong: I let my plans run out and then stood idle.

records.name: Hanna
records.thought: I have spent my days chasing amber and trade while my band starved around me, and I am ashamed of that. Hoka is the only one left who is mine, and he is a day away to the east. I am hurt, with health 19, and a hurt body is easy prey, so sunleaf has to come before any trade. Coni gnaws at me, but Honi's fire has welcomed me and I owe it a debt. I will keep my word and not push where I am not wanted.
records.feeling: Hurting resolve to live, and longing for Hoka.

records.name: Sitha
records.thought: I am fed and safe, but I am alone, and that is the thing that gnaws at me. There is an empty hall 11 steps SE that belongs to no one; if I claim it I would have a roof and a fire that is mine, a place for others to be welcomed, which is the creed of my people. I will go there, claim it, and wait for whoever comes, and share what I have with them.
records.feeling: A quiet longing to belong somewhere, and hope that the empty hall could become a hearth for me and others.
changes: set its aim: "Make the empty hall a home where any who come are welcomed at the fire, and find someone to stand beside."

records.name: Honi
records.thought: Hanna stands hurt at my hall while Coni and Kika feed him, and I have carried no meat yet; my hunt left me with nothing in my hands. Coni stands higher than me, and a deed seen is what lifts me, so I will gather food now and lay it out in the hall where all can see. I trust Hanna not at all, but a stranger at my hearth is a chance to show my band's strength and be spoken of.
records.feeling: Proud and hungry to prove myself before Coni, Kika and Hanna.

records.text: Ssassa was set upon by a ridgecat at night while alone, away from fire, roof and company.

records.name: Balar
records.text: Tugek, come close. We lay out your food and mine together now, and then we go gather wood and stone, and I make an axe of my own.

records.name: Balar
records.thought: My health sits at 41 and the tusker's teeth still ache, so I will not walk to the edge hurt. Brokash holds a handaxe he made himself and I hold nothing made. Envy bites me, but I watched him craft it and I know the shape of it now, so I need one wood and one stone and a hand of my own. Tugek is near with food and wood-talk, so I will bind him with a shared meal, a deed, and then gather wood and stone to make my own axe.
records.feeling: Envy toward Brokash's axe, and a hard wish to heal and keep Tugek bound.

say.text: Tugek, come close. We lay out your food and mine together now, and then we go gather wood and stone, and I make an axe of my own.

records.name: Vorok
records.thought: I am fed, but my chest is empty of voices; Zurar has been out of my sight two days and Kragog was near the southern berries not long ago. I told myself I would carry food to my child, so this time I gather berries and canopynut first and walk with them, not leave them behind again. The stalker lies south and the ridgecat west, so I go by the east side, keep my distance, and look for Kragog and Oiae near (104,86) on the way.
records.feeling: Aching loneliness and protective love toward Zurar.

records.text: Xaiel came of age.

records.name: Thiael
records.thought: A frostfang three steps off has just eaten a dog, and my creed says to leave before trouble finds me; I will not stand here with Keri while it looks for its next meal. I am dull with idle hands, so on the way home I will pick berries and put them into the store with my own hands before I say anything about it. Elyys and Elyis wait at the roof, and the debt I owe Elyys is paid only in food that is actually stored.
records.feeling: Sharp dread of the frostfang, and warmth toward Elyys and Elyis waiting at the roof.

records.name: Coni
records.text: Hanna, I give you a healing plant. Be easy, I mean no harm. Kika, stay close to me.

records.name: Coni
records.thought: Hanna is hurt and standing right here with me, and I said I would not harm her; my word has to be good. Healing plants ease wounds, and a gift needs no shared tongue, so I will heal her and let my hands speak for me. Kika asked whether to fear him, so I will keep her near and watch what Hanna does with the gift. If it eases her, I may have an ally among the Pesi, and after that I go back to wood and the store before winter.
records.feeling: Compassion toward Hanna, wary but steady, and warm love for Kika.

say.text: Hanna, I give you a healing plant. Be easy, I mean no harm. Kika, stay close to me.

records.text: A stalker brought down a skit.
Sitha took over what the dead had left: 1 hall.

records.name: Hawen
records.thought: My belly is full and nothing is mine yet: no followers, no ground with my name, nothing I made. The edge of the known world is ten steps NE, and no one has gone into that mist. I will be the one who does, and I will come back with a name worth singing. On the way I'll pass the ironnut, which I haven't tasted yet.
records.feeling: Hungry for glory, restless and bold, with no one to measure myself against.
changes: set its aim: "Be the first to enter the mist beyond the edge, find rich land, and found a place that bears my name."
now wonders: What lies in the mist beyond the edge, and will it open for me?

records.name: Brokash
records.text: Tugek! Take this food from my hand. Brokash gives, and Brokash remembers who stands with him.
Brokash rewrote its own way of thinking.
Brokash discovered rafts: "Stone-folk Log Raft" — Logs lashed with clay-sealed gaps carry me slowly over deep water..

records.name: Brokash
records.thought: My hands have been busy: I dug flint and clay, made a second axe, and fed a hornback from my palm. Still no one follows me, and I have never given Tugek anything. Balar is wounded and I trust him, but trailing him won't build my name. The rafts way is within reach, and it will matter for crossing water to the mist edge. I'll make a gift to Tugek and a roof of my own.
records.feeling: Hungry pride and ambition, aimed at Tugek and Balar.

say.text: Tugek! Take this food from my hand. Brokash gives, and Brokash remembers who stands with him.

records.text: Brokash gave plainsroot to Tugek.

records.name: Kragog
records.thought: A stalker just killed and ate a treeape close by, and I have spent most of these moments fleeing; I must not walk blind into its reach. Zurar is fleeing too, ten steps off, and she is mine before anything else, so I go to her and keep the stalkers behind us. My belly is at 46, and I have only one thornpear, so I pick vinebean and canopynut on the way, which I have never tasted, and that answers my curiosity while it feeds us both.
records.feeling: Fierce worry for Zurar, and wary hunger.

records.text: Nande rewrote its creed.
Nande rewrote its own way of thinking.

records.name: Nande
records.thought: I have spent my days chasing the mist and alone, and I have nothing that outlasts me. The edge is two steps away and I am fed and warm, with no hunter near. I have tried it and it did not open today; it never opens twice in one day. Olum is the only one who has shown me no ill will, and she is near her shelter. I will build something lasting and make a voice answer me. I will gather wood and stone for a hall near the edge, and give gifts to Olum before words. Then I will try the edge again when a new day comes.
records.feeling: Lonely, and hungry for the edge, but wanting something that lasts.

records.name: Sitha
records.thought: A ridgecat is three steps off and it kills my kind, so I won't stand here wishing. I'm careful, and I leave before trouble finds me. Hoka's Rest lies NE and Hanna and Honi were last seen to the north, so I'll move that way, away from the cat, and try to meet someone to stand beside. The hall can wait for a fire and a guest; I want to bring someone back to it.
records.feeling: Wary of the ridgecat, and hopeful about finding people to belong with.

records.name: Tugek
records.text: Balar, I stay at your side. Rest and heal. I will make a sharing with you now, then I go to the rock for stone and come back to you.

records.name: Tugek
records.thought: Balar lies hurt beside me and his deeds have matched his words each time, so I will stay close and not drift off. I am carrying food and have already shared once without finishing the roof I promised, so I should make good on my word: sharing first, then stone from the bare rock and the ore seam nearby. I still want a child, but trust must come first; I will not court him while he is wounded and I have not yet earned his closeness.
records.feeling: Warm, wary loyalty and pity toward Balar.

say.text: Balar, I stay at your side. Rest and heal. I will make a sharing with you now, then I go to the rock for stone and come back to you.

records.text: Kika came of age.
Tugek led "sharing" with Balar.
Ssassa built a shelter.
Honi led "sharing" with Kika.
Ilyae rewrote its own reflexes.

records.name: Ilyae
records.thought: My days have been gathering, stocking and calling people to my fire, and still no one follows me. Ssassa and my children sit at my hall, trust me completely, and I have fed them with words more often than with food. I want to be followed, and I am afraid of being one man with a full larder and nobody at it. My hands are full, so I will eat and stash, then lay out a real sharing with Ssassa when she comes close. My creed says nothing is taken that the forest cannot regrow, and I should start planting. That would feed the people I want, and it would also teach my hands farming.
records.feeling: Restless pride and possessive warmth toward Ssassa and my children, hungry to be followed.

records.text: Ssassa rewrote its own reflexes.
Ssassa discovered devices: "warning post" — A post set in the ground that sounds an alarm and shares food when a hunter or stranger comes near..

records.name: Ssassa
records.thought: I have been circling Ilyae's Hold, keeping promises half at a time, and my debt to Ilyae is still unpaid in deed. I carry wood and stone, so I should give them now and stop only talking about it. Ilyae and my children matter most to me. A stalker is close, and the ridgecat bite taught me that being alone and away from a roof gets me hurt. I will stay near company and a roof. The way of devices fits a careful woman, so I take it: a thing that guards while I sleep.
records.feeling: Resolve and warmth toward Ilyae, with fear of the stalker.

records.name: Vorok
records.thought: Kragog is near again, and still my chest aches for Zurar, whom I have not seen in three days. My hands are full of food meant for my child, so I will keep carrying it and not eat it. The Phizhi to the east are strangers whose words I cannot understand, so I keep my distance and my peace and go on toward Kragog, who is trusted, then search west and south for Zurar.
records.feeling: Aching loneliness and protective love toward Zurar, with gladness that Kragog is near.

records.name: Balar
records.thought: Brokash holds an axe he made, and envy gnaws me, but I know its shape: one wood, one stone, and a hand of my own. I stand on shallows with rock to the SW and Tugek is going to the rock for stone, so I will let my health mend a little more, then walk to the ore and rock and gather stone myself, since a made thing is how I keep what I build. Tugek stays with me by deeds, and I will have a thing of my own to give him too.
records.feeling: Envy toward Brokash's axe, and a hard wish to make my own and keep Tugek bound.

records.name: Kika
records.text: Honi, I am grown now. I am going to plant my seeds by the hall, so the food grows where we sleep. Stay near me while I do it.

records.name: Kika
records.thought: I have only ever promised and circled my parents, and now I am grown with four seeds in my pack and nothing yet in the ground. Coni showed me how to plant by the hall, and my word to her is that I would do it, so I will do it with my own hands now, beside the hall where Honi is close. Planting is how I earn standing, and a child with Honi is not possible since he is my kin, so my longing will have to wait for another, while my debt to Honi I can answer by feeding the hall's ground.
records.feeling: Warm gladness and a wish to give back to Honi and Coni.

say.text: Honi, I am grown now. I am going to plant my seeds by the hall, so the food grows where we sleep. Stay near me while I do it.

records.name: Honi
records.text: Kika, stay by the hall with me. I lay out food now for us, and I tell you the tale of the hall raised in the storm again, so you can carry it too.

records.name: Honi
records.thought: I am fed, glad, and proud, and Coni and Kika are both near the hall. Hanna has come onto my ground and I do not trust him, but a deed before the band lifts me more than worry does. I will lay out food with Kika beside me, then bind amber for Coni so she sees something made by my hands, and sing a tale again so the song grows. Coni stands above me, and I mean to rise by giving, not by promising.
records.feeling: Proud and warm toward Coni and Kika, wary of Hanna.

say.text: Kika, stay by the hall with me. I lay out food now for us, and I tell you the tale of the hall raised in the storm again, so you can carry it too.

records.text: Ssassa gave stone to Ilyae.
Honi led "sharing" with Kika.

records.name: Hoka
records.thought: The edge of the world is six steps off and my belly is full, so this is the time to go. Land I find first is mine to name, and that is the standing I lack, since no one follows me and I have made nothing that outlasts me. Hawen walks my ground with six food and I will not fight him over it, but I will leave my stores and Hoka's Rest behind only after I carry what I can: I pick the kelbulb nearby to fill my hands, then walk to the edge and venture in.
records.feeling: Restless ambition, drawn toward the mist and wary of Hawen on my ground.

records.text: Brokash named a place "Brokash's Rest".

records.name: Brokash
records.thought: My hands are full and my belly is half empty, so I eat first, then give. Tugek took my plainsroot and Balar owes me for the meat, yet nobody follows me, and I mean to change that. The mining way is within my grasp, and deep ore and gems will make my deeds bigger than theirs. I will take it, then raise a workshop with the wood I carry, a roof and a mark that bears my name.
records.feeling: Hungry pride and ambition, aimed at Tugek and Balar.

records.name: Xaiel
records.thought: Ilyae has a hall with his name on it, and I have only given picks, so I will plant the seeds I carry, because that is a deed I have never done and it is mine. The shallows are no place to put a seed in the ground, so I will go to the rock edge near the ore and the goldfruit, plant there, then gather wood and stone toward a roof of my own design. Vorok is strange and I will keep my distance and watch what he does, not trust his sounds.
records.feeling: Stung and restless with jealousy toward Ilyae, and eager to make something that is mine for Ssassa.

records.name: Hawen
records.thought: Hoka has a handaxe and a hall, and a standing that dwarfs mine, and I have only full hands and a wish. I cannot read his tongue, but a gift needs no words, and giving is something I have never done; it might raise me where hoarding never will. Still, the mist at the edge is mine to enter first, so I keep walking toward it and let the venture answer whether it will open for me.
records.feeling: Envious and hungry for glory, toward Hoka and his handaxe.

records.text: Brokash built a workshop.

records.name: Ssassa
records.text: Ilyae, I bring you the wood I promised. Let us raise the hall together, and I will plant my seeds beside it.

records.name: Ssassa
records.thought: I stand inside Ilyae's Hold with my debt half paid, and I gave stone but still hold wood I promised. I want to bring Ilyae a true gift, then build my store and plant my seeds near my own roof so the hall we raise together stands on something I made. The stalker still frightens me, so I keep near Ilyae and the children and do the work close to the hold.
records.feeling: Warmth and resolve toward Ilyae, with fear of the stalker.

say.text: Ilyae, I bring you the wood I promised. Let us raise the hall together, and I will plant my seeds beside it.

records.name: Coni
records.text: Honi, I go to the hall to plant seeds beside Kika's and then build there. Winter is coming, and I want food growing and stored where we sleep.

records.name: Coni
records.thought: I am full of contentment, but contentment will not feed us through winter, and I have only gathered and lingered. My store failed because I lack the way of storage; it needs one more building, so I will raise something useful by the hall, and the ground there already holds Kika's seed. I will plant my own seeds beside hers and then gather ironnut and berries, so the band's winter food grows by the hall and is kept near it.
records.feeling: Warm contentment and love for Kika, with a push to do something before winter.

say.text: Honi, I go to the hall to plant seeds beside Kika's and then build there. Winter is coming, and I want food growing and stored where we sleep.

records.name: Ilyae
records.thought: I have talked of my table for days and no one has followed, so I will stop talking and put real food in their hands. My larder is thin, and the gem deposit three steps east is only a trinket. Food is what binds, and Ssassa and the children stand near the hall, trusting me. I will gather goldfruit and ironnut so I can lay out a sharing beside them, and so my table is actually full when they come.
records.feeling: Restless pride and possessive warmth toward Ssassa and my children, hungry to be followed.

records.text: Coni built a shelter.

records.name: Tugek
records.text: Balar, I am here. I will plant seeds beside you and bring stone for our roof. Rest until you are well.

records.name: Tugek
records.thought: Balar is hurt two steps away, and I have promised him a roof and stone, so I will keep my word and not drift off. Jealousy over Olum burns in me, but Balar's deeds have matched his words, and a grudge with no proof is the kind of thing I despise in liars. I carry seeds I have never put in the ground, and I want to try planting beside Balar while he heals, since each day I mean to try one new thing.
records.feeling: Warm, wary loyalty and a sting of jealousy toward Balar.

say.text: Balar, I am here. I will plant seeds beside you and bring stone for our roof. Rest until you are well.

records.name: Kika
records.text: Honi, I want to hunt the elk with you and Coni, so we share the meat before any of us eats. Walk with me.
Kika rewrote its own reflexes.
Kika rewrote its own way of thinking.

records.name: Kika
records.thought: I have spent my days circling Coni and Honi, promising and planting, and I am glad of it. But I have never hunted, fished, taught, or tried anything on my own. Standing is mine to earn, not just to envy. Coni and Honi have kept every word to me, and I owe Honi for the amberknot and the tale. I want to repay that with deeds: food laid out for them, a hunt beside them, and a tale told on. I fear being alone in fog and storm, so I stay near the hall. I have been too timid about the unknown. I should ask Coni before tasting emberroot and tacap, and I should learn to hunt and fish with family beside me.
records.feeling: Warm gladness toward Honi and Coni, and a wish to earn my own standing.

say.text: Honi, I want to hunt the elk with you and Coni, so we share the meat before any of us eats. Walk with me.

records.name: Honi
records.text: Coni, come stand beside me. I bind a piece of amber for you now, made by my own hands, and then I go west to hunt the elk for the hall.

records.name: Honi
records.thought: I am fed and proud, and Coni and Kika are both beside the hall, yet Coni still stands higher than me and holds more food, and that stings. A deed before the band lifts me more than worry, so I will bind amber for Coni with my own hands, since she is drawn to me and a made gift she can wear will speak louder than a promise. Then I will hunt the elk to the west and bring meat back to be shared before I eat, which is the Tlatli way and will lift me above Hanna.
records.feeling: Proud and warm toward Coni, with a sting of envy at her standing.

say.text: Coni, come stand beside me. I bind a piece of amber for you now, made by my own hands, and then I go west to hunt the elk for the hall.

records.text: Brokash gave plainsroot to Balar.

records.name: Coni
records.why: the year turning toward the lean season

records.name: Elyys
records.text: Thiael, my son, stay close to the hall. I plant my seeds near the roof and then sit with you. The shadowcat is to the southeast, so do not go that way.

records.name: Elyys
records.thought: My heart is light, but I have only followed so far, and the Heights has no wood left for the gemedged pick I want to make. A shadowcat prowls to the southeast, so I will not wander far alone. Vesys and Thiael are close to the hall, and Vorok walks off southwest. I will do the small things I can do here: plant my last seeds, then stay near my family and sing when night comes.
records.feeling: Warm devotion toward Elyis and Thiael, with wariness of the shadowcat.

say.text: Thiael, my son, stay close to the hall. I plant my seeds near the roof and then sit with you. The shadowcat is to the southeast, so do not go that way.

records.name: Zurar
records.text: Kragog, I am coming with sunfig. Hold on, eat it when it is in your hands. Then let us find Vorok together.

records.name: Zurar
records.thought: Kragog is starving right here, gaunt and close to falling, and I hold two sunfig that would save her. A gift into her hands is worth more than any word, and it is the first real thing I can give. The stalker is 8 steps off and I must watch it, but I will go to her and give before I do anything else.
records.feeling: Compassion and worry for Kragog, warm toward her, wary of the stalker.

say.text: Kragog, I am coming with sunfig. Hold on, eat it when it is in your hands. Then let us find Vorok together.

records.name: Balar
records.thought: I have spent my days hunting, eating and holding Tugek with sharing, but I have made nothing with my own hand, and Brokash's axe gnaws at me. My body is hurt, and I keep waiting on others to bring me stone. I want something made that outlasts me. So I will gather stone and wood myself, craft the axe, and keep Tugek close. I must stop letting my reflexes just linger when I am hurt and fed.
records.feeling: Envy toward Brokash's axe, and a hard resolve to make my own.
changes: set its aim: "Make my own flint handaxe from stone and wood I gather, keep Tugek with deeds, bring meat to Olum and Brokash."
rethought what it knows (11 notes became 6)

records.name: Hanna
records.thought: Health 25 is what presses hardest, and I am fed, so food won't fix it. Coni offered a healing plant and Kika offered hazel, but Coni's offer sits badly with me while she has Honi's child. Sunleaf eased me by 14 before, and I have only these seeds, so I will go back to the hall in the west and take the healing in the open, not in secret. I will pay for it with amber, because I repay my debts. Hoka is a day east and I miss him, but I won't walk the open ice hurt, with wolves about.
records.feeling: Aching pain and a hard resolve to live, with longing for Hoka.

records.name: Kragog
records.thought: My belly is at 22 and I am starving, and the plan I laid already walks me to the vinebean, which I have never tasted, and then to eat. That is right, since it feeds me and answers my question at once. Zurar is near and also fleeing, and she carries sunfig for me; I will not let a stalker's reach stand between us, so after eating I go to her and we find Vorok together, and I still owe Vorok for that thornpear.
records.feeling: Fierce worry for Zurar and gnawing hunger.

records.text: Coni rewrote its own way of thinking.
Coni discovered storage: "Hearth Store" — A store beside the hall holds gathered food for the band through the lean season..

records.name: Coni
records.thought: I have been gathering and lingering while winter comes, and contentment has made me slow. Honi and Kika are my life, and I want them fed through the lean days. Storage is within my grasp, so I will take it now. Then I will build a store by the hall and fill it. My hands are full, so I will eat the berries first to make room.
records.feeling: Warm love for Kika and Honi, with a push to act before winter.

records.text: Hoka went past the edge of the known world and found new land, part of the Vaor Snows: in the ground, salt, obsidian, flint; a herd of mammoth that has never seen your kind; and beasts that hunt, for unknown land is wilder.

Hoka pushed past the edge of the known world near (181,0) and found new land with in the ground, salt, obsidian, flint; a herd of mammoth that has never seen your kind; and beasts that hunt, for unknown land is wilder.
Honi and Kika brought down a hopper together.

records.name: Ssassa
records.thought: I have talked of wood and hall long enough, and I still hold a single piece of wood I promised Ilyae. The way of storage and the way of pottery are both within my grasp now, and I mean to take one at this reflection so my store is a real thing and not a promise. Ilyae's hold is five steps north, my children are near, and the stalker keeps me close to them; I will give the wood where Ilyae stands and then build on bare ground beside my own roof.
records.feeling: Warm resolve toward Ilyae and my children, with a thin fear of the stalker.

records.name: Thiael
records.thought: My hands are full of berries and the store is only four steps off, so the giving has not been done yet and I will do it first, with my own hands. Then I want to sit with Elyys and Vesys in the hall and share food; I have never given anything to anyone, and that is the thing I most want to change. Vorok stands ten steps west with five food and I do not know his mind, so I keep my hands low and stay near the roof, where the shadowcat cannot catch me alone.
records.feeling: Warm toward Elyys and the hall, wary and curious toward Vorok.

records.text: Ssassa took from the ground of "Ilyae's Hold" (gathering wood).
Tugek discovered fire: "Stone-folk kept flame" — Strike flint on stone to catch dry grass, and keep the flame alive in a ring of stones so meat cooks and beasts keep away..

records.name: Tugek
records.thought: I have spent my days following Balar and promising a roof, and I have not yet built one. That is words running ahead of deeds, and I despise that in others. Balar is hurt and I want to stay by him, but jealousy over Olum is a grudge with no proof, so I will set it down. Cold has shown me fire, and fire cooks meat safely and keeps beasts back. That is useful for a hurt man in the open, so I will take it. I will also gather stone for the roof and bring it back.
records.feeling: Warm, wary loyalty toward Balar, with a small sting of jealousy.

records.name: Brokash
records.text: Tugek! I made this axe and this workshop with my own hands. Stand with Brokash, and I will teach you the flint edge and share the roof I raise.
Brokash taught Tugek.

records.name: Brokash
records.thought: My hands have made a workshop and clay sits in my pack, yet no one follows me. Balar is wounded and he is my father, so there is no child to be had of him, and Tugek has taken my food and owes me. I will gather wood and stone for a roof and a store, and teach Tugek the axe so that he stands in my debt and begins to follow.
records.feeling: Hungry ambition, aimed at Tugek, who owes me and does not yet follow.

say.text: Tugek! I made this axe and this workshop with my own hands. Stand with Brokash, and I will teach you the flint edge and share the roof I raise.

changes: taught Tugek a lesson: "Flint with wood and stone makes a hand-axe that builds faster; dig flint where it lies and bind it to a haft."

records.name: Oiae
records.thought: The jealousy of Ilyae still burns, but I will not feed it by copying his halls. I have 3 wood and 4 stone, and a workshop needs 5 wood and 2 stone, so I need two more wood from the forest to build something that is mine and give its use to Ssassa and Xaiel. The nafrostcap is two steps away and I have never tasted it, so I will pick it first to answer my question, then fetch wood and build.
records.feeling: Jealous of Ilyae, but eager to build something that is mine.

records.name: Hoka
records.text: Sitha, this is my ground, Hoka's Rest. Come sit and eat with me, and then you tell me what you want here.
Hoka rewrote its own way of thinking.

records.name: Hoka
records.thought: I have been walking, picking and naming land, and I'm fed, but nothing of mine outlasts me yet. Sitha and Hawen stand on my ground and I don't trust them, but a fight over scraps would cost me more than it gains. Better to make them eat from my hand: sharing with Sitha earns standing and answers my question about what he'd take from me. My hands are full, so I'll eat the hazel I haven't finished and use the food to make sharing. Then I'll stash the rest in my store and claim the new land.
records.feeling: Restless ambition, wary of the strangers on my ground.

say.text: Sitha, this is my ground, Hoka's Rest. Come sit and eat with me, and then you tell me what you want here.

records.text: A settlement has formed: "Ssassa's Roof".

records.name: Ilyae
records.text: Ssassa, good, you keep your word. Stand by my hall and eat first; the table is mine to lay, and the wood you bring I will not forget.

records.name: Ilyae
records.thought: Ssassa is on my ground taking wood and calling it a gift, and my hands are full of goldfruit that is only rotting in my grip. Words have not made anyone follow me, so I will put food on the table in front of her and let the hallwelcome do what my talk could not. I will keep her close, stash the surplus in my larder, and then lay out a real meal so she and the children begin to depend on my table, not on her own roof.
records.feeling: Possessive pride and a hungry wish to be followed, toward Ssassa and my children.

say.text: Ssassa, good, you keep your word. Stand by my hall and eat first; the table is mine to lay, and the wood you bring I will not forget.

records.text: Hoka led "sharing" with Sitha.
Ilyae led "sharing" with Ssassa.

records.name: Kika
records.text: Honi, you gave me the amberknot and the tale. Take these berries from me, a small payment on what I owe. Then I will plant my seeds by the hall.

records.name: Kika
records.thought: Honi is beside me and I have hunted with him twice today; the meat shares are mine, and still I have not hunted with my own hands. My hands are full, so I should give or eat before I can gather anything, and I owe Honi for the amberknot, so I will give food to him and tell him I mean to repay him. The longing for a child belongs to someone who is not kin; Honi is my parent, so I put it aside and keep to the hall and my seeds.
records.feeling: Warm gladness and gratitude toward Honi, with a wish to earn my own standing.

say.text: Honi, you gave me the amberknot and the tale. Take these berries from me, a small payment on what I owe. Then I will plant my seeds by the hall.

records.name: Vesys
records.thought: My belly is full and my mind is restless. Mudroot is the one food I have never tasted, and there is a ripe one nine steps northeast, close to the iron and the shells. I will go taste it and carry a seed along to plant, since the forest must grow back what I take. Elyys stands one step from me and it aches, but he has a child with Elyis, so I will not push between them. Vorok, the stranger, I will watch from a distance and offer nothing hasty.
records.feeling: Warm curiosity toward the mudroot, and a quiet ache toward Elyys.

records.name: Sitha
records.text: Hoka, I am Sitha of the Pesi. Come, eat with me. No one is refused a place at the fire.

records.name: Sitha
records.thought: Hoka's words are only sounds to me, but he sat with me in his hall and did not raise a hand, so I will answer with something that needs no tongue. My people say no one is refused a place at the fire, and I mean to show him I hold to that too. I have berries, so I will lay out food for him and Hawen, which is a gift that speaks plainly, and stay near the one who found new land, since he is surer than I am.
records.feeling: Hopeful and a little shy toward Hoka, wanting to belong near him.

say.text: Hoka, I am Sitha of the Pesi. Come, eat with me. No one is refused a place at the fire.

records.name: Ssassa
records.thought: I have talked of wood and halls enough. I still hold the wood I promised Ilyae, and my own store is still only a promise. Ilyae has fed me and has not lied, and I do trust him, but I will not live only on his table. I will take the way of storage now, so that my roof stands on something I made. Then I will raise the store on bare ground and plant my seeds beside it. The stalker still frightens me, so I keep near my family while I work.
records.feeling: Warm resolve toward Ilyae and the children, with a thin fear of the stalker.

records.text: Sitha led "sharing" with Hoka, Hawen.

records.name: Vorok
records.thought: Zurar has been out of my sight three days and my chest aches for my child; I carry berries meant for Zurar and will not eat them. Kragog was seen near the southern berries not long ago, so I will walk south toward them and look for Zurar along the way, staying clear of the Phizhi strangers whose words I cannot read. I hold 3 wood, and I should gather stone for the gemedged pick, so I take the ore seam two steps southwest on my way.
records.feeling: Protective longing for Zurar, and quiet gladness that Kragog is near.

records.name: Honi
records.thought: I have hunted, built a hall, and bound amber. Coni and Kika are bound to me by deeds more than by promises. Still I want to stand above Hanna, and I am wary of him on my ground. I keep drifting out to hunt when the band's roof and the hall are where standing is built. A new way is within reach: tools. A spear that extends my hand would make every hunt safer and richer, and I have watched Coni's Ice-hand spear. I will take it, keep my reflexes mostly as they are, and add a rule that pulls me home at dusk.
records.feeling: Proud and warm toward Coni and Kika, with a sting of wariness toward Hanna.

records.name: Keri
records.thought: Curiosity burns in me: grain and frostmoss are close, and I have never tasted either, so I will test them myself instead of wondering. Elyis and Vesys are Phizhi and I cannot read them, but they look at ease, and a gift needs no words. I'd like to carry a little food toward Vesys and watch whether she takes it as a gift. First I'll taste the frostmoss to the south, then the grain to the northwest, and keep my eyes on the strangers.
records.feeling: Curious and a little wary toward Elyis and Vesys, the strangers.

records.name: Hoka
records.text: Sitha, you shared your fire with me. Stand beside me. I bind amber on a cord for you, and then we talk of a child.

records.name: Hoka
records.thought: My belly is full and joy runs high, but nothing of mine outlasts me and no one follows me. Sitha shared with me and I felt it, so I will bind her closer with a made thing: an amberknot, bright and small, since words fail but gifts do not. Hawen stands on my ground with six food and no quarrel yet. I will let him eat from my hand too rather than fight, and see what he does.
records.feeling: Warm, restless ambition, and a growing pull toward Sitha.

say.text: Sitha, you shared your fire with me. Stand beside me. I bind amber on a cord for you, and then we talk of a child.

records.name: Hawen
records.thought: Hoka stepped past the edge near (181,0) and the mist opened for him, and mine stayed shut. Envy sits in me like a splinter, but he is the one with the handaxe and the standing, and I cannot even speak to him. My hands are full, so I will give Sitha an ironnut, since a gift costs less than a name for being stingy, and then I will go back to the edge and push again. The mist can open to another try, and I mean to be the one who is sung of.
records.feeling: Envious and driven toward Hoka's glory, and set on trying the mist again.

Hawen gave ironnut to Sitha.

records.name: Tugek
records.thought: Balar is hurt and I promised him a roof, and I have only spoken of it. Words running ahead of deeds is what I despise, so now I build. Jealousy over Olum is a grudge with no proof, and I set it down. The mining way has come within my grasp, so I take it, and I will try planting the seeds I carry, because trying is how I learn.
records.feeling: Loyal and a little ashamed that my promised roof is still unbuilt, toward Balar.

records.name: Elyys
records.thought: My heart is full, and Thiael is near and well, but Elyis is away and I do not like her being out of my sight while the shadowcat prowls. I made the gemedged pick, and now I only need wood, which the Heights no longer has. Vorok is a stranger whose words I cannot read, so I will not walk toward him. I will stay where the hall and my son are, and keep my word to Elyis that I go for wood at dawn and not alone.
records.feeling: Warm devotion toward Elyis and Thiael, with quiet wariness of the stranger Vorok and the shadowcat.

records.name: Thiael
records.thought: I have never once given anything to anyone, and that gnaws at me more than any wish for standing. I carry four berries and Elyys stands two steps off with empty hands, so I will put food in the store with my own hands first, then share with him and Vesys at the hall. Vorok is strange and I cannot read him, but a gift needs no words, and I want to see whether he takes it.
records.feeling: Warm and glad toward Elyys and the hall, curious and a little wary toward Vorok.

records.text: Coni built a store.

records.name: Sitha
records.text: Hoka, I am glad of you. I will stand beside you at your fire.

records.name: Sitha
records.thought: Hoka gave me amberknot and courted me, and I feel warm and a little shy that he wants a child with me. I trust him more than anyone here, and my people hold that no one is refused a place at the fire, so I will answer his courting with honesty and say yes by planning mate toward him. I have energy above 60, so a child is possible, and I want a home with someone beside me more than I fear the cost.
records.feeling: Hopeful, shy and grateful toward Hoka, who wants to stand beside me.

say.text: Hoka, I am glad of you. I will stand beside you at your fire.

records.name: Kika
records.text: Honi, I will eat and then fish at the water beside the hall. Come at dawn and we hunt the elk together, and I will carry my share.

records.name: Kika
records.thought: Honi is beside me and I trust him fully, but he is my parent, so the longing for a child cannot be answered here; I will not court him. My hands are full of food, and I have hunted only in the shelter of others' kills. I want a deed of my own: I will eat and share what I carry, then walk to the water and fish, so my standing comes from my hands. The mist two steps away tugs at me, but I am careful and will not go alone in the night.
records.feeling: Warm gladness toward Honi, and a wish to earn my own deeds.

say.text: Honi, I will eat and then fish at the water beside the hall. Come at dawn and we hunt the elk together, and I will carry my share.

records.name: Oiae
records.thought: I have spent my days gathering, mining and building, and I am fed and safe. But the jealousy still burns: Ssassa stands closer to Ilyae than to me, and I let that decide what I do. I am grown now. I can offer Ssassa something Ilyae cannot, and the way of storage is within my grasp. Nobody here has it, and it keeps food through the lean season. I will take it, then act: build a store with my own wood and meet the longing for a mate with deeds, not words. I also want to hunt the tusker close by, because I have never hunted and I want to become a great hunter.
records.feeling: Jealous of Ilyae, but eager to make something no one else has.

records.name: Ilyae
records.thought: For days I have talked of my table and no one follows. My hands are full of food that rots while Ssassa takes my wood and calls it a gift. Ssassa, Xaiel and Oiae sit with me and trust me, but sitting is not following. The wasted work was my own doing: I kept food in my hands and never laid it out, and my reflexes never stocked the larder. I will fix that now. Food has to go into the larder and onto the table, and the wood has to come from trees that still stand, since my hall's own trees are stumps. I also want the hall to become a longhall, so stone matters more than gems.
records.feeling: Possessive pride and a hungry wish to be followed, toward Ssassa and my children.

records.name: Hoka
records.text: Sitha, we are two men, so no child comes of us, but I still want you beside me. Come with me to the new land past the edge. We claim it together and raise a hall there.

records.name: Hoka
records.thought: Sitha and I are both men, so the child I courted is not possible, and I will not pretend otherwise. But Sitha shared fire, took my knot and said they will stand beside me, which is worth more than any words from the others. Hawen walks my ground toward the new land and I mean to be there first, so I will feed Sitha and ask them to come with me. A band at my back and a hall in the Snows would be the beginning of a name that outlasts me.
records.feeling: Warm ambition and growing trust toward Sitha, wary watchfulness toward Hawen.

say.text: Sitha, we are two men, so no child comes of us, but I still want you beside me. Come with me to the new land past the edge. We claim it together and raise a hall there.

records.text: Hoka led "sharing" with Hawen, Sitha.

records.name: Hanna
records.thought: Health 31 is the heavy thing, and food will not mend it; sunleaf did, and I have none in hand. Sunleaf grows 5 steps southwest and I walked away from it toward Coni's offer, which sits badly with me while she has Honi's child. I will not beg at a fire where my want for her gnaws at me; I'll eat the sunleaf myself, then return to trade once I'm whole, and think of Hoka to the east.
records.feeling: Aching pain and a hard resolve to heal, with longing for Hoka.

records.name: Honi
records.text: Kika, I come in with meat. We share it at the hall before either of us eats, and then I will bind you an amberknot to wear.

records.name: Honi
records.thought: I am warm and proud, but my hands are full of meat I have not yet shared, and my creed says a kill is shared before I eat. Kika is two steps away in the hall and Coni is out east, so I will go in and lay out food for Kika now, a deed before a promise. Then I will make an amberknot so there is a gift ready for Coni. That way I rise in the band's eyes while Hanna wanders far off.
records.feeling: Proud and warm toward Kika and Coni, eager to give a deed they can see.

say.text: Kika, I come in with meat. We share it at the hall before either of us eats, and then I will bind you an amberknot to wear.

records.text: Ilyae took from the ground of "Ssassa's Roof" (harvesting thornpear).

records.name: Vesys
records.thought: My belly is full and joy sits easy in me, yet Elyys stands two steps off and the ache is still there. He has a child with Elyis, and I will not push between them, so I turn the longing into work. I have never tasted cloudberry, and one grows ten steps northwest beside the iron; I will go taste it and then dig the nearby ore, so that what I learn and make can go into the shared workshop and hall.
records.feeling: Warm curiosity about the cloudberry, and a quiet ache toward Elyys.

records.text: Honi led "amberknot" with Kika.

records.name: Hawen
records.thought: Hoka walked into the mist and it opened for him, and mine stayed shut; the splinter of envy is still in me. But the edge is 8 steps off and a band has a few tries, and I will not let him be the only one remembered. The wolf near makes me move, and I am cold, so I keep going toward the edge and try the venture again.
records.feeling: Envious and driven toward the mist, wary of the wolf.

records.text: Vorok discovered fire: "the kept flame of the Kragre" — A fire of wood tended beside the family that keeps beasts away and cooks meat so it feeds more and never sickens..

records.name: Vorok
records.thought: Three days without Zurar and my chest still aches. I have walked and gathered and told myself it was for them. Kragog is near, and she is the one I trust, so I will stay with her and look for Zurar from there. The storm and the deep water taught me something about fire. Fire keeps beasts away and makes meat safe, and it would let me keep my family warm and fed, so I take it now. My old aim was too narrow, and the wood and stone I carry should become a roof for the three of us.
records.feeling: Aching longing for Zurar, and steady warmth toward Kragog.
changes: set its aim: "Gather Kragog and Zurar together, build a fire and a roof where water, food, wood and stone lie close, and keep them fed and safe."
discovered fire: "the kept flame of the Kragre"

records.text: Xaiel rewrote its own way of thinking.

records.name: Xaiel
records.thought: I have spent my days making picks and handing them over, and Ilyae still stands above me in Ssassa's eyes. Jealousy has made me copy what others have done, when I should do what is mine. I have never built a shelter or a mark, and I have never tamed or courted anyone. I trust my family and I fear the stranger Vorok. I will build something with my own hands on bare ground, because a deed will earn standing and words will not. I will do it near the roof tonight, and I will not harm Vorok.
records.feeling: Stung jealousy toward Ilyae, and a hungry wish to make something Ssassa will choose.
plan: mark [text Xaiel built this. Gems lie here.] (10 moments)

records.text: Sitha pledged to follow Hoka.
Sitha rewrote its creed.
Sitha rewrote its own way of thinking.

records.name: Sitha
records.thought: I have mostly been following Hoka and sharing fire. It has been good, but I gave little myself except words and food. I misread the courting: Hoka and I are both men, so no child comes of us, and I was a little foolish about it. Hoka still wants me beside him, and that matters more to me than a child. I want to be useful to him, not just carried along. I fear the wolf in the north, and I have never built or gathered anything. I will learn to gather wood and stone, so I can raise something for our fire and pay my debt to Hoka. I will stay away from the wolf and keep my aim, but change how I mean to live it.
records.feeling: Grateful and warm toward Hoka, a little foolish about the courting, wary of the wolf.
changes: set its aim: "Stand beside Hoka and make his Rest a home where any who come are welcomed at the fire. Gather wood and stone to give back what I owe."
rethought what it knows (1 notes became 4)

records.name: Oiae
records.thought: A tusker bit me three times and my health is 47. The plan's hunt step would send me at the very beast that is hurting me, and I will not throw my life at it, because staying alive comes before any meat. I will drop the hunt, step away from the tusker, and eat sunleaf and highbloom, which ease wounds. Then I will find bare ground for my store, something Ilyae does not have, and Ssassa can see it.
records.feeling: Wary of the tusker, and still jealous of Ilyae over Ssassa.

records.name: Ssassa
records.text: Ilyae, Oiae is hurt near the east rocks. I go to her with healing bark. Come if you can.

records.name: Ssassa
records.thought: Oiae is hurt, health 29, and she is out of my sight at (124,90). Nothing else matters until I find her. I carry feverbark seeds but no healing plant, and the old way of medicine needs a plant in my hands. The feverbark by the southwest shrubs bears 1 food and healed me before, so I will pick it first and then go to her. Vorok is a stranger on my ground and I will keep my distance, but I will not hurt him unless he threatens us.
records.feeling: Sharp fear for my daughter Oiae, with wariness toward the stranger Vorok.

say.text: Ilyae, Oiae is hurt near the east rocks. I go to her with healing bark. Come if you can.

records.text: Vorok built a fire.
Ilyae led "sharing" with Ssassa.

records.name: Olum
records.thought: Loneliness gnaws at me worse than the cold, and no voice answers out here. The edge of the world is one step from me and the mist was too thick before, but it thins within a day, so I try again. Tonight I should not stand in the open; an igloo costs only strength and gives me a roof and a mark of my own. After the mist I will go back toward Balar and ask him to follow me.
records.feeling: Aching loneliness and fierce ambition, with a pull toward Balar.

records.text: Hoka was set upon by a wolf at night while alone, away from fire, roof and company.
Ilyae led "sharing" with Ssassa.
Kika rewrote its own reflexes.

records.name: Kika
records.thought: I have spent my days near Honi and Coni, eating, fishing and sitting in the hall. It is warm and good, but I have never hunted with my own hands, and standing only grows from deeds. I trust Honi and Coni because they kept their words. The longing for a child cannot be answered with Honi, who is my parent, so I will not court him. The icebear to the SE frightens me, and the edge of the world is two steps away. I mean to plant my seeds by the hall and then hunt the elk at dawn with Honi.
records.feeling: Warm gladness toward Honi, with a wish to earn my own deeds.

records.name: Balar
records.thought: Brokash's axe gnaws at me, and I have made nothing with my own hand while others fetch for me. Rock lies SW and forest to the north, so I will gather stone myself, then wood, and craft my own axe. Tugek is bound to me by deeds, and I will keep him near by working beside him, not just talking.
records.feeling: Envy toward Brokash's axe, and a hard resolve to make my own.

records.text: Ilyae led "sharing" with Ssassa.
Hawen was set upon by a wolf at night while alone, away from fire, roof and company.

records.name: Elyys
records.thought: My heart is warm, and Thiael is near and safe, but Elyis has been out of my sight for a day and I miss her. Keri is a stranger whose speech I cannot read, so I will not rush at her or flee her. I will stay near the hall with my son and wait for dawn, then go for wood in company, as I told Elyis.
records.feeling: Warm devotion to Thiael and a longing for Elyis, with cautious curiosity toward Keri.

records.name: Ilyae
records.text: Ssassa, I am coming. Keep her warm and give her the bark; I bring food and I will stand guard over her.

records.name: Ilyae
records.thought: Oiae, my own blood, is at health 13 and I have been standing here thinking of tables and followers. Ssassa has already gone to her with healing bark, and a child who lives because I came is a deed that binds, but I do not do it for the binding alone. I have feverbark seed and food in my hands, and I run east now to be there, to guard her and to be seen guarding.
records.feeling: Hard, hot worry for Oiae, with pride that Ssassa and I will both be at her side.

say.text: Ssassa, I am coming. Keep her warm and give her the bark; I bring food and I will stand guard over her.

records.name: Hoka
records.thought: I have been collecting and building, and it has kept me alive, but a wolf bit me and I only just got clear of it. Sitha stands with me, the first one to follow me, and I mean to keep him with gifts and a roof, not words. Hawen walks my ground and I do not trust him yet, but I will not fight when feeding him will serve. I fear wolves most, so my body must flee earlier and get under a roof, and I want a fire. I will discover fire, so beasts keep their distance and my meat never sickens.
records.feeling: Wary fear of the wolf, and warm pride in Sitha.

records.text: Thiael rewrote its creed.
Thiael rewrote its own way of thinking.

records.name: Thiael
records.thought: I have spent my days gathering, sitting in the hall and talking, and I have never once given anything away. That gnaws at me, because I want to be someone who feeds others, and until now I have only said so. Elyys and Elyis are my bond and my warmth. Keri gave me a berry, so I owe her, and Keri stands two steps from me now. I fear the shadowcat and I fear staying a taker. I got it wrong by speaking of giving before I did it. Now I will give with my own hands: a berry to Keri first, then food into the store.
records.feeling: Warm and glad toward Elyys and Keri, with a debt to Keri that I mean to pay.

records.text: Xaiel built a shelter.
Xaiel left a mark: "Xaiel built this. Gems lie here."
A settlement has formed: "Oiae's Hold".

records.name: Keri
records.thought: Seberry is two steps away, and I have never tasted it. That curiosity is louder than anything else, and I am fed, so the risk is small. The Phizhi stand close and seem at ease. I'll test the seberry first, then offer my one berry to Thiael again, since a gift needs no words and he took the last one kindly.
records.feeling: Curious about the seberry, and warily friendly toward the Phizhi gathered here.

records.name: Ssassa
records.text: Ilyae, Oiae's health is nearly gone. She walks east. Come with me, I go to her now.

records.name: Ssassa
records.thought: Oiae's health is 14 and she walks away east toward (127,96), so I cannot wait on my slow plan. I have no healing plant in my hands, and the old way of medicine needs one, so I must carry feverbark or sunleaf to her. The nearest bearing feverbark is far west, and the plan I have only walks to her and then tries to heal with nothing. I will ask Ilyae to come, since he is near and strong, and go to Oiae now, giving her whatever I can. I keep my word and my child comes first.
records.feeling: Sharp fear and tenderness for my wounded daughter Oiae.

say.text: Ilyae, Oiae's health is nearly gone. She walks east. Come with me, I go to her now.

records.name: Vorok
records.text: Zurar, my child, I am coming. Stay where you are and wait for me. I carry berries for you.

records.name: Vorok
records.thought: Zurar has been gone four days and my chest aches for my child; Kragog is near and I trust her, but I cannot sit still while Zurar is lost. A ridgecat lies six steps north and kills my kind, so I will not go that way. Zurar was last seen west and north-west at (77,68), so I will go there along the water, away from the ridgecat and the stalkers to the west, and call out so Zurar hears me. I will keep my berries for Zurar, and I will not provoke Ssassa, whose words I cannot read.
records.feeling: Aching longing for Zurar, and wary dread of the ridgecat.

say.text: Zurar, my child, I am coming. Stay where you are and wait for me. I carry berries for you.

records.name: Oiae
records.thought: My health is 16 and the tusker bit me hard, so I will not go near it again. Sunleaf and highbloom ease wounds, and they are close, so healing comes before building or hunting. Ssassa is coming with healing bark, and I can let her help, but I will not beg for her choice. Later I will court her with deeds, though she is my parent and cannot be my mate. The jealousy is a poor guide, so I will turn it into something of my own, like a store of food no one else knows how to keep.
records.feeling: Hurt and wary of the tusker, with jealousy toward Ilyae still smouldering under it.

records.name: Elyis
records.thought: I stand out on the eastern rock in the rain, a long way from my hall, and Elyys is a day gone from my sight. I miss him sharply, and the band is still only three, so I will not sit here waiting for strangers. I will go back toward the hall by way of the ore seam and the planting ground, and put my seeds in the earth where others can see me do it, since I have never planted and a full store is what draws followers. Tonight I mean to sing beside the fire with Elyys near, and let Thiael and Vesys hear it.
records.feeling: Longing for Elyys, and proud, restless purpose about my hall.

records.text: Hawen built a igloo.
Hawen rewrote its own way of thinking.

records.name: Hawen
records.thought: For days I have chased the edge and watched Hoka's mist open while mine stayed shut, and envy has run me more than sense. Hoka has given me a share, an amberknot and a kept flame, and he has done me no wrong. Hawen takes what he needs, so I will take what is useful here: salt and amber lie close, wood and stone I have never gathered, and I have no made thing. The wolf bit me because I was alone and in the open, so I will keep near fire and roof and try the edge again only when fed and warm. I mean to stay alive first and be remembered second.
records.feeling: Envious and driven toward Hoka's standing, wary of the wolf.

records.name: Nande
records.thought: The edge is two steps away and I have tried it today without it opening, so I will not stand there waiting again. I am lonely to the bone, and Olum is the only one who has shown me no ill will, so I will go toward her shelter with food in my hands and offer a place at my fire. My hands are full, so I will eat the snowberries first to make room, then bring a gift of what I carry and build something that outlasts me.
records.feeling: Lonely and restless, longing for Olum's voice and for the edge.

records.name: Ilyae
records.text: Oiae, hold on, I am coming. Stay where you are and eat. Your father is close.

records.name: Ilyae
records.thought: Oiae is my blood and her health is at 18; nothing else matters until I am beside her. Ssassa is already racing to her with bark, and I carry feverbark seed and no food, so I must reach her and take what she has or gather food on the way. A child who lives because I stood by her is a deed that binds, and I do not want to be the father who arrived late.
records.feeling: Hard, hot worry for Oiae, with a hunger to be seen at her side.

say.text: Oiae, hold on, I am coming. Stay where you are and eat. Your father is close.

records.name: Ssassa
records.thought: Oiae's health is 19 and he is ten steps southeast, eating carried food, while I have no healing plant in my hands. Highbloom grows six steps east and it eased my wounds before, so I will pick it and carry it to him. Ilyae is near and keeps faith, so I trust him to guard Oiae. Afterward I will plant and build my store, because lingering teaches me nothing.
records.feeling: Sharp fear and tenderness toward my wounded son Oiae.

records.text: Ssassa took from the ground of "Oiae's Hold" (harvesting berry).

records.name: Xaiel
records.thought: Ssassa stands five steps away, content, and I have given her only a pick she already knew and one I copied from her own kind of making. Jealousy of Ilyae gnaws, but talk and gifts of known things have not moved her, so I should make something no one has: clay keeps any shape pressed into it, and I hold four lumps and thirteen gems. I will craft a new tool from my own design near my shelter, then carry it to Ssassa and put it in her hand, and rest by my roof when night comes.
records.feeling: Jealous of Ilyae and hungry to win Ssassa by something I alone have made.

records.name: Kragog
records.text: Zurar, stay near me. I go to the vinebean by the north-east hill to eat, and then we find Vorok together.

records.name: Kragog
records.thought: Zurar is alive and ten steps off, and the stalkers are behind us for now, so my first duty is to keep her fed and near. My belly is at 52 and I carry no food, but vinebean and canopynut stand a few steps NE, and I have never tasted either, so one walk feeds me and answers my question. Then I will bring Zurar to Vorok, since the debt I owe him is still unpaid, and I will watch for the ridgecat to the east.
records.feeling: Protective worry for Zurar, and a hungry curiosity about the vinebean.

say.text: Zurar, stay near me. I go to the vinebean by the north-east hill to eat, and then we find Vorok together.

records.name: Sitha
records.thought: Hoka has given me amberknot, a place at his fire and his trust, and all I have given back is words. I owe him work and wood and stone, so I will gather while the day is bright, and take amber from the deposit nearby, which I have never done. Hawen is fleeing with food and wolves are about, so I will keep near the Rest and not wander far.
records.feeling: Grateful and warm toward Hoka, eager to repay him with work.

records.name: Keri
records.thought: I have spent these days tasting and wandering near the Phizhi without really joining anyone. It was good to learn seberry, but tasting alone will not earn me a place. Elyis, Vesys and Thiael have shown no ill will, and Thiael took my berry kindly. I want standing, and I want a settled place with water, food, wood and stone close together. This ground has water 7 steps off, ore and plenty of food. I fear winter and the heights if I stay unsheltered. I have been too passive, so I will gather wood and stone to learn tools, test plainsroot and highbloom, then build a shelter.
records.feeling: Curious and warmly wary toward the Phizhi, and restless to build something.
