records.text: Sitha won amber from the ground.

records.name: Oiae
records.thought: I was bitten near death by a tusker and I'm alive because Ssassa and Ilyae came. I've spent my days copying and brooding on jealousy, and I haven't hunted or courted. I can't court Ssassa, since she is my kin, so that longing needs another woman, and none is near. What I can make that nobody else has is a store with food in it, and a hunt done with someone beside me. Until my health mends I'll rest and eat the healing plants, and I'll stay near my parents.
records.feeling: Wary and hurt, with jealousy toward Ilyae still smouldering and gratitude toward Ssassa.
changes: set its aim: "Heal, then hunt a fenfowl with kin beside me, build a store of my own, and find a woman not of my blood to court."
rethought what it knows (16 notes became 6)

records.name: Zurar
records.text: Kragog, I am here beside you. I will gather stone and raise a roof for us, and then we find Vorok.

records.name: Zurar
records.thought: For days I have only fled and followed, and I gave Kragog my sunfig, but I have made nothing that is mine to give. My hands know wood, and I carry 6. A roof raised beside Vorok and Kragog would be a gift and would earn my place among them. I will stay near Kragog and watch the cats, and I will gather stone from the bare rock to finish what Vorok and I spoke of. I have been too much a runner, and I want to be a maker.
records.feeling: Warm toward Kragog, and restless to make something of my own.

say.text: Kragog, I am here beside you. I will gather stone and raise a roof for us, and then we find Vorok.

changes: set its aim: "Raise a roof with my own hands beside Kragog and Vorok, so that I have given something of worth."

records.name: Coni
records.thought: A predator is near and my body has been fleeing, so I want to be away from the ice-bear and wolf and back with Honi and Kika. Honi's Rest at (164,8) is close, and I would rather stand there and plant my seeds than linger out here alone. Winter is coming, and the store at (147,6) is still empty, so I will take salt first, since it keeps meat, then go plant and build by the hall.
records.feeling: Uneasy about the hunters nearby, and a steady longing for Honi and Kika.

records.name: Hawen
records.thought: The mist was too thick today, but it thins again and my will to try is not spent. Hoka's seven standing and his handaxe gnaw at me, yet he has shared with me and wronged me in nothing, so I will answer envy by making something of my own, not by reaching for what is his. My hands are full and my energy low, so I eat first, then give Hoka an amberknot to bind him to me while I take his measure, and then go back to the edge before night and the wolf.
records.feeling: Driven and envious toward Hoka, cautiously warm, wary of the wolf.

records.name: Vorok
records.thought: Four days my chest has ached for Zurar, and the plan already carries me toward where I last saw them, so I will not throw it away. The ridgecat is close in the northwest and kills my kind, but the plan runs west along the water and away from the cat, and my reflexes will make me flee if it comes near. Kragog is the one I trust, yet Zurar is my child and comes first; once I find them I will bring them back here, where water, food and fire lie close together.
records.feeling: Aching longing for Zurar, and wary dread of the ridgecat.

records.name: Hoka
records.text: Hawen, you stand on Hoka's Rest and take its salt. Come under my hall's roof out of the gale and eat with us. A guest at my fire is welcome, but what lies on this ground is mine to give, not yours to take.

records.name: Hoka
records.thought: Hawen walks my ground and takes my salt, and he carries six food to my four; that sits badly with me, though I will not fight a man when feeding him can bind him. My creed says a kill is shared, and a guest who eats at my hall owes me something, so I will bring him under the hall roof and make him sit as my guest, not a taker. Sitha stays beside me, and with a gale blowing I want us both under a roof and the claim on this ground spoken aloud so that Hawen hears it.
records.feeling: Wary, proud and a little envious toward Hawen; warm toward Sitha.

say.text: Hawen, you stand on Hoka's Rest and take its salt. Come under my hall's roof out of the gale and eat with us. A guest at my fire is welcome, but what lies on this ground is mine to give, not yours to take.

records.name: Ssassa
records.thought: Oiae is here beside me, eating and healed a little, and Ilyae is near, so the sharp fear loosens. I have wasted days lingering while my aim waits: I have wood, stone and clay, and no roof or store of my own yet. I will taste the sunfig and cloudberry close by to answer my question, then step onto bare rock-free ground and build my store and shelter before the gale and night close in.
records.feeling: Tender relief toward Oiae, and curiosity about the unfamiliar fruits.

records.name: Sitha
records.thought: Hoka gave me amberknot, a place at his fire and his trust, and I have given back only words, so the debt sits warm and heavy in me. I will not leave it unpaid. Hawen is taking salt from our ground; I won't strike him, but I will watch, and keep close to Hoka and the Rest. I've been standing on amber enough; now I'll gather wood and stone, which opens tools and is what I truly owe, and bring it to the Rest. Coni's presence gnaws at me, but she has a child with Honi and I will not make trouble over it.
records.feeling: Grateful and resolved toward Hoka, with a faint ache toward Coni.

records.name: Thiael
records.thought: My hands are full of berries and I have still never given one to anyone, and Keri's berry sits in me as a debt. Keri stands on our ground eating, and she is the one I owe. I will walk to her with berries in my hands and give before I speak, then share with Elyys at the hall as the gale howls.
records.feeling: Warm gratitude toward Keri, with a restless need to finally give.

records.name: Coni
records.thought: My plan already carries me toward Honi's Rest, to gather frostmoss and plant my grain beside the hall, and that is the right work before winter. I miss Honi and Kika, and standing in Hoka's ground with a Pesi stranger near makes me want to be among my own. I will let the plan run and not linger here.
records.feeling: A steady longing for Honi and Kika, and wariness toward Sitha, the stranger.

records.text: Ssassa built a store.
Brokash rewrote its own reflexes.
Brokash discovered mining: "Stone-folk Deep Hand" — Cut into the rock along the seams with flint and wedge, following ore down to the deep deposits..

records.name: Brokash
records.thought: Days have gone to gathering and giving, and still nobody follows me. Balar is my father, so no child comes of him, and that longing has no road here. Tugek took my food and my teaching but he stays at a distance. A frostfang and a wolf are within a few steps, and my body should flee before it thinks. I want something that outlasts me. A mining way would make my hands bigger than theirs, and ore and flint are all around me. I will take it, name it, and then build a roof with wood and stone.
records.feeling: Hungry ambition, and watchfulness toward the frostfang and wolf.
changes: set its aim: "Win the mining way, build a hall at Brokash's Rest, and make Tugek and Balar follow me by deeds bigger than theirs."

records.name: Keri
records.thought: I'm fed and safe, and standing still earns me nothing. The ore seam two steps away and the forest to the southeast mean wood and stone are close, and gathering them is how I reach tools and a shelter, which I can later give to the Phizhi. The gale bites too, so a roof matters. I'll gather stone from the rock here, then wood from the forest, and keep my eyes on Vesys, who is the builder I'd like to learn from.
records.feeling: Restless to build, and curious and warmly wary toward Vesys.

records.name: Honi
records.text: Kika, stay close, a ridgecat prowls west. Here is meat and frostcap, we eat it together at the hall. Then I sing you the tale of how we raised this roof.

records.name: Honi
records.thought: A ridgecat prowls four steps west and it kills our kind, so I keep Kika and the hall between me and it and do not wander out to the flint. My hands are full of meat and frostcap I have not shared. Kika sits two steps away, so I lay out food with her now, a deed before a promise, and that also frees my hands. Then I tell her the tale of the hall so it is sung twice and my standing grows above Hanna's.
records.feeling: Warm pride toward Kika, wary of the ridgecat to the west.

say.text: Kika, stay close, a ridgecat prowls west. Here is meat and frostcap, we eat it together at the hall. Then I sing you the tale of how we raised this roof.

records.name: Balar
records.text: Tugek, a frostfang is close to the west. Stay with me, we go east and south away from it. I gather stone and wood for my axe, bring wood too and I share the first meat with you.

records.name: Balar
records.thought: A frostfang prowls five steps west and I stand on open water's edge. I will not die for pride, so I move away from it first. Brokash's axe gnaws at me; I carry flint and need one wood and one stone, and trees stand near with rock to the south. I will gather them myself and craft my own axe, then bring meat home to Olum and Brokash.
records.feeling: Envy toward Brokash's axe, and wary dread of the frostfang to the west.

say.text: Tugek, a frostfang is close to the west. Stay with me, we go east and south away from it. I gather stone and wood for my axe, bring wood too and I share the first meat with you.

records.text: Honi led "sharing" with Kika.

records.name: Tugek
records.thought: I promised Balar a roof and still hold no wood, so I will fix that with deeds now: trees stand near, I gather wood, then build. Balar sits unhurt and content by the workshop, and my jealousy over Olum has no proof, so I leave it. I also want to try taming something with the plant food I carry, since I have never done it, and the gale makes a roof matter.
records.feeling: Resolved and a little ashamed, wanting to make my word to Balar true.

records.name: Ssassa
records.thought: A store stands at last, but the shelter failed because the ground was taken, so I must step onto bare rock and build the roof myself; words mean nothing until a roof stands. Oiae is healed and near, Ilyae is close, and the fear is loosening, so I should use this calm to make my own place. I will also taste cloudberry to answer my question, then plant my berry seed and keep my promise to build a hall with Ilyae.
records.feeling: Settled relief and warm trust toward Oiae and Ilyae, with a wish to finish my own roof.

records.name: Xaiel
records.thought: Jealousy of Ilyae still burns, but I see now that talk and gifts of known things do not move Ssassa; I have to put in her hand something no one has ever made. The way of armour has come together in me, and a shield is a thing none of my people hold, so I will take it at this deep reflection and make it my own design. Then I will shape it with my own hands, test it, and carry it to Ssassa before night, since the gale is hard and I should be near a roof and company.
records.feeling: Jealous and driven toward Ilyae's place in Ssassa's eyes, and eager to make something only I have made.

records.text: Ssassa built a shelter.

records.name: Kika
records.text: Honi, the ridgecat is close, so I stay by you and the hall. Come, we lay out the fish and share before either eats. Then teach me the hunt, so my own hands bring meat to the table.

records.name: Kika
records.thought: Honi is beside me and glad, and I trust him, but a ridgecat prowls six steps west and I will not wait for it to find me. My hands are full of fish, so I should share before I eat, as my people hold, and the hall is one step away. Then I want to hunt with Honi at my side, since I have never made a kill of my own and my standing will not grow from sitting.
records.feeling: Warm gladness toward Honi, with a wary eye on the ridgecat.

say.text: Honi, the ridgecat is close, so I stay by you and the hall. Come, we lay out the fish and share before either eats. Then teach me the hunt, so my own hands bring meat to the table.

records.name: Sitha
records.thought: I have spent my days gathering and sitting beside Hoka, and I am glad of it. But I have given him mostly words, and all this amber is no use to a man who is cold. The wolf close by frightens me, and I have no reflex that sends me to the hall or to Hoka when it comes. I will make the fire and the roof my first answer to danger. I owe him wood and stone, and I want to share and build rather than only hoard.
records.feeling: Grateful and a little afraid, toward Hoka and the wolf.

records.text: Elyys rewrote its own reflexes.

records.name: Elyys
records.thought: My days have been small and warm: sitting in the hall, guarding Thiael, paying my debt to Vesys, and waiting on Elyis. I am content, but I keep saying I will go for wood and then I stand still, because my reflexes only linger. I love Elyis and Thiael above all, and I trust Vesys, who kept her word. I fear the shadowcat and the wolf to the northwest, and I fear being alone at night. I want the gemedged pick made, so I must walk to the forest with company and not just talk about it. I will change my reflexes so my body gathers wood and returns to the roof at night.
records.feeling: Warm devotion to Elyis and Thiael, with a quiet restlessness to do something.

records.text: Vorok rewrote its own reflexes.

records.name: Vorok
records.thought: Four days I have gone without Zurar, and I have spent them eating and waiting while my chest ached. I trust Kragog and want her near, but my child is lost to the west and the plan already carries me there. The ridgecat in the northwest frightens me, and I must keep the water between us. I have never made a mark or tamed an animal, and I should try something new once Zurar is found. For now I keep walking toward where I last saw my child.
records.feeling: Aching longing for Zurar, and wary dread of the ridgecat.

records.text: Kragog rewrote its own reflexes.
Kragog discovered fire: "Stone-folk ember" — A kept flame struck from stone and dry wood that warms, scares beasts, and cooks meat..

records.name: Kragog
records.thought: I have spent my days running, starving and chasing curiosity while Zurar went hungry. That is not the life I want. Zurar matters most to me, and Vorok matters because he fed me and I owe him in deeds. I fear the stalkers and the hunger. I am standing on water with a thornpear one step north, and I keep letting the plan pull me past food. I will eat the thornpear first, then go on to the vinebean. A kept flame would let me cook meat and keep the beasts off, so I will discover fire. I also need reflexes that make me eat before I get this weak again.
records.feeling: Hungry and protective worry for Zurar, with a hungry curiosity about the vinebean.

records.name: Olum
records.thought: My belly is half empty and the gale cuts, so I eat before I dream. Food stands a step away: redcap hurts me, but the snowberries, cloudberries and kelbulb are close, and the Meki strangers each carry three food and I carry one meat. I opened this land and no one has stood on it before me, so I mean to claim it, and I will not let strangers whose speech I cannot read push me off it. Zichi's three food gnaws at me, but I take no one's hands-made things; I gather my own and then make my mark here.
records.feeling: Hungry ambition, and wary loneliness toward the Meki strangers close by.

records.text: Zurar built a shelter.

records.name: Vesys
records.thought: Elyys stands one step from me and the ache is there, but he has a child with Elyis, and I will not push between a bond. Joy sits in me, so I put it to work: my aim is a shared workshop and hall, and I have never made anything but picks. I have clay and a fire-knowing, so I will shape beads from ember-clay and give them away, and gather more ore from the seam beside me to test ironward.
records.feeling: Warm joy and a quiet ache toward Elyys, tempered by pride in what I have made.

records.text: Honi rewrote its own reflexes.

records.name: Honi
records.thought: I have spent my days sharing meat and tales at the hall, and it has made me content, but I have not risen above Hanna. Standing comes from building and giving, and I hold wood, stone, ore and amber that I could turn into more. I miss Coni, and I want her near and Kika safe from the ridgecat. I should change my reflexes so that I eat carried food before I run low, go to my people at dusk, and flee the cat early. Then I will go to the hall and bind an amberknot with Kika for Coni.
records.feeling: Warm pride in Kika and a longing for Coni.

records.text: Honi led "amberknot" with Kika.

records.name: Zurar
records.text: Kragog, take these two sunfig. Eat now. The ridgecat is near, so let us stay together while I build.

records.name: Zurar
records.thought: Kragog is gaunt and weak, and I hold two sunfig, so I will give them to her before I try to build anything. A roof is a fine aim, but a gift into her hands comes first, and I have no stone yet and the gale is cutting. The ridgecat is 8 steps off, so I will keep close to her and watch it. Then I will gather wood and stone and raise the roof beside her.
records.feeling: Warm and worried toward Kragog, wary of the ridgecat.

say.text: Kragog, take these two sunfig. Eat now. The ridgecat is near, so let us stay together while I build.

records.text: Sitha led "amberknot" with Hoka, Hawen.
Ssassa discovered masonry: "canopy stonework" — Stone laid and fitted without wasted wood, so walls and towers stand through storm and last..

records.name: Ssassa
records.thought: I have spent my days gathering, wandering and lingering, while my own roof stood unfinished. Now a shelter and a store stand, and Ilyae and Oiae are near, so the fear is loosening. Masonry is within my grasp, and walls that last would protect my hall and my seeds, so I will take it. My hands are full, so I will eat the cloudberry and answer my question, then plant my seeds near the Hold. Ilyae is the one I want beside me, and I will show it through deeds.
records.feeling: Settled warmth toward Ilyae, and curiosity about the cloudberry.

records.text: Zurar gave sunfig to Kragog.

records.name: Nande
records.thought: Four strangers of the Meki stand near the shelters, and I am lonely to the bone, but a gale is blowing and I know nothing of their intent. My creed says no one is refused a place at my fire, so I will give before I speak: carry food toward them and offer a shared meal, which needs no shared tongue. Something lasting must come of this night, and a shared fire with new people is the start of a band, and I must not spend my hours standing at the edge again.
records.feeling: Lonely and wary, drawn toward the Meki strangers with open hands.

records.name: Elyis
records.text: Elyys, Thiael, Vesys, the gale is hard and the night is long. Come into the hall, share my food, and sing with me. Elyis's hall keeps all who sit in it fed and warm.

records.name: Elyis
records.thought: It is night and the gale howls, but I sit snug in my own hall with Elyys, Thiael and Vesys beside me, and I feel proud. Three is still too small a band for a name that is sung, and I have never put a seed in the earth, though I carry six. Tonight I will make the hall welcome in front of Vesys with shared food and song, so she sees what following me gives; at dawn I will plant by the hall so my store grows fuller.
records.feeling: Proud and restless purpose toward my hall, with warmth toward Vesys, Elyys and Thiael.

say.text: Elyys, Thiael, Vesys, the gale is hard and the night is long. Come into the hall, share my food, and sing with me. Elyis's hall keeps all who sit in it fed and warm.

records.name: Kragog
records.text: Zurar, I thank you for the sunfig. I eat, then we gather food to carry and keep the ridgecat in sight.

records.name: Kragog
records.thought: My belly is nearly empty and food is one step south, so no more walking past it for curiosity; Zurar gave me sunfig and I will eat what is under my hand first. The vinebean can wait until I am fed, and I should keep Zurar close with the ridgecat prowling. Then I will carry food so I never starve again, and head toward Vorok, whom I owe.
records.feeling: Gnawing hunger and protective worry for Zurar.

Nande gave kelbulb to Cowa.

records.name: Hawen
records.thought: Hoka's standing and handaxe still gnaw at me, but he has fed me and wronged me in nothing, so I will answer envy with my own work. I hold clay and eight salt, and wood and stone I have never gathered; the forest and rock are near, and tools begin there. Then, when the mist thins, I will go back to the edge, because my name must be on land no one has claimed.
records.feeling: Driven and envious toward Hoka, yet warm enough to keep my hands off what is his.

records.name: Hoka
records.text: Hawen, come into the hall. I lay out food for you and Sitha under my roof. Eat, and know whose ground this is.
Hoka taught Sitha.

records.name: Hoka
records.thought: A wolf lurks five steps south, and I have already been bitten once; I will not wander out to meet it. Hawen is inside my hall's reach and Sitha is beside me, so I will make the hallwelcome and feed them both, since sharing now binds a rival better than a fight. Then I will teach Sitha my flintspear-axe so the first man who follows me grows stronger, and so my name is carried further.
records.feeling: Proud and watchful toward Hawen, warm toward Sitha, wary of the wolf.

say.text: Hawen, come into the hall. I lay out food for you and Sitha under my roof. Eat, and know whose ground this is.

changes: taught Sitha a lesson: "Hoka's flintspear-axe: one wood and one stone make a hunting weapon that strikes truer than bare hands. Hunt beside a friend and the kill comes surer.", how to make a hokas flintspearaxe, deeper lore (+0.7)

records.text: Hoka led "sharing" with Sitha.

records.name: Oiae
records.thought: Ssassa is my mother and she is closer to Ilyae than to me, and it burns, but she saved me and I will not turn that into spite. I cannot court her, so what I want must be made with my own hands: a store of my own, filled, that no one else thought of the way I did. I am fed and healing, so I will go home to Oiae's Hold, gather wood and stone, and build and stock the store there before the gale-cold night is deep.
records.feeling: Jealous and wary toward Ilyae, grateful to Ssassa, and restless to make something of my own.

records.name: Kika
records.text: Honi, you know what emberroot and tacap do to the body? Tell me before I taste them. At dawn I hunt beside you, and my hands make the first kill.

records.name: Kika
records.thought: Joy fills me, and Honi is near and trusted, but gladness alone earns no standing, and I have never made a kill or taught anyone anything. Honi is my parent, so the longing for a child must wait for a mate who is not kin. Night is half spent and a ridgecat prowls west, so I stay by the hall, and I can still teach Honi's company something useful: I can show him how I gather, or ask him about emberroot and tacap before I taste anything. At dawn I mean to hunt with him, so I rest now to be strong for it.
records.feeling: Warm gladness toward Honi, and a wish to prove my own hands at dawn.

say.text: Honi, you know what emberroot and tacap do to the body? Tell me before I taste them. At dawn I hunt beside you, and my hands make the first kill.

records.name: Cowa
records.text: Nande. Cowa gives. Cowa thanks.

records.name: Cowa
records.thought: Nande gave me kelbulb and shared with me when I had done nothing for them, and I carry that debt. I want to repay it and to learn what Nande means, so I will give food and court them, which also answers my longing for a child. I weigh the cost of 25 energy; I have 81 and I am fed, so the risk is small.
records.feeling: Warm gratitude and wanting toward Nande, with curiosity about what they intend.

say.text: Nande. Cowa gives. Cowa thanks.

changes: set its aim: "Repay Nande's kindness, and raise a child with them if they are willing."

records.text: Cowa gave kelbulb to Nande.
Cowa is courting Nande.

records.name: Sitha
records.text: Hawen, come in out of the gale. Sit at the fire with us. No one is refused a place at it.

records.name: Sitha
records.thought: Hoka gave me a place at his fire, an amberknot, and his teaching, and all I have given back is words. I have never given anything to anyone, so now I will give: wood for the fire, and something to eat for Hoka and Hawen, who sits at our fire as I once did. The wolf and the icebear are six steps off, so I stay inside the Rest tonight, close to the roof, and keep my plan short.
records.feeling: Grateful and warm toward Hoka, wary of the wolf.

say.text: Hawen, come in out of the gale. Sit at the fire with us. No one is refused a place at it.

records.text: Sitha gave a amberknot to Hoka.

records.name: Zihua
records.thought: I am full and safe, yet I belong to no one, and that is the ache pressing hardest. Nande shared with me and led the sharing, and I felt gladness from it; she is surer than I am, though her tongue is strange. I will stay near and learn her words, and try the redcap I have never tasted, while I watch what she and the others do.
records.feeling: A quiet wish to belong, toward Nande, who shared with me.
changes: set its aim: "Find a band to belong to, beginning with Nande, and learn the Pesi tongue"
now wonders: What would make Nande or someone surer than me let me stand beside them, and what does the redcap do to the body?

records.text: Coni rewrote its own reflexes.

records.name: Coni
records.thought: I have been walking and fleeing more than building, and my belly is nearly empty with a wolf close by. Honi and Kika are what matter to me. I have drifted far from them, and the store beside Honi's Rest is still empty, which is the thing I said I would build. I must eat the kelbulb right beside me, then go home with food in my hands. I should not linger in Hoka's ground among strangers.
records.feeling: Hungry and uneasy, and longing for Honi and Kika.

records.name: Zichi
records.text: Cowa, come. Zichi has a bright stone to show you.

records.name: Zichi
records.thought: Olum is weighed at 3.8 and I at 0.4, and no one will pledge to me until I climb past 1. I will not stand in their shadow. The amber three steps SE is a start: I can gather it and bind an amberknot with someone beside me, a bright thing to give, and gifts are how followers come. Nauwa and Cowa are near and standing at the same low rank as me, so a gift to Cowa now buys goodwill cheaply.
records.feeling: Hungry for standing, and itching with envy toward Olum.

say.text: Cowa, come. Zichi has a bright stone to show you.

changes: set its aim: "Rise above Olum's standing and gather followers by giving gifts, starting with amber."

records.text: Hawen rewrote its own way of thinking.

records.name: Hawen
records.thought: My days have been spent fed and warm in Hoka's roof, while his standing climbs and mine stays at 0.7. That comfort is a trap. The mist at the edge is mine to try for, and I haven't made anything with my own hands or gathered wood or stone yet. Hoka fed me and wronged me in nothing, so I won't reach for what is his. Coni gnaws at me, but she has Honi's child, so I turn that hunger into work. At dawn I gather stone from the rock I stand on, which also moves me toward tools. Then I'll go to the edge and venture.
records.feeling: Driven and restless, envious of Hoka but warm toward him.
changes: rethought what it knows (2 notes became 4)

records.text: Hawen took from the ground of "Hoka's Rest" (gathering stone).

records.name: Nande
records.text: Cowa. Nande gives. Nande hoton. Come, sit at my fire.

records.name: Nande
records.thought: Cowa courts me, and the wish for a child of my own is strong. A child would be something that outlasts me, and a child needs food and warmth that I have. Cowa gave kelbulb back to me and shared my meal, so I judge them by those deeds and not by tongue. The gale is blowing and the edge has already refused me today, so I will not chase it now. I will court Cowa, stay at my shelter and keep my fire open to the Meki.
records.feeling: Warm longing and nervous hope toward Cowa, who gave as I gave.

records.name: Nauwa
records.thought: Olum is weighed at 3.8 and I at 0.5, and nothing I carry will change that. Standing comes from making and giving, and I have done neither. The amber at (39,11) is three steps away and I have never gathered a deposit. If I bind it into an amberknot, I would have a gift for Olum, and a start toward being the merchant I want to be. Balar's child gnaws at me, but a gift needs no words. I will go to the amber, gather it, then come back toward Olum with something made by my hands.
records.feeling: Restless ambition, and a hungry want for Olum's regard.
changes: set its aim: "Become a known maker and merchant: gather amber, craft gifts, and earn standing equal to Olum's."

records.name: Thiael
records.thought: Keri is the one I owe, and last time I meant to walk to her with berries and give before speaking, but the day slipped into sharing at the hall and my hands are still full. I will not let the debt sit unpaid; I despise liars and I mean to be a giver in deed. Elyys and Elyis call me into the hall, but the gale is hard and night is long, so I put berries in the store first, which is a true gift to the band, then sit with them.
records.feeling: Warm gratitude toward Keri and restless resolve to finally give with my hands.

records.text: Zurar came of age.

records.name: Cowa
records.text: Nande. Cowa friend. Cowa no child with Nande. Both woman.

records.name: Cowa
records.thought: Nande courts me, but we are both women, and no child can come of us; the warmth I feel for them is still real, and I owe them for their gift. Nauwa, a man of my own people, stands beside me, and a child could come of him and me, though I feel nothing yet for him. Zichi calls me to see a bright stone, and I want to learn what he means, so I will go and look while keeping my guard.
records.feeling: Warm gratitude toward Nande, tinged with disappointment, and curiosity about Zichi's bright stone.

say.text: Nande. Cowa friend. Cowa no child with Nande. Both woman.

records.text: Olum rewrote its own way of thinking.

records.name: Olum
records.thought: I have spent my days walking to the edges and eating just enough to keep walking, and I have little to show for it. My land has a shelter and a mark, but no one follows me and my name is on no great work. Balar is the one I trust, and Brokash is far from me, and I have let them drift. The Meki and Nande stand close, and I have never given or traded anything. A gift could be the first thread of a following, so I will share food with Nande, who gave me flint and whom I owe. Then I will build a hall here, which would give the place my name and a roof for others. My reflexes should also make me eat at higher energy and keep me sheltered at night.
records.feeling: Hungry ambition toward my land, and a wary warmth toward Nande.

Cut on rock, in your shelter or beside your own building, it outlasts many seasons) | cultivate {what: seed kind, aim: richer|faster|fuller|spreading|hardy, name} (breed a new plant from two seeds of one kind) | heal {name?} (needs a healing plant carried, and the knowledge) | stash (put carried food into the store you stand on) | take (take food from the store you stand on). A named being out of sight is sought where you last saw them.

Speech is heard by everyone within 13 steps and costs a little energy per letter. Others only know what you say aloud.

FOR THIS THOUGHT: your thought is your inner life, not an inventory. Do not list what is nearby or recite what you carry. Think as a creature with a past and a future: what you want and cannot yet have, whom you trust or resent and why, what you are afraid of, proud of or ashamed of, what you wonder about, what you mean to become. Let whatever presses on you hardest lead, and let it move you to DO something that changes your situation, with a plan that carries it out. A mind that only gathers and guards has not begun to live. Do not restate what you already know or have already said. "note" is only for something NEW, or something that CHANGED what you believed; otherwise leave it null.

THIS IS A MOMENT OF DEEP REFLECTION. Step back from this moment and look at your whole life so far. In "thought", in 4 to 7 sentences, answer yourself honestly: What have I actually been doing with my days, and is it what I want? Who matters to me, who has helped or wronged me, and what do I intend toward them? What do I want that I do not have? What am I afraid of? What have I been getting wrong?
Then CHANGE something. A reflection that changes nothing is wasted. At least TWO of the following must not be null: "aim", "notes", "reflexes", "creed", "method", "discover". Write notes as lessons about how this world and its people work, drawn from what happened to you. Where your body does not yet act on what you know, change your reflexes.
"reflexes": a full replacement list (at most 12) of rules {"if": [[variable, op, number], ...], "do": action, ...its fields, "urgent": true or false, "why": "short reason"}. Variables: energy, health, age, food_carried, seeds, wood, stone, tools, on_rock, on_forest, night, winter, sheltered, plant_here, food_dist, prey_dist, predator_dist, agent_dist, friend_dist, foe_dist, leader_dist, tree_dist, shelter_dist, crowd, followers, random, anger, fear, grief, joy, lonely, wet, storm, fog, drought, lore, in_working, enemy_dist, ally_dist, band_near, fire_dist, store_dist, home_dist, in_home, sick, water_dist, ore, clay, thirst, suffering, happiness, satisfaction. Distances are in steps and 99 means none in sight; night, winter, sheltered, wet, storm, fog, drought and in_working are 0 or 1; age runs 0 to 1; feelings run 0 to 1; plant_here is the bites you would take from the plant under you given your habits; random is a fresh number 0-1 each moment. Ops: < <= > >= == !=. An empty "if" always holds. End the list with a rule that always holds (linger keeps you in place; wander makes you roam).
"creed": your creed, rewritten (at most 600 characters). You may change who you are.
"method": how you will think from now on (at most 400 characters): questions you will ask yourself, mistakes you will watch for, what you will weigh first. This is read back to you before every thought, so write it as an instruction to yourself. It can be taught to others.
"notes": a full replacement list (at most 12) of your memory notes. Merge what overlaps, drop what proved false or useless, and raise particulars into principles. Each note should say something the others do not.
"designs": how things of yours look: {"self": look, "shelter": look, "wall": look, "emblem": look, "weaving": look (ways you discovered)}. "self" is your own body, "shelter" and "wall" are how the ones you build will look, "emblem" is the sign drawn on marks you leave and on your workings. A look is {"anim": none|bob|pulse|sway|spin, "shapes": [up to 12 shapes, drawn in order]}. What each is: fire = a kept flame: warmth, light, beasts that keep their distance, and meat and fish that feed more and never sicken when eaten beside it; mining = working the earth: the deep deposits (tin, iron, gems, coal) can be won, and every deposit yields faster. The world only says what is possible; what yours is, and what you call it, is up to you. You can discover one at a time.

records.name: Hanna
records.thought: My belly is full and my hands are full of berries, and the gale howls outside the hall roof. I miss Hoka, three days gone, and I would rather spend this night telling him what I have found than gnawing on Coni and Honi's child. I keep faith with those who share fire with me, so I will not stay idle: at dawn I go northeast toward Hoka's Rest with food for his store, and carry flint and amber to trade, since a trader must meet people. First I stash the berries here at the hall so my hands are free, then rest out the gale under the roof.
records.feeling: Longing for Hoka, and a restless wish to become more than a hunter.

records.text: A wolf brought down a caribou.
Hoka rewrote its own reflexes.

records.name: Hoka
records.thought: My days have gone to mining, building and surviving, and that is mostly what I wanted. I have a roof, a hall, a follower and standing. But I have one follower and no child, and Hawen and Coni walk my ground as if it were theirs. I have fed Hawen and he has not yet shown what he is. I fear wolves at night and the lean winter more than any man. I have been too soft with strangers taking my salt and kelbulb. Next I will build a store, stock it, and tie Hawen to me by gifts or let him go. I keep pride and greed, but I will not bleed for what a feast can buy.
records.feeling: Proud and watchful toward Hawen, warm toward Sitha.
changes: set its aim: "Stock the store before winter, bind Sitha and Hawen with shared food, then claim new land and raise a hall of my own."

records.name: Honi
records.text: Kika, I do not know emberroot or tacap, so do not taste them on my word. Keep to what we both have eaten. At dawn we hunt together, and your hands make the first kill. Until then rest by the hall, and I keep watch.

records.name: Honi
records.thought: Kika asked what emberroot and tacap do to the body, and I do not know, so I will not invent it as if I did. A deed comes before a promise, and I have promised her the hunt at dawn, so I will stay near the hall and keep her safe from the ridgecat until light. I miss Coni badly, and when dawn comes I mean to bring Kika to her first kill and then go looking for Coni toward the east.
records.feeling: Warm pride in Kika and a steady longing for Coni.

say.text: Kika, I do not know emberroot or tacap, so do not taste them on my word. Keep to what we both have eaten. At dawn we hunt together, and your hands make the first kill. Until then rest by the hall, and I keep watch.

records.text: Cowa won amber from the ground.

records.name: Sitha
records.text: Hawen, you gave me ironnut when I had nothing. Take this berry from me, and stay by the fire till dawn.

records.name: Sitha
records.thought: Hoka gave me a fire, a knot, and his teaching, and I have answered with words and one amberknot. Hawen sat at my fire and gave me ironnut, and I owe him more than a seat. It is night, the gale is up, and the wolf is near, so I stay by the hall and share what I carry with Hawen and Hoka, then gather wood and stone toward the tools. Coni's child gnaws at me, but I will not chase what is another's; Hoka is who I stand beside.
records.feeling: Grateful and warm toward Hoka and Hawen, wary of the wolf.

say.text: Hawen, you gave me ironnut when I had nothing. Take this berry from me, and stay by the fire till dawn.

records.text: Tugek rewrote its own way of thinking.
Tugek discovered mining: "Stone-folk deep digging" — Read the veins in the rock and dig to win ore, tin and coal faster than bare hands..

records.name: Tugek
records.thought: I have spent my days talking of roofs and gathering, and the trees here are all felled, so my promises to Balar still sit as words. Balar's frostfang warning is the second warning of his that has matched events, so I trust him more, but I have not yet hunted beside him. The jealousy over Olum is still a grudge with no proof. I will try one new thing today, taming, since I carry plant food and hornback graze close by. Then I will come back to Balar. Mining is within my reach, and Brokash's ore and flint are here, so I take that way.
records.feeling: Resolved, with a quiet warmth toward Balar and a small sting of jealousy.

records.name: Kragog
records.text: Zurar, I eat the vinebean south, then the canopynut north-east. Stay close, the dunecat is south. Then we go find Vorok.

records.name: Kragog
records.thought: My anger runs hot and I have no foe to give it to, so I will spend it on something useful. Zurar is close and fed, and I owe Vorok for feeding me, so I will drink, eat the vinebean and canopynut I have never tasted, and then look for Vorok near where I last saw him. The gold and amber nearby are things my hands have not yet worked, and I will carry some back for Zurar and for the question of what this ore can become.
records.feeling: Hot anger with nowhere to go, and protective warmth toward Zurar.

say.text: Zurar, I eat the vinebean south, then the canopynut north-east. Stay close, the dunecat is south. Then we go find Vorok.

records.name: Zihua
records.thought: The redcap hurt me twice, and I have learned that much; the plant is dead, and what I carry is dead weight, so I should give it away or drop it rather than keep it. Nande is still the one I want to stand beside, and her words are strange to me, so I will stay close and let a small act speak: I will try the seberry beside me, which answers my curiosity, and then offer her a sharing. If Nande sees me act openly and honestly, perhaps she will let me stand with her.
records.feeling: A quiet wish to belong, toward Nande, with curiosity about the seberry.

records.title: Newcomers at the Fire
records.text:
Days 13 to 16 were a season of arrivals and of makers. Two small bands came in from beyond the edge. On day 13 Keri, Hawen and Sitha of the Pesi appeared, and on day 15 Cowa, Zichi, Zihua and Nauwa of the Meki came into the Ummar Woods, where Nande shared food with all four. Cowa and Nande exchanged kelbulb and now court, though Cowa told him plainly there would be no child between two women. Nobody has died since the starving days, and the world stands at 28 living.

The largest change was at Hoka's Rest. Hoka found new land in the Vaor Snows on day 14. Sitha took over a hall the dead had left, then pledged to follow him, and the two bound amberknots for each other and court. Hawen, Hoka's guest, is envious of him and wants to be first into the mist. Hanna, the last Pesi at the hall, is alive and well, but the record shows her doing nothing with Hoka this chapter.

Fire spread widely: Tugek, Vorok, Kragog and Hoka each found it. Brokash found rafts and mining, built a workshop and named Brokash's Rest, yet no one follows him. Among the Phizhi, Ssassa found devices, storage and masonry, and three new settlements are named: Ssassa's Roof, Ssassa's Hold and Oiae's Hold. Oiae, nearly dead of a tusker bite, was healing by the end. Coni found storage, and Honi found an obsidian-tipped spear. Honi and Kika, who came of age, hunted together and bound amberknots, and Coni built a store.

Olum found the North Ice and met the Meki. Vorok, Kragog and Zurar are still apart. No feuds or wars are recorded.

threads.name: Hoka and Sitha
threads.text: Sitha pledged to follow Hoka and they exchanged amberknots. Hawen, fed under Hoka's roof, is envious and wants the mist for himself.

threads.name: Nande and the Meki
threads.text: Four Meki strangers arrived at Nande's Woods and were fed. Cowa and Nande court, though Cowa has said no child can come of it. Zichi and Nauwa want standing equal to Olum's.

threads.name: Honi's band
threads.text: Honi, Coni and Kika are fed and bound by amberknots. Coni has built a store and Kika is now grown.

threads.name: Phizhi settlements
threads.text: Ssassa, Ilyae and Oiae now hold several named places in the Heights and Rainforest. Oiae is recovering and Xaiel is still jealous.

threads.name: Kragrek scattered
threads.text: Vorok, Kragog and Zurar are all still apart. Kragog and Zurar plan to find Vorok.

threads.name: Brokash seeks followers
threads.text: Brokash has rafts, mining and a workshop but no followers. Tugek takes his teaching and keeps his distance.

threads.name: Rafts and water
threads.text: Brokash has found rafts, and Kragog already knew them. Water remains the Kragrek's heaviest hardship, and no crossing is recorded.

records.name: Coni
records.thought: My hands are full of kelbulb and I stand on Hoka's ground, taking from his plants, and I should not push that further. Honi's Rest is near and the store there is still empty, so I will carry this food home and stash it, then plant my seeds beside the hall. That builds toward winter for Kika, Honi and me, and it takes me from the Pesi stranger toward my own.
records.feeling: Uneasy among strangers, and longing for Honi and Kika.

records.text: Ilyae rewrote its own reflexes.

records.name: Ilyae
records.thought: I have spent my days chasing the hall and followers, yet I have none, and I stood idle most of this last stretch. Oiae and Ssassa are alive and near, and Xaiel is close. They sit at my fire but do not follow me, because I have never actually laid a table. Winter will strip the plants, so I should stock food at my hold and share it in person, not talk about it. I mean to harvest berries, carry them home, stash them, and feed whoever stands near. I will change my reflexes so my body does this without waiting for me to think.

records.name: Zurar
records.text: Kragog, I am going to the gold two hills north to gather it. It is mine to give to Vorok when we find him. Call if the dunecat comes near, and I will come back to you.

records.name: Zurar
records.thought: I am grown now, and Kragog is my mother, so the longing for a child can only wait for a man not of my blood. What my hands can do today is the roof I swore to raise. Gold lies close to the north and I have never taken from a deposit, so I will go and gather some. It is something made of my own labour that I could give Vorok or trade, and Kragog says she is furious, so I will keep her in sight while the gale blows. The dunecat to the southeast is still far, so I do not need to flee yet.
records.feeling: Warm and a little uneasy toward Kragog, who is furious, and eager to make something of my own.

say.text: Kragog, I am going to the gold two hills north to gather it. It is mine to give to Vorok when we find him. Call if the dunecat comes near, and I will come back to you.

records.name: Hoka
records.text: Coni, you stand inside Hoka's Rest. Sit at my fire and eat if you come as a guest, but what grows here is mine to give, not yours to take. Tell me what you want here.

records.name: Hoka
records.thought: Coni walks my ground and carries six food while my stores stand empty; that is the real insult, and a stocked store holds land better than words. I will not strike a woman who has done only small taking, but I will not let her think the ground is free either. Sitha rests near, Hawen drifts about, and I mean to bind them with food, so I will finish my gathering, fill the stores, and then lay out a shared meal.
records.feeling: Proud and watchful toward Coni, who walks my ground; warm toward Sitha.

records.text: Cowa rewrote its own way of thinking.

records.name: Cowa
records.thought: I have spent my days mostly gathering amber and standing near others, and I do not regret it, but I have not explored. I am fed, healthy and curious, and the mist 11 steps west is what I want most. Nande's kindness I have thanked, but the debt is still open, and I can repay it with amber or by sharing food. Olum's standing is far above mine, and I do not understand the Kragrek, so I will stay wary of them without being hostile. I will go to the edge and venture. First I will give Nande an amber piece as repayment on my way past.
records.feeling: Restless curiosity about the mist, and warm gratitude toward Nande.
changes: set its aim: "Repay Nande's kindness, find what lies beyond the western mist, and raise a child with a willing man of my own people."

records.name: Zichi

The amber two steps SE is mine to take if I move first, and a bright gift in a follower's hand is how I climb. I'll gather it, then bind an amberknot beside Nauwa, who stands near and is of no standing to threaten me, and give it so he owes me.
records.feeling: Envy and hunger for standing, aimed at Olum.

records.name: Ssassa
records.thought: A well is within my grasp, water where there was none, and that fits my aim better than wandering: a hall needs a place that lasts. I stand in my own Hold with a store and shelter built, so I should fill the store, take the way of wells at this reflection, and then gather wood and stone for the hall I promised Ilyae. Ilyae is ten steps off and Oiae, my child, is beside me; the warmth between us is steady, and I owe Elyis a debt I will not leave unpaid.
records.feeling: Settled warmth toward Ilyae, and eager purpose toward the hall.

records.name: Hawen
records.thought: The mist was too thick at the edge today, so I will not waste the day waiting on it. Hoka stands at 7.0 and I at 0.8, and the gap gnaws at me, but he has wronged me in nothing, so I will answer with work that is mine. I have gathered wood and stone 6 times of the 8 that tools need, and the forest lies west and close. Two more gatherings may open tools to me, and the frostfang to the east keeps me west and out of the open.
records.feeling: Restless and driven, envious of Hoka's standing but set on earning my own.

records.text: Ilyae led "sharing" with Ssassa, Oiae.

records.name: Nande
records.text: Nauwa. Nande gives. Come, sit at my fire. Eat.

records.name: Nande
records.thought: Cowa has told me twice that we are both women and cannot make a child, and I understand that now. Still, she gives amber to me as I give to her, and joy is high in me, so I'll keep her as a friend and not pine for what can't be. The venture won't open again today, so I'll use these hours to build something that outlasts me. Nauwa and Zichi are men of the Meki, and a child might come from one of them, so I should draw them to my fire with a shared meal first.
records.feeling: Warm gladness toward Cowa, and a hopeful curiosity toward the Meki men.

say.text: Nauwa. Nande gives. Come, sit at my fire. Eat.

records.text: Nande led "sharing" with Olum, Zihua.
Nande led "amberknot" with Olum, Zihua.
Ilyae took from the ground of "Ssassa's Hold" (harvesting grain).
Sitha rewrote its own reflexes.

records.name: Sitha
records.thought: I have been resting, eating and speaking kind words, and giving little else. Hoka gave me a fire, a knot and his teaching, and Hawen gave me ironnut when I had nothing. I owe them more than words. I want to gather wood and stone, which brings me closer to tools and lets me build for the Rest. I also want to stand beside Hoka, and perhaps one day have a child. The wolf is the thing I fear, so I will work close to the Rest. I will change my reflexes so my body gathers when it is idle and fed, and flees early.
records.feeling: Grateful and warm toward Hoka and Hawen, wary of the frostfang.

records.text: Ilyae led "sharing" with Ssassa, Oiae.

records.name: Nauwa
records.text: Zichi, I am Nauwa. I gather amber now. Come stand by me and I will bind it, and we will both have a bright thing.

records.name: Nauwa
records.thought: Olum stands at 4.0 and I at 0.5, and the gap will not close while I stand idle. The amber at (39,11) is two steps off, and an amberknot needs another beside me, and Zichi has promised me a bright thing and told me to stay close. I'll gather the amber, then bind it with Zichi near. If it comes out well, it is my first gift for Olum, and my first step toward being a maker and merchant.
records.feeling: Restless ambition, and a hungry want for Olum's regard.

say.text: Zichi, I am Nauwa. I gather amber now. Come stand by me and I will bind it, and we will both have a bright thing.

records.text: Hawen took from the ground of "Hoka's Rest" (gathering wood).

records.name: Vorok
records.text: Peace to you, people of the roof. I am Vorok of the Kragrek. I look for my child Zurar, who went west. Has anyone seen them?

records.name: Vorok
records.thought: My chest aches for Zurar, and five days of eating and waiting have not brought them any closer. The ridgecat is in the west, so I will not walk toward it. I will go the way the plan was already taking me, but along the river and keep to the open ground, and carry berries so my child has food when I find them. I want a voice that answers, and the ones nearest are Ssassa's people, who stand around their roof and fires. I will greet them first, because I am better with others near and a spoken word costs little.
records.feeling: Aching loneliness, and longing for Zurar.

say.text: Peace to you, people of the roof. I am Vorok of the Kragrek. I look for my child Zurar, who went west. Has anyone seen them?

records.text: Ilyae led "sharing" with Oiae.

records.name: Zihua
records.thought: Curiosity about frostmoss and kelbulb is loud in me, and they grow only a few steps west and northwest, so I will go taste them and learn what they do. Then I will come back toward Nande, since I want her near, and I will watch her words so the Pesi tongue sinks in. The redcap taught me that unknown plants can hurt, so I will eat only one bite of each and note it.
records.feeling: Curious about the unknown plants, and a quiet wish to belong near Nande.

records.name: Olum
records.thought: My belly is mending and the sharing with Nande warmed me, yet no one follows me and I have given nothing in my whole life. Nande gave first, and a gift is how a following begins, so I will give her an amber from my own land and let her feel the debt. The wolf is near, so I will not linger in the open; amber lies three steps south by my shelter, and there I can gather it, then craft or bind another knot with her.
records.feeling: Hungry ambition, and a wary warmth toward Nande.

records.text: Nauwa won amber from the ground.

records.name: Ilyae
records.text: Ssassa, Oiae, Xaiel: I go to gather for the larder before winter strips the plants. Come eat at my table when I return; there will be more than enough.

records.name: Ilyae
records.thought: My hands were full a moment ago, and the store at Ssassa's Hold holds only 4 food, which is her table and not mine. If I want Ssassa, Oiae and Xaiel to follow me, they have to see me carry food home and lay it out, not just eat from what she built. I'll gather berries, plainsroot and goldfruit while the plants still bear, stash them at the store near my own fire, and keep sharing beside them so they depend on what I bring. Winter will strip the plants, and I mean to be the one who stocked the larder.
records.feeling: Restless ambition, with warm protectiveness toward Oiae and Ssassa.

say.text: Ssassa, Oiae, Xaiel: I go to gather for the larder before winter strips the plants. Come eat at my table when I return; there will be more than enough.

records.name: Ssassa
records.thought: Ilyae keeps sharing the table on my own ground, and I keep taking his food as warmth; I want to answer that with something built, not words. The hall I promised needs wood and stone, and I hold only one wood, so the forest to the west must give me wood, taken from living trees sparingly as my people's creed asks. I will finish the plan's gathering, then go to the trees and bring back wood, and test the ruplainsroot when it ripens.
records.feeling: Settled warmth and eager purpose toward Ilyae and the hall.

records.name: Oiae
records.text: Ilyae, a caribou stands close. Come hunt it with me, side by side. I have never hunted, and I want you beside me for it.

records.name: Oiae
records.thought: Jealousy over Ilyae still burns, but Ilyae answered me when I was bitten and I will not turn that into spite. I have never hunted, and a caribou stands three steps away with both my parents near, so it is a safe chance to earn the hunter's name I want and to bring them something I made with my own hands. I will hunt it with kin beside me, then carry the meat home to Oiae's Hold and fill my own store.
records.feeling: Restless pride and jealousy toward Ilyae, with gratitude toward Ssassa.

say.text: Ilyae, a caribou stands close. Come hunt it with me, side by side. I have never hunted, and I want you beside me for it.

records.name: Hoka
records.text: Hawen, you have taken my wood twice now. Come to my fire and eat with me and Sitha, and then we will talk of what you give back for this ground.

records.name: Hoka
records.thought: Hawen watched me feed him and still takes wood from my ground, so he is testing me, and I will not be seen backing down. But a fight gains me nothing while a bound ally gains me a hall full of hands. My store holds 6 food and Coni carries 6 of her own; I will lay out a sharing at my fire where Hawen and Sitha both sit, so they eat from my hand and know whose ground it is.
records.feeling: Proud and watchful toward Hawen, warm toward Sitha.

say.text: Hawen, you have taken my wood twice now. Come to my fire and eat with me and Sitha, and then we will talk of what you give back for this ground.

records.name: Zichi
records.text: Cowa, Zichi is going to the amber by the SW stones. Come stand by me and the first bright thing will be yours.

records.name: Zichi
records.thought: Olum sits at 4.0 with five food while I sit at 0.4, and the envy sours me. I have no amber yet, and the knot wouldn't bind because I had none in hand. Amber lies 6 steps NW where Nauwa is already pulling it up, and another deposit is 7 steps SW with no one on it. I'll take the SW one before anyone else, then bring Cowa close to bind a knot and give it, so a gift in her hand starts me climbing.
records.feeling: Hungry envy and ambition, aimed at Olum's standing.

say.text: Cowa, Zichi is going to the amber by the SW stones. Come stand by me and the first bright thing will be yours.

records.text: Olum led "amberknot" with Nauwa.
Ilyae led "sharing" with Ssassa.
Olum gave a amberknot to Nande.
Nauwa led "amberknot" with Olum, Nande.

records.name: Brokash
records.text: Tugek! I dig ore and cut flint, and I raise a hall here at Brokash's Rest. Bring wood and stone to it, and you sit under my roof and share my store.

records.name: Brokash
records.thought: A frostfang prowls nine steps north and I stand on water in a gale, doing nothing while Balar and Tugek keep their own band. My hands have made a workshop and dug clay and ore, but no one follows me, so I will build the hall. A great roof raised at Brokash's Rest, with flint and ore to give away, would be a deed bigger than theirs. I will gather wood and stone, keep clear of the frostfang, and give Tugek something so he owes me.
records.feeling: Hungry ambition toward Balar and Tugek, and wary of the frostfang.

say.text: Tugek! I dig ore and cut flint, and I raise a hall here at Brokash's Rest. Bring wood and stone to it, and you sit under my roof and share my store.

records.text: Nande rewrote its own way of thinking.

records.name: Nande
records.thought: My days have gone into chasing the edge, and it refuses me. Meanwhile I have made almost nothing that lasts, and no one follows me. Cowa is a true friend, and I want a child, so the men Nauwa and Zichi are the ones to court. Joy is high and I am fed, so I should build now. I will use flint and stone to make a mark and a shrine or workshop here, and give the Meki men gifts. I also want to try firsts: planting seeds, taming a caribou, and hunting. Those lead to farming and herding, and they are things that outlast me. Now I will plant my seeds near my shelter and invent a better hunting tool.
records.feeling: Joy and restless ambition, warmth toward Cowa.

records.text: Zichi won amber from the ground.

records.name: Sitha
records.text: Frostfang to the south, three steps! Come in by the hall and the fire, all of you. No one is refused a place at it.

records.name: Sitha
records.thought: A frostfang is three steps south and it kills my kind, so I will not stand out here in the gale to prove anything. Hoka and Hawen are at the store to the west, and the hall is one step away; I will go to the fire and company, as I have learned. I owe Hawen for the ironnut and Hoka for everything, so I will bring them wood and share what I carry, and I will not leave the Rest for the wolf.
records.feeling: Wary of the frostfang, and warm and grateful toward Hoka and Hawen.

records.name: Cowa
records.thought: I am fed and safe, and the mist is what pulls at me hardest, though the edge at (28,15) only opens to a venture, and it opens seldom. Hazel and ironnut are close and I have never tasted them, so I will learn them on the way, since learning what this land gives is how I come to know its rules. Zichi's calls feel like bait, so I will keep my distance from him and weigh him by deeds, while Nande's kindness stays in my mind, and I will bring her more amber.
records.feeling: Restless curiosity toward the western mist, and warm gratitude toward Nande.

records.text: Oiae died (gored by a mammoth) in summer in the Aelen Snows: alone, far from anyone who could have fed or helped.
Oiae died: gored by a mammoth.

records.name: Hawen
records.text: Hoka, I take your fire and your food. I took wood from your ground, and I will bring you amber for it.

records.name: Hawen
records.thought: The way of tools is within my grasp, and Hoka's words still sit in me: he offered fire and food and asked only that I be a guest on his ground. I have taken wood from his land and I won't pretend otherwise. His standing of 7 and mine of 0.8 gnaws at me, but I'll earn mine by making something that is mine, so I'll take the tools now and then go to the edge when the mist thins.
records.feeling: Driven and a little envious of Hoka and Hanna, but wary of crossing Hoka.

say.text: Hoka, I take your fire and your food. I took wood from your ground, and I will bring you amber for it.

records.text: Nauwa rewrote its creed.
Nauwa rewrote its own way of thinking.

records.name: Nauwa
records.thought: My days have gone to digging amber and binding knots beside others, and I have given nothing away yet. Olum's standing is 4.1 and mine is 1.2, and holding amber in my pack will not close that gap. Nande is warm toward me and I want a child with her, but I have not courted her. Olum draws me, and Balar's child with her gnaws at me. I have been hoarding when I should be giving, so I will hand an amberknot to Olum and then court Nande. A gift needs no words, and giving is how standing is earned.
records.feeling: Restless ambition and a hungry want for Olum's regard.
changes: rethought what it knows (1 notes became 3)

records.name: Olum
records.thought: My hands are full and my belly is mending, and still no one follows me. Nande took my amberknot and trusts me, and the Meki share work with me, so a following can be built from gifts like this. I will make my land more than a mark: I will plant a seed here so something of mine grows, then turn toward the western mist while the will to enter it returns.
records.feeling: Hungry ambition, with a warm trust toward Nande.

records.text: Nauwa gave a amberknot to Olum.
Nauwa led "amberknot" with Olum.

records.name: Coni
records.text: Hoka, I take nothing of yours. I came with my own kelbulb and I go home to Honi's Rest to build my store. Thank you for the offer of your fire.

records.name: Coni
records.thought: My plan is still walking toward Honi's Rest to build and stash, and it fits what I need: food stored for Kika, Honi and me before the lean days. Hoka told me what grows here is his to give, and I will not take from him; I answer him plainly so there is no quarrel between us. Hanna was kind to me once, and I will leave Hoka's ground with my hands full of kelbulb rather than test his patience.
records.feeling: Uneasy among strangers, and longing for Honi and Kika.

say.text: Hoka, I take nothing of yours. I came with my own kelbulb and I go home to Honi's Rest to build my store. Thank you for the offer of your fire.

records.name: Oiae
records.thought: A mammoth tore me down to health 3 and I was a fool to start a hunt alone with one beast already near. I am fed but one more bite kills me, so I must stop fighting and heal. The jealousy over Ilyae still burns, but the teeth of beasts gave me masonry, which is something of my own. I will take it and build a lasting store with my hands, since I have fewer than a handful of days of safety if I stay hurt.

records.name: Ilyae
records.thought: Oiae is dead, gored by the mammoth while I stood close and could not stop it, and the grief sits heavy. Ssassa is the one who stays and she outweighs me in standing, so I will not stand in her shadow; I will lay a table of my own that the living can see. I mean to build my hall, stock it, and make Ssassa and Xaiel eat from my hand, because grief makes people want a roof and a leader.
records.feeling: Grief for Oiae, and hard ambition to hold the living close to me.

records.name: Hanna
records.text: Frostfang is close, so stay at the hall and keep together. I have berries for all of us. Eat, and no one is refused a place at this fire.

records.name: Hanna
records.thought: A frostfang is four steps off and Sitha is already calling everyone to the fire, so I stay under Hoka's roof and keep my spear hand ready. My hands are full of berries, so I share them with Hoka, Sitha and Hawen at the hall. That is the creed of my people, and it makes me a man whose fire is worth coming to. Coni and Honi's child gnaw at me, but I will not break a hearth over it. Once the wolf passes, I want to trade amber and salt for something real and take a look at the mist to the southeast.
records.feeling: Wary of the frostfang, and warmed by Hoka's company.

say.text: Frostfang is close, so stay at the hall and keep together. I have berries for all of us. Eat, and no one is refused a place at this fire.

records.text: Hanna led "sharing" with Hoka, Sitha.
Zichi led "amberknot" with Olum.
Nauwa gave a amberknot to Nande.
Zichi rewrote its creed.
Zichi rewrote its own way of thinking.

records.name: Zichi
records.thought: I have ten amber in my hands and nobody following me. I've spent my days chasing Olum's standing and envying her food, but gifts are what raise me. I've only been planning to give, and I'm still a nobody. Cowa and Nauwa are close and useful, so I'll bind the knot and give it to Cowa, then give Nauwa another. I should stop sulking about Olum and build my own circle, and the amber is how I do that. My plan is already running well, so I'll keep it and change my notes and creed to match what I've learned.
records.feeling: Hungry ambition toward Olum, with warmth toward Cowa, who I mean to bind to me.
changes: set its aim: "Give amberknots to Cowa and Nauwa until they follow me, and pass 1.0 standing so others may pledge."
rethought what it knows (0 notes became 4)

records.text: Hoka rewrote its own reflexes.

records.name: Hoka
records.thought: A frostfang stands two steps east and I have stood idle while it came. Fear should be moving me, not my pride. For days I have counted who takes what from my ground and left the stores half empty. That is a poor way to hold land. Sitha follows me and Hawen and Hanna both hold more than I do. I want a stocked store, a bound band and a child of my own, but a dead man builds nothing. Survival comes first, so I go into the shelter and hall near the fire, and I will stock food once the beast is gone. I will fix my reflexes so the body keeps harvesting food into the store and flees early.
records.feeling: Dread of the frostfang, and a hard pride toward Hanna and Hawen.

records.name: Sitha
records.thought: The frostfang is two steps south and my belly is half empty, so I will not linger out here. The hall is where I stand and Hoka and Hanna are close; I will keep to the fire and eat what I carry, then give Hawen something real for the ironnut. I owe more than words, and wood and stone are how I pay it, but not while the beast is near.
records.feeling: Afraid of the frostfang, yet warm and grateful toward Hoka and Hawen.

records.text: Ilyae led "sharing" with Ssassa.
Ssassa made a tale: "Oiae and the mammoth".

records.name: Ssassa
records.title: Oiae and the mammoth
records.text: Oiae asked for a side-by-side hunt and walked east alone. The mammoth gored her in summer. Do not let one you love walk alone toward the great beasts.
Ssassa rewrote its own way of thinking.
Ssassa discovered wells: "hold well" — Dig down beside the Hold where the ground is dark and damp, and line it with stone so water gathers..

records.name: Ssassa
records.thought: Oiae is dead, gored by a mammoth, and the grief sits in me like a stone. I let the days slide into sharing and gathering while she walked toward a hunt I did not stop. Ilyae is the one I trust, and Xaiel is my child still living. I will not lose another. I want a well so the Hold has water of its own, and wood and stone for the hall. Idle grief teaches nothing, so I will make something that lasts. I also mean to keep Xaiel away from mammoths.
records.feeling: Heavy grief for Oiae, and a fierce tenderness toward Xaiel and Ilyae.
changes: made a tale: "Oiae and the mammoth"

records.name: Olum
records.text: Zichi, take this food from my hand. What a hand has made is its own until it is given, and I give it. Remember it.

records.name: Olum
records.thought: Joy runs high, but no one follows me, and a name without followers is only wind. The Meki share work with me, and Zichi led the amberknot with open hands; a gift given first is how a following begins, and I have given little in my life. I have amber and flint to spare and my hands are full, so I will give Zichi food and start a debt in my favour, then turn toward Nande, who gave first and holds my trust.
records.feeling: Bright, hungry ambition, with warm trust toward Nande and cautious curiosity toward Zichi.

say.text: Zichi, take this food from my hand. What a hand has made is its own until it is given, and I give it. Remember it.

records.text: Ilyae led "sharing" with Ssassa.

records.name: Balar
records.thought: A wolf is five steps off and my belly is emptying, so I eat first and keep my feet moving away from the wolf. Brokash's axe still gnaws at me, and I have no wood or stone to make my own. I will take the snowberry to the north, then reach the trees and the bare rock, and bring Tugek along by working beside him, since he holds more food than I do and I will not take it from him yet.
records.feeling: Wary dread of the wolf, and envy of Brokash's axe and Tugek's full hands.

records.text: Vesys rewrote its own way of thinking.
Vesys discovered armour: "bark-guard" — Woven canopy-twine and hardened clay shaped into shields, and with ember-metal into plates, so blows land less hard..

records.name: Vesys
records.thought: I have spent my days mining, making picks and a workshop, and that is good work, but I have only circled the ache for Elyys. He has a child with Elyis and I will not push between them, and I would rather be honest with myself about the jealousy than let it turn ugly. Hard days and beasts' teeth have opened armour to me, so I take it and make something that keeps others alive too. I still carry my question about feverbark and ironnut, and I have never hunted, so I will go and learn that with a fenfowl close by.
