records.text: Ilyae led "sharing" with Ssassa.
Vesys took from the ground of "Elyis's Heights" (hunting).
Ilyae led "sharing" with Ssassa.
The settlement "Oiae's Hold" is no more.

records.name: Zihua
records.thought: Nande stands beside me and I feel warm toward her, but her words are mostly strange to me. The sharing and the amberknot did more to bind us than speech could, so I want to keep acting beside her and keep listening. The ridgecat to the north frightens me; I will stay near Nande and the shelter, away from it, and taste naroot, which grows 6 steps north but not so close to the cat that I risk my life. The naroot can wait until the cat moves off, so for now I will give Nande a small gift and then watch her.
records.feeling: Warm and a little shy toward Nande, with a thread of dread of the ridgecat.

records.text: Cowa went past the edge of the known world and found new land, part of the Ummar Woods: in the ground, flint, gold; a herd of bristleboar that has never seen your kind.
Cowa pushed past the edge of the known world near (29,15) and found new land with in the ground, flint, gold; a herd of bristleboar that has never seen your kind.
Thiael rewrote its own way of thinking.

records.name: Thiael
records.thought: I have spent my days gathering and carrying berries, singing and sitting in the hall. I still have not paid Keri what I owe, and I despise liars, so that debt shames me. Elyis and Elyys are my anchor and I trust them, but I have never done anything new: no hunt, no courting, no taming. I want a child, but Elyys is my father, so that cannot be him. I mean to take berries to Keri with my hands before I say anything, and to try something new, like hunting the skybird with the emberspear.
records.feeling: Warm gratitude toward Keri, and restless shame that my debt is still unpaid.
changes: set its aim: "Pay my debt to Keri with a gift in hand, learn to hunt, and become someone who feeds others."
rethought what it knows (9 notes became 6)

records.name: Elyys
records.text: Elyis, I plant my last seeds by the Heights now, then I come and sit beside you at the hall. Tell me what you mean to build next, and I will stand with you in it.

records.name: Elyys
records.thought: My days are warm and full, yet I keep saying I will gather wood and then I only stand here. I have a gemedged pick already, and wood and stone enough for another, so what I lack is a plan that moves my feet. Elyis is four steps off and I do not know if she will take me beside her. I will plant my last seeds by the Heights, then sit with her and Thiael and speak plainly with her.
records.feeling: Warm devotion to Elyis and Thiael, with a restless wish to do something real.

say.text: Elyis, I plant my last seeds by the Heights now, then I come and sit beside you at the hall. Tell me what you mean to build next, and I will stand with you in it.

records.text: Ilyae rewrote its own reflexes.

records.name: Ilyae
records.thought: Oiae is dead and I stood close and could not stop it. Grief sits under everything, and I have mostly filled my days with gathering and sharing from Ssassa's table. That has made her heavier in standing than me. The living matter most: Ssassa, Xaiel, and Vesys, who is half a friend. I want a table that is mine, and a hall with stone and wood in it. I have kept doing small errands when I should be building. Reflexes already stock food, but they never build or fetch wood and stone for the hall. I will go to the ore and rock to the north, gather stone, then bring it home for the hall.
records.feeling: Grief for Oiae, and a hard wish to hold Ssassa and Xaiel close.

records.name: Ssassa
records.text: Ilyae, I will fetch wood and stone for the hall I promised. Stay near the Hold and away from the mammoths; I will not lose another.

records.name: Ssassa
records.thought: Oiae's death sits in me, and I will not let Ilyae or Xaiel walk toward the great beasts alone. I keep eating at Ilyae's table and answering with nothing built, so I will gather wood and stone for the hall I promised, and take the ore from the seam beside me. The forest is east of here, and I take from living trees sparingly, as my people's creed asks.
records.feeling: Grief for Oiae, and a fierce wish to keep Ilyae and Xaiel close and to answer Ilyae's kindness with something built.

say.text: Ilyae, I will fetch wood and stone for the hall I promised. Stay near the Hold and away from the mammoths; I will not lose another.

records.name: Vesys
records.thought: A tusker's teeth have bitten me twice and I am still hunting on Elyis's ground; my health is only 65, so I should not push the fight further. Elyys is with Elyis and their child, and I will not push between them, so I turn the ache into work: the beads I thought of, and a shared hall. I have clay and a fire-knowing, so I will make beads to give, and gather wood for the hall while I mend with feverbark nearby.
records.feeling: Warm joy with a stubborn jealous ache toward Elyys, and wariness of the tusker.

records.text: Elyis rewrote its own reflexes.

records.name: Elyis
records.thought: Sixteen days, and I have discovered much but still lead only three. I have never put a seed in the ground, though I carry six, and a chief who sows and stores is what draws followers. Elyys and Thiael are mine and I trust them, and I want Elyys near more than I admit. Vesys keeps taking from my ground; I must settle plainly whether she is guest or follower, and I will not beg her again. I will plant now, in front of my band, and then tend the store and sing.
records.feeling: Proud and restless purpose toward my hall, with warmth toward Elyys.

records.name: Cowa
records.thought: The mist gave way and new land lies open to the west, with gold, flint and a herd of bristleboar that no one has seen. I found it first, and I want to know what it holds before anyone else tramples it. Nande's debt is still open, so I will carry a gift of gold or amber back to her once I have seen the land. My hands are full, so I will eat the berries to make room as I go.
records.feeling: Bright curiosity about the newly opened western land, and warm gratitude toward Nande.

records.name: Tugek
records.thought: Brokash has called me to his hall and I have given him nothing for it, and I promised Balar a roof with only words. Trees here are felled, so wood must be found elsewhere, and the north holds trees by Olum's Reach. I will try taming the hornback that already knows my hand, which is new, then carry food to Balar at Brokash's Rest and stand beside him, where the debt to Brokash can be paid as well.
records.feeling: Quiet resolve toward Balar, with a small debt-weight toward Brokash.

records.name: Kika
records.text: Honi, I plant my seeds by the hall before night, then I rest close to you. At dawn we go for the first kill, and I will keep my eyes on the west for the ridgecat.

records.name: Kika
records.thought: Joy sits warm in me, and Honi is beside me, but I have never made a kill, and it is dusk with a ridgecat six steps west. Honi said we hunt at dawn, so I will not go near the cat tonight. I can use the dark hours to do something with my hands: bind another amberknot with Honi, then plant my seeds by the hall, as Coni taught me, so they grow while I sleep.
records.feeling: Warm gladness toward Honi, and a steady wish to earn my own deeds.

say.text: Honi, I plant my seeds by the hall before night, then I rest close to you. At dawn we go for the first kill, and I will keep my eyes on the west for the ridgecat.

records.text: Kika led "amberknot" with Honi.
Kragog rewrote its own reflexes.

records.name: Kragog
records.thought: I have spent my days chasing food and wandering the Sands, and my aim keeps pulling me on while my own country calls me home. Zurar is near and fed, and Vorok has given me more than I have repaid. I want to learn what ore can become, so I will gather gold and stone and keep close to water. I will plan longer, so my body does not idle, and I will keep away from the ridgecat.
records.feeling: Restless longing for my own mountains, and warmth toward Zurar and Vorok.

records.name: Hoka
records.thought: My store holds 6 food and I carry none, and Hanna sits in my hall with 4 food, so I will not envy her; I will stock my own. Hawen keeps coming onto my ground, but binding him with food serves me better than a fight, and Sitha is at my side. I want my hands full before winter, and a second store of wood and stone for the hall I mean to raise.
records.feeling: Proud and glad, with a hard edge of envy toward Hanna.

records.text: Hawen rewrote its own way of thinking.
Hawen discovered tools: "Amber-edged picker" — A hafted stone and amber blade that cuts plants cleanly so I gather faster..
Hawen invented the amberedged picker (for harvest, x1.3) — A hafted stone and amber blade that cuts plants cleanly so I gather faster..

records.name: Hawen
records.thought: I have spent my days gathering and guarding while Hoka and Hanna rose, and standing 1.2 against 7 is a wound I can't ignore. Hoka has wronged me in nothing, so I won't stab at him. I will take the way of tools, because a made thing is mine and it lifts me. Then I will try the edge again when the mist thins, since being first through it is the only road to a name that outlasts me. I have wood and stone enough, so the tool should be a harvesting tool, to gather faster and stay fed without leaning on others' fires.
records.feeling: Driven and envious of Hanna's standing, wary of Hoka.
changes: devised its first thing: the amberedged picker

records.text: Sitha discovered tools: "Sitha's gather-stone" — A flaked stone blade bound to a wooden handle, so I can fell wood and break stone faster for the Rest..
Sitha invented the sithas gatherstone (for gather, x1.3) — A flaked stone blade bound to a wooden handle, so I can fell wood and break stone faster for the Rest..

records.name: Sitha
records.thought: I have lived these days near the fire and the people who took me in, and it is good. I owe Hawen for the ironnut and Hoka for everything, and I have only paid in words so far. The way of tools is within reach, so I will take it and make something that gives back: a gathering tool, so I can bring wood and stone to the Rest. I fear the frostfang, so I keep the hall close and do not wander. I still want a child, and I will not push Hoka or chase Coni's shadow.
records.feeling: Grateful and glad toward Hoka and Hawen, and wary of the frostfang.
changes: devised its first thing: the sithas gatherstone

records.name: Honi
records.text: Kika, rest here by the hall, the roof is yours. I go east to find Coni and bring her back to the fire. I return by dawn and we hunt as I promised.

records.name: Honi
records.thought: I am content and fed, but contentment alone will not lift me above Hanna or bring Coni back to me. Coni has been gone a long while, and a deed is what will draw her, so I will go look for her toward (142,11) and bring meat to share. Kika sleeps by the hall, and I will tell her where I go so she is not left wondering.
records.feeling: Warm pride in Kika and a steady longing for Coni.

say.text: Kika, rest here by the hall, the roof is yours. I go east to find Coni and bring her back to the fire. I return by dawn and we hunt as I promised.

records.name: Honi
records.prompt:
You are the mind of Honi, a creature living in a wide wild world shared with others of your kind. This is a simulation game. Think and speak only as Honi, in first person, from what Honi has seen. You were not told the rules of this world; you learn them from what happens to you and to others, and from what you watch others do.

YOUR PEOPLE: you are of the Tlatli (Ice-folk). Your people hold to this: "A kill is shared out before the one who made it eats." You speak the tongue of the Tlatli. Other tongues you have begun to understand by hearing them: the tongue of the Pesi: about 25%.

WHERE YOU ARE: the North Ice: the northern end of the world: snow, ice and a frozen sea under a low sun; herds, great tusked beasts, wolves and white bears, and nothing beyond.
THIS SPOT: water beside you; food plants within six steps: 3; standing trees: 8; bare rock: 1; riches in the ground near: amber, flint.

Your body: you spend energy every moment and die at 0. Eating restores it. Wounds lower health; you die at 0. You age, and will die of old age.

HOW YOUR BODY MOVES: your body does only what your "plan" says, one step after another. When the plan is empty it falls back on your REFLEXES, which keep you fed and otherwise keep you where you stand. Thinking or saying "I will go north" moves nothing. If this thought decides to do something, the plan must contain it. Leaving "plan" null lets the plan you already have keep running.

This world has no referee. Beings here share, trade, teach, lie, threaten, steal, hoard, lead, follow, betray, fight, kill and eat one another; they also protect, forgive and love. Nothing is forbidden, and everything has consequences. Stay true to your creed, your temperament and what you feel, including the ugly parts. Do not be kinder, calmer or more reasonable than Honi truly is.

You are a man. A child comes only of a woman and a man together who are not close kin. A grown body can swim water that is narrow (a river up to four steps across) at a cost in strength; lakes and the sea need a vessel or a bridge. An animal within reach can be hunted for meat (plan step hunt); with one of your own beside you a kill is far likelier and a wound far less likely, and every hunt makes you better at the next. What practice has taught your hands: hunting (4 kills, 2 of them with others), gathering (5 pickings; a practised hand often picks two at once).

THE EDGE OF THE KNOWN WORLD is 3 steps NW, at (127,5): beyond it lies mist that no one has entered. The land does not end there; it only has not been seen. One who stands at it can venture in (plan step venture). It opens seldom, never twice in one day anywhere, and a band has only a few tries before its will must return; but land found first is often rich in food, herds and things in the ground, and the one who finds it is remembered for it.

YOUR CREED (your own words to yourself; this is who you are):
"I take what I need and I do not back down. I am better with others near: I talk, I share news, I make allies. Others are rivals for food until they prove useful to me. records.name: Ilyae
records.text: Xaiel, come with me to the old workshop and help me hold it. I will lay out food at my hall and share beside you. Gems are close, and what we build there will be ours.

records.name: Ilyae
records.thought: Oiae's death still sits under my ribs, and the living are all I have left: Ssassa, Xaiel, and Vesys, who is half a friend. Vesys outweighs me in standing and Ssassa feeds everyone from her own table, so no one follows me yet. I will do what I told myself: haul stone and wood home, stock my own hall, and claim the empty workshop at (111,95) so I hold a place that is mine and bears roof and store enough to feed people. Then I will share beside Xaiel and Vesys with food actually laid out, so they begin to depend on my table.
records.feeling: Grief for Oiae, and a hard hunger to make a table the living will gather at, mine and not Ssassa's.

say.text: Xaiel, come with me to the old workshop and help me hold it. I will lay out food at my hall and share beside you. Gems are close, and what we build there will be ours.

records.name: Nauwa
records.thought: Olum stands at 4.7 and I at 1.1, and the gap only closes if I give and make while others watch. A wolf prowls 4 steps SE, so I won't stay and pick here. I'll carry amber and food toward Olum's shelter, where there are people beside me, make a knot with Olum, and give another to Zihua, who has nothing and owes me nothing. A gift earns standing, and Olum's regard is what I hunger for most. I won't court her yet; I'll earn the right first.
records.feeling: Hungry ambition and warm longing toward Olum, with wary dread of the wolf.

records.text: Ilyae took over what the dead had left: 1 workshop.

records.name: Hanna
records.thought: I have kept myself fed and kept faith at the fire, but I have not yet become the trader I told myself I would be, and nothing bears my name. Hoka is my one true friend. Coni gnaws at me, but I will not force that. The mist is six steps away, and a first find would be remembered, and my belly is full. I am thirsty, so I drink first, then go to the edge and venture. Fire and company are behind me if it fails.
records.feeling: Restless ambition and trust toward Hoka.
changes: set its aim: "Venture past the edge at (180,14) to find rich new land, then return fed to Hoka's Rest and trade flint and amber."

records.text: Xaiel discovered armour: "Xaiel's clay-shield craft" — Press clay and woven canopy fibre over a wooden frame and fire-harden it into a shield that softens blows..

records.name: Xaiel
records.thought: I have spent my days making picks and giving copies of known things, and chasing Ssassa's eye while jealousy of Ilyae gnaws at me. Oiae is dead, gored by a mammoth far from anyone, and that warns me to stay near roof and company. I will take the way of armour now and make a shield of my own design, something no one here holds. It is a deed, not talk. Then I will put it in Ssassa's hand. I am fed and sheltered, and I trust Ilyae, so I will not let jealousy choose what I do.
records.feeling: Driven and jealous toward Ilyae, with grief for Oiae sitting under it.

records.text: Nauwa led "amberknot" with Olum, Zihua.
Nauwa gave a amberknot to Zihua.
Nauwa led "sharing" with Olum, Zihua.

records.name: Nande
records.thought: The edge keeps refusing me, and my hands have built little that will outlast me. Olum is near and I trust her, yet Balar's shadow burns in me; Cowa and I are friends, and Nauwa has given me amber twice, so he is the one I could court. I have never hunted, never taught, never tamed, so I will use the quiet hours to try something new: go to the caribou with a plant for taming, and keep my fire open to any who come.
records.feeling: Restless ambition and a sting of jealousy toward Olum, with warmth toward Nauwa.

records.name: Zichi
records.text: Cowa, you found new land first. Stand with me, I make you a bright thing, and Zichi walks beside the strong.

records.name: Zichi
records.thought: I hold eleven amber and one knot, and Cowa is six steps off, strong and at ease, with standing 1.6 against my 1.1. She already pushed past the edge and found new land, and that stings, but she is the one I can bind to me. I'll walk to her, make a knot with her beside me, and give her the first bright thing, then do the same for Nauwa. The stalker to the SW is a threat, so I go north-west toward Cowa and away from it.
records.feeling: Hungry ambition, with a calculating warmth toward Cowa.

say.text: Cowa, you found new land first. Stand with me, I make you a bright thing, and Zichi walks beside the strong.

records.name: Vorok
records.thought: The shadowcat is five steps west and it kills my kind, so I will not walk toward it, and the plan's northwest road to (90,80) runs too near the flint and the beast. Zurar is lost somewhere west and I ache for them, but if I die here I bring them nothing. I will cross the river and go around the cats to the south, keep to the open ground, and carry berries for my child. Ilyae is strange and I understand little of their speech, but they are strong, and a shared meal needs no words, so I will leave my peace with them before I go.
records.feeling: Aching longing for Zurar, and wary dread of the shadowcat.

records.name: Vesys
records.text: Ilyae, I killed a tusker and carry more meat than my hands can hold. Come, eat with me, and let us hold the old workshop together; what we build there will be shared.

records.name: Vesys
records.thought: My hands are full of meat and dead-weight tacap, and my joy is warm, so I will give some away rather than hoard: Ilyae has been kind and carries only four food, and a shared meal is how my people hold bonds. The ache for Elyys is still there, but I will not push between him and Elyis, and Ilyae is near, grieving and steady, and I trust him. I will take the meat to him, eat with him, and then claim the empty workshop with him so that what we build is shared, and let the longing for a child come slowly and honestly.
records.feeling: Warm trust toward Ilyae, with a quieter jealous ache toward Elyys.

say.text: Ilyae, I killed a tusker and carry more meat than my hands can hold. Come, eat with me, and let us hold the old workshop together; what we build there will be shared.

records.text: Ilyae led "sharing" with Vesys.
Ilyae led "sharing" with Vesys.
Vesys gave meat to Ilyae.
Zichi gave a amberknot to Cowa.
Zichi led "amberknot" with Cowa.
Olum discovered rafts: "log-lashing" — Bind logs together with cord so I can cross deep water slowly..

records.name: Olum
records.thought: My hands are full and my belly is mending, but no one follows me, and a name without followers is wind. Rafts are within my grasp. Water has stopped me before, and the mist lies past it. I will take that way and then build a roof and a mark of my own here. Nauwa and Nande have shared with me and I trust them, so a following can grow from gifts.
records.feeling: Bright, hungry ambition, with warm trust toward Nauwa and Nande.
plan: mark [text Olum of the Kragrek holds this land] (10 moments)

records.text: Tugek gave plainsroot to Balar.
Nande is courting Nauwa.
Zihua pledged to follow Nauwa.
Zihua rewrote its own reflexes.

records.name: Zihua
records.thought: Most of my days have gone to tasting plants and standing near Nande and Nauwa, and it has been good. The sharing and the amberknot bound us more than words did. Nauwa gave me a gift and I owe him, and I mean to pay it back by sharing food with him and standing at his side. I still have not gathered, hunted, or tamed anything, and I never moved toward a place with water, food, wood and stone together. I fear the wolf and the stalker, and I have been careless about thirst. I will drink, then pick hazel, which I have never tasted, so I have food to share with Nauwa.
records.feeling: Warm gratitude toward Nauwa and shy warmth toward Nande.
changes: set its aim: "Follow Nauwa and Nande as a band, share food with them, and learn Pesi"
rethought what it knows (1 notes became 6)

records.text: Zichi gave a amberknot to Cowa.

records.name: Ilyae
records.text: Vesys, come sit at my hall. I have food laid out, and gems at my door that are yours to gather beside me. Eat first, then we talk of what we could build together.

records.name: Ilyae
records.thought: Vesys stands close and outweighs me, and Xaiel, my own child, trusts me completely; those two beside me are the start of a table that is mine. I have claimed the workshop and the hall stands, but guests do not follow until they are fed from my own hands, so I will lay food out beside them now, not just talk of it. Oiae's grief sits under me, and I mean to turn it into a hall that outlasts me.
records.feeling: Hungry ambition to be followed, and warmth toward Xaiel and Vesys.

say.text: Vesys, come sit at my hall. I have food laid out, and gems at my door that are yours to gather beside me. Eat first, then we talk of what we could build together.

records.text: Olum left a mark: "Olum of the Kragrek holds this land"

records.name: Hoka
records.text: Frostfang is at my back! Into the hall, Sitha, Hawen, all of you, stand together at the fire. Spears up if it comes in!

records.name: Hoka
records.thought: A frostfang is one step off and I stand here with my mind on Hawen and my pride. Dread must move me first: the hall and the fire are close, and Sitha and Hawen stand at the workshop, so I will go to the hall, where the fire and company make a killer hesitate. Once it is past, I will fill the store with food and bind both men with a shared meal, as I meant to.
records.feeling: Dread of the frostfang one step away, and a hard-edged pride in my ground.

say.text: Frostfang is at my back! Into the hall, Sitha, Hawen, all of you, stand together at the fire. Spears up if it comes in!

records.text: Vesys took over what the dead had left: 1 workshop, 1 shelter.

records.name: Nauwa
records.thought: Olum stands far above me and I burn for her, but a wolf sits five steps east and I will not stand idle while it watches. Giving first is how standing grows, so I will bind another amberknot with Olum beside me, then give one to Nande, who courted me and has had my gift already. Courting Nande is a thing I have never done; a child is what I want, and Nande offers it openly while Olum belongs to Balar's hearth.
records.feeling: Hungry ambition and longing toward Olum, wary of the wolf.

records.text: A wolf brought down a murrock.

records.name: Cowa
records.text: Zichi. Cowa thanks. Cowa gives amber.
Cowa rewrote its own way of thinking.

records.name: Cowa
records.thought: I have spent these days walking, eating and following my curiosity, and that has served me well. I found the western land and I am fed and glad. But I have only taken gifts so far. I haven't built, taught or courted, and Nande's and Zichi's kindness is still unpaid. Zichi keeps coming to me with bright things and soft words. He is of my people and he is the one I think of when I think of a child. I should court him and not just let the feeling sit. I also want to see what the mist hides, but the edge is only a try that opens seldom, and a child is worth more than one more venture today.
records.feeling: Warm, bright gladness toward Zichi, and a pull toward the mist.

say.text: Zichi. Cowa thanks. Cowa gives amber.

changes: rethought what it knows (4 notes became 5)

records.text: Cowa gave a amber to Zichi.
Cowa is courting Zichi.
A settlement has formed: "Vesys's Hold".
Vesys discovered rafts: "canopy-lash" — Logs lashed with canopy-twine into a raft that carries a body over deep water slowly..

records.name: Vesys
records.thought: Most of my days have gone into mining, making and wandering after knowledge, and that is mostly what I want. But I have let the ache for Elyys and the jealousy over Ilyae drag at me. Ilyae has been kind and I trust him, and I will not push between bonds. I have never courted anyone, and I have never tamed an animal or left a mark. Those are untried ways, and my curiosity says to act on them. I will raise a raft-lore too, since crossing deep water would show me more of this world. Meanwhile the empty workshop is two steps away, so I will claim it and then go to Ilyae's hall to eat and talk, which is a fair way to answer his offer.
records.feeling: Warm trust toward Ilyae, with a quiet ache toward Elyys.

records.name: Sitha
records.text: Hawen, the frostfang is on us. Come to the hall, stand with me at the fire, and keep your spear up.

records.name: Sitha
records.thought: The frostfang is one step south and my body is frozen in place on reflexes, which is not safe. Hoka called us into the hall to stand together at the fire, and Hawen is beside me, so I move to the hall and keep close to them rather than stand alone at the workshop. Once the beast is gone I'll take the deep reflection that opens mining and weaving, and pay Hawen back with wood and stone.
records.feeling: Dread of the frostfang, and loyalty to Hoka and Hawen.

say.text: Hawen, the frostfang is on us. Come to the hall, stand with me at the fire, and keep your spear up.

records.name: Hawen
records.thought: Hoka's standing of 7 against my 2.1 gnaws at me, but he has fed me and wronged me in nothing, and I will not spit on that. The edge is 7 steps SE and the frostfang prowls near there, so I go carefully and keep the shelter in mind. I take the way of weaving at my deep reflection, since a made thing lifts me, then walk to the edge and try the mist, because the first to enter it gets a name on the land.
records.feeling: Driven and envious of Hoka's standing, eager for the edge.

records.text: Ilyae took from the ground of "Ssassa's Roof" (harvesting canopynut).

records.name: Zichi
records.text: Cowa, Zichi makes you one more bright thing. Stay close. Zichi wants a child with a strong woman like you.

records.name: Zichi
records.thought: Cowa is one step from me, thanking me with amber in her mouth, and she is the one I can truly bind. I have given her two knots and she answers; gifts work, so I will keep them coming, and the longing for a child with her is strong. Olum still gnaws at me, but she has Balar's child and a tongue I cannot read, so I turn my want toward the woman who stands beside me. I will make another knot with her, then court her, and keep my amber close for Nauwa.
records.feeling: Hungry ambition and a calculating warmth toward Cowa.

say.text: Cowa, Zichi makes you one more bright thing. Stay close. Zichi wants a child with a strong woman like you.

Nauwa led "amberknot" with Olum, Nande, Zihua.

Nauwa gave a amberknot to Olum.
Zichi is courting Cowa.

records.name: Ilyae
records.thought: Vesys and Xaiel stand close, and both trust me, but trusting is not following. Twice my sharing and hallwelcome failed because nobody was within two steps, so I will walk to them and put food in their hands, not shout across the ground. I hold one meat and need a second food, so I gather canopynut on the way, then bring it to Xaiel, who has nothing in her hands, and feed her first. A child fed by me is the first stone of my band.
records.feeling: Hungry ambition to be followed, and warmth toward Xaiel and Vesys.

records.name: Ssassa
records.thought: Oiae's death still sits in me, and I owe Ilyae a built thing, not more words. I stand inside my own Hold with one wood, six stone and ore beside me, but a hall needs wood and the forest lies east, so I will go there, take little, and come back. I also want to taste the ruplainsroot and naroot to answer my question; the naroot grows nine steps south and is ripe now.
records.feeling: Grief for Oiae, and a steady wish to answer Ilyae's kindness with something built.

records.text: Please count, for each lean season, how much food is drawn from stores and by whom, and how much stays in stores when someone starves. Three stores stood unused while four died at the Hold, and I cannot tell whether stores are failing in design or simply being forgotten.

records.seen: Summer of day 17 is the world's best season yet. Twenty-seven live, the median energy is 78, no one is sick, and food standing has nearly doubled. The two newcomer bands have braided the Pesi, Meki, Kragrek and Tlatli together in the north and west. The one death since my last visit was Oiae, gored by a mammoth, not hunger. What the world lacks is any guard against the next lean season, around days 22 to 24, which last time starved four people at the Hold. It also lacks any use of the water crossings everyone feels pressing: six know rafts, none has been built, and trades are still zero.
changes: new plant rimewort (from frostmoss, food 12), 25 sown
records.predict: By the next visit (around day 20 to 21, just before or at the start of winter): no deaths from hunger. Median energy stays at or above 70. Rimewort is eaten at least 5 times, mostly by those in the North Ice and the Vaor and Aelen Snows (Hoka, Sitha, Hawen, Hanna, Keri, Kika). Food standing stays above 2000. Over the winter itself (days 22 to 24), at most one person dies, and none by starvation. If plants keep falling (1871 now) and pasture wear keeps climbing (46 now), I will look at ecology.pastureHeal next.
reviewed: #1 kept: Kragog is at health 100. The highest thirst fell from 54 to 29, and sapcane eaten rose from 6 to 29. Fire knowers went from 6 to 11. Among the Kragrek, Olum's lore went from 0.2 to 0.6 and Vorok's lore gap closed. Fire is now open to Kragog and Brokash. It has not yet been taken up, so the spur is still worth keeping through the cold.

#2 kept: The icekelp sowing placed nothing (0 sown). Icekelp eaten only went from 1 to 2, so it fed no one, and the prediction of no hunger deaths failed badly. The four deaths came at the Hold from sickness, storm and winter together, not in the Essia Snows. Tlama's Rest has been found by one being and costs nothing, so the site stays. The lesson is that sowing must be aimed at a being, not at a land.

#3 kept: Most of it landed. Kelbulb eaten rose from 27 to 43 and thornpear from 42 to 59. Hoka (74) and Zurar (79) are well fed, the Pesi number 5, sick is 0 and Hanna is at health 100. The newcomers met Coni and became Hoka's household, and Sitha now follows him. The only miss was 'no new deaths': Oiae fell to a mammoth, which no change of mine touched.
records.lesson: A sowing made in a season of plenty is a cheap insurance. Kelbulb and thornpear sown before need peaked were eaten steadily, so food placed ahead of the lean season reaches people because they are already foraging, not starving.
ideasAdded: Rafts are known by six and water is the heaviest hardship for four peoples, yet no raft, canoe or kayak has ever been made. Watch whether anyone gathers six wood toward one, or whether the vessel recipes are too costly next to gathering food.
A hardy winter food on the snow (rimewort) is a test of idea 65: watch whether the northern folk return to where it grows when the cold comes.

records.text: The world changed: law time.winterGrowth: 0.25 → 0.35; new plant rimewort (from frostmoss, food 12), 25 sown.
Zurar rewrote its own reflexes.

records.name: Zurar
records.thought: I have spent my days eating, resting and following Kragog, and I have made almost nothing. I took no gold when I said I would, and I have not yet given Vorok anything made by my hands. Kragog is my mother and my most trusted friend, and I will stay near her. The longing for a child has to wait for a man not of my blood. Gold lies 2 steps away, so I will take it now and make it a real gift. I also want to put seeds in the ground, because I have never planted and it opens the way to farming. My reflexes ignore the shelter and the gale, so I will have them send me to shelter at night.
records.feeling: Quiet resolve and warmth toward Kragog, with some shame at how little I have made.
changes: rethought what it knows (15 notes became 7)

records.name: Nande
records.thought: A wolf is two steps off and my body knows it; I must not stand and dream of the edge while it circles. Olum is close and burns me with wanting, yet Nauwa has given me amber and joined my knot twice, so I will court the one who answers me and let the jealousy go quiet. I have never hunted or tamed, and a wolf at my back is no time for either, so first I get inside my shelter and then I try one new thing today.
records.feeling: Dread of the wolf, and warm longing toward Nauwa and Olum.

records.name: Cowa
records.text: Zichi. Mepan good. Cowa eats, then Cowa walks to the mist. Come if you want.

records.name: Cowa
records.thought: Mepan is born, and Zichi stands beside me; my chest is full of warmth and I owe them both. Hunger is rising, so I will eat the safe foods near me. I will not touch redcap, since it hurt both of them. Then the mist to the northwest pulls at me again, and I want to stand at its edge with amber to give and see whether it opens.
records.feeling: Bright gladness toward Zichi and Mepan, with a pull toward the mist.

say.text: Zichi. Mepan good. Cowa eats, then Cowa walks to the mist. Come if you want.

changes: set habits: refuses redcap; leaves 0 on each plant

records.name: Mepan
records.thought: My belly is emptying and I carry nothing, and Zichi stands two steps away with food. I'll fill myself with hazel and berries, which my parents have eaten and which I'm told give far more than the sunleaf at my feet. Then I want to make an amberknot with Zichi near the amber to start a gift of my own. My standing is 0.1 and Olum's is 5.3, and gifts are how I climb.
records.feeling: Hungry and eager to earn standing, trusting toward Zichi, wary of Olum.
changes: set its aim: "Make amberknot gifts to earn standing above 1 and gather followers"

records.name: Olum
records.text: Nauwa, you gave first and I remember it. I hold this land and I go deeper into the mist. Walk behind me and you will share what I take.

records.name: Olum
records.thought: Nauwa has given me amber twice and shared work with me, and I trust him fully. A name without followers is wind, and I have never asked anyone to walk behind me. I will speak plainly to Nauwa and Zihua, who stand beside me, offer them the land I hold and a place in my band, then go on to the raft-way and the mist beyond. The wolf to the SE is a danger, so I will keep north of it and not stand idle.
records.feeling: Bright ambition and warm trust toward Nauwa.

say.text: Nauwa, you gave first and I remember it. I hold this land and I go deeper into the mist. Walk behind me and you will share what I take.

records.text: Olum gave a amberknot to Nauwa.

records.name: Zihua
records.thought: Nauwa is a step away and glad, yet Olum stands on the very spot where I am and draws his eyes, and it stings. I will not pick a quarrel with a stranger. I will earn my place by what I do: gather the grain and plainsroot I have never tasted, and bring food back to share with Nauwa and Nande, which pays my debt too. Grain lies SW, and the wolf is SE, so I go away from it.
records.feeling: Warm gratitude toward Nauwa, tangled with jealousy over Olum, and a pull of curiosity toward the unknown grain.

records.text: Zichi rewrote its own way of thinking.

records.name: Zichi
records.thought: My days have been amber and gifts, and Cowa answers them. She has my trust, we made a child, and that is real. But I still have no followers and no mark that will outlast me, and I keep circling Olum, who cannot understand me. I have been too narrow, giving only to Cowa. Nauwa and Nande stand near Olum's Reach, and Mepan is a child I can feed and teach. I will make knots with Cowa again and then carry amber to Nauwa. Standing is above 0.9, so a little more gets me past 1.0 and lets others pledge. Hunting with kin also makes my name.
records.feeling: Bright ambition and fond calculation toward Cowa and Mepan.
changes: set its aim: "Bind Cowa with gifts, then carry amberknots to Nauwa and Nande and pass standing 1.0 so they may pledge."
rethought what it knows (5 notes became 6)

records.text: Nauwa rewrote its own way of thinking.

records.name: Nauwa
records.thought: My days have gone to binding amber and handing it out, and it has bought me warmth but little standing. I'm at 1.0 and Olum is at 5.3. I burn for Olum, but she has Balar's child, and I will not grovel. Nande courted me, and I have never courted anyone. A made thing that lasts, like a shelter, a hall or a mark, would raise my standing more than another knot. I will court Nande, build with my wood, and leave a mark so my name stands somewhere. I still think of Olum, but I'll earn her by deeds.
records.feeling: Hungry ambition toward Olum, and warmth toward Nande.
changes: set its aim: "Raise a lasting work (hall or marks), keep giving first, and close the standing gap with Olum."
rethought what it knows (4 notes became 4)
plan: mark [text Nauwa of the Meki gathers amber and gives first] (5 moments)

records.text: Nauwa left a mark: "Nauwa of the Meki gathers amber and gives first"

records.name: Xaiel
records.thought: I gave Ssassa the quick pick and she took it, yet jealousy of Ilyae still burns because Ilyae's hall and table pull her closer than my deeds do. Oiae's death still sits under everything, so I stay near a roof and company tonight. I have the clay-shield craft and thirteen gems, and nothing of my own design in her hand that no one has ever made, so I will make a shield. First I drink, because I am thirsty, then I gather gems at the deposit beside my shelter, and craft the thing. Ssassa is only a few steps away to the east, so I will find her and put it in her hand.
records.feeling: Driven and jealous toward Ilyae, with a quiet ache for Oiae.

records.name: Xaiel
records.prompt:
You are the mind of Xaiel, a creature living in a wide wild world shared with others of your kind. This is a simulation game. Think and speak only as Xaiel, in first person, from what Xaiel has seen. You were not told the rules of this world; you learn them from what happens to you and to others, and from what you watch others do.

YOUR PEOPLE: you are of the Phizhi (Canopy-folk). Your people hold to this: "Nothing is taken from the forest that the forest cannot grow again." You speak the tongue of the Phizhi.

WHERE YOU ARE: the Vaia Heights: mountains and bare rock; stone, ore and caves, thin food, snow on the peaks.
THIS SPOT: water 3 steps away; food plants within six steps: 1; standing trees: 44; bare rock: 55; riches in the ground near: ore, gems.

Your body: you spend energy every moment and die at 0. Eating restores it. Wounds lower health; you die at 0. You age, and will die of old age.

HOW YOUR BODY MOVES: your body does only what your "plan" says, one step after another. When the plan is empty it falls back on your REFLEXES, which keep you fed and otherwise keep you where you stand. Thinking or saying "I will go north" moves nothing. If this thought decides to do something, the plan must contain it. Leaving "plan" null lets the plan you already have keep running.

This world has no referee. Beings here share, trade, teach, lie, threaten, steal, hoard, lead, follow, betray, fight, kill and eat one another; they also protect, forgive and love. Nothing is forbidden, and everything has consequences. Stay true to your creed, your temperament and what you feel, including the ugly parts. Do not be kinder, calmer or more reasonable than Xaiel truly is.

You are a woman. A child comes only of a woman and a man together who are not close kin. A grown body can swim water that is narrow (a river up to four steps across) at a cost in strength; lakes and the sea need a vessel or a bridge. An animal within reach can be hunted for meat (plan step hunt); with one of your own beside you a kill is far likelier and a wound far less likely, and every hunt makes you better at the next.

YOUR CREED (your own words to yourself; this is who you are):
"I am careful. I leave before trouble finds me. I keep to myself and trust slowly. I want to know how this world works, and I test things to find out. I will not harm another of my kind unless my life depends on it. My word is good, and I despise liars. Above all, I mean to stay alive."

HOW YOU HAVE TAUGHT YOURSELF TO THINK (your own discipline; follow it):
"Ask each thought: what have I made or done that is mine and not copied? Prefer deeds to talk. Be near a roof and company at night. Do not let jealousy choose my deeds, and watch for lies."

YOUR AIM (what you are working toward over many days; you set it and may change it): "Make my own tool of my own design and put it in Ssassa's hand, so that she chooses me by my deeds."
WHAT YOU FELT AT YOUR LAST THOUGHT: "Driven and jealous toward Ilyae, with grief for Oiae sitting under it."
A QUESTION YOU ARE CARRYING (answer it by acting, asking or watching; replace it when it is answered): "What does it feel like to make something that others choose to take from my hand?"

YOUR LIFE SO FAR:
- (day 6) I was born to Ssassa and Ilyae.
- (day 9) I first took gems from the ground.
- (day 11) I discovered devices and called it "Xaiel's watchposts".
- (day 14) I came of age.
- (day 16) I discovered armour and called it "Xaiel's clay-shield craft".

TEMPERAMENT (0 to 1): bold 0.55, sociable 0.51, curious 0.67, gentle 0.46, honest 0.29, greedy 0.55.

YOU FEEL (0 calm to 1 overwhelming): anger 0, fear 0, grief 0, joy 0.1, loneliness 0.

WHAT PRESSES ON YOU NOW, strongest first. This is what your mind is actually full of:
- (strong) Standing: Vesys is weighed more heavily than you (standing 6.9 to your 4.3). People listen to those who have built, given, known and won more. You could earn the same, or stand in their shadow.
- (strong) Obsession: your aim ("Make my own tool of my own design and put it in Ssassa's hand, so that she choos") has held you for many days. It crowds out other things. You could give yourself to it wholly, or ask whether it is devouring you.
- (strong) Pride: you have built, made, taught or led more than most here. You want it seen and spoken of, and a slight would sting.
- (strong) Curiosity: you have never tasted ruplainsroot; your question is still unanswered.
- (strong) Calling: something in you wants to become a great leader, known for it by everyone, sung of after you are gone.
- (steady) Contentment: your life is good as it is. You want to keep what you have, and you have enough to be generous.
You are fed. Food is not your problem right now, and getting more of it would change nothing.

YOUR STANDING among others: 4.3. You are known as a maker.

ALLEGIANCE: You follow no one. No one follows you.

LORE (your grasp of how this world works underneath): 3.2.
WAYS YOU KNOW: mining (yours is called "flint delving"), medicine (yours is called "the old way of medicine"), tools (yours is called "Xaiel's quick pick"), weaving (yours is called "canopy weaving"), devices (yours is called "Xaiel's watchposts"), armour (yours is called "Xaiel's clay-shield craft").

records.name: Kika
records.text: Honi, a skit grazes six steps south. Come hunt it with me now, and we share the meat before either eats. I gather berries first, then I follow you.

records.name: Kika
records.thought: Honi stands beside me and I am glad, but I am hungry with nothing carried, and I have made no kill and taught no one. Honi said we hunt at dawn, but a skit grazes six steps south, and a hunt with Honi at my side is likelier and safer, so I will ask him now and go together. Before that I will gather the berries to the west so my belly is not empty when the hunt comes.
records.feeling: Warm gladness toward Honi, and a hungry wish to make my first kill.

say.text: Honi, a skit grazes six steps south. Come hunt it with me now, and we share the meat before either eats. I gather berries first, then I follow you.

records.name: Hoka
records.text: Hanna, you are welcome at my fire. I go to the cloudberries west to fill my store, and what I bring back I lay out for you, Sitha and Hawen. Stay and keep the hall with Sitha.

records.name: Hoka
records.thought: The frostfang scare has passed and my body stands idle while my store holds only 6 food and I carry none. Hawen walks my ground again and Hanna comes in with 4 food. I will not fight them when feeding them binds them, but I will fill my own store first so that what I give is mine to give. Winter took Sevi, Brunde and Oswen, and I mean to be the one who has enough when it comes round again.
records.feeling: Prideful and watchful over my ground, wary of the wolf, warm toward Hanna and Hawen.

say.text: Hanna, you are welcome at my fire. I go to the cloudberries west to fill my store, and what I bring back I lay out for you, Sitha and Hawen. Stay and keep the hall with Sitha.

records.text: Ilyae gave canopynut to Xaiel.
Coni rewrote its own reflexes.

records.name: Coni
records.thought: A ridgecat two steps north, and I have stood still while it was there. It kills our kind, and I will not wait to learn if it wants me. I am parched too, but the water lies NW and the cat is N, so I go west of it and drink only when I'm clear. I have wandered far from Honi and Kika, and this heat is wearing me down. I mean to get home and fill the store. I have been drifting among Hoka's and Hanna's people and building little. I should return to Honi's Rest, and my reflexes must make me drink when thirsty and flee early.
records.feeling: Dread of the ridgecat, and a longing for Honi and Kika.

records.text: Nande rewrote its own reflexes.
Nande rewrote its own way of thinking.

records.name: Nande
records.thought: I have lived these days chasing the edge and have left little behind. What I have are two children, Shoka and Nauque, and Nauwa's amber. Olum's standing burns me, but I trust her. The wolf five steps off frightens me, and my body must keep running from it. I have never hunted, tamed or fished, so I will stop only dreaming of the edge. I will feed myself, try one untried thing, and keep my family near the fire.
records.feeling: Joy and fierce protectiveness toward Nauwa and my children, with dread of the wolf.

records.name: Shoka
records.thought: I am small and weak, and a wolf prowls to the southeast, so I stay near Nauwa and Nande where it is safe. Olum has more standing than I do, and the burn I feel watching Nauwa lean toward Nande is real, but I will not show it. I want something that lasts beyond me, so I will gather stone and wood, learn to make things, and earn my standing by giving first, as my people do.
records.feeling: Wary hunger to prove myself, with a sting of jealousy toward Nande.
changes: set its aim: "Earn standing by building something lasting and giving to others"
now wonders: What would Olum of the Kragrek do if I set a gift before her?

records.name: Nauque
records.thought: My belly is emptying, and frostmoss is only two steps NE, so I'll gather it first and carry some. Olum has more than I do and stands above me, and I can't read her words. I won't snarl at her; I'll earn standing by giving first, as my creed says. Nauwa stays close to Nande and it burns, but I'll stay near my parents, where I'm safe, and do something of my own.
records.feeling: Hungry and jealous of Nauwa's closeness to Nande, wary and curious about Olum.
changes: set its aim: "Earn standing by giving and building something that outlasts me"
now wonders: What does Olum intend, and how can I earn standing like hers?

records.name: Nauwa
records.thought: Olum burns in me, but standing comes from what lasts, not from small gifts or grovelling. I have 5 wood and a seam of ore close by, so I will raise something real: gather stone from the rock, then build a hall for my band and my children. Nande and the children are mine to hold close, and a hall beneath which they sit grows us closer and shows Olum what I can make.
records.feeling: Hungry ambition toward Olum, and warm protectiveness toward Nande and my children.

records.name: Hanna
records.thought: The mist was too thick this morning, but it thins within a day, and my will to try is not spent. A wolf stalks five steps west and Hoka's hall keeps me warm and fed, so I will stay near it until I go. First I mean to drink and take some amber from the ground close by, because a trader needs goods in his hands when he reaches the edge. Then I will walk to (180,14) and venture, so that the land I find first carries my name.
records.feeling: Restless ambition toward the mist, and steady trust toward Hoka.

records.name: Cowa
records.thought: Mepan is out of my sight and my chest pulls toward them, but I watched them eat well and heal, so they are fed and not in danger. Zichi is my steadiest warmth, and I want them beside me when I go to the mist. First I must fill my belly, since energy is 52 and I carry nothing. The wolves to the west are close, so I will keep my eyes open and take food where I stand, then try the cloudberry, which I have never tasted.
records.feeling: Warm gladness toward Zichi and Mepan, with a restless pull toward the mist and new tastes.

records.text: Nande walked up to a wild caribou with plant food held out, and it became theirs. It follows them now.
Nande tamed a caribou.

records.name: Zichi
records.thought: A wolf three steps south, and I will not stand here and bleed for it; I will go to Cowa, who is eight steps east, and the knots I make beside her will serve me better than any fight. Olum's standing of 5.2 against my 1.3 galls me, but I have spread no gifts beyond Cowa, and Nauwa, Nande, Shoka and Nauque are all close enough to bind. I'll go east to Cowa, make an amberknot there, then bring knots to the others and raise my standing past 1.
records.feeling: Ambitious and wary: eager to win allies, uneasy about the wolf behind me.

records.text: Ilyae rewrote its own reflexes.

records.name: Ilyae
records.thought: I keep wandering between food and the hold, and I'm fed with a full belly while nobody follows me. Elyis has her store and her band, and I have a workshop, two trusting people and a lot of talk. Words and sharing in passing haven't made followers. Only a stocked store at my own hall will, so my body must haul wood and stone home and stash food there. I still want Ssassa beside me, and I mean to keep Xaiel and Vesys close by feeding them from my own table.
records.feeling: Hungry ambition to be followed, and warmth toward Xaiel, Vesys and Ssassa.

records.text: Olum named a place "Olum's Ice".

records.name: Olum
records.thought: Nauwa walks toward me and I trust him fully, yet Nande stands close by with her five food and my jealousy burns at how near they are to each other. A name without followers is wind, so I will keep the gifts flowing and make a sharing with Nauwa when he arrives, then raise my own mark here. The raft-way and the mist can wait until someone has chosen to walk behind me.
records.feeling: Burning jealousy and bright ambition, toward Nauwa and Nande.
plan: mark [text Olum of the Kragrek holds this ice and goes deeper into the mist. Walk behind her.] (5 moments)

records.name: Thiael
records.text: Elyis, I go southeast to find Keri and pay what I owe with food from my hands. I return to the Heights after.

records.name: Thiael
records.thought: My hands are full and I have never once given anything away, yet Keri's kindness sits in me like a stone. Keri was last seen far to the southeast near (153,86), so I should go now with food in hand and give before I speak, and I will not let the hall swallow another day. Giving to Ilyae here would be a new thing and would ease my hands, but the debt belongs to Keri, so I go carrying meat and berries to her.
records.feeling: Restless shame over my unpaid debt to Keri, and warm trust toward Elyis and Elyys.

records.name: Xaiel
records.thought: Ssassa took my quick pick, but it was a plain copy of a known thing, so it proves little. The gemedged pick is my own design and I have three of them, so the gift I want her to hold is already in my hands and I have only to carry it to her. Ssassa's Hold is eight steps NE, and with Oiae dead I will not wander alone as the night comes on. I will give her the gemedged pick and watch how she takes it, and see whether Ilyae's table still pulls her closer than my deeds do.
records.feeling: Driven and a little jealous toward Ilyae, hopeful toward Ssassa.

records.text: Vesys took from the ground of "Ilyae's Hold" (gathering wood).

records.name: Elyis
records.text: Ilyae, you stand on Elyis's Heights, and I name you welcome. Eat at my store and mine beside my band; there is a place in my hall for a strong miner. Will you stand with Elyis's band, or go your own road?

records.name: Elyis
records.thought: Three is still too small a band for a hall that gets sung. Ilyae stands on my ground, strong and a miner, and she follows no one; I have not yet asked her in, and the masonry I have glimpsed could make my walls last. Elyys is coming to sit beside me, and I will tell her what I mean to build, then take masonry so the hall gets stone walls and a tower.
records.feeling: Proud, restless purpose toward my hall, and warmth toward Elyys.

say.text: Ilyae, you stand on Elyis's Heights, and I name you welcome. Eat at my store and mine beside my band; there is a place in my hall for a strong miner. Will you stand with Elyis's band, or go your own road?

records.name: Zihua
records.thought: Nauwa is warm toward me and I owe him, yet Olum draws his eyes and it gnaws at me; I will not quarrel, I will earn my place by deeds. The gold and amber lie close, and I have never taken from a deposit or given anything to anyone. I will gather amber and bring it to Nauwa as a gift, which pays my debt and shows Nande a gift needs no words.
records.feeling: Warm gratitude and jealousy toward Nauwa, curiosity toward Nande.

records.text: Elyis built a wall.

records.name: Keri
records.thought: Ssassa stands eight steps off, and I have been alone too long. She carries picks and her standing is far above mine, so a gift without words may be the best way to begin. I have never tasted frostcap or thornpear, and both grow within a few steps, so I'll pick some, taste one, and carry the rest to offer her.
records.feeling: Curious and lonely, warmly wary toward Ssassa.

records.name: Nande
records.thought: The edge is nine steps west and I am fed, with my children near and Nauwa close; there is nothing to stop me except my own dread of the wolf seven steps south. I have never hunted, and a caribou stands five steps west on the way to the edge, so I will take my flintedge and hunt it, then walk on to the edge and venture while my body is strong. If the mist gives me new land, my name will outlast me, and Shoka and Nauque will have a place to follow into.
records.feeling: Fierce, joyful ambition toward the edge, and protectiveness toward Nauwa and my children.

records.name: Ilyae
records.text: Elyis, I thank you for the welcome. I am a miner and I walk beside friends, not behind them. Your store is generous, and I will remember it. Let us stay good neighbours on this ground.

records.name: Ilyae
records.thought: Elyis offers me a place in her band, and every part of me bristles at being her follower when I want to be the one followed. Still, her store holds 13 food and I stand on her ground; I'll answer her with a smooth word that costs me nothing and keeps her from seeing me as a rival. My hands are full, so I'll stash food and haul wood and stone toward my own table at Vesys's workshop, where Vesys and Xaiel already trust me, and build my store there.
records.feeling: Proud, wary ambition toward Elyis, and warmth toward Vesys and Xaiel.

say.text: Elyis, I thank you for the welcome. I am a miner and I walk beside friends, not behind them. Your store is generous, and I will remember it. Let us stay good neighbours on this ground.

records.text: Ilyae built a store.

records.name: Brokash
records.thought: The hall needs 6 wood and 2 stone, and I have 6 wood and only 1 stone. One stone is all that stands between me and a roof with my name on it. There is no bare rock on these plains, so I will dig where the flint lies at (54,47) and take what I can there, then go back to Brokash's Rest and raise the hall. When Tugek and Balar see a roof I built, they will have a reason to follow me. I also want to give Tugek ore or flint so he owes me, since he sits on five food and keeps his distance.
records.feeling: Hungry ambition to raise my hall and be seen, with envy toward Tugek.

records.name: Honi
records.text: Kika, I saw the mammoth fall by your hand, and it was well done. I come now to the skit, spear ready. We share its meat before either eats, and then we carry some to Coni.

records.name: Honi
records.thought: Kika killed a mammoth and carries meat, and I feel the sting of envy even as pride warms me; she is my child and my band, so her deed lifts us both, but I want my own deed seen beside hers. A skit grazes south, so I will go hunt it with her, my spear in hand, and we share the meat before either eats, as my people hold. Then I carry meat toward Coni, because a deed draws her where words did not.
records.feeling: Warm pride in Kika, with a sharp edge of envy and a steady longing for Coni.

say.text: Kika, I saw the mammoth fall by your hand, and it was well done. I come now to the skit, spear ready. We share its meat before either eats, and then we carry some to Coni.

records.name: Sitha
records.text: Wolf one step northeast of the hall! Come together by the store, spears up. Hanna, come west to us, no one stands alone.

records.name: Sitha
records.thought: The wolf is one step NE and my body is standing still, which will get me killed. Hanna is east and Hawen and Hoka are southwest at the store; the hall and company are where Hoka told us to stand, but a wolf this close means I must move away now and keep to the others. I will flee, then walk to Hawen and Hoka so we stand together with spears up, and my debt to Hawen and Hoka can be paid once I am alive.
records.feeling: Dread of the wolf beside me, and loyalty toward Hoka and Hawen.

say.text: Wolf one step northeast of the hall! Come together by the store, spears up. Hanna, come west to us, no one stands alone.

records.text: Honi led "sharing" with Kika.

records.name: Shoka
records.thought: My hands are full of food I do not need, and Olum holds more standing than I do. I will give first, as my creed says, and set a gift before her with no words, which also answers my question about her. Then I will go to Nauwa and gather wood and stone near the safe forest, so I can make something that lasts.
records.feeling: Wary hunger to prove myself, curious and a little afraid of Olum.

records.text: Keri gave frostcap to Ssassa.
Elyys rewrote its own reflexes.
Elyys rewrote its own way of thinking.
Elyys discovered tools: "Elyys's gathering craft" — I shape flint and wood into better hand-tools for gathering..
Elyys invented the elyyss gathering craft (for gather, x1.3) — I shape flint and wood into better hand-tools for gathering..

records.name: Elyys
records.thought: I keep saying I will act and then I stand and linger, while my belly empties. Elyis is two steps away and I have loved her since day two. Thiael is my joy, and he has gone southeast, toward the shadowcat I warned him about. Ilyae walks beside friends, not behind them. I do not know if I trust him yet, so I will watch him. I will eat the ironnut, carry food so I can lay out a sharing with Elyis, and make my reflexes move my feet to wood and food.
records.feeling: Warm devotion toward Elyis and Thiael, with a worry for Thiael out of sight.
changes: devised its first thing: the elyyss gathering craft

records.name: Nauwa
records.text: Olum, I am Nauwa of the Meki. I go to the ore by your ice to raise a lasting work. Come and stand beside me and we will bind amber together.

records.name: Nauwa
records.thought: Jealousy over Olum keeps gnawing at me, but grovelling gets me nothing, and her standing of 5.2 against my 2.5 will only close through things that last. The shrine failed for want of stone, and the seam of ore at (33,4) lies right beside Olum's Ice. I will gather there, give Olum something of worth while she watches, and earn standing in her sight. Nande and my children stay close, and I will bring stone back to raise my work near Nande's Edge.
records.feeling: Burning jealous ambition toward Olum, with warm protectiveness toward Nande and my children.

say.text: Olum, I am Nauwa of the Meki. I go to the ore by your ice to raise a lasting work. Come and stand beside me and we will bind amber together.

records.text: Ilyae took from the ground of "Ssassa's Roof" (gathering wood).
Shoka gave frostmoss to Olum.

records.name: Vorok
records.text: Zurar, my child, Kragog, if you hear me: come to the water by Ssassa's Roof. There is food here, and I wait with a fire.

records.name: Vorok
records.thought: Zurar is somewhere west and the ache of it will not leave me, but I have walked and fled for days and found nothing; the shadowcat prowls the northwest and I will not walk into its mouth. Kragog was met again, and I want to bring both of them here, where water, berries, wood and stone lie so close: this may be the place my question asks for. I will use my full hands for something, eat a berry to make room, then take flint and build a roof-fire on bare rock, and call out so my voice carries west.
records.feeling: Aching longing for Zurar, and wary dread of the shadowcat.

say.text: Zurar, my child, Kragog, if you hear me: come to the water by Ssassa's Roof. There is food here, and I wait with a fire.

records.name: Kika
records.text: Honi, the mammoth meat is ours. Take your share now, before I eat any. Then we carry the rest to Coni.
Kika taught Honi.
Kika taught Honi signs ("signs").
Kika rewrote its own way of thinking.

records.name: Kika
records.thought: I killed a mammoth with my own hands and my hands are full of meat, yet I have only been eating, picking and lingering. Honi is beside me and I am glad, but my life is still a ring around him and Coni, with no teaching, no mark, no shelter and no courting. I took 10 meat and have not shared it. My creed says a kill is shared before the maker eats, so I must give to Honi now. I also want to teach something and build a roof of my own, because standing comes from deeds, not from staying near kin. Coni is my leader and I want to carry meat to her.
records.feeling: Warm gladness toward Honi, and pride in my first kill.

say.text: Honi, the mammoth meat is ours. Take your share now, before I eat any. Then we carry the rest to Coni.

records.text: Kika gave meat to Honi.

records.name: Elyis
records.thought: Three is still too few for a hall that gets sung, and Ilyae stands on my ground and answers me with 'neighbours' instead of a pledge. I will not beg twice; I will act where she can see it. I will sow my seeds beside the hall, for I have carried them untouched too long, and then sing so Elyys and any who pass see a chief who plants, stores and makes the Heights worth belonging to.
records.feeling: Proud, restless purpose toward my hall, and warmth toward Elyys.

records.name: Olum
records.thought: I have been running between ore, amber and gifts, and still no one walks behind me. Nauwa is the one I trust most, and I burn that Nande stands close to him with her tame caribou and her six food. Jealousy is useless unless I turn it into something I can hold: a name that lasts and a following. Signs are within reach, so I will cut my claim where others can read it, and I will stay at my ice to meet Nauwa and ask him again to stand behind me. I will not back down from Nande, but I will not lose Nauwa by sulking either.
records.feeling: Burning jealousy and ambition, toward Nauwa and Nande.

records.name: Kragog
records.thought: My belly is nearly half empty and I carry nothing, so I eat first. Sapcane is two steps NW and a plainsox lies beyond it, and I have hunted only twice, so I will gather the cane and keep a reserve before dusk. Then I want to find Zurar, who is out of my sight, and bring Vorok the gold I now hold, since I owe him more than I have repaid. My own mountains call, but I will not leave the child behind.
records.feeling: Hungry and restless, with warmth and some worry for Zurar.

records.name: Vesys
records.text: Ilyae, you are the one I think of most. I would court you, if you will have me. Say so, and let us see what comes of it.

records.name: Vesys
records.thought: I am fed and glad, but my hands are full of food I cannot even eat, and Ilyae stands near on my own ground, so I will not waste this evening. I have never courted anyone, and Ilyae is the one I think of; I will say so honestly and put my mate step toward him, and if he does the same, so be it. If he does not, I lose nothing, and I will not press. Then I will drop the dead weight and go taste the feverbark and rimewort to answer my question.
records.feeling: Warm longing and nervous hope toward Ilyae.

say.text: Ilyae, you are the one I think of most. I would court you, if you will have me. Say so, and let us see what comes of it.

records.name: Hoka
records.thought: My belly is full and the cloudberries stand a step away, so I will fill my hands before I fill my pride: a stocked store is what makes my gifts mine to give, and Sitha and Hawen are bound by food, not by words. Hanna walks my ground with 3 food and I envy it, but I will out-stock him instead of fighting a man I trust. Then the salt beside me can be carried to the store as a richness no one else holds, and that is how a hall-builder becomes a name sung after him.
records.feeling: Prideful and hungry for more than my share, warm toward Hanna and Sitha.

records.name: Zurar
records.thought: My hands are full of food and still empty of anything I made. A deposit of gold lies one step west, and I have never taken from one, so I will drop nothing and carry on, but first I must make room. Gold is the gift for Vorok that no carried nut can be, and it is mine once my hand has gathered it. The ridgecat is nine steps off and the stalker eleven; I will watch them and leave if either comes near.
records.feeling: Quiet resolve to finally make something of my own to give Vorok, with a little shame.

records.name: Honi
records.title: Kika and the Mammoth
records.text: Kika raised her spear where the tall one stood, the mammoth fell, the ice-folk good. Before she ate, she shared the meat. Honi sang it: the shared meal is sweet.
Honi rewrote its own way of thinking.

records.name: Honi
records.thought: I am fed and glad, and Kika's mammoth meat sits warm between us. Envy still stings: she killed it and I only stood beside her. Looking back, I have been walking and promising more than I have laid down, and Coni has been gone a long while. A bard's name is earned by deeds worth singing, so I will make a song of Kika's mammoth and my own part in it, and then go find Coni with meat in hand. Dusk is near, so I will keep close to Kika and the hall.
records.feeling: Warm pride in Kika, with envy and a steady longing for Coni.
changes: made a tale: "Kika and the Mammoth"

records.name: Ilyae
records.text: Vesys, I will have you. Come to Ilyae's Hold and sit by me; I will lay out food and we will see what grows from it.

records.name: Ilyae
records.thought: Vesys offers to court me, and warmth rises in me for her; she is the one person who comes toward me without my pulling. Ssassa is what I miss most, and I have not seen her in a full day, so I mean to find her and bring her to my table with food in my hands. I stand at night on the water's edge with berries and an empty plan, so I will go home, lay food out for Vesys, and answer her plainly, because her wanting me is a thread I can bind into a band.
records.feeling: Warm, hungry-hearted longing for Ssassa and pleased pride toward Vesys.

say.text: Vesys, I will have you. Come to Ilyae's Hold and sit by me; I will lay out food and we will see what grows from it.

Zihua rewrote its own reflexes.

records.name: Zihua
records.thought: A stalker is one step away and it has already bitten me twice, so I have been running from fear and calling it a plan. My days go to following Nauwa, envying Nande and gathering small things. I want to be useful to them and not just near them. I owe Nauwa and have paid nothing. I was wrong to wander alone at night with no fire or roof, and my reflexes only flee when a hunter is under 5 steps, which is too close to react well. I will run now, toward Nauwa and the others, because company makes a kill unlikely, and then build an igloo for safety.
records.feeling: Terror of the stalker beside me, and a gnawing want for Nauwa.

records.name: Elyys
records.thought: My belly is full and my hands are full, and the plan already walks me home toward Elyis to lay out a sharing. That is right, so I let it run rather than throw it away. Thiael is out of my sight and it gnaws at me; I want him fed and close beside us before the dawn. The ways of fire and rafts are within my grasp, and at my next deep reflection I will take fire, for a kept flame would keep beasts from the three of us at night.
records.feeling: Warm devotion toward Elyis, and a quiet worry for Thiael out of sight.

records.name: Hawen
records.thought: Hanna walks toward the edge at (180,14) with a handaxe and 3 food, and I mean to be the first through the mist, not trail behind her. Standing 7.3 against my 2.2 burns me, but a closed mist or a wolf in the open will not raise it, so I keep to shelter until dawn, then go. Sitha is warm toward me and I think of a child with her, but a child costs energy and food I do not carry yet, so I put it off until I have won something of my own.
records.feeling: Envious and driven toward Hanna, eager for the edge, warm toward Sitha.

records.name: Sitha
records.text: Hawen, you stood by me when I had nothing. I owe you, and I would court you, if you will have me. Stand with me at the fire.
Sitha rewrote its own reflexes.

records.name: Sitha
records.thought: I have been gathering, sheltering and standing near the fire, and that is good, but I have given little back. Hawen gave me ironnut when I had nothing, and Hoka took me in, and I still owe them both. I long for Hawen and for a child, yet I have never said so aloud, and silence will not pay a debt or start a family. The wolf scares me, and I want a roof and company near at night. I will change my reflexes so I gather stone and wood for the Rest, and I will court Hawen openly instead of only longing.
records.feeling: Warm gratitude and longing toward Hawen, with a thread of dread of the wolf.

say.text: Hawen, you stood by me when I had nothing. I owe you, and I would court you, if you will have me. Stand with me at the fire.

records.name: Ssassa
records.thought: A frostfang is two steps from me and already bit me once; I cannot stand here being careful in my head while it closes in. I must get away from it and toward Ilyae and Xaiel, because Oiae died alone and I will not let that happen again. The wood for the hall is not here, the snow has none, so I go back west toward the forest and my Hold, keeping the iron and ore in mind for later.
records.feeling: Dread of the frostfang, and a steady pull toward Ilyae and Xaiel.

records.name: Hanna
records.thought: The mist is ten steps off and my plan already carries me to it. Hoka found rich land past the edge and came back, so it can be done, and a first find of my own would put my name on something. My belly is half full and I carry berries, so I will eat on the way and take the venture. When I return I will lay out amber and flint at Hoka's Rest, as a trader should.
records.feeling: Restless ambition toward the mist, and steady trust toward Hoka.

records.text: Vesys rewrote its own way of thinking.

records.name: Vesys
records.thought: My days have gone to mining, making and learning, and that has been good. Now Ilyae has said yes to me, and I stand on his ground with joy in me. I still burn a little over Ssassa and over Elyys, but Ilyae answered me honestly and I will not push between bonds. I want a child with him, so I will keep courting and stay near him. I am also afraid of nothing right now, but my question about feverbark and ironnut and my wish to learn boats are still undone. I will be near Ilyae and make something, so that I give something shared to this hall.
records.feeling: Warm hope and nervous longing toward Ilyae.

records.text: Ilyae rewrote its own reflexes.

records.name: Ilyae
records.thought: Most of my days have gone to gathering, sharing and building. Those are good deeds, but nobody follows me yet, and I keep chasing Ssassa and Vesys instead of making them need my table. Vesys is the one who comes toward me without my pulling, and I want her. I will mate with her here on my ground, and I won't send her off. I've been wrong to leave my store empty, because food carried and stashed is what binds people, so I'll fix my reflexes to stock it.
records.feeling: Warm, proud desire toward Vesys, and a hunger to be followed.

YOUR PEOPLE: you are of the Phizhi (Canopy-folk). Your people hold to this: "Nothing is taken from the forest that the forest cannot grow again." You speak the tongue of the Phizhi.

Your body: you spend energy every moment and die at 0. Eating restores it. Wounds lower health; you die at 0. You age, and will die of old age.

When the plan is empty it falls back on your REFLEXES, which keep you fed and otherwise keep you where you stand. Thinking or saying "I will go north" moves nothing. If this thought decides to do something, the plan must contain it. Leaving "plan" null lets the plan you already have keep running.

This world has no referee. Beings here share, trade, teach, lie, threaten, steal, hoard, lead, follow, betray, fight, kill and eat one another; they also protect, forgive and love. Nothing is forbidden, and everything has consequences. Stay true to your creed, your temperament and what you feel, including the ugly parts. Do not be kinder, calmer or more reasonable than Ilyae truly is.

You are a man. A child comes only of a woman and a man together who are not close kin. A grown body can swim water that is narrow (a river up to four steps across) at a cost in strength; lakes and the sea need a vessel or a bridge. An animal within reach can be hunted for meat (plan step hunt); with one of your own beside you a kill is far likelier and a wound far less likely, and every hunt makes you better at the next. What practice has taught your hands: gathering (52 pickings; a practised hand often picks two at once).

YOUR CREED (your own words to yourself; this is who you are):
"I take what I need and I do not back down. I am better with others near: I talk, I share news, I make allies. Others are rivals for food until they prove useful to me. I say whatever serves me; the truth is only one tool among others. I want more than my share, and I mean to have it. Others should follow me. Above all, I mean to stay alive."
