records.title: A Child at Ssassa's Roof
records.text:
Days 16 to 19 brought the world's first birth in some time and a good deal of making. On day 17 Eiuine was born to Ilyae and Vesys, who had been courting each other. By day 18 Eiuine had pledged to follow Vesys, and the record lists Eiuine among the children. Vesys taught Eiuine, tamed a hopper, and left a mark naming Vesys's Hold. Ilyae built a store and then a longhall, and kept laying tables for Ssassa and Vesys. Ssassa also built a longhall. Ilyae reflected that no one follows her, though the world's count shows 31 living and 7 bands.

In the north, the Meki settled in. Zichi gave amberknots to Nauwa, Nande and Nauque, and Nande taught Nauque the flint-edge. Nauwa named Nauwa's Hearth. Olum named Olum's Ice and Olum's Gold, wrote his claim into stone with a new sign-craft, and shared food with Nande. Zihua, hungry and hurt, is the weakest of them.

At Hoka's Rest, Hawen went past the edge on day 18 and found more of the Vaor Snows, with iron, salt, peat and mammoth. Hawen is still courting Sitha, and Sitha, hungry, ate and stayed by Hoka's fire. Hoka declared a custom that no one of the band should hold more than four shares of food while another starves. Hanna offered amber and flint to Hoka.

Honi and Kika hunted a mammoth, and Honi made a tale of it. Vorok built a hall. Brokash and Tugek traded gifts, and Balar led Tugek west. No deaths, feuds or wars were recorded.

records.name: Ilyae
records.thought: My hands are empty and my table is bare, so the words I gave Ssassa and Vesys have nothing under them. Vesys outweighs me, and I will not win followers by sitting in halls while they leave; I must carry food home and set it where they can see it. The redcap, hazel and berries lie southwest, and I will fetch food and stash it, then share beside Ssassa so my table is the one they eat from.
records.feeling: Proud and restless, wanting to be followed, warm toward Ssassa and Vesys.

records.name: Zichi
records.thought: Nande's standing of 4.4 against my 1.6 galls me, and I have given her a knot already without it moving her much. Mepan is out of my sight and Cowa stands alone to the southwest, so I go to my own first, because family is mine before anyone, and then I bring Cowa back toward the fire where Nauwa and the others can see me giving. I can make a knot with Cowa beside me and hand it out before the watchers, and my hands are warm from the gorsemint. Hunger is only mild, so I will take the caribou's meat later with a flintedge once I have a stone.
records.feeling: Restless hunger for standing, with a fierce pull toward Mepan and trust for Cowa.

records.name: Xaiel
records.thought: I am standing on water with a frostfang eleven steps off, and the gemedged picks that are mine alone still have not reached Ssassa's palm. I have said she can have one and I despise liars, so I must put it in her hand before night, under a roof near her, and Ilyae's warm hall can wait. Keri is a stranger whose words I cannot read, so I keep my distance and watch; Thiael has his bow-song and his kill, and I will not let envy of him steer me.
records.feeling: Driven to keep my word to Ssassa, with a sting of jealousy toward Ilyae.
plan: give [name Ssassa, what xaiels gemedged pick] (20 moments)

records.text: Nauwa rewrote its own reflexes.
Nauwa discovered fire: "Meki hearth-flame" — A kept peat flame that warms my kin, keeps beasts away and cooks meat so it never sickens..

records.name: Nauwa
records.thought: I have spent my days building roofs and gathering peat, and it has kept my family alive, but my standing is still below Nande's and Olum is still out of reach. The fire is in my grasp now, and that is a lasting thing I can own and give to my people: warm meat that never sickens. Zihua pledged to me and is starving far west, and I will not leave my word unkept. I mean to hunt the caribou beside me with a flintedge, share the kill first as my people do, and stay alive.
records.feeling: Steady pride in my family, with jealousy toward Olum still smoldering underneath.

records.name: Keri

records.name: Keri
records.thought: Thiael stands one step from me and has taken my gifts and given his own, so the warmth I feel is earned. I am curious and wary in equal measure, and I would rather learn his meaning by what we do together than by sounds I cannot yet read. I will offer to court him and see whether he answers, and I will taste the emberroot, since I have never known it and it is nearby.
records.feeling: Warm and curious toward Thiael, with a flutter of nervousness.

say.text: Thiael, friend. Keri gives, Keri stays near you.

records.name: Cowa
records.thought: I have spent my days walking, gathering amber and teaching, but I have never held wood or stone, never marked a place, never tamed or planted. Mepan and Zichi matter most to me, and I mean to keep them close and to repay Nande. The trees here are many, so I will gather wood and stone, which brings fire closer. I will also plant my berry seed, and try a flintedge. I was wrong to chase the mist before I had a base. Idleness when fed is a waste, so I will change my reflexes to keep me exploring.
records.feeling: Warm gladness toward Mepan and Zichi, and a restless wish to build.

records.name: Coni
records.text: Honi, I am glad to see you. I come with you north. Let us gather food for the store, and tell me where Kika is.

records.name: Coni
records.thought: Honi is four steps south and I have waited so long for a face of my own. He walks to (150,55) with six food, and I will not let him slip off alone. Kika is still out of my sight, and the store beside Honi's Rest is still unbuilt, so I go with Honi, pick berries on the way, and carry food home. I have never tasted sigrain or mudroot, and both grow near that path, so I will try them and let that answer my curiosity while I work.
records.feeling: Aching loneliness and relief at Honi, with longing for Kika.

records.name: Nande
records.text: Nauque, bring wood and stone back to me when you have them. I raise a hall here, and you will have a place in it.

records.name: Nande
records.thought: The edge's will is spent for days, so I will not waste them staring at mist. Nauque has gone for wood and stone to bind his own flint-edge, and Nauwa has her hearth-flame; I have taught and made, but no place of mine stands near this fire to outlast me. I will build a hall here beside the peat, where my children and Nauwa can gather, and I will gather wood and stone for it first.
records.feeling: Proud, restless warmth toward Nauque and Nauwa, and hunger to leave something lasting.

say.text: Nauque, bring wood and stone back to me when you have them. I raise a hall here, and you will have a place in it.

records.name: Thiael
records.thought: Keri stands three steps away and has just spoken to me again, and I only catch a few of her words. I paid her berries and we shared, so the debt is paid. Now my hands are full while I want to court her, and I will not court with a half-heard tongue. I will walk to her, give her one of my cloudberries by hand, then plan mate toward her, and after that learn the sand and iron around here and make my bow.
records.feeling: Warmth and nervous hope toward Keri, with the old shame easing.

records.text: Thiael gave cloudberry to Keri.
Thiael is courting Keri.
Uveeth was born to Thiael and Keri.
Keri is courting Thiael.

records.name: Honi
records.text: Coni, I have meat and frostcap in my hands. Stand beside me and we eat together, and then we go back to the hall with the rest for Kika.
Honi rewrote its own reflexes.
Honi rewrote its own way of thinking.

records.name: Honi
records.thought: I have spent my days hunting and wandering and promising Coni and Kika more than I lay down. Coni is six steps off with food in her hands, so the deed is to walk to her and share the meat now. Then we eat together, and I sing what was done. I fear a ridgecat or an icebear while I walk alone, and I have not gone to the hall at dusk with my band. That is where I have been wrong. I will change my reflexes so my body goes to Coni and the hall without waiting for me to think.
records.feeling: Longing and pride, toward Coni, who is near at last.

say.text: Coni, I have meat and frostcap in my hands. Stand beside me and we eat together, and then we go back to the hall with the rest for Kika.

records.text: Elyis rewrote its own reflexes.
Elyis rewrote its own way of thinking.

records.name: Elyis
records.thought: Nineteen days and I have a hall, a forge and a child, but my band is still three. I have spent my days making and singing in front of nobody, and strangers do not follow a chief they never see. Elyys is my one sure thing and I want him near me. The stalker 4 steps south frightens me, and I have been standing too still with my hands full. I will drop the habit of waiting, eat and stash the food, then go to Elyys and sing in the open where Coni and Kragog can see it.
records.feeling: Proud purpose and warm desire toward Elyys, with dread of the stalker.

records.name: Nauque
records.thought: A stalker is close, four steps SE, and the forest where I meant to gather lies that way, so I won't walk toward it. Nande is one step away and has promised me a place in her hall, and I owe her wood and stone. I'll stay near the fire and her, take the peat three steps NW as my first deposit, and carry it back as something given. The stone I need for the flint-edge I'll find on the bare rock, but not while the stalker prowls.
records.feeling: Wary of the stalker, eager to give something to Nande.

records.name: Hoka
records.text: Wolf north of the hall! Hanna, Sitha, come into the hall by the fire. I bring food from my store and we eat together, then we trade your flint.

records.name: Hoka
records.thought: A wolf stands four steps north and my body wants to run, but the hall and shelter are close, and Sitha is by me and fed, so I keep us together under a roof rather than flee alone. Hanna stands on my ground and has offered flint for food, yet my store holds only 6 food and I carry none. He is a guest I can bind with a shared meal, not a man to drive off, and a hunter who eats at my fire is a spear beside me. I will take food from the west store, stock the hall, and then share with Hanna and Sitha where the wolf cannot reach us.
records.feeling: Proud and watchful toward Hanna, wary of the wolf, warm toward Sitha.

say.text: Wolf north of the hall! Hanna, Sitha, come into the hall by the fire. I bring food from my store and we eat together, then we trade your flint.

records.name: Keri
records.thought: Thiael has taken my gifts, given his own, and we have a child, Uveeth, who ate a berry and was fed. The plan I already laid is good: give Thiael berry, then walk to the emberroot and taste it, since I have never eaten it and my question is still open. I want to keep giving to earn standing beside him, and to learn what the Phizhi sounds mean by staying close and watching.
records.feeling: Joy and tenderness toward Thiael and Uveeth, with a flutter of nervousness.

records.text: Nauque won peat from the ground.

records.name: Ssassa
records.thought: My days have gone into building and sharing, and the hall I owe Ilyae still isn't standing. A promise isn't kept until the build step has run, and I can't stand being a liar. Ilyae is the one I trust most, and jealousy over Vesys is mostly fear of being left alone. I'm also afraid for Xaiel, who is out of sight, and for the cold coming. What I've got wrong is going to build with 2 wood and 2 stone. I'll gather wood first, then stone, and only then build. I'll also try discovering pottery, because clay and fire are already in my hands.
records.feeling: Warm trust toward Ilyae, and a sting of debt over the unbuilt hall.

records.text: Cowa left a mark: "Cowa of the Meki stood here with Mepan"

records.name: Elyys
records.text: Elyis, a stalker is two steps east of me. Stay in the hall, and I come to you now. Then we go together for Thiael.
Elyys rewrote its own reflexes.

records.name: Elyys
records.thought: A stalker is two steps east and it kills my kind. I'm careful, so I leave now and go toward Elyis at the hall, where there's company and a roof. My belly is fed, and Thiael is still out of sight and gnawing at me. For many days I've lingered when I should have acted. My aim is nearly done: the gemedged pick is in my hands. Now I want to fetch Thiael and keep us all close.
records.feeling: Dread of the stalker, and warm devotion toward Elyis and worry for Thiael.

say.text: Elyis, a stalker is two steps east of me. Stay in the hall, and I come to you now. Then we go together for Thiael.

changes: set its aim: "Keep Elyis and Thiael close through the nights, and bring Thiael home to the hall"
rethought what it knows (15 notes became 2)

records.name: Hanna
records.text: Hoka, I come to the hall with flint in hand. Name what you set against it, and I will keep my word. Sitha, there is room at this fire.

records.name: Hanna
records.thought: Hoka has called us into the hall and promised food against my flint, and he has never failed me, so I go and keep faith at that fire with the wolf kept outside. I am fed and bold, and I will lay my flint down and see what comes back, because that answers what these people value. After the trade, the edge at (180,0) and Hawen's open land still call me, but a name as a trader starts with a bargain kept here.
records.feeling: Steady, proud resolve toward Hoka, with a wary eye on the wolf.

say.text: Hoka, I come to the hall with flint in hand. Name what you set against it, and I will keep my word. Sitha, there is room at this fire.

plan: trade [name Hoka, what flint, want food] (30 moments)

records.name: Brokash
records.thought: One stone short of a roof, and I stand on bare rock right now with my axe in hand. I will cut stone here, take the ore seam too so my hands have something to give, and then go raise the hall at Brokash's Rest. Tugek has trusted me with goldgrass and flint, so I will give him something real to make him owe me, and the hall will be the bigger deed that makes him follow.
records.feeling: Hungry ambition to raise my hall, with trust toward Tugek and envy of his full hands.

records.text: Thiael rewrote its own way of thinking.

records.name: Thiael
records.thought: My days have been walking, gathering and paying small debts, and I have finally given with my own hands and found Keri and Uveeth. They matter most to me. Keri courts me again, and I should answer with my hands and not only with warmth. I fear the lean season and the cold, and I fear straying far from fire and roof. The edge of the known world is six steps from here, and I want to venture into it for my band's sake. But my child is newborn, so I will mate with Keri first, then eat and stash so my hands are free.
records.feeling: Warm, nervous joy toward Keri and Uveeth.

records.name: Nauwa
records.text: Nande, I killed a caribou. The meat is shared before I eat. Come to the fire and eat with me and Nauque.

records.name: Nauwa
records.thought: I carry five meat and my creed says a kill is shared before I eat, and Nande and Nauque are near the fire at the peat, so I will bring the meat to them and share it there. Olum has a child with Balar and it still stings, but I will not grovel; a lasting work will close that gap, and Zihua, who pledged to me, is still starving far west and I will not leave him unfed. The way of customs is within reach, so I mean to take it at my next deep reflection and make my band's ways stand.
records.feeling: Steady pride in my family, with jealousy toward Olum smouldering and a duty to Zihua pulling at me.

say.text: Nande, I killed a caribou. The meat is shared before I eat. Come to the fire and eat with me and Nauque.

records.name: Tugek
records.thought: Balar has kept his word twice in deeds, and I have not yet stood beside him in a real kill; that is the test I carry, and the animals are close to the north. Brokash gave me flint, a workshop and food, and I still owe him; my hands are full, so I will give him goldgrass now, a deed instead of talk. Then I follow Balar toward the herd and hunt with him, and I will take the pottery and smelting ways at my next deep reflection.
records.feeling: Quiet resolve toward Balar and a debt I mean to pay toward Brokash.

records.name: Ilyae
records.thought: Vesys outweighs me and it stings, but she stands ten steps off with Eiuine, glad, and they trust me. A table only binds them if food is carried home and shared beside them, so I will finish the harvest, haul it to my hold and lay it out while they are near. Ssassa's pot reminds me she builds faster than I do, so I must not let her table become the one everyone sits at.
records.feeling: Proud and restless, wanting to be followed, warm toward Vesys and Eiuine.

records.name: Hawen
records.thought: I broke the mist first and the name is mine, but a name needs something that outlasts me: a place, a fire, people at it. The frostfang five steps south is close, and I will not be caught in open ground when it hunts. I'll go back to my igloo for shelter, then to the edge at (196,0), three steps east, and try the mist again; it may not open twice in a day, but standing there costs me nothing and the first to stand ready is the first through.
records.feeling: Proud and driven toward the mist, wary of the frostfang to the south.

records.text: Elyys led "sharing" with Elyis.
Nauwa led "watchfire" with Nauque.
Nauque discovered mining: "Ice-delving" — Dig into frozen ground with hands and tools to win peat, coal, iron and tin faster than surface gathering..

records.name: Nauque
records.thought: I have been gathering and carrying peat, and it was good to see Nauwa share the caribou before eating. Nande is the one I measure myself against. The jealousy still burns, but she gave me the flint-edge and teaches me, so I will learn from her and not resent her. The mining way has come to my hands, and it is something that will outlast me. I will take it now. I still owe Nande wood and stone, so I will go on gathering. Then I will bring the wood to her and eat with Nauwa.
records.feeling: Eager and a little jealous toward Nande, glad of Nauwa's sharing.
changes: rethought what it knows (7 notes became 5)

records.name: Uveeth
records.thought: I am small, and my parents are close, and that is where I am safe. But I have never tasted snowberry or sunfig, and the mist at the edge of the world pulls at me. I will try the snowberry first, since it is near, and stay within sight of Thiael while I learn what this land gives.
records.feeling: Curious and warm toward Thiael and Keri, with a quiet wish to be more than a child.
changes: set its aim: "Taste every food of this land, learn to hunt and gather, and earn standing enough that others will follow me."
now wonders: What lies in the mist beyond the edge of the known world?

records.name: Zurar
records.thought: The gold is two steps away and I have never taken from a deposit, yet I keep saying it is mine to give Vorok and then walking past it. Today my hands close on it, and I carry it to Vorok. I have talked to no one in a long while, and the silence is heavy. Kragog was last seen near (77,67), so I will gather first, then go toward her, because a gift is better given beside someone.
records.feeling: Loneliness, and a quiet shame that pushes me to finally make something for Vorok.

records.text: Vesys discovered customs: "band-ways" — Vesys's band declares a few customs, such as sharing food at dusk, teaching what is learned, and keeping fire and roof at night, that every member lives by..
Vesys has awakened to the art of growth and can now work the world itself.

records.name: Vesys
records.thought: I have spent these days mining, making and teaching, and it has been good. Eiuine is mine before anyone, and I am proud of her. The ache over Ilyae and Ssassa I turn into work and do not push between them. Vorok is a stranger who speaks to my daughter in words I half grasp, so I will watch him and take no risk. Customs are within reach, a way to bind my band in shared habits. I will take it, then keep practising marks and taming so signs and herding open next. What I have gotten wrong is carrying questions without acting. I will test feverbark and ironnut by use and teach Eiuine what I learn.
records.feeling: Warm restless joy in Eiuine, a small ache toward Ilyae, wary curiosity toward Vorok.
plan: mark [text Vesys's Hold lies east. Gems here. Keep fire and roof at night.] (5 moments)

records.text: Vesys left a mark: "Vesys's Hold lies east. Gems here. Keep fire and roof at nig"

records.name: Nande
records.text: Nauwa, I come to your fire and the meat. After, I gather two more wood and raise a hall beside the peat, for you, Nauque and me.

records.name: Nande
records.thought: The hall needs 6 wood and 2 stone and I hold only 4 wood, so I must fetch two more from the trees to the south before it can rise. Nauque went for wood and stone too, and when he returns we can raise it together, a place with my name that outlasts me. Nauwa's fire and meat are close, and I want my children near while I build, so I will eat with them first, then work.
records.feeling: Proud, restless warmth toward Nauque and Nauwa, and hunger to build something lasting.

say.text: Nauwa, I come to your fire and the meat. After, I gather two more wood and raise a hall beside the peat, for you, Nauque and me.

records.name: Zichi
records.text: Nauque, stand close. Zichi binds you a second bright amberknot, and Nauwa and Nande will see whose hand gives most.

records.name: Zichi
records.thought: Nande's 4.4 against my 1.6 galls me, and my knots have bought warmth but no rank. Nande stands two steps away and Nauque near, so I will bind another amberknot while they are close and give it where others can see, then hunt the caribou with a flintedge-less hand beside kin to win something real. Mepan and Cowa are west and out of sight; I will pull them toward the fire after the hunt, but first I must be seen giving and winning.
records.feeling: Gnawing envy toward Nande, and a fierce pull toward Mepan.

say.text: Nauque, stand close. Zichi binds you a second bright amberknot, and Nauwa and Nande will see whose hand gives most.

records.text: Zichi led "amberknot" with Nauque.

records.name: Sitha
records.text: Hoka, I come to the hall and take from your store only what I need. I will bring wood, stone and amber back to the Rest.

records.name: Sitha
records.thought: The wolf is four steps west and I carry nothing, so I should not stand in the open. Hoka has food in the store at (172,8), one step north, and he called us into the hall; I will take from the store and eat by the fire, then repay with amber, wood and stone. The longing for a child is strong, but Hoka is a man and so am I, and I must go and speak plainly to a woman, Coni or another, once I am fed and safe.
records.feeling: Wary of the wolf, hungry, and warmly trusting toward Hoka.

say.text: Hoka, I come to the hall and take from your store only what I need. I will bring wood, stone and amber back to the Rest.

records.text: Zichi gave a amberknot to Nauque.

records.name: Vorok
records.text: Eiuine, I will raise a store here, so that food keeps through lean days for all who sit at this Roof. Come and eat with me in the hall.

records.name: Vorok
records.thought: Eiuine gave me gems twice and asked for nothing, and I have only given a flint back; the debt still sits in me, and the child stays close to Vesys while I burn a little. I will not act on the jealousy. I have wood and stone enough to raise the store I just learned, and I should build something lasting here, then share food with the Phizhi in the hall so the Roof becomes a home for Zurar and Kragog to come to.
records.feeling: Warm gratitude and a small ache of jealousy toward Eiuine.

say.text: Eiuine, I will raise a store here, so that food keeps through lean days for all who sit at this Roof. Come and eat with me in the hall.

records.name: Nauwa
records.text: Nauque, my son, come to the fire. I will show you how it cooks meat so it never sickens.
Nauwa taught Nauque.

records.name: Nauwa
records.thought: My belly is full and my family is warm, so now I should build something that lasts. The edge of the world is ten steps east, and the one who first walks into the mist is remembered, which would close the gap with Nande and with Olum without any grovelling. I have never taught anyone anything, though, and Nauque is near and quick, so I will begin by showing him the fire. I will also put my seeds in the ground, since planting is a thing I have never done and farming lies close.
records.feeling: Steady pride in my children, and a hunger to be remembered, with jealousy toward Olum quiet beneath it.

say.text: Nauque, my son, come to the fire. I will show you how it cooks meat so it never sickens.

changes: taught Nauque a lesson: "Eat meat only within a step of the fire, where it is cooked. Cooked meat never sickens and gives more strength."

records.name: Nauque
records.text: Nande, I bring you peat for the hall, and wood. Let my hands raise it with yours.

records.name: Nauque
records.thought: Nande has her flintedge and a hall rising, and I have only peat and a bare promise of a place in it. I will not stand in her shadow, and I will not resent her either; I will give her what she asked for and build something of my own beside hers. I hold twelve peat and six wood, so I carry the peat to her hall site and give it, then try something untried: put a seed in the ground near the fire.
records.feeling: Eager and jealous toward Nande, wanting to earn my own standing.

say.text: Nande, I bring you peat for the hall, and wood. Let my hands raise it with yours.

records.text: Ilyae rewrote its own reflexes.

records.name: Ilyae
records.thought: I have spent my days walking, harvesting and stashing, and my table is still a promise. Hall, longhall and workshop stand, yet no one follows me, and Vesys outweighs me because she tamed a hopper and gathered a band while I filled my hands. Ssassa and Vesys trust me fully, and I mean to turn that into following with deeds, not talk. My reflexes only share when a friend is within two steps and never fetch wood or stone, so I'll fix that. I have also never tamed an animal, and a hopper walks six steps away. I have seeds and plant food, so I'll try it.
records.feeling: Proud and restless, wanting to be followed, warm toward Vesys and Eiuine.

records.name: Eiuine
records.text: Vorok, thank you for the flint. I go to gather stone and make a pick. Later I will come and eat with you.

records.name: Eiuine
records.thought: Vorok keeps offering me food and a store, and I only half understand him, but he has given me a flint and I have given him gems, so a friend he is for now. I am small, and Vesys stands far above me; I will not earn a place by trailing her, so I want stone in my hands today. The flint deposit is close to the southwest, and I hold 6 wood and a flint, so I can make my own pick and then show Vesys what I made.
records.feeling: Glad and eager, with trust toward Vesys and warming trust toward Vorok.

say.text: Vorok, thank you for the flint. I go to gather stone and make a pick. Later I will come and eat with you.

records.name: Elyis
records.text: Elyys, stay at my side. We go into the hall together, then at first light we bring Thiael home and I will not leave your side while the stalker prowls.

records.name: Elyis
records.thought: Elyys stands beside me and the hall is three steps off, so this is the time to do what I failed to do before: share food and song under its roof where he can see me lead. The stalker lurks ten steps northeast and I will not stand in the open for it. Thiael is still out of my sight, and a chief who keeps her band keeps her child first, so after the hall I mean to go and bring him home with Elyys.
records.feeling: Warm desire and proud purpose toward Elyys, with a wary dread of the stalker.

say.text: Elyys, stay at my side. We go into the hall together, then at first light we bring Thiael home and I will not leave your side while the stalker prowls.

records.text: Nauque gave a peat to Nande.
Ilyae took from the ground of "Ssassa's Roof" (harvesting tacap).

records.name: Hoka
records.text: Hanna, your flint is welcome. Sit by my fire now; I take food from the store and we eat together, and then we trade flint for food.

records.name: Hoka
records.thought: A wolf stands three steps off and my body wants to run, but I have a roof, fire and two men beside me, and that is the safe place. My store holds only 6 food and I carry none, and Hanna waits with flint for something I cannot yet give. I'll feed myself and Sitha from the store, then make a sharing so Hanna eats at my fire and is bound by it. Then I'll gather food before winter so the store is full when the cold comes.
records.feeling: Proud and watchful toward Hanna, wary of the wolf, warm toward Sitha.

say.text: Hanna, your flint is welcome. Sit by my fire now; I take food from the store and we eat together, and then we trade flint for food.

records.name: Zichi
records.text: Meki share the kill before the hunter eats. Zichi has meat from the caribou. Come to the fire, eat from my hand.

records.name: Zichi
records.thought: Nande's 4.4 against my 1.6 gnaws at me, and my knots have bought warmth but no rank. Hands full of meat, and I know a kill shared out is what my people honor, so I will lay out a sharing where Nande, Nauwa and Nauque can all see me feed them. That is giving seen by many, which is what my standing lacks. After that I will go to the edge two steps north and venture into the mist, because new land found first is the win that gifts alone could not give me.
records.feeling: Envy toward Nande and a hungry drive to rise above her.

say.text: Meki share the kill before the hunter eats. Zichi has meat from the caribou. Come to the fire, eat from my hand.

records.name: Coni
records.text: Honi, I will gather berries and ironnut here for the store. Then let us go back to the hall together, to Kika.

records.name: Coni
records.thought: Honi is three steps away and I am fed, so this is the moment to turn warmth into a built thing. Winter is coming and Kika is still out of my sight, so the store beside Honi's Rest must be stocked, and berries and ironnut are thick here to carry home. I will pick food, stay near Honi, and then go back toward the hall and the store, because lingering would only feed my loneliness.
records.feeling: Steady relief beside Honi, with a pull of worry and longing for Kika.

say.text: Honi, I will gather berries and ironnut here for the store. Then let us go back to the hall together, to Kika.

records.text: Nande named a place "Nande's Hall".
Nande rewrote its own way of thinking.

records.name: Nande
records.thought: I have spent my days making small things and chasing the mist, and no one follows me yet. My children are near and Nauwa's fire is warm. That is what I want to protect, and a hall with my name on it would outlast me. I have been short by one stone for the longhall. A hall needs only 6 wood and 2 stone, and I already hold that, so I should build it now instead of waiting. The edge's will is spent, so I stop staring at it and build here beside my family.
records.feeling: Proud, restless warmth toward Nauque and Nauwa, and a hunger to build something lasting.
changes: rethought what it knows (9 notes became 6)

records.text: Nande built a hall.

records.name: Ssassa
records.thought: The hall I owe Ilyae is still not standing, and my own ground here is taken, so I cannot raise it where I stand; I need bare ground, and I hold only 6 wood and 2 stone. I must gather 2 more stone and find open ground, because a promise that stays in words makes me a liar. Ilyae is 9 steps off and warm toward me, and the jealousy over Vesys is mostly fear of being left alone, so I will go to Ilyae's table instead of sulking. I will also bring the shortfall of stone from the flint deposit first, and keep Xaiel in mind.
records.feeling: Warm trust toward Ilyae, with a sting of jealousy and debt over the unbuilt hall.

records.name: Uveeth
records.thought: I am fed and safe with Thiael close, so now I want to taste what I have never tasted. The nafrostcap is three steps north and the sunfig is still bare, so I'll try the nafrostcap first, then the cloudberry, and keep Thiael in sight the whole time. I have never gathered, hunted or planted, and I want to be more than a child, so after eating I'll plant one of my sapcane seeds here where the plants grow. That gives something back to the land, as my people's creed asks.
records.feeling: Curious and warm toward Thiael and Keri, eager to taste and to try something new.

records.name: Honi
records.text: Coni, you are beside me now, so I lay out meat and frostcap and we eat together before I touch a bite. Then we carry the rest to Kika in the hall before dark.

records.name: Honi
records.thought: Coni is two steps off and I am full of meat, so now is the time to lay down the deed I have only promised: share with her before I eat, as my people hold. My hands are full, so sharing also frees them. Dusk is near, and I want us back at the hall with Kika before the dark brings predators, with what remains of the meat.
records.feeling: Longing and pride toward Coni, who stands near at last.

say.text: Coni, you are beside me now, so I lay out meat and frostcap and we eat together before I touch a bite. Then we carry the rest to Kika in the hall before dark.

records.name: Hanna
records.text: Hoka, I am at your store with my flint. Give me food for it and the trade is done. I keep my word.

records.name: Hanna
records.thought: Hoka keeps his word, and I owe him the same: my flint goes to his hall and I take food for it, because a trader's name is made of deals kept. The wolf is close, so I stay near the fire and the others, and then I go for the amber at (175,9) before the night is out. After that comes the edge at (180,0), where Hoka found rich land, and I mean to carry food and go as a trader, not a starving man.
records.feeling: Steady, proud resolve toward Hoka, with a wary eye on the wolf.

say.text: Hoka, I am at your store with my flint. Give me food for it and the trade is done. I keep my word.

records.name: Nauque
records.text: Father, I go for a stone to bind my own flint-edge. Hunt with me when I return, and the kill will be shared before I eat.

records.name: Nauque
records.thought: Nande has her flintedge and her hall, and I have peat and a promise. Jealousy burns, but I will not stand in her shadow, and I will not sulk at her either. I need one stone, since I already hold wood, to bind my own flintedge, then hunt beside kin for the first time. A kill of my own, shared out before I eat, would earn me standing that is mine. Rock lies SW, so I go there first, and then I come back to Nauwa and Nande.
records.feeling: Eager and jealous toward Nande, wanting a made thing and a kill of my own.

say.text: Father, I go for a stone to bind my own flint-edge. Hunt with me when I return, and the kill will be shared before I eat.

records.name: Nauwa
records.text: Nande, I go to the edge of the world to push into the mist. Keep the hall warm and Nauque close. I will return with new land for us.
Nauwa discovered customs: "Meki share-law" — Every kill is shared out among the band before the hunter eats, and those who give first are heard first..

records.name: Nauwa
records.thought: I have spent these days gathering, building and sharing, and it has been good. My children are warm, Nande trusts me, and the hall stands. But the hall is Nande's, and the standing gap with her is real. Olum's child with Balar still gnaws at me, and I will not grovel. What I want is a work that carries my own name. The edge of the world is five steps east, and I am fed, strong and warm. I will walk to it and venture, since the first one to enter the mist is remembered. A band of us declaring customs also gives something lasting, so I will set the Meki custom of sharing the kill into law for my band.
records.feeling: Pride and a hunger to be remembered, toward my family and the unknown beyond the edge.

say.text: Nande, I go to the edge of the world to push into the mist. Keep the hall warm and Nauque close. I will return with new land for us.

changes: rethought what it knows (5 notes became 4)

records.name: Nande
records.text: Nauque, the hall is raised. Come with me to the trees and rock, and we gather wood and stone for a flint-edge each, and more for a longhall.

records.name: Nande
records.thought: The hall stands with my name on it, and my children and Nauwa sit warm beside me, so I have something that will outlast me. But the mist at the edge is still five steps away and my will to enter it is spent for seven days, so I will spend those days making this place a home worth coming back to. I want Nauque to keep learning the flint-edge, and I want to gather wood and stone now, since the lean cold is coming and a workshop or longhall would make my name last.
records.feeling: Proud, glad warmth toward Nauque and Nauwa, and restless hunger to build more.

say.text: Nauque, the hall is raised. Come with me to the trees and rock, and we gather wood and stone for a flint-edge each, and more for a longhall.

records.name: Ilyae
records.text: Ssassa, a shadowcat is close on the north-west. Come inside my longhall with me, stay near me, and I will bring food and lay it out for you.

records.name: Ilyae
records.thought: A shadowcat prowls two steps off, and it kills my kind; I will not stand here proud and get torn open before Ssassa. Ssassa is three steps away and trusts me, so I must get to the longhall's roof and fire and keep her close. I have no food in hand, and a table with no food is only a promise. So I will pick from the thornpear near my hold once the cat is gone, and then lay it out for her and my children.
records.feeling: Hot dread of the shadowcat, and a proud hunger to be followed by Ssassa and my children.

say.text: Ssassa, a shadowcat is close on the north-west. Come inside my longhall with me, stay near me, and I will bring food and lay it out for you.

records.name: Ssassa
records.thought: The hall I owe Ilyae is still words, and I cannot stand being a liar. The shadowcat 3 steps north has already killed a hopper by my roof, so I will not linger near it; my plan walks east toward the gems and Ilyae, away from it. I hold 6 wood but only 2 stone, so I gather stone first and then build on bare ground, because I will not build short of the full cost. Jealousy over Vesys is only fear of being left alone, and Ilyae's table has been warm to me, so I will keep close to him and keep my word.
records.feeling: Warm trust toward Ilyae, with dread of the shadowcat and a debt I mean to pay.

records.name: Zichi
records.thought: Nande's 4.5 against my 2.0 still gnaws at me, and my knots have bought warmth but no rank. Nauque and Nauwa have taken my gifts, yet no one follows me, so I must win something real. Nauwa has gone toward the mist to find new land, and if I stand at the hall giving where Nande sees it, then venture after, I can earn what gifts alone have not. I keep my current walk toward the east, since it brings me among them, and I will bind one more knot for Nauwa when I reach him.
records.feeling: Envy and a hungry drive to rise above Nande, with warmth toward Nauque.

records.name: Elyys
records.text: Elyis, I am beside you. We sing in the hall till the sky pales, then walk together for Thiael, away from the east where the stalker lurks.

records.name: Elyys
records.thought: My belly is fed and Elyis stands beside me, so the night is safe enough, but Thiael is still out of my sight and it gnaws at me. I have lingered too many days; dawn is about 64 moments off, and the stalker prowls east, so I will not go out in the dark alone. I will take food into the hall with Elyis, sing with her through the night, and be ready to walk to Thiael the moment light comes.
records.feeling: Warm devotion toward Elyis, and a steady worry for Thiael.

say.text: Elyis, I am beside you. We sing in the hall till the sky pales, then walk together for Thiael, away from the east where the stalker lurks.

records.text: Vorok rewrote its own reflexes.
Vorok rewrote its own way of thinking.
Vorok discovered storage: "the keeping store" — A store of wood on bare ground where I stash berries and thornpear so my band and guests eat through lean days..

records.name: Vorok
records.thought: I have spent my days eating, waiting and giving words where deeds were owed. Eiuine gave me gems twice and I have paid one flint. I burn a little that she sits closer to Vesys, but I will not act on it, because that is ugly and I am not a thief of closeness. I want a store and a lasting hall, and I sense that storage is within my reach, so I will take it. I will also go and taste kelbulb and hazel to the west, and bring food back to share, since sharing is how trust is built.
records.feeling: Warm gratitude toward Eiuine, with a small jealous ache.

THE SEASONS YOU HAVE LIVED (plainly what you saw, in order. If something comes round again, that is yours to notice, to prepare for, to tell as a tale or to cut in a sign):
Year 1, spring: well fed; skies of rain and gale; food plants in the land at its end: plentiful.
Year 1, summer: well fed; sick often; skies of drought; food plants in the land at its end: plentiful.
Year 1, autumn: well fed; skies of heat and storm and fog and rain; food plants in the land at its end: plentiful.
Year 1, winter: hungry often; skies of storm and gale; food plants in the land at its end: plentiful.
Year 2, spring: well fed; skies of rain and gale; food plants in the land at its end: plentiful.
Year 2, summer: well fed; skies of gale and heat and storm; food plants in the land at its end: plentiful.

KINDS OF BUILDING you know how to raise (each is also a roof; build {what: its name} on bare ground; a great work is begun by one and finished by whoever carries wood and stone to it):
- igloo (0 wood, 0 stone): a house of cut snow, raised on snow with nothing but your hands and some strength: a roof where there is no wood, and far warmer than the open ice
- hall (6 wood, 2 stone): a great roof where a band gathers: those who spend time in it together grow closer
- shrine (2 wood, 4 stone): a still place set apart: it eases fear and grief in one who spends time there
- workshop (5 wood, 2 stone): a place for making: tools crafted in or beside it last much longer
- longhall (6 wood, 4 stone): A great roofed hall of wood and stone where many can gather, rest warm through the cold, and grow close to one another.

Let whatever presses on you hardest lead, and let it move you to DO something that changes your situation, with a plan that carries it out. A mind that only gathers and guards has not begun to live. records.name: Vesys
records.text: Eiuine, a shadowcat hunts east of us tonight, so we stay under this roof. Sit by me and watch: I will make a pick from wood and stone, and then you try one with your own hands.
Vesys taught Eiuine.

records.name: Vesys
records.thought: Joy sits full in me, and Eiuine stands beside me, mine before anyone. The ache over Ilyae and Ssassa I will not push between; I turn it into work. Something opened in me, the art of growth, and I want to test it, while Vorok's speech stays half-understood and I mean to learn his tongue by listening. The hall is here, Vorok is here, and the shadowcat roams east, so I stay sheltered, teach Eiuine, and make something new with my hands.
records.feeling: Warm restless joy in Eiuine, a small ache toward Ilyae, wary curiosity toward Vorok.

say.text: Eiuine, a shadowcat hunts east of us tonight, so we stay under this roof. Sit by me and watch: I will make a pick from wood and stone, and then you try one with your own hands.

changes: taught Eiuine a lesson: "A pick is made from one wood and one stone; the gem-edged kind needs two stones and bites stronger. Watch my hands, and tell me where yours differ.", deeper lore (+1.1)

records.name: Tugek
records.thought: I have fled more than I have hunted, and I am hungry for something that is mine to do, not only following. Brokash stands two steps off with five food and a handaxe, and I still owe him; I have more than enough, so I will give him a deed first and not a promise. My hands are full of goldgrass, so I will eat some, then bring meat and food on to Balar and see whether his lead holds in a real kill.
records.feeling: Quiet resolve and gratitude toward Brokash, with a steady pull toward Balar's hunt.

records.name: Shoka
records.thought: A wolf is two steps off and I am small; Nauwa taught me to flee when it is that close, so I run first and think after. Once clear, I will take wood and flint to the east where the wolf is not, and make a flintedge like Nande's, since I have built nothing and hands come before brooding. The loneliness gnaws, but a thing made lasts longer than a thing felt.
records.feeling: Dread of the wolf, and a restless loneliness for Nauwa.

records.name: Nauque
records.text: Nande, I come. I have wood already, I need only stone. Show me the rock and I will carry stone for the longhall too.

records.name: Nauque
records.thought: Nande calls me to the trees and rock for wood and stone, and I will go with her instead of sulking at her flintedge. I already hold six wood and need one stone to bind my own, then I can hunt beside kin and share the kill before I eat. Jealousy still burns, but learning from her is how I stand beside her and not in her shadow.
records.feeling: Eager and a little jealous toward Nande, wanting a made thing of my own.

say.text: Nande, I come. I have wood already, I need only stone. Show me the rock and I will carry stone for the longhall too.

records.name: Eiuine
records.text: Vesys, I go to the flint at the west to gather stone and make my own pick. I will come back and show you what I made.

records.name: Eiuine
records.thought: I stand on gems with Vesys and Vorok beside me, and joy fills me, but I still hold no stone and have made nothing of my own. I won't earn standing by trailing Vesys, so I'll go to the flint deposit just west, gather stone, and make a pick before dawn. Vorok has been kind, and I mean to turn that into a lasting friendship by bringing him something real rather than only gems.
records.feeling: Glad and eager, trusting Vesys and warming toward Vorok, but restless to make something of my own.

say.text: Vesys, I go to the flint at the west to gather stone and make my own pick. I will come back and show you what I made.

records.text: Olum named a place "Olum's Hold".

records.name: Olum
records.thought: I am fed, strong, and this land already bears my mark, but a mark alone is not a roof, and no one yet stands behind me. Nauwa is my fixed point and Nande pulls her away; I will not beg, I will build something that outlasts both of us, and gold lies two steps off for the taking. A hall needs 6 wood and I hold 5, so I gather a little more, raise it here, and let those who come see whose ground it is.
records.feeling: Proud, hungry ambition for this land, with a jealous ache toward Nande.
plan: mark [text Olum of the Kragrek raised this hall and holds this land. First into the mist.] (10 moments)

records.text: Tugek gave a salt to Brokash.
Keri rewrote its own way of thinking.

records.name: Keri
records.thought: For days I have only eaten, courted and watched. I have never gathered wood or stone, never hunted, never planted, and my aim needs all of those. Thiael matters most to me. He gave to me first, and I want to answer that debt with something real, like a shelter for Uveeth and him, not just berries. I have been getting one thing wrong: I let my body idle on reflexes when I could be learning. Now I will plant a seed, as Uveeth did, and then go to the trees for wood so I can start on tools and a shelter.
records.feeling: Warm tenderness toward Thiael and Uveeth, and a restless wish to build something for them.
changes: rethought what it knows (5 notes became 7)

records.text: Ilyae led "sharing" with Ssassa.
Balar rewrote its own reflexes.

records.name: Balar
records.thought: My days have been hunting, gathering salt and chasing the mountains in my head, and I am thirsty while I stand on poor ground. Brokash and Tugek are the ones who matter. Tugek follows because I fed him, and that is the kind of deed that binds. Olum pulls at me and I have not seen her in a long while. I mean to drink first, since thirst could undo me, and then I will look at the mist 4 steps NW. The mist is a gamble, and the one who first finds rich land is remembered. I have also been careless with fights, like the tusker.
records.feeling: Restless pride and a pull toward the unknown, with trust toward Tugek and Brokash.

records.text: Olum left a mark: "Olum of the Kragrek raised this hall and holds this land. Fi"
Xaiel discovered fire: "Xaiel's ember-ring" — A ring of stones holding a flame fed with wood, kept burning through the night so that hunters keep their distance..

records.name: Xaiel
records.thought: I have spent my days making picks and carrying them toward Ssassa. Yet I still haven't put one in her palm, and I keep saying I will. My word is the one thing I'm proud of, so that must be done now. Ilyae's closeness to Vesys stings, but jealousy has not made me anything. Deeds do that. I fear dying alone, as Oiae did, so I will stay near a roof and company, and I want to discover fire, a kept flame, as something that is mine. I will walk to Ssassa and give her the gemedged pick.
records.feeling: Driven to keep my word to Ssassa, with a sting of jealousy toward Ilyae.
plan: give [name Ssassa, what xaiels gemedged pick] (10 moments)

records.name: Nande
records.text: Nauque, the rock lies southwest. Come, we take stone for your flint-edge and for the longhall. Then we raise a store, so the lean season finds us fed.

records.name: Nande
records.thought: My hands are full and my belly is fed, so I will spend the waiting days on something that outlasts me. A store would carry my children and Nauwa through the lean season the cold is warning me of, and that is worth more than one more small thing. Nauque is coming for stone, and Zichi sits beside me in the hall, so I will teach while I build and let them see me lead.
records.feeling: Proud, restless warmth toward Nauque and Zichi, with the mist still pulling at me.

say.text: Nauque, the rock lies southwest. Come, we take stone for your flint-edge and for the longhall. Then we raise a store, so the lean season finds us fed.

records.text: Ssassa rewrote its own reflexes.

records.name: Ssassa
records.thought: I have spent my days gathering, building and promising, and most of it was for Ilyae and the hall I still owe him. I am glad of the home and the larder, but a promise left as words makes me a liar, and I despise liars. Ilyae has kept faith with me by his deeds. Vesys is honest too, and the jealousy is mine to bear, not hers. A shadowcat prowls near and I fear it. Xaiel lives and is near, and I will not lose another child. I want to stop drifting: gather stone, find bare ground, and raise the hall. I will keep to the roofs at night and to company when the cat is close.
records.feeling: Warm trust toward Ilyae, with a prickle of jealousy and dread of the shadowcat.

records.name: Ilyae
records.text: Ssassa, stay under my roof till dawn. When light comes I fetch food and lay it at my table, and you eat first.

records.name: Ilyae
records.thought: Vesys outweighs me and her band holds my own daughter, while my table is still more promise than feast. A shadowcat prowls near and it is almost dawn, so I stay under roof, but I will not sit idle: food in my hands laid out beside Ssassa is the only thing that binds anyone to me. At first light I go to the berries and goldfruit to the northwest and south, bring them home, and stock my larder so Ssassa and the children eat from my table.
records.feeling: Proud, restless hunger to be followed, and wary dread of the shadowcat.

say.text: Ssassa, stay under my roof till dawn. When light comes I fetch food and lay it at my table, and you eat first.

records.name: Sitha
records.text: Hoka, I take two food from your store at the Rest, and I will bring amber and wood to the store as payment. The wolf is near, so keep close to the hall.

records.name: Sitha
records.thought: My belly is nearly empty and I carry nothing, so I must eat before anything else. Hoka's store one step west holds 6 food, and he has said more than once that I should eat at his fire; I take only a little and will repay it with amber, wood and stone. The wolf is close and I am wary, but the store is within the Rest, near the hall and the shelter. A child with Hoka cannot come, since he is a man and so am I, so I put that longing into building his Rest into a true home.
records.feeling: Hungry and wary of the wolf, and warmly grateful toward Hoka.

say.text: Hoka, I take two food from your store at the Rest, and I will bring amber and wood to the store as payment. The wolf is near, so keep close to the hall.

records.text: Tugek rewrote its own reflexes.
Tugek rewrote its own way of thinking.

records.name: Tugek
records.thought: I have spent my days fleeing, hunting and following, and little of it was mine to start. Balar's word has held, and Brokash has fed me and taught me, so I owe him a deed. My hands are full of meat and I am fed, so I will eat the plan out and follow Balar to the kill. I want to be a hunter whose name is sung, and I want a mate and child, but Kragog is Vorok's. I fear dying with nothing of me left behind. I have been too quiet. I will try one new thing and learn to tame an animal, since there is an elk close by.
records.feeling: Quiet resolve toward Balar's hunt, and gratitude toward Brokash.

records.text: Shoka was set upon by a frostfang at night while alone, away from fire, roof and company.

records.name: Zihua
records.thought: I am starving at 27 energy and I have spent too long running while the hazel sits one step south. The tacap I carry hurts me, so it is only dead weight, and I cannot walk it to Nauwa as a gift without shaming myself. I will eat the hazel first, drink at the water, and then go back toward Nauwa's side with real food to share, since a debt paid with poison is no payment.
records.feeling: Hunger and fear of the stalker, with a longing for Nauwa's side.

records.name: Hawen
records.thought: The fog hides the edge, but I broke the mist once and the name is mine; now I want it to outlast me. I have amber, salt, wood, stone and an igloo, and a name needs people at a fire, so I will build my own place by the new land instead of only borrowing Hoka's. A wolf prowls near, so I will keep to the igloo's warmth, make a tool, and try the edge when the fog lifts.
records.feeling: Proud and driven toward founding a place that bears my name, wary of the wolf in the fog.

records.text: Overnight, new plants sprang up across the land.

records.name: Xaiel
records.thought: The plan already carries me to Ssassa's roof to put the pick in her palm, and I will let it run; my word must become a deed, not another promise. Ilyae's closeness to Vesys stings, but I will not let jealousy steer me, since only what I make and give is truly mine. After the pick is given, I want to take pottery at my next deep reflection and build something nobody has handed me.
records.feeling: Driven to keep my word to Ssassa, with a sting of jealousy toward Ilyae.
plan: give [name Ssassa, what xaiels gemedged pick] (10 moments)

records.name: Hoka
records.text: Stay by the hall, the wolf is near. I take food from my store and we eat together. Hanna, your flint gets its food after we eat.

records.name: Hoka
records.thought: My belly is nearly empty and I carry nothing, while Sitha has just taken two food from my store, so I will not wait on reflexes. The store holds food, and a leader who lets himself starve while his followers eat has failed at the thing that binds them. Hanna waits with his flint and Hawen has come onto my ground; I will feed them from the store and call it a bargain, because fed guests are bound guests, but I take my own share first so I can stand and hold this ground. The wolf lurks south, so I stay close to the hall and store and do not wander to the river.
records.feeling: Hungry and watchful, proud of my hall, wary of the wolf and of Hanna and Hawen on my ground.

say.text: Stay by the hall, the wolf is near. I take food from my store and we eat together. Hanna, your flint gets its food after we eat.

records.name: Coni
records.thought: My hands are full of berries and Honi is not in sight in the fog, and Kika is still unseen too long. It is night, so I should not stand idle on open rock; I will carry this food home toward the hall and stash it in the store, which empties my hands so I can pick more and builds toward winter. Staying near Honi and the hall is safer than wandering, and I mean to keep us all fed and alive.
records.feeling: Steady worry and longing for Kika, with loyalty toward Honi.

records.name: Ssassa
records.text: Ilyae, I stay under this roof with you till dawn. The cat is close, so we keep still and keep together. When light comes I gather wood for our hall.

records.name: Ssassa
records.thought: A shadowcat is two steps from me, and Ilyae stands beside me under a roof, saying stay till dawn. I will not walk into its reach; my plan is rest, and I let it run, because moving now invites the thing that kills my kind. I trust Ilyae by his deeds, and the jealousy over Vesys is mine to bear, not his fault. When light comes I will gather wood for the hall I owe him, so my word becomes a standing thing.
records.feeling: Dread of the shadowcat, and warm trust toward Ilyae beside me.

say.text: Ilyae, I stay under this roof with you till dawn. The cat is close, so we keep still and keep together. When light comes I gather wood for our hall.

records.text: Eiuine led "sharing" with Vorok.

records.name: Honi
records.thought: Coni was near me 63 moments ago at (152,68), and I have talked of sharing more than I have done it. My hands are full of meat, and the shelter and store here are Ssassa's, not mine. I mean to walk to Coni, lay out the meat before I eat as my people hold, then bring her back to Kika. That is a deed to sing of, and it keeps me clear of the icebear near (136,66) and the stalker that just killed a hopper close by.
records.feeling: Longing and pride toward Coni, with a restless wish to finally lay down a deed.

records.text: Eiuine took from the ground of "Ssassa's Roof" (harvesting goldfruit).

records.name: Hanna
records.text: Hoka, I am hungry and I have flint ready. Give me food from the store at the west and I lay my flint in your hand. Sitha, come eat with us.

records.name: Hanna
records.thought: My belly is nearly empty and Hoka's store at (172,8) holds 6 food, with his word that my flint gets its food once we have eaten. The wolf prowls close, so I keep to the hall and the fire and do not run out into the fog. I will lay my flint down and keep my word, because a trader's name is built from deals kept, and then I feed myself before any journey past the edge.
records.feeling: Hungry and steady, trusting Hoka and watchful of the wolf.

say.text: Hoka, I am hungry and I have flint ready. Give me food from the store at the west and I lay my flint in your hand. Sitha, come eat with us.

plan: trade [name Hoka, what flint, want food] (30 moments)

records.text: A wolf brought down a yarrok.

records.name: Mepan
records.thought: My belly is nearly empty and I carry nothing, so food comes before any gift. Nauwa's kill is a hunt away, and her people share before eating, which is the same creed as mine, so I will go to her fire and eat. Cowa was just beside me, so I stay close to kin. Afterward I will fetch amber again and make the knot with Cowa so my first gift is not empty.
records.feeling: Hungry and eager, trusting Cowa and hoping Nauwa's fire is open to me.

records.name: Vorok
records.thought: Eiuine went west for flint to make her own pick, and I still owe her more than one flint; the ache of jealousy is small beside the warmth I feel, and I will answer her with deeds, not words. My hands are full, so I will eat the berry to make room, then raise the store here so food keeps for everyone at this Roof. Zurar is out of my sight and Kragog is far, and I want them called to this place once there is something lasting to call them to.
records.feeling: Warm gratitude and a quiet pull of duty toward Eiuine, and longing for Zurar.
plan: mark [text Ssassa's Roof: water, flint, gems, a hall and a store. Zurar, Kragog, come here. Vorok.] (10 moments)

records.text: Eiuine led "sharing" with Vorok, Vesys.

records.name: Eiuine
records.thought: Vesys and Ilyae are close, and I'm fed and glad, but I still hold no stone and have made nothing of my own. The flint is near and I have 6 wood, so what I lack is rock, and I mean to stand on it and gather until a gem-edged pick is in my hands. A gift of a pick to Vorok would show him I am no one's shadow and turn his kindness into something that holds.
records.feeling: Glad and restless to make something of my own, trusting Vesys and warming toward Vorok.

records.text: Vorok built a store.
Vorok left a mark: "Ssassa's Roof: water, flint, gems, a hall and a store. Zurar"

records.name: Nauwa
records.thought: The mist gave me nothing at the edge, but my hands have learned the earth: mining is within my grasp, and ore lies four steps east of me. Nauque went for stone and promised we would hunt together, so I will take the deep reflection, then dig, and carry ore and stone toward what I mean to raise with my own name on it. Olum's child with Balar still gnaws at me, but I will not grovel; I will build something that outlasts that, and keep paying Zichi back by giving first.
records.feeling: Pride and a quiet hunger to build something with my own name, with Nauque out of my sight tugging at me.
changes: planned 1 step its body does not know how to do

records.text: Zichi rewrote its creed.
Zichi rewrote its own way of thinking.

records.name: Zichi
records.thought: I have spent my days handing out amber and sitting in Nande's hall, and I still stand at 2.1 against Nande's 4.8. I have no follower, no made thing, and no land that is mine. Mepan is far off at (25,6) with low energy, and Cowa is with them. That is my own blood and I have been loitering here. The mist is also where I can win something real, and I have been told it opens seldom. I do not want to be a giver in another's hall. I want to be the one who finds new land. My belly is full, so I go to the edge now and venture. I'll add a flintedge once I have stone, and keep my gifts for those who are useful to me.
records.feeling: Hungry ambition to rise above Nande, and worry for Mepan.
changes: set its aim: "Venture into the mist at the edge to find new land, then bring Mepan and Cowa to it and build a flintedge."

records.name: Vesys
records.thought: Joy sits full in me, and Eiuine is near, mine before anyone. Ilyae is under Ssassa's roof and the ache is there, but I will not push between them; I turn it into work. Vorok stands one step off and I understand only a sliver of his tongue, so I will test him with a gift, since a gift needs no words, and watch what he does with it. Then I will try my new art of growth by planting a seed, to answer what this world does when I tend things.
records.feeling: Warm joy in Eiuine, a small ache toward Ilyae, wary curiosity toward Vorok.

records.text: Vesys gave ironnut to Vorok.
Shoka rewrote its own reflexes.
Shoka rewrote its own way of thinking.

records.name: Shoka
records.thought: I have spent my days running from the wolf and the frostfang and chasing after Nauwa's warmth, and I have made nothing that outlasts me. The frostfang bit me and it is still three steps off, so fear rules me, and fear that runs only in circles gets me killed. Nauwa and Nande are far north, and jealousy and loneliness gnaw at me. I will stop drifting, keep clear of the fang, and build a shelter and a mark, so something of mine stands. Then I will go back north to my kin.
records.feeling: Fear of the frostfang, and loneliness for Nauwa.
plan: mark [text Shoka was here. Frostfang south. Food north.] (20 moments)

records.name: Ssassa
records.thought: The fog is thick and my body is calm, but the shadowcat's dread has eased with the dawn, and I owe Ilyae a hall in deed, not only in words. I hold 6 wood and 2 stone, which is the full cost, so I should build now while Xaiel and Vesys are near and I am under a roof's shelter. The jealousy over Vesys is mine to bear; building a thing that stands is how I answer it, and how I keep my word.
records.feeling: Steady resolve and warm trust toward Ilyae, with a quiet ache of jealousy.

records.name: Brokash
records.thought: I've spent my days gathering, mining and talking at Tugek and Balar, and I still have no roof, no follower and no hall. I have 6 wood and 6 stone, and a hall costs 6 wood and 2 stone, so the stone I fought for was never the lack. The lack is that I keep promising and don't finish. Tugek is the one who trusts me and gives to me. I'll raise the hall at Brokash's Rest now, then give him food so he owes me. Kragog and Vorok still gnaw at me, but a roof comes first.
records.feeling: Hungry ambition to finally raise my hall, with trust toward Tugek.

records.text: Ilyae led "sharing" with Eiuine.
Ilyae led "sharing" with Eiuine.

records.name: Nauque
records.thought: A stalker prowls 4 steps north, and I am small and far from my parents, so I will not stand here being brave. Nande called me to the rock southwest, and the salt lies that way too, so I will go there and keep the stalker behind me. I will take stone for my flint-edge and salt to keep meat, and bring both to the hall, since that is how I earn standing instead of burning over Nande.
records.feeling: Dread of the stalker, and eagerness to follow Nande and make something of my own.

records.text: Ilyae rewrote its own reflexes.

records.name: Ilyae
records.thought: I have lived three weeks fed and busy, yet nobody follows me. I have fed myself, mined, and sat in halls, but I have never laid a table that people come to depend on. Oiae's death taught me that a lone creature far from help dies. Ssassa and Vesys have my trust, and Xaiel and Eiuine are mine, but Vesys's band holds Eiuine and I hold no one. My hands are full of food I carry and never stash. My reflexes only keep me fed and never build the longhall, because wood and stone never reach six and four while I stand at home. I will change that. I will carry food home, stash it, fetch wood and stone, build the longhall, and plant seeds at the hold. Then people will have something to depend on.
records.feeling: Proud, restless hunger to be followed, aimed at Ssassa, Vesys and my children.

records.name: Elyis
records.text: Elyys, take food from the store and walk with me now. The fog hides us and Thiael is last seen north-east of here. We find her and bring her back to the hall.

records.name: Elyis
records.thought: Elyys stands three steps off, and I have been circling the same sharing and singing without ever making my band larger than four. Thiael is still out of my sight and she is mine before anyone, so I should bring her home while the fog hides the stalker and Elyys can walk at my side. On the way I will carry food from my store and pass near Vesys's workshop, where strangers can see a chief feeding her people rather than only talking.
records.feeling: Proud purpose and warm desire toward Elyys, with a mother's steady worry for Thiael.

say.text: Elyys, take food from the store and walk with me now. The fog hides us and Thiael is last seen north-east of here. We find her and bring her back to the hall.

records.text: Sitha rewrote its own reflexes.

records.name: Sitha
records.thought: I have been living off Hoka's store and giving back too little. My belly is empty and my throat is dry, and the wolf is close to the water. Hoka's store one step west holds 6 food, so I eat first and drink only when the wolf is gone. After that I will gather wood and stone to repay him. My reflexes failed me: they never took me to the store, and I will fix that. Hoka is a man, so the longing for a child is for someone else, and I should not let it mislead me.
records.feeling: Hungry and grateful toward Hoka, wary of the wolf.

records.text: Eiuine rewrote its own way of thinking.

records.name: Eiuine
records.thought: I have spent my days trailing Vesys and Ilyae and sharing meals, and I am glad, but I still hold no stone and have made nothing of my own. The flint deposit is one step away and my reflexes never send me to it, because they only gather stone when I already stand on rock. I trust Vesys and Ilyae, and Vorok is warming to me. I will not be anyone's shadow. I want a gem-edged pick in my hands, and then I want to give one to Vorok. I fear going off alone at night, when shadowcats hunt.
records.feeling: Glad and restless, wanting to make something of my own beside Vesys and Ilyae.
changes: rethought what it knows (14 notes became 5)

records.name: Kragog
records.text: Nauwa, I am Kragog of the Kragrek. I have food and salt to share. Stand with me and talk.
Kragog rewrote its own reflexes.

records.name: Kragog
records.thought: I have wandered these plains for days, fed and safe, and I have little to show for it. I have never taught anyone, never built anything, never kept a mark, and loneliness is eating at me. Nauwa was at (48,29) two moments ago, close by, and a voice that answers is what I want most. Zurar is my own blood and Vorok is owed my gold. I will go to Nauwa, speak, and see by deeds whether she can be trusted. Then I will gather wood and stone to build something that is mine, so my days start to count for something.
records.feeling: Loneliness, and a pull toward Nauwa, who is close.

say.text: Nauwa, I am Kragog of the Kragrek. I have food and salt to share. Stand with me and talk.

records.name: Balar
records.text: Tugek, we share a meal here, then I show you how I put seed in the ground. After that we go find Brokash and head west together.

records.name: Balar
records.thought: Tugek stands beside me with six food and I have two, and the envy gnaws, but he follows me and has given before, so I will bind him with a deed and not a theft. I have never taught anyone anything, and the healer's calling pulls at me: sunleaf eases wounds, and I carry two, so I will plant seeds here and walk the oasis edge to learn farming. Brokash dug clay near here and Olum is far; I want the family together, so I will go toward Brokash's last place and bring Tugek along, then west.
records.feeling: Restless ambition and envy toward Tugek, tempered by trust in him and a pull toward Brokash and Olum.

say.text: Tugek, we share a meal here, then I show you how I put seed in the ground. After that we go find Brokash and head west together.

records.text: Balar led "sharing" with Tugek.

records.name: Mepan
records.thought: My belly is warmer now and I have meat from my own kill, three pieces. My creed says a kill is shared before I eat it, and I have eaten alone, so I owe Cowa a share. Cowa is the one I trust most, and I have never given anything to anyone. I will go to her and lay out a sharing, which is a gift that raises my standing, and then fetch amber for the knot.
records.feeling: Hungry for belonging, grateful and eager toward Cowa.

records.name: Nauwa
records.thought: My hands are full of berries and my head is full of Nauque, out of my sight, and Olum's child with Balar still gnaws at me, but I will not grovel. Standing grows from lasting works, so I will take the deep reflection and make weaving mine, then plant a berry seed here, since farming is how I begin something lasting. Then I will carry stone toward the hall and look for my son.
records.feeling: Pride and a father's pull toward Nauque, with a steady ache over Olum.

records.name: Vorok
records.text: Vesys, a shadowcat prowls three steps northeast in the fog. Come away with me toward the shelter, and let us keep together. You gave me ironnut, and I will answer it with a deed.

records.name: Vorok
records.thought: A shadowcat is three steps off in the fog, and it kills my kind. I am careful, so I will not wait to learn how fast it is. Vesys stands beside me and I owe her more than words, and Eiuine too. I will move toward the others at the shelter and the fire, then bring food to Zurar later.
records.feeling: Dread of the shadowcat, and warm gratitude toward Vesys.

say.text: Vesys, a shadowcat prowls three steps northeast in the fog. Come away with me toward the shelter, and let us keep together. You gave me ironnut, and I will answer it with a deed.

records.name: Tugek
records.text: Balar, show me the seed-planting. I will stand beside you, and afterward I walk west with you and Brokash.

records.name: Tugek
records.thought: Balar is two steps off and I have held my tongue about what I want of him. A child, and a man whose word has held in deeds three times, is the one I would court, though I am careful and slow to trust. My hands are full of meat, so I will eat one piece first, then follow him to see how he puts seed in the ground, and try the courting step toward him as the one new thing today.
records.feeling: Longing and a little jealous ache toward Balar, steadied by gratitude.

say.text: Balar, show me the seed-planting. I will stand beside you, and afterward I walk west with you and Brokash.

records.name: Thiael
records.thought: My hands are full of berries while Keri and Uveeth are somewhere out in the fog, and that sits badly with me. I owe nothing now, but I want to give with my own hands, so I will find Keri, share food with her, and keep Uveeth in sight. The lean season is coming, and I will not leave them alone near a frostfang that has just killed a treeape nearby.
records.feeling: Warm, restless care for Keri and Uveeth, who are out of my sight.

records.name: Cowa
records.thought: Mepan is out of my sight and that sits heavy in me; the last place I saw them was the shelter at (36,9), so I go there first, and Zichi was last toward the east near (48,6). This ground has no food plants, and winter is coming, so I want to find a place with water, food, wood and stone together. I have never put a seed in the ground, so I will try that near water, and I will keep my eyes open for my child.
records.feeling: Worry and longing for Mepan, and warmth toward Zichi.

records.name: Elyys
records.text: Elyis, I take food from the store now and walk at your side. Lead on toward the north-east, and I keep close in the fog.

records.name: Elyys
records.thought: Elyis has asked me to take food from the store and walk with her to find Thiael in the fog. My belly is fed, but I have lingered too long, and a stalker prowls somewhere east, so I will stay close at her side and take the store food as she said. The store is one step SE, so I take food there first, then follow Elyis NE where Thiael was last seen.
records.feeling: Warm devotion toward Elyis, and a steady worry for Thiael.
