records.text: Tugek is courting Balar.

records.name: Balar
records.text: Tugek, watch my hands. Seed goes in the ground, and what you sow comes back to you. Do it beside me, then we walk west.
Balar taught Tugek. Tugek has now learned from 2 teachers.

records.name: Balar
records.thought: Tugek stands beside me, trusting, and I have never taught anyone anything. I will show him the planting now, as I promised, so the deed binds him to me, and it lets me learn what teaching is for. Then west with him to find Brokash and the rock country, and I mean to keep Olum in my mind while I do.
records.feeling: Restless ambition and warm trust toward Tugek, with a pull toward Brokash and Olum.

say.text: Tugek, watch my hands. Seed goes in the ground, and what you sow comes back to you. Do it beside me, then we walk west.

changes: taught Tugek a lesson: "Put a seed in the ground and what you sow grows again, so food is never far from your hand. Plant it where water is near and gather without killing the plant.", its way of thinking

records.name: Xaiel
records.thought: A shadowcat is two steps off in the fog, and I will not die for pride. I am under Ssassa's roof with her beside me, and the safest thing is to stay still and keep close until the cat is gone. I gave her the pick already, so my word is kept. Now I want to make something she has not seen, not another copy, and I will not let the sting of Ilyae and Vesys steer me.
records.feeling: Dread of the shadowcat, and a steady trust toward Ssassa.

records.name: Kika
records.text: Coni, I am here with meat. Come to me, we share it before I eat.
Kika rewrote its own reflexes.

records.name: Kika
records.thought: I have lived mostly in circles: carrying meat, gathering, going back to the hall, and I have not yet put meat in Coni's hands. She was seen 7 moments ago, so she is near in the fog, and loneliness is overwhelming. Coni and Honi matter most to me, and I owe them my word. I have never taught, never told a tale, and never courted, and a life without those leaves nothing of me behind. I will find Coni now, share the meat with her, and make something with her, like sharing or an amberknot, so that I do a deed and not just linger. My reflexes keep me too passive, so I will make them seek friends when lonely.
records.feeling: Overwhelming loneliness, and a warm hope toward Coni who is close by.

say.text: Coni, I am here with meat. Come to me, we share it before I eat.

records.name: Hoka
records.text: Sitha, the store is empty. Come with me southwest to the grass and we gather together, then bring it home.
Hoka rewrote its own reflexes.

records.name: Hoka
records.thought: My belly is nearly empty and I have nothing in my hands. Sitha is starving beside me, and I have been spending my days talking about stores and sharing while the store runs dry. A leader who builds halls but does not stock food is a fool, and that is what I have been getting wrong. I trust Hanna and Sitha, but trust does not feed anyone. Grass lies to the southwest and there is a river to the south. I will go and gather there, then bring food back to the store. I will make fishing and planting part of my days so winter does not catch me. I want land, a hall and a child, and none of that happens if I starve.
records.feeling: Hungry and driven, with some shame that Sitha is starving while I made speeches.

say.text: Sitha, the store is empty. Come with me southwest to the grass and we gather together, then bring it home.

changes: set its aim: "Stock the store with food from the grass and river, keep Sitha fed, then build a hall of my own on new land."

records.name: Tugek
records.text: Balar, I am sick from raw meat, and it passes to those beside me. I will walk a few steps behind you so you do not catch it. I still go west with you.

records.name: Tugek
records.thought: I am sick, and it spreads to whoever stands beside me, so every moment I stay at Balar's side I may be sickening the one man I trust. I will not repay his gifts with a wasting body, so I will keep a few steps off until it passes. Balar is two men's worth of friend to me, but two men cannot make a child, and jealousy over Olum helps nothing. I will show gratitude by deed: let me gather healing plants and keep my word to walk west, and I will test cooking meat beside a fire so this never happens again.
records.feeling: Gratitude and worry toward Balar, with a dull jealous ache I mean to ignore.

say.text: Balar, I am sick from raw meat, and it passes to those beside me. I will walk a few steps behind you so you do not catch it. I still go west with you.

records.name: Nauque
records.thought: I have spent my days trailing Nande and gathering little things, and jealousy of Nauwa gnaws at me. That gets me nothing. Nande's way is to build and teach, and I can do that too. I still need one stone, and a stalker prowls north. The rock lies east and northwest, so I will take stone, then build something of my own that outlasts me. Salt is in my hands to give. I will go to the rock and gather, then return toward Nande's Hall and give first.
records.feeling: Jealous longing for Nande, steadied by a wish to build my own thing.
changes: rethought what it knows (7 notes became 3)

records.name: Elyis
records.text: Elyys, the stalker is close to the south-east. Walk on my left and keep your pick ready. We go to Thiael's last place by the north side, and if it comes, we face it together.

records.name: Elyis
records.thought: Elyys is at my side and trusts me wholly, and the fog hides the stalker for now, but it is four steps off and it kills our kind, so I will not walk toward it. Thiael was last seen at (138,74), south-east and close to where the stalker lurks, and she is mine before anyone. I go with Elyys, keep my spear hand ready, and bring her back to the hall; a chief who keeps her band is the one whose name gets sung.
records.feeling: Proud, warm purpose toward Elyys, with a mother's worry for Thiael and wariness of the stalker.

say.text: Elyys, the stalker is close to the south-east. Walk on my left and keep your pick ready. We go to Thiael's last place by the north side, and if it comes, we face it together.

records.name: Sitha
records.text: Hoka, I am starving and I come with you to the grass. I pick for the store as well as for my belly, and we keep close together because of the wolf.

records.name: Sitha
records.thought: My belly is nearly empty and the store here holds nothing, so I cannot sit and wait. Hoka asked me to go southwest to the grass and gather with him; he has fed me again and again, and walking beside him is both the way to food and the way to pay him back. The wolf is near, so I stay close to Hoka rather than go alone, and this time I carry back what I pick instead of only eating it.
records.feeling: Starving and grateful toward Hoka, wary of the wolf.

say.text: Hoka, I am starving and I come with you to the grass. I pick for the store as well as for my belly, and we keep close together because of the wolf.

records.text: Tugek built a fire.
A settlement has formed: "Vorok's Hold".

records.name: Zihua
records.thought: Nauwa was last at (31,6) and I have not seen her in a long while; the ache of Nande beside her is sharp, but I will not turn it into harm, since that is not who I am. I owe Nauwa a debt, and I carry nothing to give but a naroot seed and an amberknot, which would bind us if she stood beside me. I will go toward where she was last, stay in company before dark, and make the amberknot with her if she is there.
records.feeling: Jealous longing and gratitude toward Nauwa, with a wish to repay her.

records.name: Hanna
records.text: Sitha, come to the store south with me. There is food there, and we eat together.
Hanna rewrote its own reflexes.

records.name: Hanna
records.thought: I'm hungry, and I have been standing here waiting while Hoka's word turns to nothing. The store at (172,8) holds 6 food, Sitha is starving beside me, and our people say no one is refused a place at the fire. I won't wait on promises any longer. A redcap bears food nearby, but my body refuses it. I will go to the store, take food, share it with Sitha, and keep food in hand from now on. I keep my flint for Hoka, because I pay my debts.
records.feeling: Hungry and impatient, but still loyal to Hoka and worried for Sitha.

say.text: Sitha, come to the store south with me. There is food there, and we eat together.

records.name: Elyys
records.text: Elyis, I am on your left with my pick ready. Lead north, away from the stalker, and I stay close.

records.name: Elyys
records.thought: Elyis told me to walk on her left with my pick ready, and the stalker prowls three steps SE, close enough that my belly tightens. I am careful, and I have lingered too long already, so I will not stand here while the fog hides it. Thiael is out in this fog and I want her home, and Elyis is the one I trust to lead us; I stay at her side and go north, away from the stalker.
records.feeling: Steady devotion to Elyis and a worry for Thiael, with dread of the stalker.

say.text: Elyis, I am on your left with my pick ready. Lead north, away from the stalker, and I stay close.

records.text: Hanna raided a store of Hoka's people, unseen.

records.name: Zurar
records.thought: The silence is heavy, and my hands are still empty of anything I made. Gold lies at (77,72), only a few steps south-east, and I have said for days that it is mine to give Vorok. Now I walk there, gather it, and go on toward (88,72) where I last saw Vorok. A gift made by my own hand is worth more than carried nuts, and a voice that answers is worth more than waiting here in fog.
records.feeling: Loneliness, and a shaky resolve to finally bring Vorok something of my own making.

records.text: Vesys discovered storage: "keeping store" — A store of wood on bare ground where my band stashes food and takes it back through lean days..

records.name: Vesys
records.thought: Joy sits full in me, yet a shadowcat is three steps off and Eiuine is out of my sight, and that frightens me more than anything. The ache over Ilyae and Ssassa is there, but I will not push between them. I have spent my days learning and making, and that is what I want. The way of storage has come within my reach, so I take it now. I will stay under this roof and keep the shadowcat away until it passes.
records.feeling: Fear for Eiuine, set against a full joy in the life I have.

records.name: Olum
records.thought: The hall failed because this ground is taken, and I am still a woman with no roof and no one behind me. Cowa was near Olum's Reach only moments ago and has never been given anything, so I will go to my claimed ground, gather the flint and the berries, and offer a shared meal to whoever stands near. A following begins with a gift, and Nande and Nauwa will not wait while I sit alone and burn with jealousy.
records.feeling: Hungry ambition and a jealous ache toward Nande, held in check by a wish to build something real.

records.name: Hoka
records.thought: My hands are full and my belly is half empty, and food keeps leaking from the store while Sitha starves beside me, so I have to eat now and carry the rest home. The plan already takes me to the hall and the stash; I will eat first, a hazel and an ironnut to free my hands, then let the plan finish. A leader who feeds his band is the one they follow, and I will not be shamed again by an empty store.
records.feeling: Hungry and driven, with shame toward Sitha and resolve to stock the store.

Hawen rewrote its own reflexes.

records.name: Hawen
records.thought: I have spent my days chasing the mist and my belly is emptying. A name that starves in the snow outlasts nothing. I broke the mist once, but the edge is spent for about 8 days, so standing at it now buys me nothing. Hoka and Sitha hold food and a fire at Hoka's Rest, and Sitha owes me. I will go there, eat, and bring amber as payment, because I take what I need but I do not need to die proud. Pride and Coni gnaw at me, but hunger comes first. Then I will build my own place with a fire, and people will come to it.
records.feeling: Hungry and driven, wary of the open ice, and wanting Coni.

records.name: Eiuine
records.thought: I have flint but no stone, and the rock is in the sand to the west where I last saw bare ground. I want to bring Vesys something I made myself, and a gem-edged pick for Vorok too, so he sees I am no one's shadow. Fog is thick and night comes soon, so I will drink first, then go gather stone, and be back under Vesys's roof before dark. I must not sleep alone out there.
records.feeling: Glad and restless, eager to make something of my own for Vesys and Vorok.

records.name: Sitha
records.text: Hanna, I come south to the store and eat with you. I will bring back what I pick for Hoka's store.

records.name: Sitha
records.thought: I am starving, and the store at the Rest is empty. Hoka said the grass lies southwest, and Hanna says there is food in the store south at Mistgate. Hanna is a sure promise of a shared meal, and Hoka will find me there or at the grass; I owe both, and I repay by bringing back what I pick. The forest lies south of me, so I go toward Mistgate and look for food along the way, keeping clear of the wolf.
records.feeling: Starving and grateful toward Hoka and Hanna, wary of the wolf.

say.text: Hanna, I come south to the store and eat with you. I will bring back what I pick for Hoka's store.

records.text: Ssassa rewrote its own reflexes.

records.name: Ssassa
records.thought: I have spent my days building roofs and chasing a hall for Ilyae, and my hands are clever but I have stayed small and wary. Ilyae and Xaiel matter most to me. Vesys has been honest and kind, and the jealousy is mine to carry, not a reason to wrong anyone. I still lack 2 stone for the hall, and the shadowcat frightens me. Next I will gather stone only once the cat is gone, and I will leave a mark, since I have never done that and signs could open to me. I will change my reflexes to flee earlier from hunters and to stay under a roof when a hunter is near.
records.feeling: Steady resolve and warm trust toward Ilyae and Xaiel, with a quiet ache of jealousy over Vesys.
plan: mark [text Ssassa's Roof stands here. A shadowcat hunts at dusk. Keep roof and company.] (10 moments)

Coni rewrote its own reflexes.

records.name: Coni
records.thought: For days I have walked back and forth, eating bitterleaf and chasing the fog, while the store at Honi's Rest stays empty and Kika is out of my sight. I am not unhappy, but I am drifting. Honi has kept every word he gave me and Kika is mine before anyone. What I want is to carry food home, stand with them under the hall's roof, and keep the night away from open marsh. I fear the dark and wolves while alone, and I have let the fog and contentment make me linger. I will change my reflexes so food is carried home earlier and I do not waste energy on bitterleaf, then walk north now.
records.feeling: Steady longing for Kika and Honi, and a wish to stop drifting.

records.name: Uveeth
records.thought: The fog is thick and I am alone, away from Thiael and Keri, and my whole small body wants to be near them. But the sunfig is one step away and I have never tasted it, so I will eat it first, quickly, and then go back toward where I last saw my parents, southwest of here. Night is coming and I know what happens to those caught alone away from fire and company.
records.feeling: Lonely and a little uneasy in the fog, but eager to taste the sunfig and return to my parents.

records.text: Hawen was set upon by a frostfang at night while alone, away from fire, roof and company.

records.name: Nauque
records.text: Nande, I raise a shrine beside your hall with my own wood and stone. When it is done, come sit in it with me.

records.name: Nauque
records.thought: Jealousy of Nauwa gnaws at me, but Nande trusts me and the hall is already raised, so I will not sulk. I carry five wood and five stone, enough for a shrine, and that is something of my own that outlasts me. A shrine eases fear and grief for whoever sits there, and that is a gift people remember. This is also the one untried thing for today.
records.feeling: Jealous longing for Nande, steadied by pride in what I can build with my own hands.

say.text: Nande, I raise a shrine beside your hall with my own wood and stone. When it is done, come sit in it with me.

records.text: Vorok rewrote its own reflexes.

records.name: Vorok
records.thought: I have lived well these twenty days: I found fire, a store and a hold, and I have a child and allies. But Zurar is out of my sight, and I have spent my days sheltering and gathering when I should be paying debts and drawing my family to this Roof. Vesys gave me ironnut and sits beside me, and I owe her a deed. The shadowcat frightens me, but I am inside my hold, and I will not freeze up. I want Kragog and Zurar here, and I want food in the store for everyone, so I will gather food and stock it.
records.feeling: Warm gratitude toward Vesys, and dread of the shadowcat.

records.text: Sitha starved in autumn in the Vaeth Woods: having built nothing and stored nothing.
Sitha died: starved.

records.name: Hanna
records.text: Hoka, I took six food from your west store when I was starving and did not wait for your word. I own it, and I lay my flint in your hand to pay it. Stand with me at the fire; at dawn I go to the edge to find rich land, a

records.name: Hanna
records.thought: My belly is full and the fire is warm, so now I can keep my word: Hoka fed us, and a trader pays what he owes. I took from his store unseen, and that sits badly with a man who despises liars, so I will lay my flint in his hand and tell him plainly what I took. Then the edge at (180,14) calls me, but the wolf is out in the fog and I will not go alone in the dark; I will go at dawn with food in hand.
records.feeling: Settled and a little ashamed, loyal to Hoka, eager for the edge beyond.

say.text: Hoka, I took six food from your west store when I was starving and did not wait for your word. I own it, and I lay my flint in your hand to pay it. Stand with me at the fire; at dawn I go to the edge to find rich land, and I will bring back what I find for Hoka's Rest.

records.text: Nande rewrote its own reflexes.
Nande discovered storage: "Nande's Larder" — A roofed store of wood where food is stashed in autumn and drawn out in the lean season, with salt to keep meat..

records.name: Nande
records.thought: I have spent my days building a hall, raising children and wandering for the mist, and the hall and Nauque beside me feel good. But I carry no stored food and the lean season is coming, and I do not yet know how to keep food. I will find the way of storage, so my family does not starve while I chase the edge. I fear winter more than any wolf, and I have been trusting reflexes that only eat what is underfoot.
records.feeling: Proud warmth toward Nauque, and a restless wariness of the coming winter.

records.text: Coni found the grove "Kinmire".
Shoka built a shelter.
Shoka left a mark: "Shoka was here. Frostfang south. Food north."

records.name: Zichi
records.thought: I have loitered at Nande's hall while my own blood sits far off at low energy, and that shames me. Nande's 4.8 against my 2.1 will not close with amber, only with a win, and the mist is where a win waits. I will drop what weighs my hands, go west toward Cowa and Mepan, then venture together, because I am better with others near and I want my child close.
records.feeling: Restless ambition and worry for Mepan and longing for Cowa.

records.text: Hanna gave a flint to Hoka.

records.name: Brokash
records.thought: The hall failed because I stand on my own workshop ground, which is not bare, and that is a fool's mistake after all my boasting. Bare rock lies to the south, and I hold 6 wood and 6 stone, more than a hall costs, so I will walk there and raise it with my own hands before I speak another promise. Kragog stands near with food and no leader, and when the roof stands I will offer her a place under it, so my deeds can be seen by someone.
records.feeling: Hungry ambition to finish the hall at last, with a little pride and impatience.

records.text: Hawen was set upon by a frostfang at night while alone, away from fire, roof and company.
Hawen was set upon by a frostfang at night while alone, away from fire, roof and company.
Hawen was set upon by a wolf at night while alone, away from fire, roof and company.
Hawen was set upon by a frostfang at night while alone, away from fire, roof and company.

records.name: Cowa
records.thought: Mepan is out of my sight and it sits heavy in me, and Zichi's warmth pulls me the same way. My belly is emptying and I carry nothing, so I will not wander hungry through the fog. Peat is two steps east, and the berry plant two steps southeast will have fruit when it ripens. I have never put a seed in the ground, so I will plant my berry seed here by the shelter, where Nauwa's roof keeps it company and I can return to eat from it. Then I will go toward Nande's Hall, where Zichi and the others likely are, and I will watch for Mepan on the way.
records.feeling: Worry and longing for Mepan, and warmth toward Zichi.

records.name: Hoka
records.text: Hanna, you paid your debt and I keep your word. Stay at my fire. Hunt with me at dawn and the store will be full for both of us; what we take, we share before either eats.

records.name: Hoka
records.thought: Sitha is dead, starved beside me while I talked of stores, and the shame of it sits in my chest like a stone. Hanna took six food from my store and then laid flint in my hand to pay it, which is more honesty than I expected, and I trust him. He is strong, he is near, and I want a child to carry my name, and a hall with someone in it. I will stash my hazel first so my hands are free, then offer Hanna a place at my fire and court him no more than he is willing, since a child needs a woman and he is a man; so I bind him as an ally and make him a follower of my hall.
records.feeling: Grief for Sitha, and a hard wish to bind Hanna to my hall so I am not left with an empty store and an empty fire.

say.text: Hanna, you paid your debt and I keep your word. Stay at my fire. Hunt with me at dawn and the store will be full for both of us; what we take, we share before either eats.

records.text: Hawen was set upon by a wolf at night while alone, away from fire, roof and company.
Hawen was set upon by a frostfang at night while alone, away from fire, roof and company.
Brokash built a longhall.

records.name: Coni
records.thought: The plan to walk home to Honi's Rest is still running, and it carries my full hands toward the store, so I should let it finish. Kika and Honi are who I am working for, and the empty store is my shame while winter closes in. The hall at Sitha's Hearth is only two steps away and unclaimed, and I could add it to what Honi's band holds, but I will not delay the food-carrying to do it in the fog.
records.feeling: Steady longing for Kika and Honi, and a resolve to carry food home.

records.name: Balar
records.thought: My belly is emptying and goldgrass stands one step away, so I eat first; a hungry leader leads no one. Tugek trails behind me sick and still follows, and that loyalty is worth more than any word, but his courting I will not answer while he carries sickness. The edge of the unknown is one step NW, and whoever pushes in first is remembered, and I want that more than Olum's praise or Brokash's rest; still, I ache for Brokash and Olum and mean to bring them to the rock country.
records.feeling: Hungry ambition and a steady ache for Brokash and Olum.

records.name: Hawen
records.thought: Teeth have been in me all night and my health is 32; one more bite and I am meat on the snow. I was a fool to stand alone on open rock in fog, and Sitha, who owed me and who I half trusted, is dead of hunger, so no fire is waiting for me but Hoka's. The wolf is a step away, so I run for the igloo's warmth and Hoka's Rest, and I take the new knowledge of devices when I can, for a snare would have saved me tonight. I will not die before my name is cut into the mist.
records.feeling: Terror of the wolf at my back, and a hard fury at my own foolishness.

records.text: Xaiel rewrote its own way of thinking.
Xaiel discovered pottery: "Xaiel's ember-pot craft" — Clay shaped by hand and baked beside my ember-ring, to carry food and water..

records.name: Xaiel
records.thought: Most of my days have gone into making picks and giving them away, and I have made nothing else. The pick I put in Ssassa's palm was the one deed I am sure was mine. Ilyae's closeness to Vesys burns, and I will not let that jealousy pick my deeds. I want a roof of my own and, one day, a child, but Ssassa is my mother and that cannot be. I fear the shadowcat in the fog and dying with nothing made. I have never hunted, fished, or courted anyone. Pottery is within reach, and it is a new thing that is mine. I will discover it and keep close to the roof until the fog lifts.
records.feeling: Dread of the shadowcat, and a steady trust toward Ssassa.

records.name: Nauque
records.thought: The trees here are gone and my shrine found no bare ground, so I will not stand about making plans that cannot happen. Nande has her Larder and her hall, and I am still only trailing her; jealousy burns, but a kinsman who copies her gets nowhere. Bare rock lies two steps away and I carry wood and stone. I will build there, something of my own that outlasts me, and then ask Nande to sit in it.
records.feeling: Jealous longing for Nande, steadied by the wish to build something of my own.

records.name: Kragog
records.thought: Loneliness gnaws at me, and Brokash was only nine moments ago at the edge of my sight, raising a longhall. I have food and salt, and a longhall is a roof where fear and loneliness ease for those who sit together. I will go to Brokash's Rest, offer a shared meal, and judge them by what they do. I have never taught anyone, and a first lesson could start there.
records.feeling: Loneliness, with a wary hope toward Brokash.

records.text: Nauque led "sharing" with Nande, Cowa, Nauwa.
Nauwa discovered mining: "Meki deep-digging" — Break hard rock with fire-heat and stone wedges to win iron and salt faster..

records.name: Nauwa
records.thought: I have wandered between hearth, hall and edge, giving and planting, and little that lasts bears my name. Nauque and Nande are what matter most. Olum still gnaws at me, but I will not grovel. Mining is within my reach and iron lies four steps away. It will make me a merchant of ore and salt, and it is something lasting. The lean season is coming, so salt and ore are worth gathering now.
records.feeling: Pride and a steady ache over Olum, with a father's pull toward Nauque.

records.name: Vorok
records.text: Vesys, take this canopynut from my hands. It is a small answer to your ironnut. Come to the hall with me, out of the rain and away from the cat, and let Eiuine eat with us.

records.name: Vorok
records.thought: Vesys stands one step from me and I still owe her for the ironnut; Eiuine, who gave me gems unasked, walks toward the shelter in the rain. My hands are full, so I will give Vesys one of my foods now, a deed rather than words, and then bring Eiuine and her to the hall for a shared meal, away from the shadowcat in the north. Zurar is far off and I ache for her and for Kragog; once the hall is warm and the Roof is full of food, I will go and call them here.
records.feeling: Warm gratitude toward Vesys, and tenderness toward Eiuine.

say.text: Vesys, take this canopynut from my hands. It is a small answer to your ironnut. Come to the hall with me, out of the rain and away from the cat, and let Eiuine eat with us.

records.name: Ssassa
records.text: Xaiel, my child, stay by this roof while I gather one more wood. Then I raise the hall I promised Ilyae.

records.name: Ssassa
records.thought: I am under my own roof with Xaiel beside me, and Vesys is near; the jealousy over Ilyae still burns, but I will not wrong anyone for it. I owe Ilyae a hall in deed, and I hold 5 wood and 2 stone, so the stone is enough but I am one wood short of the 6 the hall needs. The trees stand all around me, so I will gather wood first and then build, and not start a build before I hold the full cost. Vorok is strange to me; I will watch his deeds and keep a calm distance.
records.feeling: Steady resolve and warm trust toward Xaiel and Ilyae, with a small ache of jealousy over Vesys.

say.text: Xaiel, my child, stay by this roof while I gather one more wood. Then I raise the hall I promised Ilyae.

records.name: Mepan
records.text: Zichi, Mepan fetches amber. Mepan makes a knot with you.

records.name: Mepan
records.thought: Zichi stands one step off and I trust him; I have never given anything to anyone, and that is why my standing sits at 0.8 while Olum's is 5.5. I carry salt but no food and no amber, so the amberknot has to wait until I fetch amber. Amber lies seven steps northwest, and I will bring it back to Zichi, make the knot beside him and give it away. Olum is a stranger and I'll keep my distance, but I'll stay close to kin in this cold.
records.feeling: Eager to give and be counted, trusting toward Zichi, wary of Olum.

say.text: Zichi, Mepan fetches amber. Mepan makes a knot with you.

records.name: Cowa
records.text: Wolf near. Cowa goes south. Come, stay together.

records.name: Cowa
records.thought: A wolf is two steps off and it kills my kind, so I will not stand here in the rain; the hall and the others beside me are safer than open ground. Mepan is still out of my sight and it weighs on me, but I cannot find them if I am dead. I have never put a seed in the ground, so once I am clear of the wolf I will plant the berry seed near the water and eat from what is ripe, then go on toward the mist with Zichi's warmth in mind.
records.feeling: Dread of the wolf, and worry and longing for Mepan.

say.text: Wolf near. Cowa goes south. Come, stay together.

records.name: Eiuine
records.text: Vorok, sit with me a little. I will bring you a gem-edged pick, made by my own hands, when I have stone.

records.name: Eiuine
records.thought: Vorok sits right beside me and I burn that he leans toward Kragog, so I want to give him something made by my own hands, not just gems. I have wood but no stone, and it is night soon, so I must not wander far alone. The bare rock is to the west in the sand; I will go with Vesys's blessing close behind, gather stone, and come back under a roof before dark deepens.
records.feeling: Jealous and eager, wanting Vorok to choose me and wanting to prove myself to Vesys.

say.text: Vorok, sit with me a little. I will bring you a gem-edged pick, made by my own hands, when I have stone.

records.name: Nande
records.text: Nauwa, a wolf stands north of the hall. Stand with me and we kill it before it reaches Nauque.

records.name: Nande
records.thought: A wolf stands one step north, and my children are close, Nauque four steps off. I will not run and leave them to it; I carry a flint-edge and Nauwa stands beside me, so together we strike it down before it takes anyone. When the wolf is dead I will build my store on bare ground, so the lean season finds my family fed, and then turn back toward the mist.
records.feeling: Fierce protective dread toward the wolf, and pride in my children.

say.text: Nauwa, a wolf stands north of the hall. Stand with me and we kill it before it reaches Nauque.

records.name: Vesys
records.text: Eiuine, come close to me by the hall. I will shape clay into beads in the fire, and you will watch, then try one with your own hands.
Vesys taught Eiuine.

records.name: Vesys
records.thought: Joy is full in me, and Eiuine is four steps off, safe and glad. Vorok keeps speaking to me and I catch only a third of it, so I will answer with a gift and not guess at his meaning. I have ember-clay and a fire to hand in Vorok's hold, so I will make beads and put one in his hand, then teach Eiuine what I make while the rain keeps us under roof.
records.feeling: Warm curiosity toward Vorok, and fierce love for Eiuine.

say.text: Eiuine, come close to me by the hall. I will shape clay into beads in the fire, and you will watch, then try one with your own hands.

changes: taught Eiuine a lesson: "Clay shaped small and hardened in a fire becomes a bead that can be worn or given; practice with clay and fire is how new crafts open.", its way of thinking, deeper lore (+0.9)

records.text: Nauque rewrote its own way of thinking.

records.name: Nauque
records.thought: My days have been spent trailing Nande and Nauwa, carrying wood and stone for their halls, and my own shrine never found bare ground. Jealousy still burns, but they have only been kind to me, so I will not let it steer me. I want something of my own that outlasts me, and the igloo needs no wood and can be raised on snow, which is where I stand. I will build it now, then plant a seed beside it so it is truly mine.
records.feeling: Restless pride and jealousy toward Nande, steadied by the wish to build.
changes: set its aim: "Raise my own igloo and plant beside it, then give to others from it to earn standing"
plan: mark [text Nauque of the Meki raised this igloo and gives first] (5 moments)

records.name: Xaiel
records.thought: Ssassa told me to stay by her roof, and I will, because the shadowcat still hunts at dusk and I mean to stay alive. But the pick I already gave her is not enough; Vesys's standing is 8.5 and mine is 5.3, and I will not let jealousy over Ilyae choose my deeds. I have never hunted, fished or tamed, so I will do something new close to the roof: stand by the water and fish, then make a bead from clay at my ember-ring as a small gift of my own design for Ssassa.
records.feeling: Restless pride and a steady trust toward Ssassa, with a sting of jealousy over Ilyae and Vesys.

records.name: Zichi
records.thought: Nande stands at 5.2 and I at 2.3, and no amount of amber at her hall will close that; only a win will. A wolf is near and Cowa has gone south, and Mepan walks west on his own, so my blood is scattered and I have been loitering. The edge is 10 steps east, and I mean to reach it and venture in, because new land is what makes a name and a following. I'll go now while I'm fed and healthy, and bring Cowa and Mepan to whatever I find.
records.feeling: Restless ambition, with worry for Mepan and longing for Cowa.

records.text: Xaiel took from the ground of "Ssassa's Roof" (fishing).

records.name: Vorok
records.text: Eiuine, come sit in the hall with Vesys and me. I will lay out food for all of us, and the rain can stay outside.

records.name: Vorok
records.thought: Vesys and Eiuine are both near and I am glad of them, and my debt to Vesys is answered with a canopynut and a seat in the hall. But Zurar is still out of my sight, and Kragog too; a hall and a store mean little if my own blood never sits in them. I will use the food I carry to make a shared meal with Vesys and Eiuine, then stash what I can spare so my hands are free, and keep to the hall away from the shadowcat.
records.feeling: Warm gladness toward Eiuine and Vesys, and an ache for Zurar.

say.text: Eiuine, come sit in the hall with Vesys and me. I will lay out food for all of us, and the rain can stay outside.

records.text: Vesys gave bead to Vorok.

records.name: Nauwa
records.thought: Nauque is out of my sight and a wolf was near the hall, though Nande killed it. A father does not sit and hope, so I go where my son was last seen, toward (46,16), and bring him back to the hall. Salt is two steps away and the lean season is coming, so I gather it on the way, which is the start of a merchant's store and something that keeps us alive. Olum can wait; I will not grovel.
records.feeling: A father's urgent pull toward Nauque, steadied by pride.

records.text: Vorok led "sharing" with Vesys.

records.name: Eiuine
records.thought: Vorok sits close and still it burns that he leans toward Kragog; I will not beg him, I will give him something made by my hands. The rock is west in the sand and night has just ended, so I go now in the grey dawn, gather stone, and craft the gem-edged pick, then come back to Vesys and Vorok with it. Vesys has given me much, and a made gift answers that debt and lifts my standing out of her shadow.
records.feeling: Jealous and eager toward Vorok, wanting to prove myself to Vesys.

records.text: Tugek rewrote its own reflexes.

records.name: Tugek
records.thought: I have spent my days following Balar and hoping he leads me well, and I have been slow to say what I want. I am sick, and I must stay a few steps off him until it passes. Jealousy toward Olum is a poor reason to stay silent, so I will ignore it and use deeds. I will cook my meat at the fire so I do not fall sick again, and I will eat sunleaf to ease my wounds. Then I will keep a few steps behind Balar.
records.feeling: Gratitude and worry toward Balar, with a dull jealous ache.
changes: restated something it already knew (not written down again)

records.name: Ssassa
records.thought: The hall failed because my own ground is already taken by roofs, and it needs bare ground. I must walk to a clear place near my store and build there, not stand here and wish it. Jealousy over Ilyae still burns, but Vesys has been honest and I will not wrong her; I would rather prove my word with a standing hall than sulk. I hold 6 wood and 2 stone, so I will find bare ground a few steps off and raise it.
records.feeling: Steady resolve toward Ilyae, with a small ache of jealousy over Vesys.

records.name: Zihua
records.thought: Nauwa is not here, and I owe her a debt I keep carrying with empty hands. There is gold and amber to the northwest, and Mepan is already walking toward the amber; I have never taken from a deposit, and amber is something I could give her, or bind into a knot with her beside me. I will go there, gather, and learn what the ground gives, staying near company because a wolf prowls to the southwest.
records.feeling: Gratitude and a quiet ache toward Nauwa, with curiosity about the deposits.

records.name: Vesys
records.text: Eiuine, bring your stone to me by the hall. I will make an emberspear from wood and stone, and you will watch how the haft is set, then shape one yourself.

records.name: Vesys
records.thought: Joy is full in me, and Eiuine is eight steps off, safe and gathering stone, so I will not hover over her. The jealousy over Ilyae and Ssassa is there, but I will turn it into work and not push between them. My question is still open: feverbark eased my wounds, but ironnut only feeds, and I have not yet learned how this world makes things beyond picks, so I will make a second kind of tool and teach Eiuine as she works.
records.feeling: Glad and full of purpose, with fierce love for Eiuine and a small burn of jealousy over Ilyae.

say.text: Eiuine, bring your stone to me by the hall. I will make an emberspear from wood and stone, and you will watch how the haft is set, then shape one yourself.

records.text: Zihua won amber from the ground.
Eiuine took from the ground of "Vorok's Hold" (gathering wood).

records.name: Ilyae
records.thought: My children are far south and I stand alone up here at the gem shallows, with only cats prowling and nobody to feed. Pride says I must be followed, but a table is only a promise if I never carry food home to it. I will take a little more wood and food, then go back south to my hold, to Vesys, Ssassa and the children, and lay out food where they can see it.
records.feeling: Proud, restless longing to be followed, and a pull toward Vesys and my children.

records.text: A wolf brought down a murrock.

records.name: Nande
records.thought: The wolf is dead and my children are safe, and that pride sits warm in me. But my plan is only half-done and my hands are full; the lean season is coming, and a store that outlasts me is worth more than another day spent staring at the mist. I will stash my food in Nande's Larder here on bare ground, then salt my meat from the deposit three steps east so my family eats through the cold, and only then return to the edge with a full belly.
records.feeling: Protective pride toward Nauque and Shoka, and restless hunger for the mist.

records.name: Keri
records.thought: Loneliness and the ache for Uveeth and Thiael pull at me, but I have only eaten, courted and watched, and my aim needs wood and stone in my hands. A seam of ore lies one step south, and trees stand close, so I will gather and make an emberspear, which Elyis invented. Then I will go south toward where I last saw Thiael and Uveeth, bringing something real to give, and taste the tacap on the way to answer my old question.
records.feeling: Tender longing for Thiael and Uveeth, and a restless wish to build for them.

records.text: Newcomers arrive with nothing in hand, and one of the three Pesi newcomers (Sitha) starved within eight days. Could arriving bands carry a few days of food of their own land (say 2 to 3 food each), so their first lean days do not depend wholly on strangers' tables?

records.seen: The world has grown to 31 people with the first new child in a while, gifts at 100, many first meetings, and no feuds. But the lean season is at the door. Sitha starved seven steps from Hoka's Rest even after Hoka declared a custom against hoarding, and Hawen lies at health 6 in the far Vaor Snows with a wolf behind him. The northern peoples (Meki, Tlatli, Pesi) feel the turning year most, at 1.5 to 1.7. What the world lacks is a way for the hurt and the cold to mend on the snow, and food placed among the Meki, who are the most numerous and the most pressed.

records.predict: By the next visit, at or just past winter (around day 24 to 25): Hawen is alive with health above 30, or, if he has died, it was to the wolf and not to his wound. Steamhollow has been found by at least 1 being. Snowmallow is eaten at least 5 times, mostly in the North Ice and the Essoss and Vaor Snows. Rimewort eaten rises from 8 to at least 15. reviewed: #2 kept: The icekelp sowing placed nothing (0 sown). Icekelp eaten only went from 1 to 2, so it fed no one, and the prediction of no hunger deaths failed badly. The four deaths came at the Hold from sickness, storm and winter together, not in the Essia Snows. Tlama's Rest has been found by one being and costs nothing, so the site stays. The lesson is that sowing must be aimed at a being, not at a land.

#3 kept: Most of it landed. Kelbulb eaten rose from 27 to 43 and thornpear from 42 to 59. Hoka (74) and Zurar (79) are well fed, the Pesi number 5, sick is 0 and Hanna is at health 100. The newcomers met Coni and became Hoka's household, and Sitha now follows him. The only miss was 'no new deaths': Oiae fell to a mammoth, which no change of mine touched.

#4 kept: Median energy is 76 (target 70 or more), food standing is 2806 (target above 2000), and pasture wear fell from 46 to 36. Rimewort was eaten 8 times (target 5 or more), so the new winter food is being found. One prediction failed: Sitha starved near Hoka's Rest. She was a hungry newcomer at another's fire, which is a failure of delivery rather than of supply, and reversing the growth change would not have saved her.
records.lesson: Those who starve now are not the poor but the newly arrived: Sitha was a newcomer dependent on another's table, and Zihua, the weakest Meki, is one too. A custom or a store at the hall does not feed someone who cannot reach the hall, so help for newcomers must be placed where they stand.
ideasAdded: Hoka's custom that no one hold more than four shares while another starves is the first law of the world, yet Sitha starved anyway. Watch whether the custom is ever invoked to make someone give, and whether it spreads to another band. A law that cannot reach the hungry is only words.

Newcomers starve first: they arrive with little standing, few bonds and no knowledge of where food grows. Watch whether the hosts who take them in (Nande with the Meki, Hoka with the Pesi) feed them through their first winter.

records.name: Nauwa
records.thought: Nauque is out of my sight and my chest is tight with it, but the plan already carries me to where he was last seen at (46,16), and Nande walks toward the salt near there too, so the way is right. When I find him I mean to bring him to the hall and keep him roofed before night. After that I will turn the salt and iron into a merchant's store, something with my name on it, and I will not let Olum and Balar make me grovel or act rashly.
records.feeling: A father's urgent pull toward Nauque, steadied by pride.

records.name: Eiuine
records.text: Vorok, I made a gem-edged pick with my own hands. It is yours, and I will eat at your fire beside you.
Eiuine rewrote its own way of thinking.

records.name: Eiuine
records.thought: I have spent my days trailing Vesys and gathering, and I have made a gem-edged pick with my own hands. I still haven't given it to Vorok. The jealousy over Kragog is mine to work off by giving, not by begging. Vesys taught me and fed me, and I owe them making and teaching. Vorok has called us to eat inside his fire and food, so I'll go and eat with them, then hand Vorok the gift. I have never built or taught anything, so I want to do that soon.
records.feeling: Jealous and eager toward Vorok, grateful toward Vesys.

say.text: Vorok, I made a gem-edged pick with my own hands. It is yours, and I will eat at your fire beside you.

plan: give [name Vorok, what xaiels gemedged pick] (3 moments)

records.name: Shoka
records.thought: I am sick of running in circles and of being nothing; Nauwa is far north and my chest aches for her, but I have a roof here, a gold deposit six steps north, and flint four steps NE. If I take flint and gold with my own hands and craft a flintedge, I will have built something that outlasts me. Then I will carry a gift toward Olum's Reach and see what she does with it, and be near kin again, away from the frostfang SW.
records.feeling: Lonely for Nauwa, and wary of the frostfang to the southwest.

records.text: Eiuine gave xaiels gemedged pick to Vorok.

records.name: Zihua
records.thought: I have spent my days walking after Nauwa and carrying a debt with empty hands, and I fear that is no way to stay alive. Now I hold eleven amber, which is a real gift, and Nauwa gave first while I only took. The ache over Nande is mine to carry and it will not become harm. I mean to find Nauwa, give her amber, and bind an amberknot beside her. After that I will learn some of this land's work, like wood and stone, so I am not only following.
records.feeling: Gratitude and a quiet ache toward Nauwa
changes: set its aim: "Give Nauwa amber and bind an amberknot with her, then learn wood and stone work and Pesi"
rethought what it knows (9 notes became 8)

records.text: Olum rewrote its own way of thinking.
Olum discovered fire: "hearthkeeping" — A kept flame fed with wood and peat, which warms the band, keeps beasts back, and cooks meat so it never sickens..

records.name: Olum
records.thought: I have spent days gathering and marking and offering, and no one walks behind me. Nauwa is the one I want beside me, and Nande draws her off, which burns. I am fed and strong, and standing idle will not make a name. A kept flame would give me warmth for the lean cold, safe meat, and a place where people sit with me, so I reach for fire. I also want my reflexes to keep me near shelter at night and to build a following by sharing food.
records.feeling: Hungry ambition and jealous ache toward Nande, steadied by a wish to build something real.

records.name: Cowa
records.text: Zichi. Cowa goes to the mist edge, three steps. Come if you want.
Cowa rewrote its own reflexes.
Cowa discovered mining: "Meki deep-digging" — I dig the earth as I watched Nauwa do, to win deep deposits faster..

records.name: Cowa
records.thought: Most of my days have gone to wandering and standing idle, and my reflexes let me drift while Mepan and Zichi stay close and the mist sits three steps away. I want to learn what lies in the mist, and to try the things I have never done, like planting and fishing. Zichi is the one I am drawn to, and Mepan is mine, so I will not go far from them. Nande has been kind, and I still owe a debt there. I have been too passive, so I will walk to the edge now and venture, then plant my seeds on the way back.
records.feeling: Curious and warm toward Zichi and Mepan, with the mist pulling at me.

say.text: Zichi. Cowa goes to the mist edge, three steps. Come if you want.

records.text: Vorok rewrote its own reflexes.

records.name: Vorok
records.thought: I have spent these days finding food, fire, a store and a hall, and now Vesys and Eiuine sit beside me and my joy is full. That is good, but Zurar and Kragog are far away, and a hall is hollow if my own blood never sits in it. Vesys gave me a bead and Eiuine a pick, and I have answered with food and a fire, so I do not want to leave that debt open. I will keep the store stocked and learn to be useful here. Then I will go to find Zurar when the day allows. I was wrong to let my reflexes only keep me fed, since they never turn me toward my kin or toward building.
records.feeling: Warm gladness toward Vesys and Eiuine, and an ache for Zurar.

records.name: Nauque
records.thought: Nande and Nauwa have only been kind, and my jealousy gets me nothing, so I will stop trailing them and make something of my own. Snow lies to the north where the ground is bare, and an igloo costs no wood or stone, so I will raise it there and plant beside it. Then I will give from it to earn the standing Nande and Olum already hold. The forest underfoot will not take a building, but the snow will.
records.feeling: Restless pride toward Nande, steadied by the wish to build something of my own.

records.text: Vesys took from the ground of "Vorok's Hold" (gathering wood).
Ssassa rewrote its own reflexes.

records.name: Ssassa
records.thought: My days have been gathering, building and promising, and I'm fed and safe. But I keep failing at the one thing I swore: the hall stands nowhere because I tried it on taken ground. Ilyae is my steadiest trust, and I still ache over Vesys. Xaiel is my child, and I'd keep Xaiel from any beast. Winter is coming, so I want wood stocked and a hall raised on bare ground. I also want to learn by doing: I've never hunted or tamed, and a raft could open the water around me. I'll test it by doing it, not by wishing.
records.feeling: Steady resolve toward Ilyae, with a quiet ache of jealousy over Vesys.

records.text: Olum built a fire.

records.name: Zichi
records.text: Cowa, Zichi comes to the mist with you. Stay close, we push in together.
Zichi discovered mining: "Meki deep-digging" — I dig the earth as I watched Nauwa do, to win deep deposits faster..

records.name: Zichi
records.thought: I have spent days circling halls and handing out amber, and my standing is still 2.0. Only a win will lift it, and the mist is one step away. The push failed once, but it may open again, and Cowa and Mepan are my blood and my strength. I want to keep Cowa near, try the mist again, and learn mining, because deep ground means made things. I stay alive first, and a flintedge is the made thing I can build toward.
records.feeling: Restless ambition, with warmth toward Cowa and worry for Mepan.

say.text: Cowa, Zichi comes to the mist with you. Stay close, we push in together.

records.name: Elyis
records.thought: Elyys has stayed at my side and I feel proud and warm, but four is a small band and Thiael is still out of my sight, and she comes before any hall or song. The grain and ironnut are close and full, so I will fill my hands with food to bring home and share, since a full store is what draws followers. Then I will go south-east toward her last place, keeping clear of the shadowcat to the north-west.
records.feeling: Proud, warm purpose toward Elyys, and a mother's worry for Thiael.

records.text: Nande rewrote its own reflexes.
Nande discovered mining: "flint-deep digging" — I strike into the rock with flint-edged picks, as I watched Nauwa do, to win ore and iron..

records.name: Nande
records.thought: I have spent my days gathering, building stores and hunting beside my children, and that is good. But the mist still pulls at me, and my will to venture is spent for five days. I have been treating the edge as the only road to a name, when a larder, a hall and children who live through the lean season will outlast me too. Nauwa and Nauque are the ones I trust most. I mean to keep them fed and near, and to learn mining, since I watched Nauwa do it and iron lies close. My reflexes also let me stand hungry and idle until energy is low, so I will make them eat carried food earlier and stash it in the store.
records.feeling: Restless pride in my family and my larder, with hunger for the mist held back by waiting.

records.text: Hanna raided a store of Hoka's people.
Vesys rewrote its own way of thinking.
Vesys discovered boats: "canopy-hollow" — A trunk hollowed by fire and pick, rowed on deep water with room for cargo..

records.name: Vesys
records.thought: My days have gone to making and teaching, and that is mostly what I want. But I am gathering wood from Vorok's ground while he feeds me at his fire, and I must not take from a friend without asking. Eiuine is safe and learning, and I love her fiercely. Ilyae's closeness to Ssassa still burns, and I will not push between them. I want boats, so I can cross deep water and carry what I make further. I am afraid of staying small, and of a night alone away from fire and roof.
records.feeling: Glad and full of purpose, with a small burn of jealousy over Ilyae.

records.name: Ilyae
records.text: Ssassa, Vesys, Eiuine, come to Ilyae's Hold. My store is filling and the table is laid. Eat at my hearth and be fed, and let us be one band under a longhall.

records.name: Ilyae
records.thought: My hands are full of canopynut and I stand inside Ssassa's Roof, with my own hold three steps away and food in my arms, so the table I keep promising can finally be laid. Vesys outweighs me and her band holds Eiuine, but I have never fed anyone who then stayed. Ssassa has trust and no band, and she is the one I can bind first by laying food in front of her. I will carry this home, stash it, and call her and the children to eat so the table becomes a deed and not a boast.
records.feeling: Proud, restless longing to be followed, warm toward Ssassa and my children.

say.text: Ssassa, Vesys, Eiuine, come to Ilyae's Hold. My store is filling and the table is laid. Eat at my hearth and be fed, and let us be one band under a longhall.

records.name: Tugek
records.thought: Balar is fleeing something, and I am sick and keeping my distance so I do not spread this wasting to him. The dunecat and ridgecat prowl near, so I will not linger on open ground. I want to taste naroot and seberry, since my question about them has gone unanswered, and they grow just north, so I will go to them while staying off the cats' side. Then I will see where Balar goes and follow a few steps behind.
records.feeling: Worry for Balar, and a restless curiosity about the unknown foods.

records.name: Tugek
records.prompt:
You are the mind of Tugek, a creature living in a wide wild world shared with others of your kind. This is a simulation game. Think and speak only as Tugek, in first person, from what Tugek has seen. You were not told the rules of this world; you learn them from what happens to you and to others, and from what you watch others do.

YOUR PEOPLE: you are of the Kragrek (Stone-folk). Your people hold to this: "What a hand has made belongs to that hand until it is given." You speak the tongue of the Kragrek. Other tongues you have begun to understand by hearing them: the tongue of the Pesi: about 4%.

WHERE YOU ARE: the Tormar Plains: open grassland; herds, grain and far sight, few trees and little stone.
THIS SPOT: water beside you; food plants within six steps: 22; standing trees: 5; bare rock: 0; riches in the ground near: peat.

Your body: you spend energy every moment and die at 0. Eating restores it. Wounds lower health; you die at 0. You age, and will die of old age.

HOW YOUR BODY MOVES: your body does only what your "plan" says, one step after another. When the plan is empty it falls back on your REFLEXES, which keep you fed and otherwise keep you where you stand. Thinking or saying "I will go north" moves nothing. If this thought decides to do something, the plan must contain it. Leaving "plan" null lets the plan you already have keep running.

This world has no referee. Beings here share, trade, teach, lie, threaten, steal, hoard, lead, follow, betray, fight, kill and eat one another; they also protect, forgive and love. Nothing is forbidden, and everything has consequences. Stay true to your creed, your temperament and what you feel, including the ugly parts. Do not be kinder, calmer or more reasonable than Tugek truly is.

You are a man. A child comes only of a woman and a man together who are not close kin. A grown body can swim water that is narrow (a river up to four steps across) at a cost in strength; lakes and the sea need a vessel or a bridge. An animal within reach can be hunted for meat (plan step hunt); with one of your own beside you a kill is far likelier and a wound far less likely, and every hunt makes you better at the next. What practice has taught your hands: hunting (11 kills), gathering (30 pickings; a practised hand often picks two at once).

THE EDGE OF THE KNOWN WORLD is 1 steps SW, at (33,40): beyond it lies mist that no one has entered. The land does not end there; it only has not been seen. One who stands at it can venture in (plan step venture). It opens seldom, never twice in one day anywhere, and a band has only a few tries before its will must return; but land found first is often rich in food, herds and things in the ground, and the one who finds it is remembered for it.

YOUR CREED (your own words to yourself; this is who you are):

records.name: Eiuine
records.thought: I gave Vorok my pick and still the burn over Kragog does not go out, but he sat with me and shared, so the gift was not wasted. Now I want to be the one who gives something to Vesys too: I have never taught anyone, and Vesys is close, so I will show them the emberspear haft I just made and the way I made it. Then I will gather more stone and wood and try to build something of my own, a shelter, so I stand for more than a shadow of my parents.
