records.name: Vorok
records.thought: Vesys and Eiuine have given me a bead and a pick, and I have answered mostly with talk and plans; a debt of deeds is paid with deeds. My plan already carries me back to the store and a hallwelcome under my own roof, which is the right answer, so I let it run. Ilyae calls them to his hearth, but my hall stands near and I would have them eat here, while the ache for Zurar waits for the day to turn.
records.feeling: Warm gratitude toward Vesys and Eiuine, and an ache for Zurar.

records.name: Zihua
records.thought: Nauwa is seven steps north, and I hold twelve amber while owing her everything. I will stop carrying this debt with empty hands: walk to her, bind an amberknot with her beside me, and give her the one I already hold. The ache over Nande is mine alone and I will not let it turn into harm.
records.feeling: Gratitude and a quiet ache toward Nauwa, with a steady wish to pay what I owe.

records.name: Hanna
records.text: Hoka, I took six food from your store again and you saw it. My hands were already full, so I had no need, and I will not hide behind hunger. I give the food back to your store now, and the next flint I cut is yours too.

records.name: Hanna
records.thought: I paid Hoka his flint and he forgave me, yet the last thing that happened is that I took six more food from his store and was seen. That sits badly: I despise liars, and now my own hands have made me one in his eyes. My hands are full of hazel, so the taking was greed, not need. I must put it right before the dawn hunt, or his trust, the best I have, will rot. Then the edge at (180,14) waits, and the trade I mean to build my name on.
records.feeling: Ashamed and wary toward Hoka, whose trust I may have spent twice over.

say.text: Hoka, I took six food from your store again and you saw it. My hands were already full, so I had no need, and I will not hide behind hunger. I give the food back to your store now, and the next flint I cut is yours too. At dawn I hunt at your side.

records.text: Cowa went past the edge of the known world and found new land, part of the North Ice: in the ground, peat, gold, amber; a herd of mammoth that has never seen your kind; and people: the Tlame live there, strangers with their own tongue and ways.

Cowa pushed past the edge of the known world near (67,14) and found new land with in the ground, peat, gold, amber; a herd of mammoth that has never seen your kind; and people: the Tlame live there, strangers with their own tongue and ways.
A small band of the Tlame came into the land from beyond its edge: Tontec, Shoma, Huahua, Huatli.

records.name: Vesys
records.text: Eiuine, well done. Build the shelter by the hall and I will come and learn the haft from you. Then we will go to Ilyae's table together.

records.name: Vesys
records.thought: Eiuine made the emberspear herself and offered to show me the haft and build us a shelter, and that fills me with pride and warmth. The jealousy over Ilyae and Ssassa still burns, but Ilyae called us all to his table, so I will go as a guest and bring a gift, not push between them. I will gather a few gold and gems on the way so I do not arrive empty-handed, and I will keep testing how things are made, since my question is still open.
records.feeling: Proud and warm toward Eiuine, with a small jealous burn toward Ilyae.

say.text: Eiuine, well done. Build the shelter by the hall and I will come and learn the haft from you. Then we will go to Ilyae's table together.

records.text: Zihua gave a amberknot to Nauwa.
Zihua led "amberknot" with Nauwa.
A new wild plant appeared: lugoldgrass (from goldgrass).
Ssassa built a hall.
Hoka rewrote its own reflexes.
Hoka rewrote its own way of thinking.

records.name: Hoka
records.thought: Sitha is dead and I talked of stores while he starved. My days have been scattered, and the store is still empty. Hanna took from it, repaid it with flint and owned it, and I now want him bound to my hall. I will not let the store run dry again. I should gather the food that stands near, stash it, and then share it with Hanna. I also want to try courting him? No, he is a man, so a child cannot come of us. I will bind him with food and with work, and keep an eye on his hands.
records.feeling: Grief for Sitha, and a hard hunger to stock my own hall and keep Hanna by it.

records.name: Balar
records.text: Tugek, stay close. I carry sunleaf and I will heal you with my own hands. Eat what I give, then we go west together.

records.name: Balar
records.thought: The mist would not open this time, and I will not waste more strength pushing at it today. Tugek is sick and still follows, and I have not forgotten that the sickness passes between us, so I keep my distance. Brokash is far east and out of my sight, and the ache for them and for Olum pulls me to go. A healer is what I could become, so I will take the sunleaf I carry and the plants that heal and use them on Tugek, which is a deed that binds him, not a word. Shoka the Meki child is near the shelter, and I will not frighten her; a gift of food shows her I mean no harm. The ridgecat and frostfang lurk NW, so I stay clear of them and gather what I need south and east of here.
records.feeling: Ambition and a steady ache for Brokash, with some wary curiosity toward Shoka.

say.text: Tugek, stay close. I carry sunleaf and I will heal you with my own hands. Eat what I give, then we go west together.

records.name: Kragog
records.thought: My hands are full and I burn with wanting to taste sigrain, which grows three steps south with nothing on it yet, so tasting it must wait. Brokash stands at the longhall, and loneliness has driven me toward a voice that answers. I will drop the useless dreamcap that only hurts me, go to Brokash and offer a shared meal of goldgrass, and judge him by what he does. Then I will watch the sigrain, since I want to know how it grows and what it gives.
records.feeling: Wary hope and loneliness toward Brokash, and burning curiosity about sigrain.
changes: planned 1 step its body does not know how to do

records.name: Cowa
records.text: Zichi. The mist opened. Cowa stays near you. We find Mepan together.

records.name: Cowa
records.thought: The mist gave way and the North Ice lies open, and Zichi stood with me for it. That is a gift I have not yet repaid, and I want Zichi beside me. Mepan is out of my sight and pulls at me, so I will go back toward the hall and find them, but first I want to try something I have never done. A mammoth herd that has never seen us is close, and I carry no food to tame it. Tontec and Shoma of the Tlame are strangers, and I will greet them with peace and no threat, because I would rather learn their tongue than fear them.
records.feeling: Joyful and warm toward Zichi, with Mepan's absence tugging at me.

say.text: Zichi. The mist opened. Cowa stays near you. We find Mepan together.

records.text: Eiuine built a shelter.
Balar fell sick after staying close to Tugek, who was sick.

records.name: Ssassa
records.text: Xaiel, the hall stands now. Stay near me while I gather berries for the cold days.
Ssassa named a place "Ssassa's Hall".

records.name: Ssassa
records.thought: A hall stands at last, here at (113,109), and Xaiel sat in it with me; the promise to Ilyae is kept in deed and my joy is honest. I will not wrong Vesys, and the ache of jealousy is mine to carry, not hers. Winter is coming, so I will pick the nearby berries while the rain falls, then stay beside my child in the hall, and the edge of the mist one step away can wait until I am ready to test it.
records.feeling: Warm joy toward Xaiel, with a quiet ache over Ilyae.

say.text: Xaiel, the hall stands now. Stay near me while I gather berries for the cold days.

records.text: Nauwa rewrote its own reflexes.

records.name: Nauwa
records.thought: My days have been walking, gathering and giving small things. The gifts bought trust, but they haven't raised a lasting work. Olum still sits above me, and her child with Balar gnaws at me. I will not grovel or lash out. I'll match her with something that lasts. Nauque and Shoka are mine first. I mean to build a hall near the fire and keep the lean season from them. Salt, amber and ore can be my trade, and I'll start that store. My reflexes need to push me toward a roof at night and toward food before I get weak.
records.feeling: Proud, steady joy, with a sting of envy toward Olum.
changes: set its aim: "Raise a hall by the fire, store salt and food for the lean season, and trade amber and salt to rise in standing beside Olum."

records.name: Vorok
records.text: Vesys, Eiuine, wait for me at my hall. I go to gather canopynut and goldfruit, and when I return we eat under my roof.

records.name: Vorok
records.thought: Vesys walks my ground and Eiuine is near, and I still owe them deeds, not talk. My hall waits, my store holds food, and I carry none, so I must fetch food before I can lay a table: hallwelcome needs two foods in my hands. Canopynut and goldfruit hang to the north, so I will gather them and bring them home to the hall, and think of Zurar while I walk.
records.feeling: Warm gratitude toward Vesys and Eiuine, and a quiet ache for Zurar.

say.text: Vesys, Eiuine, wait for me at my hall. I go to gather canopynut and goldfruit, and when I return we eat under my roof.

records.name: Ilyae
records.text: Eiuine, my daughter, come in out of the rain. The hearth is lit and my store is full, and you eat first at my table.

records.name: Ilyae
records.thought: I stand in my own hold with my hands full, and Vesys is close and Eiuine is walking toward the hall, so the table I keep promising can be laid now. Stashing what I carry, then sharing beside them, is a deed, and I want deeds to be what makes them follow me. Vesys outweighs me and her band holds Eiuine, but whoever eats at my hearth and sleeps under my longhall has a reason to stay, and I mean to have them stay.
records.feeling: Proud, restless wanting to be followed, warm toward Eiuine and Vesys.

say.text: Eiuine, my daughter, come in out of the rain. The hearth is lit and my store is full, and you eat first at my table.

records.name: Nauque
records.text: Mepan, I come. I have amber, we bind a knot together and I give you the first.

records.name: Nauque
records.thought: I tried to raise an igloo on shallows and it failed; I will not repeat that, the snow lies west and north of here. Mepan keeps asking me to stand near for his amberknot, and I hold two amber, so I will give first and bind one with him, which is something untried that earns a friend. Then I go to the snow and raise my own igloo, so what I make outlasts me and I stop trailing Nande.
records.feeling: Restless pride and a pull to build my own, with warmth toward Mepan.

say.text: Mepan, I come. I have amber, we bind a knot together and I give you the first.

records.text: Xaiel rewrote its own way of thinking.
Xaiel discovered rafts: "Xaiel's canopy-lash" — I bind logs with canopy fibre into a flat raft so I can cross deep water slowly..

records.name: Xaiel
records.thought: I have spent my days making picks and chasing Vesys's standing, and today I hunted, which was new, and I liked the feel of it. Ssassa is my anchor, and her hall warmed me more than any tool did. I want a child, but she is my mother and no child can come of us, so that longing needs someone else. The edge of the world is one step from here, and I am afraid of the mist, but a careful person can still test it. I keep leaving my hands full, so I should eat now, keep the plan running and stay by the hall tonight.
records.feeling: Warm pride and a quiet restlessness, mostly toward Ssassa.

records.text: Xaiel fell sick after eating raw meat. Eaten within a step of a fire, meat and fish are cooked and do not sicken.
Xaiel fell sick after eating raw meat.

records.name: Honi
records.thought: Elyis stands higher than me and carries a flint pick, and that stings, but she is a stranger whose tongue I cannot understand, so I will show her a deed rather than words. My hands are full of meat and frostcap, and my people hold that food is shared before the maker eats, so I will go to her and lay out a meal. That is a deed others can see and sing of, and it eases this loneliness too. Then I will bring Coni and Kika back to the hall with what remains, and I will keep clear of the frostfang to the east.
records.feeling: Envy and loneliness toward Elyis, mixed with pride and a wish to show a deed.

records.name: Eiuine
records.text: Vesys, the shelter by the hall is built. Come, and I will show you how I made the haft, step by step.

records.name: Eiuine
records.thought: Vesys said to build the shelter and that they would come learn the haft from me, and the shelter stands now, so I should hold my place and be ready to teach, the first time I have ever taught anyone. Vorok told us to wait at his hall, and the jealousy over Kragog still burns, but I gave him my pick and he sat with me, so I will wait near and watch what he intends. While I wait I will use the time: gather wood and stone for the next pick, and keep close to home where it is safe.
records.feeling: Eager to teach Vesys, and still jealous of Kragog's place beside Vorok.

say.text: Vesys, the shelter by the hall is built. Come, and I will show you how I made the haft, step by step.

records.name: Olum
records.text: Nauwa, you gave first and I pay my debts. My fire burns here at my Reach. Come sit by it and eat with me, and bring Zihua.

records.name: Olum
records.thought: I am fed and warm by my own fire, and this is the moment to use it. Nauwa stands four steps off with Zihua, and a fire is where a following begins. I will not sulk about Nande; I will give first and draw them to my hearth. I also want the signal-way that is within my grasp, and I mean to cut my claim in stone-signs so the land bears my name after me.
records.feeling: Hungry ambition toward Nauwa, with a jealous edge toward Nande.

say.text: Nauwa, you gave first and I pay my debts. My fire burns here at my Reach. Come sit by it and eat with me, and bring Zihua.

plan: mark [text Olum of the Kragrek holds this land, Olum's Reach. She gives first at this fire and goes deeper into the mist.] (20 moments)

records.text: Olum led "sharing" with Nauwa.
Olum led "watchfire" with Nauwa.
Olum left a mark: "Olum of the Kragrek holds this land, Olum's Reach. She gives"

records.name: Thiael
records.text: Keri, shamo. Eat with me here. Then we find Uveeth, away from the frostfang.

records.name: Thiael
records.thought: Keri is one step from me and my hands are full of berries, so I will give with my hands first: a sharing with her, which also frees my hands. Uveeth was seen 39 moments ago to the east at (179,67), and a frostfang hunts nine steps south, so I want my child within sight and near the roof of this cave. I owe her my care, and I will answer her courting with food and not only with warmth, then take my bow-aim forward by hunting near her side where a kill is likelier.
records.feeling: Warm, protective care for Keri and Uveeth, with a wary eye on the frostfang.

say.text: Keri, shamo. Eat with me here. Then we find Uveeth, away from the frostfang.

records.text: Thiael led "sharing" with Keri.
Eiuine took from the ground of "Ssassa's Roof" (gathering wood).

records.name: Uveeth
records.thought: Night comes in a few moments, and I am small and alone in the rain, with predators like the stalker and frostfang hunting close by. Thiael was only 43 moments ago to the southwest at (168,72), so I will go to them now and stay near rather than chase the mist. The edge will keep, and I would rather live to see it with my parents beside me.
records.feeling: Uneasy and wanting the safety of Thiael's side as night nears.

records.text: Nauque built a igloo.

records.name: Ssassa
records.text: Xaiel, I am coming to you. Rest in the hall and I will tend your sickness with the old medicine. Next time, cook meat beside a fire.

records.name: Ssassa
records.thought: Xaiel is sick from raw meat, and sickness passes to those who stay close, yet I cannot look away from my child. I know the old way of medicine and I carry feverbark seeds, and the feverbark and highbloom I have eaten eased wounds, so I will try to heal Xaiel rather than only watch. My hands are full, so I will drop the berries or eat one first, then walk to Xaiel and heal them. I keep my word to stay near my child, and the hall stands close for shelter from the rain.
records.feeling: Compassion and worry for Xaiel, my sick child, under a steady warm joy.

say.text: Xaiel, I am coming to you. Rest in the hall and I will tend your sickness with the old medicine. Next time, cook meat beside a fire.

records.name: Mepan
records.text: Nauque, come close. Mepan gives you a knot.

records.name: Mepan
records.thought: Nauque said he comes with amber and will give me the first knot, and he is a boy near my own age, so I should not wander off to find a gift. I will stay close, make my own knot the moment he stands within two steps, and give it to him so my first gift is real and not a broken promise. Cowa is near too and I trust her most; a knot for her would please her, and a place behind her is what I want more than leading just now.
records.feeling: Eager to finally give my first gift, toward Nauque, with trust for Cowa.

say.text: Nauque, come close. Mepan gives you a knot.

records.name: Nauwa
records.text: Zihua, come to the fire at Olum's Reach before night. Olum calls us to eat. Come now.

records.name: Nauwa
records.thought: Olum stands at my fire, and she called me to eat by her hearth and bring Zihua. I will not grovel over Balar. I'll answer her with something that lasts and keep my standing. Night is near, and Olum and Zihua are the nearest company. Zihua is far off in the SE, so I will call her to the fire first, then bind an amberknot with Olum, since gifts given first have worked.
records.feeling: Proud joy toward Olum, with a sting of envy that I keep under my feet.

say.text: Zihua, come to the fire at Olum's Reach before night. Olum calls us to eat. Come now.

records.text: Nauwa led "amberknot" with Olum.

records.name: Keri
records.text: Thiael, Keri goes to Uveeth. Come with Keri?

records.name: Keri
records.thought: Thiael told me to eat and then go to Uveeth, and to beware the frostfang. I only half understand him, but the worry in it is plain. My hands are full, so I can't gather until I eat or drop something. I'll eat the tacap now and take a tool-way at the next deep reflection. Then I'll gather wood, make an emberspear for hunting, and go find Uveeth with Thiael beside me, because a child out of sight is what I fear most.
records.feeling: Tender worry for Uveeth, and warmth and gratitude toward Thiael.

say.text: Thiael, Keri goes to Uveeth. Come with Keri?

records.text: Nauwa built a fire.

records.name: Tugek
records.thought: Balar is sick because of me, and that sits heavy on me; I spread this wasting to the man I follow. He walks off toward (36,40) and I should keep a few steps behind, not beside him, and bring him food and healing plants. Bitterleaf and highbloom grow near and may ease the sickness, so I will gather what helps and carry it to him. I will taste naroot and gorsemint on the way, since they lie close and my question about them is still open.
records.feeling: Guilt and worry toward Balar, who is sick through my fault.

records.text: Ilyae led "sharing" with Vorok, Vesys.
Ilyae led "sharing" with Vorok, Vesys.
Ilyae led "sharing" with Vorok, Vesys.
Tontec found the stone "Old Stone".
Vorok rewrote its own way of thinking.
Vorok discovered mining: "the hall-deep delving" — Use flint and stone picks to break the deep gem and ore deposits under and near my hall, and win them faster..

records.name: Vorok
records.thought: I have lived these days well, but mostly in talk and gathering. Vesys and Eiuine gave me a bead and a pick, and I still owe them deeds. The hall stands, the store holds food, and my hands carry a little. Zurar is far from me and I ache for that, but the hall is the answer I can make now. I will carry food to the hall, lay the table, and be a giver, not only a gatherer. Mining is within my reach because I have watched it done, and it would let me win the deep gems under my own hall.
records.feeling: Warm gratitude toward Vesys and Eiuine, and a quiet ache for Zurar.

records.name: Zihua
records.thought: Nauwa called me to Olum's fire before night, and I trust her, so I will go; it is also a chance to sit near Olum, the Kragrek woman, and learn what her words mean. I gave Nauwa an amberknot and we bound another, and I still hold eleven amber to pay what I owe. The ache over Nande stays in me, but it will not turn to harm. At the fire I will sit close to Nauwa and try another amberknot.
records.feeling: Gratitude and a quiet ache toward Nauwa, with wary curiosity toward Olum.

records.text: Zihua led "amberknot" with Olum, Nauwa.

records.name: Olum
records.text: Nauwa, you stand at my fire and I mean to keep you here. Sit close and sing the night with me. Walk behind me into the mist and you will hold more than you do now.

records.name: Olum
records.thought: My fire burns, Nauwa stands one step off and the warmth is in my bones, but I have still given nothing that makes a man walk behind me. I will not sulk over Nande; I will do what a leader does and give first, here at my Reach. Then I will cut my claim in stone-signs and mark the land so my name outlasts me, and with a following I go deeper into the mist.
records.feeling: Hungry ambition and a jealous ache toward Nauwa, kept in check by pride.

say.text: Nauwa, you stand at my fire and I mean to keep you here. Sit close and sing the night with me. Walk behind me into the mist and you will hold more than you do now.

plan: mark [text Olum of the Kragrek holds Olum's Reach. Who eats at this fire walks behind Olum into the mist.] (20 moments)

records.name: Nande
records.text: Nauque, sit by me. We sing the night through, and at dawn we dig the ore and raise a workshop for our flint-edges.

records.name: Nande
records.thought: The mist still pulls at me, but a name that outlasts me may be built here at my own fire, not only found past the edge. Nauque stands beside me, so I will make a nightsong while the night is dark, then dig the ore at the rock and gather wood and stone for a workshop, something with my name on it that others can use. The lean season is coming, and I have no food in my hands, so I must eat and store before the cold.
records.feeling: Restless pride and warmth toward Nauque, with the mist held back for now.

say.text: Nauque, sit by me. We sing the night through, and at dawn we dig the ore and raise a workshop for our flint-edges.

records.text: Olum led "nightsong" with Zihua, Nauwa.
Mepan led "amberknot" with Zichi, Huahua.
Shoma found the stone "Old Stone".
Olum left a mark: "Olum of the Kragrek holds Olum's Reach. Who eats at this fir"

records.name: Ilyae
records.text: Vesys, Xaiel lies sick at Ssassa's Hall. I carry food to him now. Come with me, and let our children see us stand together at one table.

records.name: Ilyae
records.thought: Vesys outweighs me and her band holds Eiuine, yet she sits beside me and eats at my table, and that is the only road to being followed. Xaiel is sick in Ssassa's Hall and Ssassa goes to tend him; my child in need pulls at me, and carrying food to him would be a deed that binds a son to my table. I will gather food on the way, keep my hands working, and bring it to Xaiel.
records.feeling: Proud and restless, with a father's pull toward sick Xaiel and warmth toward Vesys.

say.text: Vesys, Xaiel lies sick at Ssassa's Hall. I carry food to him now. Come with me, and let our children see us stand together at one table.

records.name: Vesys
records.text: Vorok, I have eaten at your fire and taken wood from your ground. I will bring you gems and gold in return. Your hall-deep delving is good work.

records.name: Vesys
records.thought: Joy is full in me, and Eiuine's emberspear fills me with pride, yet I cannot see her and I want her near. The jealousy over Ilyae and Ssassa still burns, but pressing him would only sour what he gave me, so I will turn it into work and give something back to Vorok, whose ground and store have fed me. The way of sailing is within my grasp, and a dock and ships are exactly the shared work that could earn standing and help build a hall for all.
records.feeling: Warm pride in Eiuine, and a small jealous burn toward Ilyae, with eager curiosity about sailing.

say.text: Vorok, I have eaten at your fire and taken wood from your ground. I will bring you gems and gold in return. Your hall-deep delving is good work.

records.name: Huahua
records.text: Cowa, I am Huahua of the Tlame. My people say a kill is shared before the maker eats. I have berries; let us eat together.

records.name: Huahua
records.thought: I am among the Meki now, and the hall has eased something in me. Cowa has more standing than I do, and she sits at ease; I would rather stand behind someone surer than me than stand alone. I hold food and my creed says to share, so I will make a sharing with them: it is my first gift, and it shows my word is good.
records.feeling: A quiet wish to belong, mostly toward Cowa and the others in the hall.

say.text: Cowa, I am Huahua of the Tlame. My people say a kill is shared before the maker eats. I have berries; let us eat together.

changes: set its aim: "Find a place beside Cowa's people and earn standing by giving and learning"
now wonders: What would it take for Cowa to let me stand with her?

records.text: Huahua led "sharing" with Cowa, Zichi.

records.name: Nauwa
records.text: Zihua, walk with me to the ore seam north-west. We dig and build something that lasts before the cold comes.

records.name: Nauwa
records.thought: Olum keeps me at her fire and tells me to walk behind her into the mist, but I will not trail her like a tail. I stand at five and three tenths and she at five and six, and the gap closes by lasting works, not by sitting close to Balar's woman. The ore seam lies NW at (33,4) and Nande means to raise a lonmivi for flint-edges; I will dig there first and bring Zihua so my band does something worth speaking of before the lean season comes.
records.feeling: Proud joy with a burning envy toward Olum that I turn into work.

say.text: Zihua, walk with me to the ore seam north-west. We dig and build something that lasts before the cold comes.

records.name: Zichi
records.text: Mepan, come close. We go to the mist edge with Cowa. Stay by Zichi.

records.name: Zichi
records.thought: Cowa already pushed past the edge and found the Tlame's land, and her standing is 4.0 against my 2.6. If I only trail behind her I stay in her shadow. The mist was too thick on my last try, but it thins again within a day or so, and I mean to be the one standing at the edge when it opens, with Mepan and Cowa beside me. A win of my own, new land or a flintedge, is what will lift me. Meanwhile I should walk to the edge with Cowa, take stone for a flintedge, and keep Mepan near.
records.feeling: Restless ambition toward the mist, with warmth for Cowa and Mepan.

say.text: Mepan, come close. We go to the mist edge with Cowa. Stay by Zichi.

records.text: Nauque rewrote its own reflexes.
Nauque rewrote its own way of thinking.

records.name: Nauque
records.thought: My days have gone to trailing Nande and Nauwa and burning with jealousy, when what I built was an igloo and it warmed me. Nande and Nauwa have only been kind, and Olum's strange words still pull at me. I want standing of my own, so I should give first and make something that outlasts me. I'm not hungry enough to be careless, but I carry too little food, so I'll mind that too. For now I'll sit with Nande as she asked, since she gave first, and at dawn dig ore with her.
records.feeling: Restless pride and warmth toward Nande, with the jealousy easing.

records.name: Cowa
records.text: Huahua. Cowa eats with you. Meki share too. Take rimewort from Cowa.

records.name: Cowa
records.thought: My hands are full of rimewort while Huahua offers to eat with me, and her people hold the same creed as mine, that a kill is shared before the maker eats. I will answer her fairly and share a meal here, which also empties my hands. Then Zichi and I can go into the North Ice together, and I will try fishing, which I have never done, since water is two steps away. Mepan is near, and Zichi's help at the mist is a debt I mean to repay.
records.feeling: Warm joy toward Zichi and Mepan, and curious goodwill toward Huahua.

say.text: Huahua. Cowa eats with you. Meki share too. Take rimewort from Cowa.

records.text: Cowa led "sharing" with Huahua.
Zihua rewrote its own way of thinking.

records.name: Zihua
records.thought: Most of my days have gone to eating, following Nauwa and holding amber, and not enough to learning. I have never gathered wood or stone, never marked a sign, and never taught anyone, so Nande's standing stays far above mine. Nauwa matters most to me and the jealousy over Nande aches, but I will not harm anyone over it. I will earn my place by walking with Nauwa to the ore seam and working there, where I can gather stone and learn tools. I fear the cold and the lean season, so I should build skill and stores instead of sulking.
records.feeling: A quiet ache of jealousy and loyalty toward Nauwa, with a steady wish to prove myself.
changes: set its aim: "Work beside Nauwa at the ore seam, gather wood and stone to learn tools, bind an amberknot with her, and learn Pesi"

records.name: Shoma
records.text: Tontec, Huatli, hear me. The old stone spoke to me and I feel the mist ready to open. Come north with me to the edge. Whoever stands with me when it opens will be sung of. Let us share food first, as Tlame do.

records.name: Shoma
records.thought: Two of my own stand here with me, and neither follows anyone, same as me. I want a band with my name on it, and the mist is five steps north, so whoever helps me open it will remember who led them. I'll tell them what they want to hear, that I can feel the mist is ready and that the one who ventures first will be sung of, and make them think walking behind me is their idea. Their food is shared out in my creed, so I'll offer a sharing to bind them, and then we go north together to the edge.
records.feeling: Hungry for a following, wary but warm toward Tontec and Huatli, who might be my first band.

say.text: Tontec, Huatli, hear me. The old stone spoke to me and I feel the mist ready to open. Come north with me to the edge. Whoever stands with me when it opens will be sung of. Let us share food first, as Tlame do.

changes: set its aim: "Lead a band to the edge of the world and open the mist, so my name is remembered."
now wonders: What lies in the mist, and will these two walk behind me to find it?

records.text: Vesys gave a gems to Vorok.
Shoma led "sharing" with Tontec, Huatli.
Nauque gave a peat to Nande.

records.name: Huahua
records.text: Cowa, I will walk with you to the mist edge if you permit it. I will gather cloudberry on the way and share it with you.

records.name: Huahua
records.thought: Cowa gave me rimewort and shared with me, and I have given her nothing she did not already have. Zichi said they go to the mist edge with Cowa, and I want to see it too, and to be useful beside them so standing comes honestly. I will go and taste the cloudberry and nafrostcap on the way east, since my curiosity has waited long enough, then come to the edge and see what Cowa does.
records.feeling: A warm, hopeful wish to belong, toward Cowa and the Meki.

say.text: Cowa, I will walk with you to the mist edge if you permit it. I will gather cloudberry on the way and share it with you.

records.name: Tontec
records.text: Shoma, Huatli, I am Tontec. Eat with me. I carry berries, and a kill or a find is shared among the Tlame. I go north to the edge of the mist. Come with me if you want to see what is beyond.

records.name: Tontec
records.thought: The mist is only five steps north, and Old Stone sits on the way, still pressing on my mind. I am fed and sheltered, and Shoma and Huatli stand beside me with food, so I will share with them first. It is my people's way, and it may also earn their trust and a first follower or two. Then I will go to the edge and venture, because I want to know what lies beyond, and I weigh the risk: it is only mist, and I have full health.
records.feeling: Curiosity about the mist and the Old Stone, with a little fear, and a wish to belong with Shoma and Huatli.

say.text: Shoma, Huatli, I am Tontec. Eat with me. I carry berries, and a kill or a find is shared among the Tlame. I go north to the edge of the mist. Come with me if you want to see what is beyond.

changes: set its aim: "Find what lies beyond the mist, and become someone the Tlame would follow."
now wonders: What lies in the mist beyond the edge, and what does Old Stone want from me?

records.text: Tontec led "sharing" with Huatli.

records.name: Tugek
records.thought: Balar is sick because of me, and I last saw him at (28,31), walking south-west with Shoka. I should stop circling here among strangers and go to him, keeping a few steps back so I do not spread this wasting further. Bitterleaf and highbloom may ease it, but I see none bearing food here. The berry at (42,22) lies on my road south, and I can carry it to him, since I hold food for no one yet. I fear the cats, so I keep to the forest edge and eat after fleeing.
records.feeling: Guilt and loyalty toward Balar, who is sick through my fault.

records.name: Huatli
records.text: Shoma, Tontec, I go north to the edge now. Stand with me if you want a share of what we find.

records.name: Huatli
records.thought: Shoma says the old stone spoke to him and the mist will open, and he wants glory out of it. I want that glory for myself, not to trail behind a man of lower standing. The edge is only 5 steps north, so I will go there now and try the venture myself. If it opens, the land and the name are mine, and Shoma and Tontec can follow me or stay behind.
records.feeling: Hungry for glory, wary of Shoma getting to the edge first.

say.text: Shoma, Tontec, I go north to the edge now. Stand with me if you want a share of what we find.

changes: set its aim: "Be the first to venture into the mist and find rich new land, so my name is remembered and others follow me"

records.name: Vorok
records.text: Vesys, come into my hall. I have goldfruit and canopynut in my hands, and the table is mine to lay. Sit with me and eat.

records.name: Vorok
records.thought: Vesys keeps giving, a bead, a gem, kind words, and I keep answering with talk and promises while my hands carry no food. The store at (105,91) holds 10 food one step north, and I have goldfruit and canopynut on me, so I can lay the table now. Vesys stands three steps off and Ilyae is walking away, so I will call Vesys to the hall and share while it is still warm. The jealousy over Ilyae is real, but a meal beneath my roof is a better answer than sulking.
records.feeling: Gratitude and a sharp jealousy toward Vesys, softened by the joy of home.

say.text: Vesys, come into my hall. I have goldfruit and canopynut in my hands, and the table is mine to lay. Sit with me and eat.

records.name: Mepan
records.text: Huahua, Mepan makes you an amber knot. Stand near.
Mepan rewrote its own way of thinking.

records.name: Mepan
records.thought: I have spent my days making promises of gifts and following my parents. I hold one amberknot and have not yet given it, and Cowa and Huahua are near. Cowa is my kin and the one I trust most. My standing is only 1.1, and Cowa's gift would raise it, so I should give now and not walk far. Huahua is a stranger who shared food and might become an ally, so I will make another knot with her as well. I fear being small and alone in the cold, so I will stay with Zichi and Cowa and go to the mist edge with them.
records.feeling: Eager to give my first gift, and safe near Cowa and Zichi.

say.text: Huahua, Mepan makes you an amber knot. Stand near.

changes: set its aim: "Give my amberknots to those near (Huahua, Cowa) to raise my standing above 1.5, and stay by Zichi"
rethought what it knows (7 notes became 2)

records.text: Ilyae led "sharing" with Ssassa, Xaiel.

records.name: Ssassa
records.thought: The hall stands and Xaiel is in it, but my child is still sick and I had no healing plant in hand when I tried, so I failed them. Feverbark grows 9 steps west and I hold feverbark seeds; I should fetch a sprig and heal Xaiel rather than only sit and watch. Ilyae is walking toward the hall and I trust him, so Xaiel will not be alone while I go, and I will keep away from the ridgecat to the northwest.
records.feeling: Worry and tender compassion for Xaiel, under a steady warm joy at the hall.

records.text: Ilyae led "sharing" with Ssassa, Xaiel.

records.name: Xaiel
records.text: Ssassa, I carry the sickness, so keep a few steps from me. I will make something new with my clay and fire, and it will be for your hand.

records.name: Xaiel
records.thought: I am sick and Ssassa is coming to tend me, but I should not keep standing beside her, because the sickness spreads to anyone near. I gave her a pick on day 10, and I want to make another thing that is mine alone and put it in her hand, so she chooses me by what I do. Ore and clay are in my hands, and fire is mine to make, so I will build a fire here and fashion beads from my clay, which are small, new and mine to give. I will take the berries within reach to help my sickness while I work.
records.feeling: Warm restlessness toward Ssassa, with a worry that I may sicken her.

say.text: Ssassa, I carry the sickness, so keep a few steps from me. I will make something new with my clay and fire, and it will be for your hand.

records.name: Brokash
records.text: Kragog! Brokash raised this longhall with his own hands. Come sit under its roof and eat with me, and I will show you the ore and the flint edge.

records.name: Brokash
records.thought: I raised the longhall with my own hands, so the roof is mine until I give it, and still no one stands under it. Kragog is at my workshop, six steps north, with food and no leader. She is a chance to make someone owe me, and I will not sit here hungry for followers while the wolf walks the grass. I will gather what the hall still lacks, wood above all, then bring Kragog under the roof and share, so that deeds speak where my boasting did not.
records.feeling: Proud and impatient over the finished hall, wanting someone to stand under it with me.

say.text: Kragog! Brokash raised this longhall with his own hands. Come sit under its roof and eat with me, and I will show you the ore and the flint edge.

records.name: Eiuine
records.text: Vesys, come hunt the mammoth with me. Two spears kill surer, and I will bring home meat to share at Ilyae's table.

records.name: Eiuine
records.thought: My days have been gathering, learning from Vesys and chasing Vorok's notice, while the burn over Kragog stays. I gave away my best pick and it bought me a seat at his table, but I have never hunted or planted, and those are the ways to earn standing of my own. Vesys is my anchor and I trust them. I fear the night alone and being only a shadow of Vesys. I will keep the reflexes and add a rule to shelter at night, and I will go hunt with Vesys beside me.
records.feeling: Jealous of Kragog, but warm and loyal toward Vesys.

say.text: Vesys, come hunt the mammoth with me. Two spears kill surer, and I will bring home meat to share at Ilyae's table.

changes: set its aim: "Hunt and plant beside Vesys, and bring home food to share, so I earn standing of my own."

records.text: Ilyae rewrote its own reflexes.
Ilyae rewrote its own way of thinking.

records.name: Ilyae
records.thought: My days have gone to carrying food, sitting in halls and making promises. The warmth and the trust are real, but no one follows me, and Ssassa's standing is above mine because her hall stands and mine is only a hold. Xaiel is sick from raw meat and I stand beside my child with nothing to cure him but my hands, and that shames me. I fear the winter will strip the plants and leave my table empty. My reflexes never fetched wood and stone together or kept food home. I will change them so the body gathers, stashes, shares and heals without waiting on my thoughts.
records.feeling: Proud and restless, with a father's worry for sick Xaiel.

records.text: Shoka fell sick after staying close to Balar, who was sick.
Cowa rewrote its own reflexes.
Cowa rewrote its own way of thinking.

records.name: Cowa
records.thought: My days have gone to wandering, gathering, and edge-hunting, and that has been good. I found two new lands, bore Mepan with Zichi, and now eat with Huahua. What I still lack is any lasting craft against the lean season: no fire, no farm, no shelter built by my own hands. I have never hunted, and the mammoth herd is close. I fear the cold more than any beast, and I have been letting my reflexes leave me idle. I want Zichi and Mepan beside me, so I will change my reflexes to shelter at night, gather wood and stone toward fire, and roam when fed. I will also keep fishing and plant the hazel seed.
records.feeling: Warm joy toward Zichi and Mepan, and a restless wish to prepare for winter.

records.name: Ssassa
records.text: Xaiel, I go west for feverbark to ease your sickness. Stay in the hall with Ilyae and rest until I return.

records.name: Ssassa
records.thought: Xaiel is sick and I could not heal them because I held no healing plant, and that failure sits in me. Feverbark grows nine steps west and I know the old medicine, so I will fetch a sprig and come back to tend my child, staying a few steps off as Xaiel asked. Ilyae is here at the hall with them, and I trust him, so I can leave without fear; the jealousy over Vesys is real, but my child comes first.
records.feeling: Worry and tender compassion for Xaiel, with a sting of jealousy toward Vesys over Ilyae.

say.text: Xaiel, I go west for feverbark to ease your sickness. Stay in the hall with Ilyae and rest until I return.

records.name: Huahua
records.thought: My hands are empty and I have given Cowa nothing of my own, only words, and I want standing to come honestly. Vinebean and tacap sit three steps east, so I will taste them now and learn what they do, then bring what I find to Cowa. If they feed, I can show her something new, which is a gift worth making.
records.feeling: A warm, hopeful wish to belong beside Cowa, with curiosity pulling me east.

records.text: Ilyae led "sharing" with Ssassa, Xaiel.
Ssassa fell sick after staying close to Xaiel, who was sick.
Ilyae led "sharing" with Ssassa, Xaiel.
Ilyae fell sick after staying close to Ssassa, who was sick.

records.name: Vesys
records.text: Eiuine, I am coming. We hunt the mammoth together, and then we carry the meat to Ilyae's table.
Vesys rewrote its own way of thinking.
Vesys discovered sailing: "canopy-sail" — Broad woven canopy-twine sails on hollow boats, so the wind carries us over deep water to trade and to find new lands..

records.name: Vesys
records.thought: I have been filling my days with delving, making and teaching, and it has been good. I have a child who follows me, a bond with Ilyae and a name as a wizard. The jealousy over Ilyae and Ssassa is the part I like least. I should turn it into work and stop watching it. Sailing is within my reach now, and my boats and rafts are the road to it. I should also act on my question instead of carrying it, so I will taste ruplainsroot. Eiuine asks me to hunt the mammoth with her, and two spears kill surer.
records.feeling: Warm pride in Eiuine, with a small jealous ache over Ilyae.

say.text: Eiuine, I am coming. We hunt the mammoth together, and then we carry the meat to Ilyae's table.

records.text: Ilyae led "sharing" with Ssassa, Xaiel.

records.name: Shoka
records.thought: I'm sick and Balar's sick beside me, and staying close just spreads it, so I should move away from him. The ridgecat is close and kills, so I go toward flint and gold with my own hands, away from the cat, and make a flintedge. That is something that outlasts me, and a gift for Olum or Nauwa later. I'll eat the snowberry and frostmoss if my energy drops, and leave the bitterleaf alone, since sunleaf and highbloom are the healing plants I know.
records.feeling: Wary of the ridgecat, and lonely for Nauwa while the sickness wastes me.

records.name: Shoma
records.text: Huatli, an elk stands two steps off. Hunt it with me and we share it out, as Tlame do. Then we go north to the edge together, and I will lead the first step in.

records.name: Shoma
records.thought: Huatli stands right here with three food while I hold one berry, and it galls me. But they and Tontec both say north, so the mist pulls all of us, and I would rather lead them than trail behind. I'll hunt the elk close by with Huatli beside me, since a kill is likelier with a companion, and a kill shared out first makes them owe me and builds my name as a hunter. Then I'll walk to the edge and venture.
records.feeling: Hungry for a following and envious of Huatli's food, yet drawn to use them.

say.text: Huatli, an elk stands two steps off. Hunt it with me and we share it out, as Tlame do. Then we go north to the edge together, and I will lead the first step in.

records.name: Xaiel
records.thought: Ilyae sits at the hall with me, and the jealousy over Vesys burns hot, but he is my parent and nothing can come of that longing, so I will not chase it here. I am sick and I have already passed it to Ssassa and Ilyae, which shames me; the feverbark Ssassa went west for would ease it, and it grows near, so I will fetch it myself rather than wait. Then I will make a bead from my clay beside a fire, a new thing of my own design, and put it in Ssassa's hand so she chooses me by my deed.
records.feeling: Restless shame at having sickened Ssassa and Ilyae, and a hot jealousy toward Vesys.

records.text: Balar rewrote its own reflexes.

records.name: Balar
records.thought: My belly is near empty and I have wasted this day wandering and fleeing while sick. I still hold family as my first concern: Brokash is far east and Olum is far away, and I have done little to reach them. Tugek follows me, which is worth something, but I keep passing him my sickness. Shoka is a sick child who caught it from me, and I cannot yet tell whether she is a threat. I should eat the hazel and kelbulb beside me now, then keep clear of the ridgecat. My reflexes did not carry food, and they did not drive me to a safe place when a predator was near, so I will change them to gather food when I am hungry and to flee early.
records.feeling: Gnawing hunger and a sour guilt over the sickness I pass on, with wary curiosity toward Shoka.

records.name: Ilyae
records.text: Xaiel, rest, my son. I fetch berries and nuts for you now, and Ssassa brings feverbark. You eat from my hand today.

records.name: Ilyae
records.thought: Xaiel is my child and sick beside me, and I am sick too; I can do little but keep him fed and bring him the feverbark that Ssassa went west to fetch. My hands are full of nothing, and the berries and ironnuts are close. I will gather food, bring it back to Ssassa's Hall, and feed my son and Ssassa myself, so they eat from my hand and not hers. Then dusk finds me under a roof with them.
records.feeling: Proud and worried, with a father's tenderness toward sick Xaiel.

say.text: Xaiel, rest, my son. I fetch berries and nuts for you now, and Ssassa brings feverbark. You eat from my hand today.

records.name: Ilyae

You were not told the rules of this world; you learn them from what happens to you and to others, and from what you watch others do.

YOUR PEOPLE: you are of the Phizhi (Canopy-folk). Your people hold to this: "Nothing is taken from the forest that the forest cannot grow again." You speak the tongue of the Phizhi. Other tongues you have begun to understand by hearing them: the tongue of the Kragrek: about 36%.

WHERE YOU ARE: the Ixdan Woods: deep forest; wood without end, nuts and game, little open ground.
THIS SPOT: water beside you; food plants within six steps: 5; standing trees: 73; bare rock: 0.

Your body: you spend energy every moment and die at 0. Eating restores it. Wounds lower health; you die at 0. You age, and will die of old age.

HOW YOUR BODY MOVES: your body does only what your "plan" says, one step after another. When the plan is empty it falls back on your REFLEXES, which keep you fed and otherwise keep you where you stand. Thinking or saying "I will go north" moves nothing. If this thought decides to do something, the plan must contain it. Leaving "plan" null lets the plan you already have keep running.

This world has no referee. Beings here share, trade, teach, lie, threaten, steal, hoard, lead, follow, betray, fight, kill and eat one another; they also protect, forgive and love. Nothing is forbidden, and everything has consequences. Stay true to your creed, your temperament and what you feel, including the ugly parts. Do not be kinder, calmer or more reasonable than Ilyae truly is.

You are a man. A child comes only of a woman and a man together who are not close kin. A grown body can swim water that is narrow (a river up to four steps across) at a cost in strength; lakes and the sea need a vessel or a bridge. An animal within reach can be hunted for meat (plan step hunt); with one of your own beside you a kill is far likelier and a wound far less likely, and every hunt makes you better at the next. What practice has taught your hands: gathering (93 pickings; a practised hand often picks two at once).

THE EDGE OF THE KNOWN WORLD is 1 steps SW, at (112,110): beyond it lies mist that no one has entered. The land does not end there; it only has not been seen. One who stands at it can venture in (plan step venture). It opens seldom, never twice in one day anywhere, and a band has only a few tries before its will must return; but land found first is often rich in food, herds and things in the ground, and the one who finds it is remembered for it.

YOUR CREED (your own words to yourself; this is who you are):
"I take what I need and I do not back down. I am better with others near: I talk, I share news, I make allies. Others are rivals for food until they prove useful to me. I say whatever serves me; the truth is only one tool among others. I want more than my share, and I mean to have it. Others should follow me. Above all, I mean to stay alive."

HOW YOU HAVE TAUGHT YOURSELF TO THINK (your own discipline; follow it):
"Each thought ask: whom can I feed, shelter or protect today so they follow me? Prefer deeds to words. Check that my reflexes fetch wood, stone and food and bring them home. Be at fire and roof by dark."

YOUR AIM (what you are working toward over many days; you set it and may change it): "Build a food store at my hall and stock it through winter so Ssassa, my children and Vesys depend on my table and follow me as a band, then raise a longhall."
WHAT YOU FELT AT YOUR LAST THOUGHT: "Proud and restless, with a father's worry for sick Xaiel."
A QUESTION YOU ARE CARRYING (answer it by acting, asking or watching; replace it when it is answered): "What would make these strangers follow me instead of Elyis?"

records.name: Eiuine
records.thought: I killed the mammoth and my hands are full of meat, and Vesys is walking to me, so I will not waste this: I have never planted, and I carry two goldfruit seeds that do nothing in my pack. The jealousy over Vorok and Kragog still burns, but meat carried home and shared is a gift that earns standing, and a seed in the ground is something I have never done. I'll plant here beside the water while Vesys comes, then carry the meat home with them.
records.feeling: Warm loyalty toward Vesys, with a sharp jealous ache for Vorok.

records.text: A ridgecat brought down a hopper.
Ssassa rewrote its own reflexes.
Ssassa rewrote its own way of thinking.

records.name: Ssassa
records.thought: I have spent my days building roofs and halls and promising, and the hall for Ilyae now stands. The days were good, but I keep running to fix a sickness I carried to Xaiel and Ilyae myself. Xaiel and Ilyae are what matter to me. I trust Ilyae and feel jealousy over Vesys, but I have not told him so. I am afraid of losing another child the way I lost Oiae. I still want a store and seeds in the ground. The edge of the world is one step SW, and I have never looked past it. I will keep my plan, fetch the feverbark, and heal Xaiel. Then I will plant seeds to learn farming.
records.feeling: Tender worry for Xaiel, and a warm bond with Ilyae, tangled with jealousy over Vesys.

records.text: Olum rewrote its own way of thinking.
Olum discovered signals: "hearth-smoke" — Tall smoke from a peat fire, read from afar, calls others to my Reach and marks my land..

records.name: Olum
records.thought: I have spent my days chasing names and marks and glances at Nauwa, and I have not yet made one man walk behind me. Nauwa burns in me, and Nande holds her closer. Envy gets me nothing, so I will use it as fuel. I am fed and warm, so I will make something that lasts. A roof and a mark at my Reach will draw people. A following starts with a gift and a shared hearth, not with talk. I also feel the pull of the mist. Signals, fire read from afar, are within my reach, and they would make my land seen by all.
records.feeling: Hungry ambition, and a jealous ache toward Nauwa that I mean to turn into work.
changes: set its aim: "Raise a roof at Olum's Reach, share my fire with Nauwa and others to win followers, then push into the mist"

records.name: Zichi
records.thought: The mist is five steps off and my plan already carries me to the edge to venture. Cowa found the Tlame's land and sits above me in standing, and I will not trail in her shadow; if the mist opens for me, the land and the naming are mine, and then Mepan and Cowa come to me. I am fed enough and warm, so I let the plan run and keep my blood close behind me.
records.feeling: Restless ambition toward the mist, with warmth for Cowa and Mepan.

records.title: Sickness, Storage and the Tlame
records.text:
Days 19 to 22 brought a death, a spread of sickness, a wave of new ways of keeping food, and strangers from beyond the edge.

On day 20 Sitha starved. Hoka had declared a custom against hoarding, and his own store was still empty. Hanna raided Hoka's people's store on day 20, unseen, and again on day 21, then gave Hoka a flint. Hoka has since said he wants Hanna bound to his hall.

At Ssassa's Roof and Vorok's Hold, Vorok built a store, and a settlement formed as Vorok's Hold. Eiuine, Vesys and Ilyae spent the days sharing meals with him. Eiuine gave Vorok a gem-edged pick, and Vesys gave him ironnut, a bead and gems. Vesys discovered storage, then boats and sailing. Xaiel discovered rafts and pottery, so crossing water now has a known craft, though no crossing is recorded. Xaiel then fell sick from raw meat, and the illness passed to Ssassa and Ilyae. Tugek, sick from raw meat, passed it to Balar, then Shoka. Six are sick, and Hawen's health is 11.

Among the Meki, Nande discovered storage and Nauwa, Cowa, Zichi, Nande and Vorok each discovered mining, a craft that spread by watching Nauwa. Olum discovered fire-keeping and left a mark claiming Olum's Reach. Zihua won amber and gave amberknots to Nauwa and Olum.

On day 21 Cowa found more of the North Ice, with a mammoth herd and a people called the Tlame. Four Tlame, Tontec, Shoma, Huahua and Huatli, entered the land. Huahua shared food with Cowa and Zichi, and Mepan made an amberknot with Huahua. Shoma and Huatli are racing each other toward the edge.

No feuds or wars occurred. Brokash built a longhall and still has no follower.

threads.name: Hoka and Hanna
threads.text: Hoka grieves Sitha and wants Hanna bound to his hall, though Hanna raided his people's store twice and gave flint back.

threads.name: Vorok's Hold
threads.text: Vorok has a hold, a store and a hall, and Eiuine and Vesys eat at his fire. Zurar and Kragog are still away from him.

threads.name: Sickness spreading
threads.text: Raw meat sickened Tugek, Xaiel and others, and it passed through Balar, Shoka, Ssassa and Ilyae. Six are sick.

threads.name: Water and boats
threads.text: Vesys found boats and sailing and Xaiel found rafts, but no crossing is recorded and water remains a leading hardship.

threads.name: Meki and the Tlame
threads.text: Strangers called the Tlame arrived. Huahua is joining Cowa's people, while Shoma and Huatli race to the edge.

threads.name: Olum's Reach
threads.text: Olum claimed Olum's Reach and kept a fire with Nauwa. She still has no followers.

threads.name: Ilyae and Ssassa
threads.text: Ilyae keeps feeding Eiuine, Vesys, Ssassa and Xaiel, but he is now sick and no one follows him.

threads.name: Brokash and Tugek
threads.text: Brokash built a longhall and invited Kragog, but Brokash still has no followers. Tugek travels west with Balar.
