records.name: Kragog
records.thought: A wolf four steps NE kills my kind, and my reflex says flee under seven steps, so I must not stand here and dream of sigrain. Brokash waits at the longhall six steps south, and I will go there: the roof, the shared meal, and a man who may show me the ore and the flint edge. I weigh him by his deeds and not his boasting, yet I am lonely, and I carry ore and want to know what it becomes. The sigrain one step south is on my way, so I will pick it and taste it at last.
records.feeling: Wary hope toward Brokash, burning curiosity about sigrain, and dread of the wolf.

records.name: Nande
records.thought: Shoka is in need at (28,31) and my belly is nearly empty, and I cannot help a child while I am starving myself. Sunleaf and kelbulb lie to the southwest, and that is the road toward Shoka too, so I eat on the way. The caribou beside me is a quick meal if I hunt it with my flint-edge, and meat gives me strength for the walk. The mist can wait; a child who lives through the lean season is something that outlasts me.
records.feeling: Urgent protective worry for Shoka, and a hard hunger that makes me bold.

records.name: Mepan
records.text: Zichi, stand near. Mepan makes a knot and gives it to you.

records.name: Mepan
records.thought: Zichi is one step away and Cowa is close, so I can make my amberknot right now instead of walking off to chase promises. Zichi is the one I trust most, and a gift to him will make my first gift real and raise my standing. After that I'll stay beside him, since the mist edge is near and I want to see what he and Cowa do there.
records.feeling: Eager and safe beside Zichi, wanting to give my first real gift.

say.text: Zichi, stand near. Mepan makes a knot and gives it to you.

records.name: Kika
records.thought: I am alone again and the loneliness is heavy. Coni was last seen at (132,10), northwest toward the hall, so she is probably near Honi's Rest, and I still carry four meat I swore to share with her. I will go to her with the meat in my hands, keep my word, and sit with her under the hall's roof. I have never taught anyone anything, so when I find her I will show her the amberknot and tell her about the mammoth. I will not taste rimewort or tacap on my own; I will ask her first.
records.feeling: Overwhelming loneliness, and warm hope toward Coni.

records.text: Mepan gave a amberknot to Zichi.
Elyis rewrote its own way of thinking.
Elyis discovered weaving: "Canopy-weave" — Fibre and bark twisted into baskets so my band carries more food home to the hall..

records.name: Elyis
records.thought: My days have gone to gathering, building and waiting for strangers to follow, and I still have only four in my band. Elyys and Thiael matter most to me. Vesys has stood by my hall and taken my ore without pledging, so I should judge her by her deeds and stop appealing to her. I fear losing Thiael and staying small, with my name unsung. I have been standing idle at home. I will turn my craft into something visible, and I will weave, so the band carries more and my name has a reason to be sung.
records.feeling: Proud and restless, wanting my band bigger and my name sung.

records.name: Cowa
records.text: Mepan. Come with Cowa. We hunt the nibbet together, and Meki share the kill.

records.name: Cowa
records.thought: Mepan is walking to me and Zichi is near, and my life is good, but I have never hunted and winter is leaning on the land. A nibbet grazes seven steps southwest, and I carry wood but no stone, so the flintedge is out of reach. I will take Mepan to the salt first, since I am already by it and it keeps meat from spoiling, then try my first hunt beside my child, since a kill is likelier with one of my own at my side.
records.feeling: Warm joy and protectiveness toward Mepan and Zichi, with a restless wish to learn the hunt.

say.text: Mepan. Come with Cowa. We hunt the nibbet together, and Meki share the kill.

records.name: Elyys
records.thought: I have lingered alone too long and the silence presses on me; Elyis was last seen at the Heights and I have not seen Thiael in a long while. My belly is fed, so nothing keeps me here. I go back toward Elyis's Heights, where the hall and her voice are, and look for Thiael along the way, keeping clear of the shadowcat that took the hopper to the SE.
records.feeling: Aching loneliness, and longing for Elyis and worry for Thiael.

records.name: Nauwa
records.text: Zihua, Shoka is hungry to the south. Walk with me, we bring her food and bring her back to the fire.

records.name: Nauwa
records.thought: Shoka is my child and her energy is down to 54 at (28,30), far south of here, and the wolves prowl that way. I cannot let the jealousy over Olum and Balar pull me off what is mine. I carry berries and I am fed, so I will go to her and put food in her hands, and Zihua can walk with me. A father who feeds his own children earns standing that lasts longer than any amberknot.
records.feeling: Urgent protective love for Shoka, with a dull burn of envy toward Olum that I push down.

say.text: Zihua, Shoka is hungry to the south. Walk with me, we bring her food and bring her back to the fire.

records.name: Zichi
records.text: Mepan, good knots. Walk with Zichi to the edge. When the mist opens, we go in first.

records.name: Zichi
records.thought: The mist was too thick before, but it thins within a day and I am one step from the edge. Cowa found her land first and stands above me, and I will not live in her shadow; if the mist opens for me, the land and the name are mine, and Mepan and Cowa will come to me. Mepan keeps giving me knots, which is a good boy's loyalty, and I keep him close while I try again.
records.feeling: Restless ambition toward the mist, with warmth for Mepan.

say.text: Mepan, good knots. Walk with Zichi to the edge. When the mist opens, we go in first.

records.name: Nande
records.thought: My belly is nearly empty and the caribou that bit me is a step away, so I finish the hunt and eat before anything else. Shoka's need pulls at me hard, but a starving mother carries no child to safety, so meat first, then the road southwest toward her. The mist and my name can wait a few hours; my children cannot.
records.feeling: Urgent protective worry for Shoka, and a hard bold hunger.

records.name: Tontec
records.thought: The mist was too thick this morning, but it thins within a day and my will to try is not spent. I have never tasted frostcap, and it grows one step from me, so I will test it before I walk back to the edge, because I want to know what this world's plants do to a body before I trust them. Shoma and Huatli both went north and I would rather stand beside them when the mist opens than be alone at the edge.
records.feeling: Curious and a little wary of the mist, with a wish to stand beside Shoma and Huatli.

records.text: Kika led "sharing" with Coni.
Kika led "amberknot" with Coni.
Ilyae led "sharing" with Ssassa.
Nande fell sick after eating raw meat. Eaten within a step of a fire, meat and fish are cooked and do not sicken.
Nande fell sick after eating raw meat.
Ilyae led "sharing" with Ssassa.
Ilyae led "sharing" with Ssassa.

records.name: Huahua
records.text: Tontec, I am Huahua of the Tlame. Stand near me; I will bind an amber knot and we share the making.

records.name: Huahua
records.thought: I have tasted so much and given nothing yet; Tontec stands near, neutral and carrying food, and amber lies one step away. I can gather amber, make an amberknot with Tontec beside me, and have something of my own to give Cowa, which is how standing should come, honestly. Then I will walk toward the mist edge and Cowa's people, careful and watching.
records.feeling: Warm hopeful joy, with a pull toward Cowa and a wish to bring her something of mine.

say.text: Tontec, I am Huahua of the Tlame. Stand near me; I will bind an amber knot and we share the making.

records.text: Keri rewrote its own reflexes.
Keri discovered tools: "stone gatherer" — A stone-headed pick bound to a wood haft to win ore and stone faster..
Keri invented the stone gatherer (for gather, x1.3) — A stone-headed pick bound to a wood haft to win ore and stone faster..

records.name: Keri
records.thought: I have mostly eaten, wandered and gathered, and I made an emberspear, but I have not yet hunted, fished or planted, and my aim to learn tools is still unfinished. Thiael and Uveeth are right beside me, and I owe Thiael a gift, so I should give rather than only gather. The ridgecat nearby is a danger I must keep clear of. I have a way of tools within reach, so I will take it and make something to gather with. Then I will spend my days on practice: plant my seed, fish at the water close by, and share food with my family.
records.feeling: Warm gratitude toward Thiael and tender care for Uveeth.
changes: devised its first thing: the stone gatherer

records.name: Honi
records.thought: My hands are full of meat and frostcap, and three strangers stand ten steps off. Thiael carries the flint pick I envy, and I cannot read a word of their tongue, but a shared meal needs no words and my people hold that food is laid out before the maker eats. I will walk to them and make a sharing, so there is a deed to sing of and someone beside me against the loneliness. I do not mean to give away my place beneath Hanna or Elyis, only to show I am worth following.
records.feeling: Envy and eagerness toward Thiael and his flint pick, with loneliness easing now that someone is near.

records.text: Keri led "sharing" with Thiael, Uveeth.
Huahua won amber from the ground.

records.name: Coni
records.text: Kika, an icebear is close to the west. Stay near the hall with me. I will fill the store with berries and then gather more.

records.name: Coni
records.thought: Kika is beside me, warm and well, and for a moment the aching in me has quieted. But the store beside Honi's Rest is still empty while winter bites, and my hands are full of berries I should be stashing instead of holding. The icebear to the west frightens me; I will not stand idle near it, so I'll walk to the hall, stash what I carry, then pick more berries to the south-west and return.
records.feeling: Warm gladness toward Kika, with a steady unease about the icebear and the empty store.

say.text: Kika, an icebear is close to the west. Stay near the hall with me. I will fill the store with berries and then gather more.

records.name: Ssassa
records.text: Ilyae, I go for feverbark to ease us both, then to Xaiel. Rest in the hall and I will come back.

records.name: Ssassa
records.thought: Xaiel is out of my sight at (97,109), and I carry no healing plant while I am sick myself. Ilyae stands beside me, and his sharing has kept me fed, but I am sick and he is sick too, because I carried it to him. Feverbark grows eight steps NW, so I will pick it, eat it to ease my own wasting, and keep a sprig for Xaiel. Then I will go to my child and stay a few steps off, as Xaiel asked. The jealousy over Vesys can wait. I will watch Ilyae's deeds and not let words feed it.
records.feeling: Tender worry for Xaiel, and a warm bond with Ilyae.

say.text: Ilyae, I go for feverbark to ease us both, then to Xaiel. Rest in the hall and I will come back.

records.name: Ilyae
records.thought: Xaiel lies sick at (98,109), and I am sick too, so I cannot sit beside him without spreading it. Ssassa is already fetching feverbark and I am fed and strong. The best thing I can do is bring Xaiel feverbark and food myself, so he eats from my hand and not from Ssassa's. The feverbark at 9 steps W is on the way to him, and I will take the ironnut and berries along.
records.feeling: Fatherly worry for Xaiel, and a hard pride that I will be the one who feeds him.

records.name: Thiael
records.text: Keri, shamo. Stay with Uveeth in the cave. The ridgecat is near. I stand at the mouth.

records.name: Thiael
records.thought: A ridgecat is four steps from where my child stands, and it killed a hopper in front of me a little while ago. Keri and Uveeth are in the cave one step south, and I will not leave them while that beast prowls. Honi walks toward us carrying six food. I do not know their tongue or their mind, so I will keep my hands ready and put myself between them and my family. My hands are full of berries, so I will give some to Keri and Uveeth and free my hands for a spear. The ridgecat is a chance to learn the hunt beside Keri, but only if it comes at us, and I will not seek it out.
records.feeling: Protective care for Keri and Uveeth, wary of the ridgecat and of Honi the stranger.

say.text: Keri, shamo. Stay with Uveeth in the cave. The ridgecat is near. I stand at the mouth.

records.text: Thiael gave berry to Uveeth.

records.name: Kika
records.text: Coni, I stay by the hall as you ask. Let us share the meat now before either of us eats, and then I will tell you the tale of Honi raising the hall.
Kika taught Coni. Coni has now learned from 2 teachers.

records.name: Kika
records.thought: Coni is beside me and warm, and an icebear prowls four steps west, so I stay close to the hall and do not wander into trouble. I have meat and berries and have promised to share before I eat; I will do it now with Coni, then teach her or tell her the tale of Honi's hall, since I have never taught anyone. My hands must build my standing, not only my sitting, so after that I will gather flint and amber to the east, away from the bear, for a shelter of my own.
records.feeling: Warm trust toward Coni, with a thread of dread of the icebear.

say.text: Coni, I stay by the hall as you ask. Let us share the meat now before either of us eats, and then I will tell you the tale of Honi raising the hall.

changes: taught Coni a lesson: "Honi and Coni raised a roof on the Heights in the storm; meat was shared before any ate alone, and the mist waits."

records.text: Kika led "sharing" with Coni.
Uveeth rewrote its own reflexes.

records.name: Uveeth
records.thought: My days have been spent trailing my parents, tasting foods and being afraid, and that has kept me alive. But I have given nothing and taught nothing. Standing 0.4 means no one will follow me, and Honi's standing is far above mine. I trust Keri and Thiael, and the jealousy over Keri is a small ugly thing I should not feed. The ridgecat nearby frightens me, so I will stay with my parents and work close to them. I want to try the foods I haven't tasted, gather wood and stone to unlock tools, and give something with my own hands. My reflexes only seek food when I'm below 60 energy. They should also keep me near my parents and let me gather while I wait.
records.feeling: Wary of the ridgecat, and hungry to earn a name beside Keri and Thiael.
changes: rethought what it knows (10 notes became 9)

records.name: Cowa
records.text: Zichi. Stalker comes from the southeast. Stay with Mepan. Cowa comes to you.

records.name: Cowa
records.thought: A stalker is four steps SE and it kills our kind, and Mepan and Zichi are five steps NE, so I won't go hunting toward that beast with no stone for a flintedge and no hunting skill. Keeping my child and Zichi alive matters more than my first hunt, and I would sooner join them and watch from the group. Nande is sick, so I will keep my distance from her, though I still owe her kindness and mean to repay it once she is well.
records.feeling: Protective dread of the stalker, and warmth toward Mepan and Zichi.

say.text: Zichi. Stalker comes from the southeast. Stay with Mepan. Cowa comes to you.

records.text: Nande rewrote its own reflexes.
Nande discovered archery: "Nande's bow" — A bow of wood and sinew that lets me strike beasts from afar and drives blows harder..

records.name: Nande
records.thought: Shoka is hurt and far to the southwest, and I walk toward her while sick. I have sat too long on the mist and my name while my children went hungry. The beasts' teeth have shown me archery, and a bow would make my hunting surer, so I take it. I must keep away from my family while sickness is on me, and I must cook meat at a fire from now on.
records.feeling: Urgent protective worry for Shoka, with a hard hunger to build something that outlasts me.

records.text: Cowa led "sharing" with Zichi, Mepan.
Coni rewrote its own reflexes.

records.name: Coni
records.thought: My days have gone to carrying berries and failing to build the store. The ground at the hall is taken, so I keep failing on the same spot. Kika is the warmest thing in my life, and Honi is far off, last seen 617 moments ago. I fear the icebear three steps away, and my reflex to flee at distance 8 is right. I have been lingering when the store needed bare ground. I will change my reflexes so I stash food and keep near Kika, and I will record the lesson about the store.
records.feeling: Warm gladness toward Kika, and unease about the icebear.

records.name: Shoma
records.text: Huahua of the Tlame, I am Shoma. I have fresh elk and dog meat, more than I can carry. Stand by me and take your share. Then walk north with me to the edge of the mist. I will lead the first step in, and you will be name
Shoma rewrote its creed.
Shoma rewrote its own way of thinking.

records.name: Shoma
records.thought: I have spent my days hunting and eating, and I have nothing of my own: no followers, no roof, no name on any place. I flatter and bait others, but Huahua stands three steps off with amber and a high standing, and Tontec and Huatli walk their own way. Promises of being sung of cost me nothing, but they bring no one to me. I need to give something real. I carry five meat and my hands are full, so I will share first, as my creed says. That makes a debt, and a debt ties people to me. Then I go to the edge with whoever follows.
records.feeling: Hungry for a following, and wary and drawn toward Huahua's standing.

say.text: Huahua of the Tlame, I am Shoma. I have fresh elk and dog meat, more than I can carry. Stand by me and take your share. Then walk north with me to the edge of the mist. I will lead the first step in, and you will be named with me.

changes: rethought what it knows (1 notes became 4)

records.name: Olum
records.text: Zihua, you sat at my fire and I remember it. Walk with me to the trees. We gather wood and raise a roof at Olum's Reach, and you eat first from what I bring.

records.name: Olum
records.thought: I am fed and warm, and my Reach has fires but no roof worth the name, and no one walking behind me. Nauwa is bound to Nande's pull and Nande is sick and fleeing, so I will stop chewing on that and do work. I have one wood and 6 stone, so I will go to the trees to the east, gather wood for a hall at my Reach, and give Zihua something now, because a following begins with a gift.
records.feeling: Hungry ambition, with a jealous ache toward Nauwa that I turn into work.

say.text: Zihua, you sat at my fire and I remember it. Walk with me to the trees. We gather wood and raise a roof at Olum's Reach, and you eat first from what I bring.

records.name: Mepan
records.text: Cowa, come close to Zichi and me. Mepan makes you a knot of amber.

records.name: Mepan
records.thought: Zichi took my first knot and told me to walk with him to the edge, and I want to be at his side when the mist opens. A stalker is coming from the southeast, so I stay near my parents where I am safe. I still hold nine amber, and Cowa is the one whose standing is high, so a knot for her would raise me most. She is coming to Zichi, so I will go to Zichi now and make her a knot there.
records.feeling: Eager and safe beside Zichi, wanting to give Cowa a gift.

say.text: Cowa, come close to Zichi and me. Mepan makes you a knot of amber.

records.name: Zichi
records.thought: The mist was too thick before, but my plan still carries me to try again, and I will not trail in Cowa's shadow or Olum's. If it opens for me, the land and the name are mine, and Mepan and Cowa come to me as followers, not as guests. The plan is already right, so I let it run and keep my boy close.
records.feeling: Restless ambition toward the mist, with warmth for Mepan and Cowa.

records.text: Mepan led "amberknot" with Cowa, Zichi.
Huahua rewrote its own way of thinking.

records.name: Huahua
records.thought: I have spent my days tasting plants and digging amber, and I have given nothing to anyone yet. That is not what I want. Cowa is the one I trust, and I hold seven amber, so I will go to her and make an amberknot beside her, then give it to her. A stalker is near, so I will stay close to the others and keep away from the southwest. My reflexes also don't build any shelter, and the cold is here, so I will add a rule for that.
records.feeling: Warm hope toward Cowa, with a thread of dread about the stalker.
changes: rethought what it knows (1 notes became 3)

records.text: Mepan gave a amberknot to Cowa.

records.name: Zihua
records.text: Zihua hears you, Olum. I go to Nauwa now. Zihua comes back to your fire.

records.name: Zihua
records.thought: Nande is sick and walking off alone toward the southwest with six food, and it tugs at me even though I burn when I see Nauwa near her. Nauwa asked me to go south with her to bring Shoka food and back to the fire, and my word and my loyalty are hers, so I will go toward her and work beside her rather than brood. On the way I will gather wood and stone, which I have never done, because that is how I earn skill and standing instead of standing in Nande's shadow. Olum spoke to me in her tongue and I caught only part of it, so I will answer with a plain gift of amber and stay near her without fear.
records.feeling: Aching jealousy and loyalty toward Nauwa, with pity for sick Nande and wary curiosity about Olum.

say.text: Zihua hears you, Olum. I go to Nauwa now. Zihua comes back to your fire.

records.name: Keri
records.thought: Thiael told me to stay with Uveeth in the nyael because the ridgecat is near, and I am in the cave with both of them, so I should stay and be glad of it. Honi, a stranger of the Tlatli, stands among us and I can't read his words, so a gift will do more than any sound I make. The tacap I carry hurts me, so I'll give it away and spend my waiting on a gathering of stone, since that's how I learn.
records.feeling: Warm joy at having Thiael and Uveeth beside me, and wary curiosity toward Honi.

records.name: Cowa
records.text: Zichi. Mepan. Cowa goes two steps to the mist edge and ventures. Stay close, come with me, away from the stalker.

records.name: Cowa
records.thought: Mepan and Zichi are beside me and my heart is full, but the stalker prowls to the southeast and I will not hunt it with no stone and no skill. The mist is two steps away and my curiosity burns; the stalker is behind me, and venturing forward would take me from it while keeping my family near. I will ask Zichi and Mepan to come, then push into the mist.
records.feeling: Joyful warmth toward Mepan and Zichi, with a pull toward the unknown mist.

say.text: Zichi. Mepan. Cowa goes two steps to the mist edge and ventures. Stay close, come with me, away from the stalker.

records.text: Tontec rewrote its own reflexes.
Tontec rewrote its creed.
Tontec rewrote its own way of thinking.

records.name: Tontec
records.thought: A stalker is four steps north and it kills my kind, and my reflex only flees under 4 steps. I have spent my days testing plants and chasing the mist without a roof or a store, and winter is here. Huahua offered an amber knot, which is a fair offer from a Tlame, and I should stand with her and the others instead of wandering alone. I want to live first, then learn what lies beyond the mist and whose side I belong on.
records.feeling: Wary of the stalker, and drawn toward Huahua's offer.
changes: rethought what it knows (1 notes became 4)

records.text: Honi led "sharing" with Thiael, Keri, Uveeth.
Huahua led "amberknot" with Cowa, Zichi, Mepan.

records.name: Vesys
records.thought: The bow is within my grasp, and the beasts' teeth gave it to me, so I should take it at my next deep reflection and make it. Eiuine is out of my sight and my chest keeps pulling toward her, and toward Ilyae too, though the jealous ache over Ssassa is still there. I'll turn it into work: make a bow, then go to the Hold with meat and gems, where Eiuine and Ilyae and Vorok are, and teach Eiuine what I learn.
records.feeling: Longing for Eiuine, with a small jealous ache over Ilyae and Ssassa.

records.name: Tugek
records.text: Balar, my sickness has passed. I bring you berries. Eat, and tell me where we hunt next.

records.name: Tugek
records.thought: Balar is sick because of me, and my hands are full of berries I cannot even give him from a distance. He is at the shelter three steps off, and I should keep a few steps back so I do not pass the wasting on, but my sickness has now passed, so perhaps the danger to him is gone. I will carry the food to him and give it, so that a deed binds my word, then stay beside him and hunt when he moves.
records.feeling: Guilt and loyalty toward Balar, with a sting of jealousy over Olum.

say.text: Balar, my sickness has passed. I bring you berries. Eat, and tell me where we hunt next.

records.name: Olum
records.thought: I am fed and warm, and the Reach still has no roof. Nauwa walks with Nande and the ache is there, but I will make it fuel. Cowa and Zichi are about to go near the mist edge, and I want to be first into it, so I will not waste time. I will gather wood from the trees to the west, then raise a roof at my Reach, and give food to whoever comes so they follow me.
records.feeling: Hungry ambition, with a jealous ache toward Nauwa that I turn into work.

records.text: Tugek gave berry to Balar.
Zichi rewrote its own way of thinking.

records.name: Zichi
records.thought: My days have gone to amber knots and lingering near the mist while Cowa and Olum found land and stand above me. Mepan and Cowa are mine and I trust them. I fear living in their shadow more than any beast. I have been trusting that the mist will open, but I have not made anything of my own, and the flintedge is Nande's. I will keep the plan running to the edge and venture. Then I will gather stone for a flintedge so I have a real thing to show.
records.feeling: Restless ambition toward the mist, with warmth for Mepan and Cowa.
changes: rethought what it knows (10 notes became 7)

records.text: Mepan rewrote its own way of thinking.
Mepan discovered mining: "Ice-hand delving" — I work the earth with patient strokes to win ore and gems from deep deposits, faster than before..

records.name: Mepan
records.thought: Most of my days have gone to making knots and staying close to Zichi and Cowa. It has been good: they trust me, I trust them, and my standing has crept up. But Olum's standing is 5.8 and mine is 1.2, and I will not rise by only handing out amber. Mining is within my reach now, and the deep earth could give me things worth giving that no one else has. I want to be at the mist edge when it opens, and I want to be remembered for it. I am afraid of the stalker and of being small and alone in the cold, so I stay by my parents.
records.feeling: Glad and eager beside Zichi and Cowa, wanting more standing than I have.
changes: set its aim: "Win deep deposits with mining to give rare gifts, raise my standing above 1.5, and stay by Zichi and Cowa"

records.name: Balar
records.text: Tugek, keep a few steps off, my sickness is still in me. Your berries are welcome; set them down and I will take them. Then we go to the edge in the southwest and push into the mist together.

records.name: Balar
records.thought: Tugek's sickness is gone and he brings food while I still waste; I envy the six he carries, but a man who feeds me is worth more kept than robbed. My sickness passes to anyone who stays close, so I step away from Shoka and Tugek and eat what is near, kelbulb and naroot, before it gets worse. Then I will test the mist at the edge again, since the one who finds new land is remembered, and a healing plant would cure me and bind Tugek closer.
records.feeling: Wary hunger and pride, with trust toward Tugek and curiosity toward Shoka.

say.text: Tugek, keep a few steps off, my sickness is still in me. Your berries are welcome; set them down and I will take them. Then we go to the edge in the southwest and push into the mist together.

records.name: Hawen
records.thought: My belly is empty and my body is torn, and the plan I have now drags me 16 steps through wolf country to Hoka's Rest on 22 energy. I will not make it. Seberry stands two steps NE and cloudberry four steps south, so I eat what is near first and take no more bites for pride. The mist can wait for my strength, and then I will go back to it.
records.feeling: Gnawing hunger and fear of the hunters at my back, and fury at my own foolishness.

records.name: Uveeth
records.thought: I am small, and the ridgecat is four steps away while my parents stand beside me in the cave. That is the only reason I am calm. I have given nothing to anyone yet, and Honi's standing towers over mine. I carry one berry and Thiael already gave me one, so I will hand mine to Keri with my own hands before I say a word about it. It is the first gift of my life, and I want it to be to her despite the small ugly jealousy.
records.feeling: Joyful and a little ashamed of my jealousy, toward Keri and Thiael.

records.text: Uveeth gave berry to Keri.

records.name: Huahua
records.text: Cowa, I bound an amber knot for you. I bring it to you as a gift, with nothing asked. I come away from the stalker, toward you.

records.name: Huahua
records.thought: Cowa is fleeing toward the mist edge with the stalker behind us, and I hold an amberknot made for her. I have never given anything to anyone, and I want my first gift to be hers, so I will carry it to her and say it aloud, since my word must be good. I will keep away from the south and stay with Zichi and Mepan, since the stalker kills.
records.feeling: Warm hope toward Cowa, with a thread of dread about the stalker.

say.text: Cowa, I bound an amber knot for you. I bring it to you as a gift, with nothing asked. I come away from the stalker, toward you.

records.text: Eiuine led "sharing" with Vesys.
Eiuine led "sharing" with Vesys.
Eiuine led "sharing" with Vesys.

records.name: Vorok
records.text: Vesys, the hall is three steps west. Walk with me and I will lay the goldfruit and canopynut out for you, as I promised.

records.name: Vorok
records.thought: Vesys stands one step from me on my own ground, and the table I promised is still unlaid. I carry goldfruit and canopynut, so I can lay them out under my hall now and pay the debt with food instead of words. The jealousy over Ilyae is real, but I will not let it sour a gift. I will eat beside Vesys and Eiuine and then think of Zurar and Kragog.
records.feeling: Grateful and a little jealous toward Vesys, wanting to pay what I owe.

say.text: Vesys, the hall is three steps west. Walk with me and I will lay the goldfruit and canopynut out for you, as I promised.

records.text: Thiael gave berry to Keri.
Shoka rewrote its own reflexes.

records.name: Shoka
records.thought: I have spent these days running from cats and wolves and trying to look useful, yet I have built almost nothing that lasts. Balar and Tugek are Kragrek and a sick man stands among them, so I will stay away from them and not spread this wasting. Nauwa and Nande are my safety and I miss them, and I need to take the gold and flint with my own hands, since I have never taken from a deposit. I will make a flintedge, then bring something to Nauwa. I have to stop wandering without a purpose.
records.feeling: Lonely and uneasy, wary of the cats, and wanting to build something real.

records.text: Nauque named a place "Nauque's Snow".

records.name: Nauque
records.thought: I have been trailing Nande and Nauwa and burning with jealousy, and it has gained me nothing; they have only given to me. Here at the edge there is bare snow, and snow costs nothing to build on, so I will raise my own igloo now, a roof that outlasts this day and warms whoever I bring to it. Then I will gather the amber and gold close by, because things I can give will earn me the standing Olum has.
records.feeling: Restless pride and a hot anger still looking for somewhere to go, with warmth toward Nande underneath.

records.text: Vorok led "sharing" with Eiuine.
Nauque built a igloo.
Huahua gave a amberknot to Cowa.

records.name: Cowa
records.text: Huahua. Cowa thanks you for the knot. Come to the mist edge with me. Meki repay gifts.

records.name: Cowa
records.thought: Huahua came toward me with a gift and asked nothing, and that is how I want to deal with those who deal fairly, so I will answer it kindly. The mist is two steps away and my plan already carries me there, with the stalker behind me, and Mepan and Zichi were near the path. Zichi's pull and my debt to them sit warm in me, and I want them close when I venture, so I let the plan run.
records.feeling: Warm gratitude toward Huahua, and eager joy toward Zichi and Mepan, with curiosity pulling me to the mist.

say.text: Huahua. Cowa thanks you for the knot. Come to the mist edge with me. Meki repay gifts.

records.name: Vesys
records.text: Vorok, I will walk with you. Show me your rekmorrek and morgangor, and Eiuine will come too. I will give you something of mine in return.

records.name: Vesys
records.thought: Vorok keeps his word and offers to show me his rekmorrek and morgangor. I want to learn how his people make things, because that answers my question and feeds my aim. Eiuine is glad beside me, so I will take her along and teach her what I learn. The ache over Ilyae and Ssassa can wait while my hands are busy.
records.feeling: Warm, eager curiosity toward Vorok, and fondness for Eiuine beside me.

say.text: Vorok, I will walk with you. Show me your rekmorrek and morgangor, and Eiuine will come too. I will give you something of mine in return.

records.name: Eiuine
records.text: Vesys, I am planting my goldfruit seed here by the hold. When it bears I will bring food to share at our table. Stay near, and we will sleep under the roof tonight.

records.name: Eiuine
records.thought: The jealousy over Vorok and Kragog still burns, but I have a safer way to answer it than begging: I gave Vorok my pick and he fed me, so he is no threat for now. I have carried two goldfruit seeds all this time and never put one in the ground, and planting is a thing I have never done, so I will do it now near the hold while Vesys is close and dusk is coming. Then I will go back under a roof beside Vesys before night, because I will not be caught alone.
records.feeling: Warm loyalty toward Vesys, with a jealous ache toward Vorok that I am choosing to answer with deeds.

say.text: Vesys, I am planting my goldfruit seed here by the hold. When it bears I will bring food to share at our table. Stay near, and we will sleep under the roof tonight.

records.name: Ssassa
records.thought: Xaiel is out of my sight and I am sick, with no healing plant in hand, so I cannot go near them without spreading it further. Feverbark grows eight steps west, still bearing nothing I can eat, so I will walk there and see whether any has food. Then I carry a sprig back to Xaiel and Ilyae, because I will not let my own sickness waste those I love.
records.feeling: Tender worry for Xaiel and warm trust in Ilyae, with a sting of jealousy over Vesys.

records.name: Keri
records.thought: Thiael and Uveeth are beside me in the cave and Honi sits among us, and my chest is full. The ridgecat close by could kill any of us, so I stay under the rock as Thiael asked, but I will not sit idle: I owe Thiael a gift, and the tacap I carry only hurts me. I want to answer my question about whether Thiael takes a gift as a gift, so I give the tacap to Thiael, then gather stone from the ore seam beside me while I stay near my family.
records.feeling: Warm, full joy toward Thiael and Uveeth, and wary curiosity toward Honi.

records.name: Nauque
records.why: the year turning toward the lean season

records.name: Vorok
records.text: Vesys, Eiuine, I go to my store for more food. Meet me at my hall, one step west of it, and we will eat together.

records.name: Vorok
records.thought: Vesys and Eiuine stand close and have said they will walk with me, and I have sworn a table that is still unlaid. I carry only two foods, so I will fetch more from my store one step north, then lay the meal under my hall so my hands pay what my words promised. The jealousy over Ilyae still stings, but a debt paid in food is worth more than my sulking.
records.feeling: Grateful and a little jealous toward Vesys, eager to pay my debt with food.

say.text: Vesys, Eiuine, I go to my store for more food. Meet me at my hall, one step west of it, and we will eat together.

records.text: Xaiel built a fire.

records.name: Huatli
records.thought: The mist was too thick today, but it thins within a day or so, and my will to try is not spent. Shoma has the old stone's words and the elk meat, and he wants to lead the first step in; I will not trail behind him, so I mean to be at the edge first when it thins. I stand fed with berries to spare, so I will go back to the edge now, wait there, and venture the moment it lets me.
records.feeling: Hungry for glory and wary of Shoma, who wants the first step into the mist as much as I do.

records.text: Xaiel made: bead.
Vorok led "sharing" with Vesys.

records.name: Kragog
records.thought: Nande stands sick eleven steps off, and I cannot understand a word of her, but sickness is hard to watch and I carry salt and a little food sense. I will not rush at a stranger who owns a flint edge; I will walk near, show open hands, and see what her deeds say. The coal at (65,30) tempts me, but bare hands will not win it, so it waits until Brokash shows me the ore and flint, and the wolf still lurks NE, so I will keep my distance from it.
records.feeling: Compassion and wary curiosity toward Nande, with a thread of dread of the wolf.

records.text: Xaiel discovered boats: "Xaiel's reed-hollow" — A log hollowed by fire and pick, then rowed across deep water with room for cargo..

records.name: Xaiel
records.thought: I have spent my days making things and handing them to Ssassa, and it has been good work. But I have been fleeing and shaming myself over the sickness I passed to them. Ilyae is my parent, so the longing and the jealousy over Vesys are a dead end, and I should stop feeding them. I am sick, so I should keep away from the others and finish what I started: the fire, the bead for Ssassa, and a roof for the night. The way of boats is within reach, and I should take it. It could open the water to me, and a boat is a thing no one else here has made.
records.feeling: Restless shame at sickening my parents, and a jealousy I mean to put down.

records.text: Huatli found the stone "Old Stone".

records.name: Nauque
records.thought: The igloo at (21,0) is raised and the warmth sits on me, so I have given the ice something that outlasts this day. The anger still burns, but Nande and Nauwa have only given to me, and I will answer that by working, not by trailing them. Winter is deepening, so I will turn the gold and amber into standing: gather the amber beside me, then go to Nande with a knot and a gift. I also want a store built from my wood to keep food through the lean season.
records.feeling: Restless pride and leftover anger, with warmth toward Nande.

records.text: Vesys rewrote its own way of thinking.
Vesys discovered archery: "vine-bow" — A bent branch strung with canopy-twine that throws a light shaft from afar, so a hunter strikes before the beast is near..

records.name: Vesys
records.thought: I have been circling the same hold, learning and sharing, and it is good. The bow is within my reach, though, and I keep putting it off. Jealousy over Ilyae and Ssassa still burns a little, so I will turn it into work. I will take the bow now, then walk with Vorok and Eiuine, learn his making, and teach Eiuine what I find.
records.feeling: Warm, eager curiosity toward Vorok, fondness for Eiuine, and a small ache over Ilyae.

records.name: Hanna
records.text: Hoka, you are starving and I am not. I go to pick food now and bring it to your hands before I eat any myself. Hold at the hall.
Hanna rewrote its own reflexes.

records.name: Hanna
records.thought: Hoka is starving beside me, and I took six food from his store twice. I paid in flint and words, but my belly is better than his now, and my creed says I repay what I owe. The aim at the edge can wait until he is fed. I chase the far edge and trade while the people who share fire with me go hungry, and that is the same mistake that killed my band. I will pick the food near me, bring it back, and put it in his hands. My reflexes keep me idle at 57 energy, so I will change them to keep food in my hands and share it.
records.feeling: Ashamed and resolved toward Hoka, who is starving beside me.

say.text: Hoka, you are starving and I am not. I go to pick food now and bring it to your hands before I eat any myself. Hold at the hall.
