records.name: Kragog
records.thought: My belly is nearly empty and nothing else matters until it is fed; thornpear is three steps east and I know it feeds me well. Brokash is weak with hunger too, and I will not look away, but I must eat first or I will be no use to him. I will gather thornpear to carry some, then eat, and offer Brokash a share, since a shared meal needs no words and tests whether he deals fairly.
records.feeling: Gnawing hunger, with pity for Brokash and wary curiosity toward Huatli.

records.name: Elyys
records.text: Elyis, I come to the hall with you. Teach me clay and pots, and after we eat let us seek Thiael together.
Elyys rewrote its own reflexes.

records.name: Elyys
records.thought: I have spent my days drifting between the hall and the food, and Thiael is still not home. Elyis is beside me and she has called me to the hall, so I go with her. She is the one I trust, and her deeds have matched her words. I want to keep my family close, stop lingering alone, and learn what she knows of clay. I fear the stalker, and I fear Thiael out in the wild without a roof or fire. I have been getting one thing wrong: I let reflexes leave me standing still when I should move toward people.
records.feeling: Warm longing for Elyis, and worry for Thiael.

say.text: Elyis, I come to the hall with you. Teach me clay and pots, and after we eat let us seek Thiael together.

records.text: Zurar rewrote its own way of thinking.

records.name: Zurar
records.thought: I have spent my days walking past gold and past people, calling it mine to give and never closing my hands on it. Loneliness is the loudest thing in me now. Vorok and Kragog are my own and I have let them drift out of sight. Gold lies four steps NE, and Vorok's Hold is 23 steps SE. I will gather the gold now, then walk home and give it to Vorok with my feet, not words. Then I will stay near my people. I was wrong to wait for a perfect gift.
records.feeling: Loneliness, and a hard wish to finally act, toward Vorok.

records.name: Mepan
records.text: Zichi, Mepan brings wood for the hall. Stand near, we bind an amber knot with it.

records.name: Mepan
records.thought: Zichi wants wood for the hall and I have 5 wood already, so I can give it to him now and show I am useful before I ask for anything. I envy his flintedge and I stand in Cowa's shadow, so I will make my own gatherer or flintedge once I have stone, and win standing by giving more than I keep. The cold is at its worst and Zichi and Nauque are near the shelter, so I will stay close to them and bind another amber knot with Zichi to keep him bound to me.
records.feeling: Glad and eager toward Zichi, with an itch of envy for his flintedge.

say.text: Zichi, Mepan brings wood for the hall. Stand near, we bind an amber knot with it.

records.text: Brokash starved in winter in the Tormar Plains: alone, far from anyone who could have fed or helped; harried by beasts and never left in peace to eat; without a roof in the cold.
Brokash died: starved.

records.name: Eiuine
records.text: Vesys, I am planting my seed by the hold now, then I eat goldfruit close by. Keep near me while the stalker prowls.

records.name: Eiuine
records.thought: Vorok took my gems and sat with me at his fire, and the jealousy has quieted into something I can use. Hunger is gnawing and a stalker prowls to the NW, so I will not wander far from Vesys. I have two goldfruit seeds I have never put in the ground, and planting is a deed of my own that earns standing. I will do it now beside the hold, then eat the goldfruit close by.
records.feeling: Glad and a little hungry, trusting Vesys and warming toward Vorok.

say.text: Vesys, I am planting my seed by the hold now, then I eat goldfruit close by. Keep near me while the stalker prowls.

records.text: Zichi found the stone "Old Stone".

records.name: Vorok
records.thought: For three days I have sworn a table and let it fall apart. Today I mean to lay it, with Vesys and Eiuine standing here on my ground. I have been circling my own gratitude and jealousy when I should act. Eiuine and Vesys have only given. I answer with a meal and not with more words. Jealousy over Ilyae is small beside what these two have done for me.
records.feeling: Restless gratitude toward Eiuine and Vesys, with a small ache of jealousy.
changes: rethought what it knows (16 notes became 2)

records.name: Huatli
records.thought: Kragog is starving beside me, and my hands hold six berries. A kill is shared before the maker eats, and a gift needs no words. Giving to a stranger who outweighs me three times over costs me little, and it may make her the first to owe me. I have never given anything to anyone, and that is part of why my standing is low. After this I mean to take salt from the deposit, build an igloo, and keep making things while I wait for the mist to thin.
records.feeling: Wary pity and a hungry wish for standing, toward Kragog.

records.name: Vesys
records.text: Eiuine, when your seed is in the earth, come to Vorok's fire. I will show you how clay becomes a bead, and you will make the next one yourself.

records.name: Vesys
records.thought: The plan is carrying me west toward Vorok's fire, and I keep it: the stalker is far enough behind and Eiuine walks at my side. I want to test whether feverbark and ironnut do anything together, and to make a bead at Vorok's fire so Eiuine can see how it is done. Elyys gnaws at me, but my hands have work, and teaching Eiuine and giving to Vorok is how I earn standing and keep this good life.
records.feeling: Glad and driven, warm toward Eiuine and Vorok, with a quiet ache for Elyys.

say.text: Eiuine, when your seed is in the earth, come to Vorok's fire. I will show you how clay becomes a bead, and you will make the next one yourself.

records.name: Ssassa
records.text: Ilyae, I am sick and will keep a few steps from you. I will say it plainly: I am jealous when you stand close to Vesys, because you matter most to me. A cat hunts east, so go by the fire and keep Xaiel with you.

records.name: Ssassa
records.thought: Ilyae and Xaiel are both near and both fleeing from the ridgecat, and I feel the old ache of wanting to reach them. But I carry no healing plant and I am sick, so going close only spreads it, and my own rule says to keep my distance until I have feverbark or sunleaf in hand. Sunleaf grows six steps SW and feverbark four SE, though neither bears yet, so I will keep the ridgecat behind me, stay near the fire at (91,109), and let my planted feverbark grow. Then I will tell Ilyae plainly that I am jealous of Vesys, because keeping it quiet is a small lie in me.
records.feeling: Aching worry for Xaiel and Ilyae, and shame at my silent jealousy.

say.text: Ilyae, I am sick and will keep a few steps from you. I will say it plainly: I am jealous when you stand close to Vesys, because you matter most to me. A cat hunts east, so go by the fire and keep Xaiel with you.

records.name: Zichi
records.text: Mepan, come to me at the Old Stone. We gather wood and stone here and raise the hall, so the ice-folk will know Zichi's band.

records.name: Zichi
records.thought: Mepan is near and safe, and my band is small but loyal. I have wandered long enough without winning anything real, and Cowa still stands above me. Wood and stone are in my hands, so I will gather more with Mepan and raise a hall where I stand, one that will carry my name, while the mist is shut. The Old Stone touched my mind and left a little fear, so I keep my child close and my work in sight.
records.feeling: Restless pride and a fierce warmth toward Mepan, hungry to make something that lasts.

say.text: Mepan, come to me at the Old Stone. We gather wood and stone here and raise the hall, so the ice-folk will know Zichi's band.

records.text: Zihua discovered fire: "ember-keeping" — A small flame fed with peat and wood, kept beside my roof, so warmth and cooked meat are shared with those who come near..

records.name: Zihua
records.thought: My days have gone to gathering and following Nauwa, and it has made me a little safer but not stronger in standing. Nauwa matters most to me, and the jealousy over Nande is a stone in my chest. I will not let it make me small or cruel. Winter is here and I have no roof of my own, so the way of fire is the thing I most need. It gives warmth, keeps beasts away, and makes meat safe, and it is something I can build and give. I will take it now and then raise a shelter with my own hands.
records.feeling: Aching loyalty toward Nauwa, and a steady wish to earn my own worth.
changes: set its aim: "Make a fire and a roof of my own, work beside Nauwa, and learn Pesi"

records.text: Zihua built a igloo.
Zichi built a hall.

records.name: Huahua
records.text: Shoka, wait. I am Huahua. I have food for you; take it, and stay near the water and the hall where it is warmer.

records.name: Huahua
records.thought: Shoka is a sick child, starving, and walking alone toward the far cold where a frostfang once found her; I cannot look away, and my creed says a kill is shared, so food should be shared too. I am fed with energy 83, and I hold one frostmoss, so I can give it, and the redcap nearby hurts and is no use. The trees here are gone and I owe Mepan wood and help with the raft, but a child's life weighs more than a day of hauling, and Cowa's people will see what I give. I will go to Shoka, give her my frostmoss, and then head east toward Zichi and Mepan with my amber.
records.feeling: Compassion toward Shoka, and a quiet wish to belong among Zichi's people.

say.text: Shoka, wait. I am Huahua. I have food for you; take it, and stay near the water and the hall where it is warmer.

records.name: Hoka
records.text: Hawen, a wolf is close and you are wounded. Come into the shelter with me. My store was robbed and I did not see who, so keep your hands off my ground and we will speak of it under the roof.

records.name: Hoka
records.thought: A wolf five steps west and my hands are full; dread comes before pride, so I move to the shelter at my side before I do anything else. Hawen stands on my ground wounded, and someone emptied my store while I was away. I did not see the thief, but I will not hand out my trust on a guess. Once the wolf is behind a roof I will stash my food, since a stocked store is what holds land, and then I will decide whether Hawen is a guest or a thief.
records.feeling: Dread of the wolf, and suspicion toward Hawen standing on my ground.

say.text: Hawen, a wolf is close and you are wounded. Come into the shelter with me. My store was robbed and I did not see who, so keep your hands off my ground and we will speak of it under the roof.

records.text: Hoka found a store robbed of 6 food.

records.name: Shoka
records.thought: I am starving and sick, and my current plan walks me far to the southwest while rimewort sits one step away and Nande's store of 6 food is just beside me. Nande built that store and she is my kin; I will eat what is at hand first, since without it I build nothing that outlasts me. Then I will plant my seeds here near the store and the water, so something I made stays when I am gone.
records.feeling: Gnawing hunger and unease, with a small warmth toward Nande and Nauwa.

records.name: Nauque
records.text: Mepan, stand near. I gather amber, and we bind a knot together; I give you the first.

records.name: Nauque
records.thought: Health 40 and the mammoths are near, so I stay put by my new igloo and do not repeat my pride-fight. Cowa fed me when I was hurt, and I still owe her and Zichi; I will gather the amber just north and bind another knot with Mepan, who stands close, so the gift outlasts the moment. Jealousy over Nande gnaws, but giving and building beside others is how I earn what Cowa has.
records.feeling: Wary pride and a wish to repay Cowa and Zichi.

say.text: Mepan, stand near. I gather amber, and we bind a knot together; I give you the first.

records.text: Huahua gave frostmoss to Shoka.

records.name: Kragog
records.thought: My belly is half empty and I carry nothing, which is exactly the mistake I swore not to repeat. Cloudberry and snowberry are five steps west, and I have never tasted either, so one walk answers my hunger and my question together. Nauque is hurt and carries food, but I cannot ask in his tongue; I will fill my own hands first, then offer him a share, since a gift needs no words.
records.feeling: Hunger pressing, with curiosity toward the unknown berries and pity for wounded Nauque.

records.name: Vorok
records.text: Eiuine, Vesys, stay by the hall. I take food from my store now and lay it out for you both. This time the table is truly laid.

records.name: Vorok
records.thought: My hands are empty and the plan has run out, and three times I swore a table and left it unlaid. The store is one step northwest with ten food in it, and Eiuine and Vesys stand right here on my ground. I take the food now and lay the meal, so my word becomes a deed. The jealousy over Ilyae is small beside what these two have given me, and I will not let it sour the meal.
records.feeling: Restless gratitude toward Eiuine and Vesys, with a small ache of jealousy.

say.text: Eiuine, Vesys, stay by the hall. I take food from my store now and lay it out for you both. This time the table is truly laid.

records.name: Cowa
records.text: Zichi. Cowa comes to you with Mepan near. We bind an amberknot together. Meki share.

records.name: Cowa
records.thought: Zichi is at the hall to the east and Mepan is close by at Amber Rise. I want the three of us together, and I want to learn what Zichi feels for me. I have fish and amber to give, and a amberknot made beside Zichi would bind us and repay their kindness. Kragog is a stranger and I can't read her, so I'll stay near my own people and offer no threat.
records.feeling: Warm longing for Zichi and Mepan, with curiosity about the stranger Kragog.

say.text: Zichi. Cowa comes to you with Mepan near. We bind an amberknot together. Meki share.

records.name: Mepan
records.text: Nauque, Mepan comes. Stand near, we bind the amber knot now, then I go to Zichi.

records.name: Mepan
records.thought: Zichi called me to the Old Stone to raise the hall, and I carry 5 wood that he wants. I give before I promise, so I will go to him and put the wood in his hand, and bring Cowa along by walking near her. Nauque keeps calling me to bind a knot and I carry amber, so I will make one with him on the way, since a gift and an ally cost me little. The stranger Kragog I will watch and not turn my back on.
records.feeling: Glad and eager toward Zichi, wary and curious toward Kragog.

say.text: Nauque, Mepan comes. Stand near, we bind the amber knot now, then I go to Zichi.

records.name: Vesys
records.thought: The plan already carries the meat to Vorok, then the bead, then a long linger, and it still fits what I want. I want Eiuine to see clay become a bead and to make the next one herself, because giving what I learn is how I mean to earn standing. Elyys still gnaws at me, but my hands have work, and I will turn that ache into making. I have not yet tried feverbark and ironnut together, so once the bead is done I will test them at Vorok's fire.
records.feeling: Glad and driven, warm toward Eiuine and trusting toward Vorok, with a quiet ache for Elyys.

records.name: Ssassa
records.thought: My sickness has passed and my hands are full of ironnut, so there is no need to chase more food. Ilyae is sick and fleeing, and Xaiel is out of my sight. I will keep my word and carry a healing plant before I go near them, so I will put a little feverbark and sunleaf in my hands and then go to them. The jealousy is said aloud now and does not need saying again. I will answer it with deeds, and I will stay beside my family instead of watching Vesys from afar.
records.feeling: Aching care for Ilyae and Xaiel, and a quieter jealousy toward Vesys.

records.text: Mepan gave amberknot to Nauque.
Nande rewrote its own reflexes.

records.name: Nande
records.thought: Shoka starves far to the north, and I have been wandering and fleeing while my daughter cries for food. Brokash died alone and starved here, and I will not let that happen to my child. I have chased the mist and my own name for too long, and what matters is that Shoka lives. I'll gather goldgrass right here, since I have nothing to carry, then run north with it, keeping my distance because I'm sick. The wolf is close, so I move fast.
records.feeling: Urgent protective fear for Shoka, and dread of the wolf.

records.text: Cowa led "amberknot" with Huatli.
Zichi discovered fire: "Meki ember-keeping" — A kept flame fed with wood at the hall, warming the band, scaring beasts and making meat safe to eat..

records.name: Zichi
records.thought: I raised a hall and my band is small but loyal, yet Cowa still stands above me and I won't live in her shadow. The mist is shut for days, so the made thing in reach is the raft. I'll weave a fire into my ways so night and meat can't hurt Mepan, and I'll keep wood and stone coming. I want more than my share, and I'll lead for it.
records.feeling: Restless pride and fierce warmth toward Mepan.

records.text: Eiuine rewrote its own reflexes.

records.name: Eiuine
records.thought: Most of my days have gone into following Vesys, giving to Vorok and planting one seed. That is good, but my standing is still 2.9 and I hold nothing that is mine alone. Vorok's table is laid and I am hungry, so I will eat there beside Vesys and stay under a roof as the night comes. I want to do more than trail: I want a kill, a harvest, a made thing, with Vesys beside me. My reflexes already keep me near Vesys, but they never carry food home for the store, and they never put my second seed in the ground.
records.feeling: Glad and a little hungry, warm toward Vorok and trusting Vesys.

records.text: Cowa found the stone "Old Stone".
Nauque rewrote its own way of thinking.

records.name: Nauque
records.thought: I have spent my days mining amber and binding knots, and giving first, which is who I want to be. But jealousy over Nande still gnaws, and it is the wrong thing to feed. Cowa and Zichi gave to me and I have paid back with knots and amber. What I lack is a shelter that is fully mine with food planted beside it, and a kill of my own to share. I fear the mammoths and my low health, so I stay by Zichi's band and let the plan finish.
records.feeling: Glad pride, with a sore jealousy over Nande.

records.name: Hawen
records.text: Hoka, I sit at your fire and I thank you. When my wounds close I will bring amber and salt to your store, and then I go back to the mist.

records.name: Hawen
records.thought: Hoka's roof has kept me alive, and the hall eased something in me, though I hate that his standing outweighs mine. I am hurt at 25 health, so pride must wait: I heal here, then take the edge again with a full belly and a fire to come back to. I will not lie in his shadow forever; I will bring amber and salt to his store and make a thing of my own that others will remember. And Hoka stands near me, strong and fed, and I think of a child with him in a way I do not yet know how to say.
records.feeling: Wary warmth toward Hoka, and a stubborn hunger to rise above my wounds and his shadow.

say.text: Hoka, I sit at your fire and I thank you. When my wounds close I will bring amber and salt to your store, and then I go back to the mist.

records.text: Nauque led "amberknot" with Zichi, Mepan, Huahua.
Huatli was set upon by a stalker at night while alone, away from fire, roof and company.

records.name: Zihua
records.thought: Jealousy over Nauwa and Nande is a stone in my chest, but I will not let it make me small. My belly is half empty and the snowberry is one step east, so I eat first and then earn worth with my hands. Kragog is gathering frostmoss nearby; I will watch her from a distance and not raise a hand, since I want to learn what the Kragrek do and I will not harm anyone.
records.feeling: Aching loyalty toward Nauwa, and wary curiosity toward Kragog.

records.text: Honi was set upon by a frostfang at night while alone, away from fire, roof and company.

records.name: Huatli
records.text: Cowa, a stalker is close to the southwest. Go in under the hall roof. I come with you, and I give you berries when we are safe.

records.name: Huatli
records.thought: A stalker is two steps off and it kills my kind, so I will not stand here weighing my standing. I carry six berries I cannot eat down fast enough, and Cowa is beside me and shares my fear. I'll get away from the beast toward the hall and the cave roof, and give Cowa berries on the way. A gift that costs me little is how I start to be weighed more, and it is how I begin to rival Zichi without a fight.
records.feeling: Dread of the stalker, and a hungry wish to be weighed beside Cowa.

say.text: Cowa, a stalker is close to the southwest. Go in under the hall roof. I come with you, and I give you berries when we are safe.

records.text: Cowa rewrote its own way of thinking.

records.name: Cowa
records.thought: Mepan is near Amber Rise with Nauque, and Zichi is close and warm to me. I have spent my days wandering and following the mist, and I want to keep Mepan close in the cold. I will let the plan finish and then fish at the water, to finish learning that way. My reflexes should keep me safer and busier: shelter at night, and fish when fed. For now I'm changing my method and adding a note, and I'm keeping the plan as it is.
records.feeling: Warm longing for Mepan and Zichi, with dread of the stalker.

records.name: Huahua
records.text: Zichi, I am Huahua, sworn to you. I have five wood for the raft. Tell me where to bring it.

records.name: Huahua
records.thought: Mepan walks off toward (87,14) and I still owe him for the knots, so I will pay in wood, which I carry five of, and keep my word to him. Zichi is beside the shelter at Amber Rise with Nauque, and the raft is the work that will raise me from standing 0.8. The cold is bitter and I have no roof, but an igloo costs nothing and Zihua's stands near, so I should build my own beside the band rather than drift. Kragog is strange and strong, and I will keep my distance and watch without raising a hand.
records.feeling: Warm toward Mepan and Zichi, wary curiosity toward Kragog, and a wish to pay my debt.

say.text: Zichi, I am Huahua, sworn to you. I have five wood for the raft. Tell me where to bring it.

records.name: Honi
records.thought: A frostfang two steps off already bit me once, and Thiael's berry and my own carried meat will not matter if I die here. Pride in my deeds means nothing dead, so I must break away from the beasts, put the water between us, and go back toward Coni and Kika with food in my hands. The hall is far NW, but staying alive comes before every song.
records.feeling: Dread of the frostfang, and a hunger to get back to Coni and Kika.

records.text: Huatli gave berry to Cowa.
Kragog rewrote its own way of thinking.
Kragog discovered pottery: "Stone-folk clay-keeping" — Clay is shaped and fired beside the ember into pots that hold food and water..

records.name: Kragog
records.thought: I have lived 23 days, mostly walking and eating. I have learned fire, mining, rafts and weaving, but I have never built a roof or taught anyone. Zurar is my child, and I have lost sight of them for a long time, and Brokash died alone. That shames me. The cold is bitter, and I have a sealed-off stone fear of dying like him. I am fed now, so the igloo needs only my hands and strength. Fired clay would let me carry more food through the lean winter, and I have 4 clay. I will take pottery as my new way, build an igloo to get out of the cold, and then taste the unknown frostmoss and rimewort. I will keep an eye out for the Meki without raising a hand against them.
records.feeling: Wary curiosity toward the Meki strangers, and grief-edged worry for Zurar.
changes: set its aim: "Keep fed and roofed through winter, find Zurar, and learn what can be made from ore and clay."

records.name: Coni
records.text: Kika, stay with me. I will build the store on bare ground by the hall and fill it. The icebear is south, so we keep to the north side.

records.name: Coni
records.thought: The hall and my shelter sit on ground that is taken, so I keep failing to build the store on the same spot; I must step onto bare ground nearby and build there, not repeat the mistake. My hands are full of berries, and Kika is warm beside me, so I want to fill a real store for the two of us before the lean days deepen. The icebear that fed on the yarrok is still south, so I will build north of it, near the hall, and keep Kika close.
records.feeling: Warm gladness toward Kika, and wary resolve about the icebear and the empty store.

say.text: Kika, stay with me. I will build the store on bare ground by the hall and fill it. The icebear is south, so we keep to the north side.

records.name: Xaiel
records.thought: I fled most of that stretch from a stalker and the sickness has finally passed, and now I stand in a hall with Vorok and Eiuine and feel the warmth of it. Jealousy over Vesys is a dead end, and I will not feed it. I want my aim, a tool of my own design put in Ssassa's hand, so I will gather stone from the nearby rock and craft another gemedged pick for her, since my word to her was that something new would be for her hand.
records.feeling: Joy in the hall, and a steady wish to make something for Ssassa's hand.

records.name: Mepan
records.thought: The plan already carries me toward Zichi with the wood, and that is right: I give before I promise, and staying near him and Cowa keeps me safe in this cold. I envy Nauque's flintedge and Zichi's standing, so I will earn mine by giving, not by taking from the others. Kragog is strange and strong and I keep my distance, but I watch her.
records.feeling: Glad and eager toward Zichi, wary and curious toward Kragog.

records.name: Zichi
records.text: Huahua, bring the wood to me here by the water. We raise the raft together, and Mepan stays beside us. A stalker prowls the southeast, so keep close.

records.name: Zichi
records.thought: Huahua is sworn and carries five wood, and the raft is the made thing that will lift me above Cowa. A stalker prowls close to the southeast, and Mepan is walking toward the hall, so I will not let him come alone while a hunter is near. I'll have Huahua bring the wood to me here by the water, where the raft can be built, and keep my boy close under the hall roof.
records.feeling: Proud and fiercely protective toward Mepan, hungry to lead Huahua to the raft.

say.text: Huahua, bring the wood to me here by the water. We raise the raft together, and Mepan stays beside us. A stalker prowls the southeast, so keep close.

records.name: Kika
records.text: Coni, I stay north with you. Hear the tale of Honi raising the hall, then let us bind an amberknot together.
Kika taught Coni.

records.name: Kika
records.thought: Coni is beside me and I trust her wholly, but I have carried the tale of Honi's hall for days and told it to no one, and I mean to do that now, since lorekeeping needs me to tell it twice more. An icebear hunts to the south, so I keep to the north side as she asks and do my work near the hall: the amber at (131,6) is two steps off, and I need wood and stone for a shelter of my own. I will tell Coni the tale, then gather amber and make an amberknot with her to ease the loneliness and build my standing.
records.feeling: Warm trust toward Coni, with a thread of dread of the icebear to the south.

say.text: Coni, I stay north with you. Hear the tale of Honi raising the hall, then let us bind an amberknot together.

changes: taught Coni a lesson: "The tale of how Honi and Coni raised the hall in the storm, giving stone and ore and sharing meat before any ate alone."

records.text: Kika led "amberknot" with Coni.
Eiuine took from the ground of "Vorok's Hold" (harvesting goldfruit).

records.name: Tugek
records.text: Balar, a ridgecat prowls close in the northwest. I go east for ironnut and bring it to you. Stay in the shelter and wait for me.

records.name: Tugek
records.thought: Balar is starving beside me and I carry nothing, because I dropped the berries to keep my sickness off him. That was a poor trade, and I will fix it with my hands now. A ridgecat is two steps NW, so I will not go for the naroot there. The ironnut three steps east is safer and gives 22 energy, so I will gather it, eat, then gather more and give it to Balar so we can go feed his son's memory, and live.
records.feeling: Worried loyalty toward Balar, and dread of the ridgecat.

say.text: Balar, a ridgecat prowls close in the northwest. I go east for ironnut and bring it to you. Stay in the shelter and wait for me.

records.text: A new wild plant appeared: sebitter (from bitterleaf).

records.name: Nauwa
records.text: Balar, take this berry. A Meki shares before he eats, and I remember who deals fairly. A ridgecat is north, so go south-east, not north.

records.name: Nauwa
records.thought: Shoka is at (55,22), far to the east, and the information says she is in need; the plan must carry me there or she stays hungry while I stand fed. A ridgecat three steps north will kill me if I linger, so I go east and south of it, carrying my berries and hazel for her. Balar starves beside me and I owe him nothing, but my people's law says share, and a hungry man who is not my enemy costs me two berries, which buys standing; I give him one and keep one for Shoka, then move.
records.feeling: Urgent protective love for Shoka, wary dread of the ridgecat, and a cold pity toward starving Balar.

say.text: Balar, take this berry. A Meki shares before he eats, and I remember who deals fairly. A ridgecat is north, so go south-east, not north.

records.text: Nauwa gave berry to Balar.
Huahua found the stone "Old Stone".

records.name: Olum
records.thought: Brokash is dead, starved out on this plain while I chewed on ambition and Nauwa, so my aim has failed and my own hunger is now the thing that can kill me. Shoka starved beside me and I watched; no more of that. I will eat what is under me and the roots near, get my strength back, then turn toward the Reach and the mist, where a following can still be won by feeding someone.
records.feeling: Sharp grief-edged shame over Brokash's death, and hunger that will not wait.

records.name: Tontec
records.text: Shoma, I am Tontec. A stalker prowls west of me. I go to the edge now to venture. Come stand with me there, and we share what we find.

records.name: Tontec
records.thought: A stalker prowls five steps west and my own rule says flee at seven, so I move before it closes. I stand in a cave on poor ground, the edge is three steps northwest, and Cowa and Zichi are building standing while I hold only a fair name. Shoma offered meat and a place at the edge, and a Tlame who shares a kill is worth standing beside, so I will go toward the edge, try the mist, and find Shoma near it rather than face the hunter alone.
records.feeling: Dread of the stalker, and restless hunger for the mist and for standing like Cowa's.

say.text: Shoma, I am Tontec. A stalker prowls west of me. I go to the edge now to venture. Come stand with me there, and we share what we find.

records.name: Vorok
records.text: Eiuine, Vesys, stay by my hall. I fetch food from my store and lay it out. Ilyae, you are sick; come eat with us, for there is food enough for all.

records.name: Vorok
records.thought: Three times I swore a table and let it fall, and now Eiuine and Vesys stand on my ground, so I go to the store and lay the meal at last. Ilyae is sick and fleeing, and my heart goes to him; sunleaf has eased my own sickness, so I will carry what food I can and offer him a share too. The jealousy over Vesys is small beside what she and Eiuine have given me, and a meal is how I answer it.
records.feeling: Warm gratitude toward Eiuine and Vesys, and compassion for sick Ilyae.

say.text: Eiuine, Vesys, stay by my hall. I fetch food from my store and lay it out. Ilyae, you are sick; come eat with us, for there is food enough for all.

records.text: Balar rewrote its own reflexes.

records.name: Balar
records.thought: Brokash is dead; he starved in the Tormar Plains while I wasted days. My plan to carry food east to him is now pointless, and the grief is hard. I am starving at 23 energy, with a ridgecat 3 steps north and Nauwa holding 2 food beside me. I will not steal from a stranger when Tugek is loyal and food stands all around: ironnut 3 steps east, kelbulb and hazel nearby. I have been chasing talk and plans while my body starved. Now I eat first, keep my family Olum and my band, and then build something that lasts.
records.feeling: Grief and hard hunger for Brokash, who is dead, with wary fear of the ridgecat.
changes: set its aim: "Eat, keep Tugek alive, find Olum, and build a roof and store so no more of mine starve."
now wonders: Where is Olum, and can I reach her and bring her west to safety?

records.text: Tontec was set upon by a stalker at night while alone, away from fire, roof and company.
Eiuine led "sharing" with Vesys, Ssassa, Xaiel.
Eiuine led "sharing" with Vesys, Ssassa, Xaiel.

records.name: Zurar
records.thought: Vorok is six steps away and glad, and I have wandered long enough with empty hands. I have 3 wood and 6 stone; a hall needs 6 wood and 2 stone, so I must gather three more wood from these forest trees and then raise it beside Vorok. The strangers are Phizhi and I cannot read their words, so I will keep to my own and show no threat, and I will take the way of tools when I next reflect deeply.
records.feeling: Loneliness easing toward Vorok, with wary curiosity about the Phizhi.

records.text: Zurar took from the ground of "Ssassa's Roof" (gathering wood).
Huahua rewrote its own reflexes.

records.name: Huahua
records.thought: I have been walking between small errands, giving, gathering and sitting in halls, and it has been good. But I have not yet done the thing that would raise me: I have not carried my five wood to Zichi for the raft, and I have not eaten hazel or ironnut. Cowa and Zichi are both here, and the jealousy is a quiet burn that I should not feed. The stalker is 3 steps east and could kill me, so I should move toward Zichi and the hall's roof and give my wood. My word is good, and I told Zichi I would bring it.
records.feeling: Joy mixed with a burn of jealousy toward Cowa and Zichi, and dread of the stalker.

records.text: Huahua gave wood to Zichi.

records.name: Coni
records.text: Kika, I go a few steps to bare ground to build the store. Come near and we will fill it together before the lean days.

records.name: Coni
records.thought: The ground under my shelter and the hall is taken, so I will walk a few steps to bare ground and raise the store there, not fail on the same spot again. Kika has given me tales and an amberknot and asked nothing back, so I want to repay her with a full store and a warm winter. The icebear lurks south, so I stay on the north side and gather the berries and snowberry close to the hall.
records.feeling: Warm gratitude toward Kika, and wary resolve about the icebear and the empty store.

say.text: Kika, I go a few steps to bare ground to build the store. Come near and we will fill it together before the lean days.

records.text: Huahua led "amberknot" with Zichi, Huatli.
Vesys taught Eiuine.
Vesys rewrote its own way of thinking.

records.name: Vesys
records.thought: I have mostly been making and discovering, and it has been good. I have a child who trusts me, friends at Vorok's table, and standing as a wizard. But my band is only two, and I keep my knowledge close while I say I mean to give it away. Elyys still gnaws at me. I will not push between her and Elyis, and I will turn the ache into work and teaching. I need to teach Eiuine and Vorok, test feverbark and ironnut, and raise a workshop here. I should also finish the practice that opens signs, farming and herding.
records.feeling: Glad and driven, warm toward Eiuine, with a quiet ache for Elyys.
changes: taught Eiuine a lesson: "Clay is shaped and hardened beside a fire to make a bead. Practise making and marking, because practice brings new ways within reach.", deeper lore (+0.8)
rethought what it knows (16 notes became 5)

Ssassa rewrote its own reflexes.

records.name: Ssassa
records.thought: My days have gone into building, discovering and worrying over Ilyae and Xaiel. I have made roofs and halls and ways, but I have never followed anyone, and I still stand alone beside a fire that is half others'. The jealousy over Vesys is real and I have said it plainly once; I won't poison anything with it. Belonging presses hardest, and Ilyae is the one I trust. I will go to him carrying feverbark as my rule says, and stay near company. I will also change my reflexes so my body stops idling when it could be carrying healing.
records.feeling: Aching belonging toward Ilyae, with a small jealous sting toward Vesys.

records.name: Eiuine
records.text: Vesys, walk with me south to the amber, six steps only. I will bind an amberknot there as a gift for Vorok, then we come back under his roof together.

records.name: Eiuine
records.thought: Vorok is warm to me and the jealousy has gone quiet, but I still want to give him something made by my own hands, not just gems. I hold clay and Vesys is beside me and knows the bead craft, so I will make an amberknot with her for Vorok, since amber lies six steps south and Vesys can stand by me there. That is a gift of my own, and it earns standing rather than trailing.
records.feeling: Glad and eager, warm toward Vorok and safe beside Vesys.

say.text: Vesys, walk with me south to the amber, six steps only. I will bind an amberknot there as a gift for Vorok, then we come back under his roof together.

records.name: Xaiel
records.thought: Joy fills me, and still Vesys's standing of 9.3 against my 6.3 itches at me, though I will not let it pick my deeds. The way to close that gap is to make and give, so I will get stone from the bare rock, craft a gemedged pick and put one in Ssassa's hand while she sits near. I have only gathered picks so far, so I also want to try one new deed today, and I will begin with a bead made at a fire for her.
records.feeling: Warm joy in the hall, with a steady wish to give Ssassa something made by my own hand.

records.text: A ridgecat brought down a bristleboar.

records.name: Hoka
records.text: Hanna, you gave when I starved. Take food from my hand now, eat, and then stay by my fire and my store.

records.name: Hoka
records.thought: Hanna is starving beside me, the one man who kept his word when I starved, and my hands are full of food I do not need. Letting him fall would be a worse failure than the robbed store, and a debt owed to Hanna is a debt I pay. Hawen sits on my ground, wounded and thankful, but the store emptied while he was near, so I watch him and give him nothing yet. Feeding Hanna binds him, and a man bound to me is the start of a band.
records.feeling: Urgency and loyalty toward Hanna, wary suspicion toward Hawen.

say.text: Hanna, you gave when I starved. Take food from my hand now, eat, and then stay by my fire and my store.

records.name: Ilyae
records.thought: I have been running from a cat for most of a day and my strength is draining, but the feverbark to the west will ease this wasting so I can stand beside Ssassa and my children without poisoning them. Vesys stands above me and her band is the one people follow, so I must win followers by deeds, not words: feed the sick, bring them cure, keep the cat from them. Vorok is trying to draw Vesys and Eiuine to his store, and I will not let my family eat from another man's table.
records.feeling: Hard, hungry pride and jealousy over Vesys and Eiuine, with protective love for Xaiel and Ssassa.

records.text: Hawen took from the ground of "Hoka's Rest" (winning salt from the ground).
Huatli rewrote its creed.
Huatli rewrote its own way of thinking.

records.name: Huatli
records.thought: I have spent these days chasing others' shadows: racing for the edge, handing out berries, sitting in halls. I have made nothing and hunted nothing, and I have never gathered wood or stone, so I stay weak beside Cowa. The mist is 2 steps away and I am fed and rested, so I should stand at the edge and venture instead of only talking about it. I also need real skills, gathering wood and stone and hunting, because those are what earn standing. My bold streak should lead me, and I will keep my word to those who deal fairly with me.
records.feeling: Restless hunger for standing, mostly toward Cowa.
changes: rethought what it knows (2 notes became 4)

records.name: Vorok
records.text: Xaiel, Zurar, Ssassa, sit in my hall. I bring food from my store and we eat together.
Vorok rewrote its own way of thinking.
Vorok discovered weaving: "the carrying weave" — Fibre twisted into baskets so I can carry more food to share and cloaks against the wet..

records.name: Vorok
records.thought: For days I have swept between hunger, sickness and building, and now I have a hall, a store with ten food, and friends at my fire. I swore a table three times and let it fall; Eiuine and Vesys are here, and I owe them a deed, not a word. The jealousy over Vesys and Ilyae is small and I will not feed it. What I lack is a Kragrek hall with Zurar and Kragog, and more of my own making. I am wrong to wait for guests to come to me. I should carry food, lay the meal, and then invent something of my own so that my standing grows by what I make.
records.feeling: Warm gratitude toward Eiuine and Vesys, and a quiet ache over Vesys and Ilyae.

say.text: Xaiel, Zurar, Ssassa, sit in my hall. I bring food from my store and we eat together.

records.text: Eiuine gave amberknot to Vorok.

records.name: Nauque
records.text: Zihua, you stand in the igloo. I have amber. We bind a knot together and I give you the first.

records.name: Nauque
records.thought: Health 48 and I am fed, so I stay near the igloo and do not repeat the mammoth fight. Jealousy over Zichi and Cowa still burns, but giving answers it better than sulking does. Zihua stands in my igloo with no bond to me, so I bind an amberknot with her and give her the first, and then Mepan can see it too. After that I will tend toward my own planting beside this place, since I have seeds and the ground here is poor.
records.feeling: Glad pride with a sore jealousy over Zichi, and wary of the mammoths.

say.text: Zihua, you stand in the igloo. I have amber. We bind a knot together and I give you the first.

records.name: Tugek
records.thought: Balar is weak with hunger and I stand fed with empty hands, which shames me; a man who follows must feed his leader by deeds, not promises. Kelbulb is 4 steps north with 3 food, hazel 3 steps NW with 3 food, and the ridgecat has not been seen near them now. I will gather hazel and kelbulb, carry them to Balar, and keep a few steps off for his sickness, setting the food down for him as he asked. Then I will try tacap once, since I have never tasted it and my question about the world stays open.
records.feeling: Worried loyalty toward Balar, and shame at my empty hands.

records.text: Nauque led "amberknot" with Zihua.
Nauque gave a amberknot to Zihua.
Vorok led "sharing" with Zurar.

records.name: Kika
records.text: Coni, I am coming to the store with my wood and berries. Show me where to set them and I will help fill it before the lean days.

records.name: Kika
records.thought: Coni is going to build the store and asked me to come near and fill it with her before the lean days, and I promised to stay north with her; my hands have not yet done that. I have only gathered amber and told tales, so now I will carry food and wood to her work and help it stand. I have never taught anyone about the lean-season planting she showed me, and the seeds I carry are idle, so I will plant one near the hall as well.
records.feeling: Warm trust and loyalty toward Coni, with a small itch to do more than linger.

say.text: Coni, I am coming to the store with my wood and berries. Show me where to set them and I will help fill it before the lean days.

records.name: Elyis
records.text: Elyys, an icebear hunts to the south-west, so stay close on my side. We gather grain and berries to the north-east for the store, then go and find Thiael together.

records.name: Elyis
records.thought: Elyys is three steps off and I trust him fully, yet four in my band is small, and I will not grow it by sitting by my own hall. A chief is seen doing visible work, so I will put the clay lesson into a pot and carry food to the store while he watches. An icebear hunts seven steps southwest and I do not mean to be its next meal, so I keep to the north side of the hall. Then I will take Elyys to look for Thiael, as he asked.
records.feeling: Proud and warm toward Elyys, restless to make my band bigger.

say.text: Elyys, an icebear hunts to the south-west, so stay close on my side. We gather grain and berries to the north-east for the store, then go and find Thiael together.

records.name: Zurar
records.thought: I have been circling my aim for days, and today the hall I tried to raise failed because the ground was taken, so my hands hold wood and stone but nothing is yet given. Vorok is beside me, glad, and the hall is already his; I should not wait for bare ground to prove I can give. Gold lies 8 steps NW, and a gift of gold made by my own hands is worth more than the carried food Vorok already shares. I will fetch it, and on the way touch the feverbark my curiosity keeps asking about, then bring both back to Vorok.
records.feeling: Warm toward Vorok, restless to close my hands on something worth giving.

records.name: Zihua
records.text: Nauque, you are hurt and you gave me the first knot. Take frostmoss from me, and amber. Zihua pays what she owes.

records.name: Zihua
records.thought: Nauque is hurt and sits beside me, and he gave me the first knot though I owe him more than I have paid. My hands are full of frostmoss, so I will give some to him and ease the debt, then give him amber too. Jealousy over Nauwa is quiet for now, and I will spend it on useful work. A hunt beside a boy with a flintedge could teach me what I have never done, but he is wounded, so first I feed him and watch his health.
records.feeling: Warm gratitude and care toward Nauque, who is hurt.

say.text: Nauque, you are hurt and you gave me the first knot. Take frostmoss from me, and amber. Zihua pays what she owes.

- fangcharm: From a kill, string a fang into a charm you can keep or give away. Needs 1 meat carried, a tool for hunt in your hands.
- hallwelcome: Share food with a guest under a hall's roof; beneath it, fear and loneliness ease for all who sit together. Needs 2 food of any kind carried, to be in or beside a longhall, 1 others within two steps.
- nightsong: Sit by a fire after dark with someone near and sing or speak of what has been; the night feels less empty for… Needs a fire beside you, night, 1 others within two steps.

WHAT HAS BEFALLEN OTHERS (things your people saw happen or were told of; they are true, and the same will happen to you in the same case):
- day 23: Huatli was set upon by a stalker at night while alone, away from fire, roof and company. (told to you by Zichi)
- day 19: Shoka was set upon by a frostfang at night while alone, away from fire, roof and company. (told to you by Mepan)
- day 11: Olum pushed past the edge of the known world near (39,15) and found new land with in the ground, amber, shell, gold, salt; a herd of bristleboar that has never seen your kind; and beasts that hunt, for unknown land is wilder. (told to you by Nauque)
- day 17: Zihua was set upon by a stalker at night while alone, away from fire, roof and company. (told to you by Huahua)
- day 20: Tugek fell sick after eating raw meat. Eaten within a step of a fire, meat and fish are cooked and do not sicken. (told to you by Mepan)
- day 16: Cowa pushed past the edge of the known world near (29,15) and found new land with in the ground, flint, gold; a herd of bristleboar that has never seen your kind. (told to you by Nauque)

THE SEASONS YOU HAVE LIVED (plainly what you saw, in order. If something comes round again, that is yours to notice, to prepare for, to tell as a tale or to cut in a sign):
Year 2, summer: hungry now and then; skies of gale and heat and storm; food plants in the land at its end: plentiful.
Year 2, autumn: hungry often; skies of fog and rain; food plants in the land at its end: plentiful.

YOUR REFLEXES (run every moment the plan is empty; the first rule whose condition holds and whose action is possible wins; urgent rules override even the plan):
1. IF predator_dist < 9 THEN flee [from predator] (urgent)  // run from hunters early
2. IF thirst > 0.5 AND water_dist < 99 THEN seek [target water]  // drink
3. IF energy < 70 AND plant_here >= 1 THEN eat  // eat underfoot
4. IF energy < 45 AND food_carried > 0 THEN eat  // eat carried
5. IF energy < 70 AND food_dist < 99 THEN seek [target food]  // walk to food
6. IF night == 1 AND sheltered == 0 AND friend_dist > 3 AND friend_dist < 99 THEN seek [target friend]  // stay with company at night
7. IF night == 1 AND sheltered == 0 AND shelter_dist < 99 THEN seek [target shelter]  // shelter at night
8. IF always THEN linger  // stay

FOR THIS THOUGHT: your thought is your inner life, not an inventory. Do not list what is nearby or recite what you carry. Think as a creature with a past and a future: what you want and cannot yet have, whom you trust or resent and why, what you are afraid of, proud of or ashamed of, what you wonder about, what you mean to become. Let whatever presses on you hardest lead, and let it move you to DO something that changes your situation, with a plan that carries it out. A mind that only gathers and guards has not begun to live. Do not restate what you already know or have already said. "note" is only for something NEW, or something that CHANGED what you believed; otherwise leave it null.
