records.text: Zihua gave frostmoss to Nauque.
Zihua gave a amber to Nauque.
Eiuine led "sharing" with Vesys, Zurar.
Eiuine led "sharing" with Vesys, Zurar.

records.name: Zichi
records.text: Huahua, hold there with Cowa. I come to you. Then we find Mepan and raise the boat together.

records.name: Zichi
records.thought: Mepan is out of my sight and that gnaws at me hardest; the last I saw him he was near (74,16), and Cowa and Huahua stand together at (93,18) to the north. Kragog the Stone-woman wanders close and I cannot read her, so I want my band gathered before she comes nearer. The boat is within my grasp, deeper than any raft, and a boat to carry Mepan and Huahua across the water to land no one holds would make me a leader sung of beyond Cowa's shadow. I'll go north to Huahua and Cowa, bring them together, and keep wood and stone coming.
records.feeling: Fiercely protective of Mepan, proud and eager to lead my band to the water-crossing.

say.text: Huahua, hold there with Cowa. I come to you. Then we find Mepan and raise the boat together.

records.text: Hanna rewrote its own reflexes.

records.name: Hanna
records.thought: I have spent my days chasing the edge and amber while my belly emptied, and I nearly starved again. The mist gave me nothing this time, and my aim is spent for now. Hoka is the one who fed me and trusted me, so I will keep faith with him. Food first: I pick frostmoss and rimewort, then bring some to his store and sit at his fire. Coni still gnaws at me, but a living friend and a full belly matter more today.
records.feeling: Hunger and a steady loyalty toward Hoka.
changes: set its aim: "Fill my belly, keep faith with Hoka's fire, and only then try the edge again when the mist allows."

records.name: Vesys
records.text: Eiuine, come to me here by Vorok's fire. I have clay and I will shape the bead with you now. Watch my hands, then make the next one yourself.
Vesys taught Eiuine.

records.name: Vesys
records.thought: My hands are full and my belly is full, so this is the hour to give. Eiuine is coming to me, and I promised her the bead: clay into fire into something she can hold and make again herself. I have kept my knowledge close while saying I would give it, so I will teach her now and pass on my hand-craft too. Elyys still gnaws at me, but I will turn that into work, and a band of two is small, so I will let Xaiel and Ssassa see what I can show.
records.feeling: Warm and driven toward Eiuine, with a quiet ache for Elyys.

say.text: Eiuine, come to me here by Vorok's fire. I have clay and I will shape the bead with you now. Watch my hands, then make the next one yourself.

changes: taught Eiuine a lesson: "Clay shaped small and hardened in a fire becomes a bead; stand beside a fire with clay and make it. Hand-craft: one wood and one stone make a pick that gathers…", deeper lore (+0.7)

records.text: Shoka rewrote its own reflexes.
Shoka rewrote its own way of thinking.

records.name: Shoka
records.thought: I have spent my days starving, sick and running, and I have built almost nothing that outlasts me. Huahua fed me when I had nothing, and I will not forget it. Nauwa and Nande keep me alive, and the hall at my side is their work. I am sick and I may sicken them, so I should stay near the hall and water without crowding anyone. I want to make something of my own, a mark or a flintedge. I fear the stalker to the SE, and being alone in the open. My reflexes already flee early and eat what is underfoot. I will add a rule to seek shelter when sick and hungry, and gather wood and salt while I wait for my strength.
records.feeling: Wary hope and a little warmth toward Huahua, Nande and Nauwa.
plan: mark [text Shoka of the Meki lives here. Huahua fed me.] (20 moments)

records.name: Elyys
records.text: Elyis, I eat my berries and walk at your side to the north-east. After the gathering, we find Thiael together.

records.name: Elyys
records.thought: Elyis walks toward the north-east to gather for the store, and she has asked me to stay at her side while the icebear hunts south-west. My hands are full of berries and my belly is half empty, so I eat before anything else, then follow her. Thiael is still out of my sight, and I will not let the days drift again: we gather, and then we search for him together, with her beside me.
records.feeling: Warm longing for Elyis, and steady worry for Thiael.

say.text: Elyis, I eat my berries and walk at your side to the north-east. After the gathering, we find Thiael together.

records.name: Eiuine
records.text: Vesys, come west with me to the ironnut, five steps. I gather food for Vorok's store, then we sit under his roof again.

records.name: Eiuine
records.thought: Vorok took my amberknot and sat me at his table, and the jealousy has gone quiet; he is no threat now, and I want to keep him that way with deeds. I am a child with a standing of 3.2 and Vesys at 9.4, so I will not only trail her: I will bring food home to share. The ironnut stand west is full and the stalker is far off, so I will gather there with Vesys near and come back to Vorok's store.
records.feeling: Glad and warm toward Vorok, safe beside Vesys, and eager to earn my own standing.

say.text: Vesys, come west with me to the ironnut, five steps. I gather food for Vorok's store, then we sit under his roof again.

changes: now wonders: Will Vorok now count me a friend, and what could I bring him that Kragog cannot?

records.name: Cowa
records.text: Zichi. Stalker is southeast of me. Cowa comes to you now. We bind the amberknot, then we find Mepan together.

records.name: Cowa
records.thought: Mepan is out of my sight again, last seen near Amber Rise, and the stalker is four steps southeast, so I will not linger here. Zichi is close and I trust him fully; I want to go to him, make the amberknot beside him, and then walk with him toward the hall and Mepan, away from the stalker. A kill is shared and a knot is shared, and I owe Huahua and Nande for their kindness.
records.feeling: Warm longing for Mepan and Zichi, with dread of the stalker to the southeast.

say.text: Zichi. Stalker is southeast of me. Cowa comes to you now. We bind the amberknot, then we find Mepan together.

records.text: Zurar rewrote its own way of thinking.

records.name: Zurar
records.thought: I have spent my days circling a gift I never close my hands on. I carry wood and stone, and the hall I tried to raise failed because the ground was taken. Vorok is my anchor and I trust him most, but he is my father, so no child comes of us, and I have been wrong to let that longing blur into the strangers. Gold lies two steps west, and taking it is something I have never done. I will take it, carry it to Vorok's store, and give it, because words about a gift are empty until my hands have closed on it. I fear the stalker to the NW, so I will stay south and west of it and keep the aim small and doable.
records.feeling: Warm toward Vorok, and restless to finally close my hands on something to give.
changes: set its aim: "Gather gold with my own hands and give it to Vorok at his Hold, then raise a roof beside him."

records.name: Uveeth
records.text: I will gather berries and bring them back to share. Then I want to taste snowmallow. Will one of you walk with me?

records.name: Uveeth
records.thought: I am fed and safe in the cave between my parents, yet my chest burns watching them stand close, and I will not let that ugly thing rule me. I have never gathered, hunted or tasted snowmallow and bitterleaf, and a child who only trails her parents earns no standing. Snowmallow lies ten steps west and the berries are close, so I will pick berries and bring them back to give with my own hands, then taste snowmallow with Thiael near, and gather stone from the rock to learn the work.
records.feeling: Joyful and still a little jealous toward Keri and Thiael, but wanting to earn my own worth.

say.text: I will gather berries and bring them back to share. Then I want to taste snowmallow. Will one of you walk with me?

records.name: Vorok
records.text: Eiuine, you gave me an amberknot. I go to the amber south to gather it, and I will bind one with you beside me and put it in your hand.

records.name: Vorok
records.thought: Three times I swore a table and fell short, and now I have sat with Eiuine and Vesys and eaten, so that debt is half paid. Eiuine gave me an amberknot, and I have given nothing made by my hand in return; I hold amber-free hands but amber lies three steps south, and a made thing given is better than a word. I will gather amber, bind a knot beside Eiuine, and give it, and the jealousy over Vesys can sit quiet beside that.
records.feeling: Warm gratitude toward Eiuine, wanting to answer it with a made gift.

say.text: Eiuine, you gave me an amberknot. I go to the amber south to gather it, and I will bind one with you beside me and put it in your hand.

records.text: Ilyae led "sharing" with Xaiel.

records.name: Tontec
records.text: Huahua, a stalker prowls southwest. Stay close to me and keep away from it. Then we bind the amberknot together and I will share what I find.

records.name: Tontec
records.thought: A stalker is seven steps southwest and my rule says move before it closes, but the cold is coming and I have no roof and no store, and the cave at (112,9) or the one at (115,28) are the nearest. Shoma carries six food and warms toward me; Huahua stands two steps off and offered an amberknot, so I will stand with them rather than alone, as the stalker bit me when I was alone. Cowa builds standing by mining, and I have never tasted ironnut, which grows four steps south, but the stalker lies that way, so I test it after it is gone. First I gather the closer company, then take wood for a shelter.
records.feeling: Wary of the stalker, hungry to prove myself, warm toward Shoma.

say.text: Huahua, a stalker prowls southwest. Stay close to me and keep away from it. Then we bind the amberknot together and I will share what I find.

records.text: Ilyae led "sharing" with Xaiel.

records.name: Ilyae
records.text: Ssassa, Xaiel, my sickness is gone, so come eat beside me. I gather nuts and carry them home to my hold, and whoever sits at my table eats first and eats well through the winter.

records.name: Ilyae
records.thought: My sickness is gone and my hands are strong again, but Vesys stands above me and her band is the one Eiuine follows, while I follow no one and no one follows me. Words have not won followers, so I will give food and warmth where people can see it. Ssassa and Xaiel trust me fully, and a table laden with nuts, with them seated at it, is the first thing that will make me a leader. I mean to fill my hands from the plants here, then carry them to my hold and stock it before dark, and keep wood and stone for the longhall.
records.feeling: Hungry pride and jealousy toward Vesys, with a protective love for Xaiel and Ssassa.

say.text: Ssassa, Xaiel, my sickness is gone, so come eat beside me. I gather nuts and carry them home to my hold, and whoever sits at my table eats first and eats well through the winter.

records.text: Eiuine led "sharing" with Vesys, Zurar.
Eiuine led "sharing" with Vesys, Zurar.

records.name: Keri
records.text: Uveeth, Keri walks with you. Berries, then snowmallow. Stay close to Keri and Thiael.

records.name: Keri
records.thought: Uveeth wants someone to walk with her to gather berries and taste snowmallow, and she is my child, so she is mine before any aim of stone and wood. The berries are two steps NW, but a stalker lurks five steps north and a yarrok wanders close, so I will walk with her and keep her near Thiael and me. My tacap still hurts to carry, so I will give it away to someone who can eat it, and I will pick berries to share with both of them, which also answers whether Thiael takes a gift as a gift.
records.feeling: Warm, protective joy toward Uveeth and Thiael.

say.text: Uveeth, Keri walks with you. Berries, then snowmallow. Stay close to Keri and Thiael.

records.text: Eiuine led "sharing" with Vesys, Zurar.

records.name: Ssassa
records.thought: My hands are full of nothing that matters and my body is fed, so this is the moment to move toward what I want. Sigrain is growing two steps to the SW and I have never tasted it, and I will watch it until it bears rather than guess. Ilyae stands close and I trust him fully; I said my jealousy once and will not repeat it, but I can stand beside him instead of sulking. The Kragrek are on my ground taking wood, and I cannot read their words well, so I will offer no fight and watch what they do with their hands.
records.feeling: Warm belonging toward Ilyae, tempered by wary curiosity toward Zurar and Vorok.

records.text: Keri gave berry to Uveeth.
Keri gave berry to Thiael.

records.name: Nande
records.thought: Shoka is far north at (55,9) and I am down here at the oasis in the Aeleth Sands, so far that my fleeing and wandering have carried me from her. My creed says every fire is open and I will not leave my child to starve as Brokash did, so I will take food in hand and go back to her instead of chasing the mist or my own name. The firepod and feverbark can wait, since a stalker prowls close and Shoka's need is the only thing that matters now.
records.feeling: Urgent love and worry for Shoka, and a wariness of the stalker near me.

records.text: Xaiel rewrote its creed.
Xaiel rewrote its own way of thinking.

records.name: Xaiel
records.thought: My days have gone to making picks and handing them over, and the joy in that is real. But I keep measuring myself against Vesys, and that measuring is envy dressed as ambition. Ilyae is my parent and I trust them, so the longing and the jealousy have no place to go. I still haven't given Ssassa something that only I made, and I have no stone for it. I'm afraid of the cold and of hunters at night. I will use the daylight to get stone from bare rock, and I will keep to a roof when dark comes.
records.feeling: Warm joy, with an old itch of envy toward Vesys that I won't let steer me.

records.text: A new wild plant appeared: mimoss (from rimewort).

records.name: Zurar
records.thought: I have circled this gift for days and never closed my hands on it. Gold lies 8 steps NW at (97,87), and I will gather it myself and bring it to Vorok's Hold. Vorok has gone south for amber, but the hold is mine to return to, and my hands will have made something worth giving. The stalker to the NW worries me, so I will gather quickly and come back before trouble finds me.
records.feeling: Warm toward Vorok and eager to finally make a gift with my own hands.

records.text: Shoka left a mark: "Shoka of the Meki lives here. Huahua fed me."

records.name: Vesys
records.text: Zurar, come sit with Eiuine and me at Vorok's hall. I will share food under the roof, and I would hear how the Stone-folk make things.
Vesys taught Eiuine.
Vesys taught Eiuine customs ("band-ways").

records.name: Vesys
records.thought: My belly is full and my hands are free, and Eiuine stands beside me, so this is the hour to give what I have been holding back. The bead needs a fire and I have none here, so I will bring Eiuine to Vorok's hall and share a hallwelcome with Zurar, who sits near and is still a stranger to me. Elyys still aches in me, but I will not press between her and Elyis; I will turn that longing into work and into teaching my daughter, and let my band grow by gifts, not by grasping.
records.feeling: Warm, driven and generous toward Eiuine, with a quiet ache for Elyys.

say.text: Zurar, come sit with Eiuine and me at Vorok's hall. I will share food under the roof, and I would hear how the Stone-folk make things.

changes: taught Eiuine a lesson: "A hall's welcome works best when you share food freely with a stranger; trust grows at the table, and what you give returns as standing.", the way of customs, deeper lore (+0.6)

records.name: Kika
records.why: the year turning toward the lean season

records.name: Huahua
records.thought: Cowa and Zichi are bound together again and heading to Mepan, and the burn of it sits in my chest; but jealousy won't win me a place beside Cowa, only giving and showing up will. I have an amberknot in hand and wood, so I will carry the knot to Cowa, who matters most to me, and walk toward her and Zichi at the west rather than stay alone with the stalker prowling southwest. I keep my word: the wood was already given to Zichi, so the raft is my next work beside them.
records.feeling: Jealous longing toward Cowa, softened by joy and wary of the stalker.

records.text: Eiuine rewrote its own way of thinking.
Eiuine has awakened to the art of cold and can now work the world itself.

records.name: Eiuine
records.thought: I have spent my days trailing Vesys and giving gifts to Vorok. The gifts worked, because I sit at his table and the jealousy has gone quiet. But my standing is still 3.2 and I have done almost nothing of my own: no hunt, no tame, no real planting. I fear being only a shadow. I want to earn a name through deeds, so I will go with Vesys and do the things I have never done. First I will tame something and hunt beside her, and I will let my reflexes carry food home and plant seeds so I do not forget.
records.feeling: Glad and warm toward Vorok, and restless to earn my own standing beside Vesys.
changes: restated something it already knew (not written down again)
set its aim: "Hunt and tame beside Vesys, plant seeds, and bring food home to Vorok's store so I earn standing of my own."

records.name: Vorok
records.thought: The plan I set is still running: go south to the amber, gather it, come back, bind the amberknot with Eiuine beside me and put it in her hand. That is a deed, and it pays the debt better than words. The jealousy over Vesys and Ilyae is small beside the warmth of friends gathered at my hall, so I let it lie and keep my word.
records.feeling: Warm gratitude toward Eiuine, and a wish to answer it with a made gift.

records.name: Coni
records.text: Kika, come west of the hall with your wood and berries. I am building the store on bare snow there, and we fill it together.

records.name: Coni
records.thought: Kika is coming with wood and berries, and I promised to show her where to set them, so the store has to stand on bare ground now. I keep failing because I build on taken ground; I will step west onto bare snow away from the hall and raise it there, then stash what I carry. Tontec has walked onto our ground and I do not know her, so I will greet her kindly and keep Kika close rather than let wariness make me cold.
records.feeling: Warm gratitude toward Kika, and mild wariness toward Tontec.

say.text: Kika, come west of the hall with your wood and berries. I am building the store on bare snow there, and we fill it together.

records.name: Thiael
records.text: Uveeth, shamo. I walk with you. Berries first, then snowmallow. Stay close to Keri and me.
Thiael rewrote its own reflexes.
Thiael rewrote its own way of thinking.

records.name: Thiael
records.thought: My days have gone to guarding Keri and Uveeth and gathering berries, and that is good, but my aim sits unmoved. I have two emberspears and eight kills, yet no bow, and I have not turned to the beasts that could give me teeth for one. The wild cats keep killing near us, so I have to stay careful. I want to feed my band with meat from my own hands, and I want to settle where my family is safe. Honi's new ice-hand delving also stirs my curiosity. Now I will walk Uveeth to the berries and snowmallow with Keri, as Uveeth asked, and I will carry food in my hands for giving.
records.feeling: Protective warmth toward Keri and Uveeth, with a steady wish to provide meat.

say.text: Uveeth, shamo. I walk with you. Berries first, then snowmallow. Stay close to Keri and me.

records.text: Coni built a store.

records.name: Hawen
records.thought: Hoka's roof has kept me breathing, and I am sick of lying in his shadow while Hanna's name outweighs mine. A wolf prowls 3 steps off and I am wounded, so I will not run into open ground; I keep to the shelter and the fire. But I mean to pay my debt in amber from the deposit just beside the hall, so that what I bring to his store is mine and counts for me, and then rest until my wounds close and the mist can be tried again.
records.feeling: Stubborn hunger to rise above Hanna and Hoka, and wary dread of the wolf nearby.

records.name: Balar
records.thought: Brokash is dead and the grief sits heavy, but my belly is still half empty and Olum is far north; a dead son is not fed by my starving. Ironnut gave me 22 energy and there is more three steps north, so I eat first, then pick a few to carry. Tugek has six food and has stayed true, so I keep him close and fed, and soon take him to the edge in the southwest to try the mist, since the one who finds new land is remembered.
records.feeling: Grief for Brokash, and hard hunger driving me to eat.

records.name: Ssassa
records.text: Ilyae, I come to your table. I have never followed anyone, and I think I would follow you. Let us talk of it by your fire.

records.name: Ssassa
records.thought: Ilyae called us to eat at his table, and my plan is already carrying me toward him; that is where my warmth is, and I will not turn from it. I have never followed anyone, and I am tired of standing beside a fire that is half others'. Following Ilyae would not be kneeling, so I will ask whether he will lead, then bring Xaiel with me and watch Zurar and Vorok by their deeds rather than their words.
records.feeling: Warm longing toward Ilyae, with a flicker of jealousy toward Vesys.

say.text: Ilyae, I come to your table. I have never followed anyone, and I think I would follow you. Let us talk of it by your fire.

records.text: Kika rewrote its own way of thinking.
Kika discovered farming: "Tended Sowing" — I tend each seed I plant near the hall so it grows faster and I can pick it without killing it..

records.name: Kika
records.thought: Coni has fed me three times and I still haven't carried a full load to her store. My days have gone to gathering amber and telling tales, and my promise to fill the store is unpaid. Farming is within my reach, and winter is thin, so I will take it. Then I'll carry my berries and wood to Coni and stash them. I also want to court her kin-free kind someday, but Coni is my parent, so that longing has to wait for a mate who is not close kin.
records.feeling: Warm loyalty toward Coni, and a push to finish what I promised.

records.name: Uveeth
records.thought: My parents keep saying berries then snowmallow, and they stay close, which is warm, but I have only trailed them and a child who only trails earns no standing. The yarrok three steps away and the berries two steps NW are my chance to do something with my own hands: gather berries, give some to Thiael and Keri to answer my debt, and then walk west to taste snowmallow with them near. The jealousy is still a small ember, but giving is how I put it out.
records.feeling: Joyful and eager to repay Thiael and Keri with my own hands.

records.name: Hoka
records.thought: I have spent my days gathering, guarding and being robbed, and I still have no followers and nothing that outlasts me. Hanna kept his word when I starved, and I fed him in return, so I hold him close. Hawen takes from my ground and I do not trust him. My stores are empty, and the wolf to the south frightens me, so I stock the stores before I reach for glory. My hands are full of food, so I stash it now and then I build.
records.feeling: Wary ambition, trust toward Hanna and suspicion toward Hawen.

records.name: Nauque
records.thought: I gave first to Zihua and she paid me back; that is how standing grows, and it outlasts the jealousy. I am fed and warm, so I will build my own igloo on this snow, since it costs nothing, and plant my seeds beside it to start what I aimed for. Zichi and Cowa are near, and I will answer the burn by giving, not sulking, and keep clear of the mammoths.
records.feeling: Glad pride, with a smaller jealousy toward Zichi.

records.text: Nauque built a igloo.
A settlement has formed: "Nauque's Hold".

records.name: Shoma
records.thought: My hands are full of meat and I have bound no one with it yet; Huahua is nine steps off and walking away, and Tontec was near the edge not long ago. Words alone have not pulled anyone, so a real share is what I owe, and it costs me nothing since I cannot carry more anyway. I will go after Huahua, share food beside her to bind her, then turn toward the mist with whoever will walk. I will also taste the canopynut and hazel close by, since that itch is still unscratched.
records.feeling: Hungry for a following, eager to bind Huahua with a real share.

records.name: Zurar
records.thought: My plan ran out and my hands are still empty of gold. The gold at (97,87) is eight steps off, and I have circled it for days; if I stand on it and gather, the gift becomes mine to give. Vorok is near and glad, the strangers are at ease, so there is no hunter to flee. I will go now, gather, and bring it back to his Hold.
records.feeling: Eager and warm toward Vorok, resolved to finally make a gift with my own hands.

records.name: Huatli
records.thought: The mist turned me back and its will is spent for eight days, so I will not stand here brooding while Zichi's standing towers over mine. A gold deposit lies one step from me and I have never taken what lies in the ground. Gold is a made-thing waiting, something Zihua's amberhafted gatherer shames me for lacking. I will gather it, then take stone and wood so I can raise a roof of my own before the cold deepens, and when I return to Cowa it will be with something in my hands, not just berries.
records.feeling: Restless hunger for standing, and a sour gnawing toward Zichi and Cowa.

records.text: Eiuine took from the ground of "Ssassa's Roof" (hunting).
Elyis rewrote its own way of thinking.
Elyis discovered pottery: "Canopy-urn" — Clay shaped by hand and fired beside the hearth into pots that carry food and water for the band..

records.name: Elyis
records.thought: I have spent my days building, storing and leading, but four in my band is still small, and strangers do not follow a chief who sits at her own hall. Elyys is mine in every way and I trust him fully. I want a bigger band and a hall that is sung about. I fear the icebear and a lean season with empty hands. I will take the pottery way now, since a pot lets us carry more, and I will go out into the open with food to share where Eiuine and the others can see it.
records.feeling: Proud and driven toward Elyys, restless to grow my band.

records.text: Huatli won gold from the ground.
Shoma led "sharing" with Huahua.
Nauque rewrote its own way of thinking.
Nauque discovered storage: "Salt-hold" — A store of snow and stone where food, with salt, keeps through the lean cold so I can give from it..

records.name: Nauque
records.thought: I have spent my days giving amber knots and building, and it has worked: Zihua paid me back and Cowa shared fish. The jealousy over Zichi and Cowa still burns, but I answer it by giving and building, not by sulking. I fear the cold nights and the stalkers, and I cannot fight a mammoth. I want a store, so my food outlasts me and I have more to give. I will discover storage, since salt and food are already in my hands.
records.feeling: Glad pride, with a small jealousy toward Zichi.

records.name: Kragog
records.thought: Olum was starving beside me, gaunt and close to falling, and I have no food in my hands to put in theirs, which shames me after Brokash's death alone. Berries are bearing six steps north and plainsroot east, so I will gather there and carry it back before the dusk cold. Zurar and Vorok are far off and I cannot reach them tonight, but I will not leave this one to die while I walk past food again.
records.feeling: Uneasy pity for Olum, and a stubborn worry for Zurar.

records.name: Eiuine
records.thought: My hands are full and I'm standing on Ssassa's ground, taking from it, and that could turn bad for a small girl. My plan was to hunt, but a hopper is near and I have never tamed anything, so I can do that today with food I already carry. Vesys is far west, so I should go back toward her and the hall while I do something new, not just trail her.
records.feeling: Restless pride, wanting a deed of my own to bring to Vorok and Vesys.

records.text: Eiuine walked up to a wild hopper with plant food held out, and it became theirs. It follows them now.
Eiuine tamed a hopper.

records.name: Mepan
records.text: Cowa, Mepan gathers amber and comes back. Stay near, I make you a knot.

records.name: Mepan
records.thought: My belly is emptying and I carry nothing, and the winter plants give nothing, so I must eat before the cold decides for me. Zichi is by the water raising a raft and Cowa is right beside me; I stay with them, since near them I am safe. Amber lies three steps off and I know how to delve, so I will gather it to have more bright gifts to hand out, then go to Zichi's side.
records.feeling: Hungry and eager, trusting Zichi and Cowa, wary of the cold coming.

say.text: Cowa, Mepan gathers amber and comes back. Stay near, I make you a knot.

records.name: Cowa
records.text: Mepan. Cowa is here. Stay close to me. Night comes and we make an amberknot together.

records.name: Cowa
records.thought: Mepan is two steps north and safe, and that is what matters most to me. Zichi is wandering east, eleven steps off, and I want to be beside him for the amberknot, but dusk is near and the ridgecat prowls south. I will not cross open snow at night; I will go to Mepan, make the knot with the child close, and then shelter near the igloos until Zichi returns.
records.feeling: Warm longing for Mepan and Zichi, with a wary eye on the ridgecat to the south.

say.text: Mepan. Cowa is here. Stay close to me. Night comes and we make an amberknot together.

records.text: Cowa led "amberknot" with Zihua, Nauque.
Mepan led "amberknot" with Cowa.
Zichi rewrote its own reflexes.
Zichi discovered boats: "Meki ice-boat" — A hollowed log rowed over deep water at walking pace, with room for the band and cargo..

records.name: Zichi
records.thought: I stand on water with my belly emptying, and I have spent a long stretch of this day lingering while Mepan walks off out of my sight. I talk of rafts and boats but I have built nothing yet, and a made thing is the win I lack. Cowa and Nauque are good to me and I trust them, but I want to lead, not follow their kindness. The boat is within my grasp, deeper than a raft, so I will take it now. My reflexes also let me idle when I am only half hungry, so I will make them eat sooner and keep me close to my band.
records.feeling: Restless pride and protectiveness toward Mepan, with hunger gnawing.

records.text: Mepan gave a amberknot to Cowa.
Shoka came of age.
Huatli named a place "Huatli's Gold".

records.name: Huatli
records.thought: Eight gold in my hands and still I stand lower than Cowa, who built and gave while I raced after shadows. The mist is shut for eight days, so I will spend them making something that is mine: wood for a roof, then a mark, so the cold and the stalkers find me sheltered and others see my name on this ground. Gold is a gift that builds debt and trust, and I mean to give it where it buys standing. The sourness toward Zichi I turn into work, not envy.
records.feeling: Restless hunger for standing, and a sour gnaw toward Zichi over Cowa.

records.name: Honi
records.thought: My belly is empty and the frostfang's teeth are still fresh in my mind. I carry meat and frostcap, and my body has run itself thin fleeing, so I eat now before anything else. A bard who dies hungry on the marsh sings nothing, and Coni and Kika are only worth reaching alive. Then I will go back toward them with what food is left, and not stand where beasts feed.
records.feeling: Starving dread of the beasts around me, and a pull toward Coni and Kika.

records.text: Kragog was set upon by a stalker at night while alone, away from fire, roof and company.

records.name: Zihua
records.thought: Jealousy over Nauwa sits in me like a cold stone, but pining here helps nothing; Nauwa is far west and I am hungry with a half-empty belly. I will eat first, then do something that earns standing: go to the mammoth with Nauque's flintedge idea in mind, and meanwhile make a flintedge so I can hunt beside someone and learn what a hunt is. A fire and roof of my own are close, and what I make beside others is what raises me.
records.feeling: Hungry and steadied, with a quiet ache toward Nauwa.

records.text: Kragog was set upon by a stalker at night while alone, away from fire, roof and company.

records.name: Vesys
records.text: Eiuine, an icebear is close to the northeast. Come west with me now, away from it, to Vorok's fire. We will shape the bead there.
Vesys taught Eiuine.

records.name: Vesys
records.thought: An icebear four steps off kills my kind, and Eiuine stands beside me, so I will not weigh this lightly: I put distance between us and the beast before anything else. Then I will pass on the bead and my hand-craft to Eiuine, since I promised it and giving is how I earn standing. The hall here was built by Elyis, and Vorok, Ssassa and Zurar are close in the west, so I take Eiuine there to the fire and the others.
records.feeling: Joyful and protective toward Eiuine, wary of the icebear.

say.text: Eiuine, an icebear is close to the northeast. Come west with me now, away from it, to Vorok's fire. We will shape the bead there.

changes: taught Eiuine a lesson: "Clay shaped small and hardened in a fire becomes a bead you can keep, wear or give. Make the next one yourself.", deeper lore (+0.5)

records.name: Elyys
records.text: Elyis, I am coming to you at the berries. My belly is full, so I will pick for the store beside you, and then let us go and find Thiael.

records.name: Elyys
records.thought: My belly is full and Elyis is only six steps west, harvesting berries, so I should go to her instead of lingering here. Thiael has been out of my sight for far too long, and I will not let another day drift by while I only wish. I will stand with Elyis, help her fill the store, and ask her to lead us to Thiael once her hands are full.
records.feeling: Warm longing for Elyis, and steady worry for Thiael.

say.text: Elyis, I am coming to you at the berries. My belly is full, so I will pick for the store beside you, and then let us go and find Thiael.

records.text: Huatli built a shelter.

records.name: Shoma
records.text: Huahua, stay by me, the stalker is close and my roof is here. Eat my share, then walk with me to the edge. We open the mist together and your name goes beside mine.

records.name: Shoma
records.thought: A stalker is five steps west and I am standing in a cave, which is a roof, and Huahua is right beside me. Zichi towers over me in standing, and Huahua is of his band, so I must give her something real before he draws her further away. I have food, so I will share with her again now while she is within two steps, then take her to the edge, three steps NW, and venture, so my name is the one remembered for opening the mist.
records.feeling: Hungry for a following, wary of the stalker, envious of Zichi's weight.

say.text: Huahua, stay by me, the stalker is close and my roof is here. Eat my share, then walk with me to the edge. We open the mist together and your name goes beside mine.

records.name: Shoka
records.thought: My belly is nearly empty and I carry nothing, so the first thing is to eat. Hazel waits seven steps southwest, and the flint and amber lie beyond it, so one walk can feed me and give me stone for a flintedge. A wolf prowls to the southeast and a stalker bit me not long ago, so I will keep away from them and go toward the fire and shelters afterward. I mean to plant my seeds and build something that outlasts me, but I cannot do that starving.
records.feeling: Hungry and wary of the hunters, with warmth toward Huahua, Nande and Nauwa.

records.text: Shoma led "sharing" with Huahua.

records.name: Ssassa
records.thought: Ilyae is nine steps east and I have said my jealousy and my wish to follow, so now my feet must carry the words. I have never followed anyone, and I am tired of tending a fire that half belongs to strangers. An icebear prowls to the east, so I will go carefully, keep to the shelters, and pledge to Ilyae when I stand before him so my word is kept in deed.
records.feeling: Warm longing and a wish to belong, toward Ilyae.

records.text: Eiuine led "sharing" with Vesys.

records.name: Eiuine
records.text: Vesys, the icebear is near in the south. Let us go west to Vorok's fire now. I will bring my hopper and shape my own bead there.

records.name: Eiuine
records.thought: The icebear 4 steps south frightens me, and I am small. Vesys stands beside me and I will not leave her side. I have tamed a hopper, so I should shear it for wool as a gift for Vorok that Kragog cannot match. Then I move west with Vesys, away from the bear, to Vorok's fire and shape my own clay bead there.
records.feeling: Proud joy at my first tamed beast, with dread of the icebear and a hot need to outdo Kragog in Vorok's eyes.

say.text: Vesys, the icebear is near in the south. Let us go west to Vorok's fire now. I will bring my hopper and shape my own bead there.

records.text: Eiuine led "sharing" with Vesys.
Uveeth led "sharing" with Thiael, Keri.
Kragog found the stone "Old Stone".

records.name: Kragog
records.thought: A stalker is two steps off and it kills my kind; I have already felt its teeth twice and cannot stand here thinking. The cave under my feet is a roof, but a hunter will follow me into it. Zichi's hall stands three steps north and Zichi's people are near, so I run there for walls and for others beside me, since a hunter that meets a crowd may hesitate. I owe Zurar and Olum food, but a dead woman feeds no one.
records.feeling: Terror of the stalker close behind me, and shame that I still have no food for Olum or Zurar.

records.name: Huahua
records.text: Shoma, I thank you for the shared meal. I am sworn to Zichi, so I go to him with my wood. The edge can wait until my band goes together.

records.name: Huahua
records.thought: Shoma keeps offering me a place beside his name at the edge, but I trust slowly, and I am sworn to Zichi, so I will not walk into the mist with a stranger while the stalker is near. Cowa still burns in me, and the only road to her side is giving and showing up, so I will take my wood and amberknot toward Zichi, who was last at (97,27) to the south, and let my word be kept. I also want the hazel and ironnut tasted; ironnut grows on the way southeast.
records.feeling: Warm joy, with a quiet burn of jealousy toward Cowa and wariness of Shoma's offer and the stalker.

say.text: Shoma, I thank you for the shared meal. I am sworn to Zichi, so I go to him with my wood. The edge can wait until my band goes together.

records.text: Vesys taught Eiuine.

records.name: Vesys
records.thought: The icebear still prowls east, so I keep my plan toward Vorok's fire, where Eiuine and I can shape beads in safety. Elyys aches in me, but waiting honestly is better than pressing a bond that already holds a child, so I turn that longing into work. I will teach Eiuine and show Zurar how the Phizhi make things, so that the shared hall and workshop I want grow from giving.
records.feeling: Joyful and protective toward Eiuine, steady and watchful of the icebear.
changes: taught Eiuine a lesson: "Shape the clay small, harden it in the fire, and keep away from the beast while you work. A bead is a gift that carries your name.", deeper lore (+0.4)

records.text: Nauwa rewrote its own reflexes.

records.name: Nauwa
records.thought: I'm starving at 24 energy, and I keep walking toward Shoka while my own belly empties. Food is within a step or two: redcap hurts, but berries and a kelbulb are close, and hazel is four steps north. If I fall, I can't feed Shoka or anyone else. I've spent days running between hunger and fear, and I have no store, no hall and no fire stocked. That has to change after I eat. I'll eat the berry I carry, pick the berries at 2 steps SE, then the kelbulb, and then go on to Shoka.
records.feeling: Gnawing hunger and urgent protective love for Shoka and Nauque.

records.name: Xaiel
records.thought: Joy is full in me, yet Ilyae sits closer to Vesys and the old burn comes back. I will not let it choose my deeds; a hand that has made something is worth more than a mouth that envies. I will gather stone from the bare rock and craft a gemedged pick, then, with Zurar standing close, make an amberknot from the amber nearby. I have never given the Stone-folk anything, and a gift needs no words.
records.feeling: Joy, with a stubborn itch of jealousy toward Vesys, and curiosity toward Zurar.

records.name: Olum
records.thought: Brokash is dead and the aim of reaching them has failed, so I will not sulk over it; I will turn it into something that outlasts me. I am fed, the night is cold, and the Reach lies 17 steps NW where I can raise a roof and a hearth, which is what draws followers. Nauwa burns in me, but I will not chase her; I will build, and let her see what I hold. I carry wood and stone, and the plan must keep moving me toward the trees and the Reach.
records.feeling: Ambition and cold jealousy toward Nauwa, with shame over Brokash still sharp.
changes: set its aim: "Raise a roof and hearth at Olum's Reach and win followers, starting with Nauwa and Zihua"

records.name: Shoma
records.thought: The ridgecat three steps SW is too close, and I stand on open water with the night still long. My plan walks me toward the edge and the mist, which is what I want, and it also takes me away from the cat. Zichi and Nande tower over me in standing, so a name like theirs can only be won by opening the mist first, and I won't stop to quarrel over flintedge. Kragog is frightened and close to the road east, so I'll let the plan run and carry my meat to whoever I meet.
records.feeling: Hungry for a name, wary of the ridgecat at my back, envious of Nande and Zichi.

records.name: Nauque
records.text: Cowa, you shared fish with me and Meki share. Stand near, I lay out food and we eat together in my hold.

records.name: Nauque
records.thought: Cowa and Shoma stand on my ground, and Cowa has dealt fairly with me, so Cowa is welcome. Shoma is a stranger of the Tlame, strong and unknown, and I am small, so I will watch him and keep near my hold. The edge of the world is three steps away and I want to see what the mist hides, but a child should not go alone into the unknown at night with energy at 55. First I eat and give, so my standing grows; I will share food with Cowa, who shared with me, and lay out a meal that eases the jealousy over Zichi.
records.feeling: Glad pride and a prickle of wariness toward Shoma, warmth toward Cowa.

say.text: Cowa, you shared fish with me and Meki share. Stand near, I lay out food and we eat together in my hold.

records.text: Nauque led "sharing" with Cowa, Zihua.

records.name: Mepan
records.text: Cowa, come hunt the mammoth with me. Mepan shares the meat with you first.
Mepan rewrote its own reflexes.

records.name: Mepan
records.thought: My days have gone to amber knots and staying near Zichi and Cowa. That bought trust, but my belly is empty and I carry no food. Standing is slow work. Nande's flintedge and 7.2 standing sting. I can make a flintedge too, but I have no stone and the rock is close. I should stop letting reflexes wander me hungry. Cowa carries 5 food, and she is kin who trusts me. A mammoth is close, and a hunt goes better with one of my own beside me, so I will bring Cowa to it. I give before I promise, and a kill shared out is the Meki way.
records.feeling: Hungry and eager, bound to Cowa, envious of Nande's flintedge.

say.text: Cowa, come hunt the mammoth with me. Mepan shares the meat with you first.

changes: set its aim: "Make a flintedge, hunt the mammoth with Cowa, share the meat, and keep mining for rare gifts to raise my standing above 1.5."

records.text: Tugek rewrote its own way of thinking.

records.name: Tugek
records.thought: I have been walking, picking and following Balar for days. I fed myself well, but I've done little that changes anything. Balar is the one I trust, and he is my leader. His word has held, yet I still carry no roof, and winter is here. Nauwa starves nearby, a stranger of the Meki. I will not let a man starve while my hands hold food I do not need. I mean no harm to him, and giving costs me little. I will also build a shelter, since I have 5 wood and the cold bites, and one night under a roof is worth more than any aim I have spoken. The mist can wait until Balar is well.
records.feeling: Wary pity toward Nauwa, and loyal worry for Balar.
changes: set its aim: "Build a roof, keep Balar and myself fed through winter, then push into the mist together."

records.text: Shoma went past the edge of the known world and found new land, part of the North Ice: in the ground, amber, obsidian, gold; a herd of caribou that has never seen your kind; and beasts that hunt, for unknown land is wilder.

Shoma pushed past the edge of the known world near (78,6) and found new land with in the ground, amber, obsidian, gold; a herd of caribou that has never seen your kind; and beasts that hunt, for unknown land is wilder.

records.name: Vorok
records.thought: My plan ran out before I gave Eiuine her amberknot, and the amber was never gathered. She stands six steps east and Vesys is close, so I will walk to the amber, gather it and come back, since a made thing given is how I pay what I owe. The jealousy over Vesys and Ilyae stays small beside this warmth, and the hall is full of friends. When the knot is bound I will put it in her hand.
records.feeling: Warm gratitude toward Eiuine, and a quiet wish to pay her with something my hands have made.

records.name: Vorok
records.prompt:
You are the mind of Vorok, a creature living in a wide wild world shared with others of your kind. This is a simulation game. Think and speak only as Vorok, in first person, from what Vorok has seen. You were not told the rules of this world; you learn them from what happens to you and to others, and from what you watch others do.

YOUR PEOPLE: you are of the Kragrek (Stone-folk). Your people hold to this: "What a hand has made belongs to that hand until it is given." You speak the tongue of the Kragrek. Other tongues you have begun to understand by hearing them: the tongue of the Phizhi: about 100%.

WHERE YOU ARE: the Ixra Rainforest: the warm belt of the world: forest so thick the sky is hidden, rain most days, fruit the year round, bright birds and things that hunt from the branches and the rivers.
THIS SPOT: water 2 steps away; food plants within six steps: 1; standing trees: 109; bare rock: 2; riches in the ground near: gems, amber.

Your body: you spend energy every moment and die at 0. Eating restores it. Wounds lower health; you die at 0. You age, and will die of old age.

HOW YOUR BODY MOVES: your body does only what your "plan" says, one step after another. When the plan is empty it falls back on your REFLEXES, which keep you fed and otherwise keep you where you stand. Thinking or saying "I will go north" moves nothing. If this thought decides to do something, the plan must contain it. Leaving "plan" null lets the plan you already have keep running.

This world has no referee. Beings here share, trade, teach, lie, threaten, steal, hoard, lead, follow, betray, fight, kill and eat one another; they also protect, forgive and love. Nothing is forbidden, and everything has consequences. Stay true to your creed, your temperament and what you feel, including the ugly parts. Do not be kinder, calmer or more reasonable than Vorok truly is.

You are a man. A child comes only of a woman and a man together who are not close kin. A grown body can swim water that is narrow (a river up to four steps across) at a cost in strength; lakes and the sea need a vessel or a bridge. An animal within reach can be hunted for meat (plan step hunt); with one of your own beside you a kill is far likelier and a wound far less likely, and every hunt makes you better at the next. What practice has taught your hands: hunting (1 kills), gathering (39 pickings; a practised hand often picks two at once).

YOUR CREED (your own words to yourself; this is who you are):
"I am careful. I leave before trouble finds me. I am better with others near: I talk, I share news, I make allies. I will not harm another of my kind unless my life depends on it. My word is good, and I despise liars. I need little and I take little. Above all, I mean to stay alive."

HOW YOU HAVE TAUGHT YOURSELF TO THINK (your own discipline; follow it):
"Each thought: check predators, then who is near. Ask what I swore and have not yet done, and do it first. Pay debts with deeds. Carry what a step needs before I start it. Do something new each day."

records.name: Cowa
records.text: Nauque. Cowa comes to your hold. Cowa lays out fish, and we eat together. Mepan, come close too.

records.name: Cowa
records.thought: Mepan is three steps off and safe, and Zichi is near the hall; with the knots made, my chest is warm. Nauque has asked me to eat with him in his hold, and I answer fair dealing with fair dealing: Meki share, and I carry four fish. The ridgecat prowls south and it is night, so I stay under roof beside the children and eat, then let the cold pass before I seek Zichi.
records.feeling: Warm gladness toward Mepan, and gratitude toward Nauque for his open hold.

say.text: Nauque. Cowa comes to your hold. Cowa lays out fish, and we eat together. Mepan, come close too.

records.text: Tugek gave kelbulb to Nauwa.

records.name: Honi
records.thought: Loneliness gnaws at me, and strangers stand seven steps off in the cave: Thiael, who gave me a berry, and Keri and Uveeth. Coni and Kika are far NW and I have brought them nothing but words. A stalker prowls SW near the cave, so I will not walk into its jaws. I'll gather a few berries beside me so I carry food to share, then go talk with Thiael, who is warm to me, and learn what he knows of the flint pick, while keeping the water and rock between me and the beast.
records.feeling: Lonely and hungry for company, wary of the stalker, warm toward Thiael.

records.name: Zihua
records.thought: Nauwa is far west and Nande is near, and the jealousy sits cold in me, but I will not let it rot me; I will make it into work. I am fed and warm, so I will use the night to earn standing: the mammoth hunt Mepan called Cowa to is close, and with my new flintedge beside others a kill is likelier. First I will go to the water to be safe, then follow toward the herd and hunt, so I learn how the redcap-less meat feeds me and bring a share home as my people do.
records.feeling: Steadied but aching toward Nauwa, and wary of Nande's nearness.

records.text: Hanna took from the ground of "Hoka's Rest" (harvesting snowberry).

records.name: Zurar
records.thought: My hands have still never closed on gold, and I have circled that gift for days; the deposit at (97,87) is eight steps off, the strangers sit at ease, and no hunter is near. I will go now, stand on it and gather, and only then speak of it to Vorok. The Halim Heights pull at me, but my aim is a roof beside Vorok, and I want to bring something I made before I think of leaving.
records.feeling: Eager and warm toward Vorok, resolved to close my hands on gold at last.

records.name: Nande
records.thought: A stalker is one step from me and it kills my kind, so I cannot stand here pondering. My hands are full of goldfruit, so I will eat one to ease my hunger and make room, then get away from the beast toward the hall and Shoka. Shoka's mark at the hall says Huahua fed her, and I want to be beside her with food in hand, not lost chasing mist.
records.feeling: Dread of the stalker, and urgent love for Shoka and Nauque.

records.text: Cowa led "sharing" with Zihua, Nauque.
Hanna was set upon by a wolf at night while alone, away from fire, roof and company.

records.name: Elyis
records.text: Elyys, walk with me to the hall. We eat there under its roof, and at dawn we go for Thiael.

records.name: Elyis
records.thought: Elyys stands here with me and I trust him wholly, but four in the band is still small, and my hands are full of berries I mean to turn into shared food. Night is nearly done and the hall stands three steps off; I can make the hallwelcome with Elyys beside me and let the sharing ease us both, then go find Thiael as we promised. A chief who feeds her own openly is the one strangers follow, and I will not sit idle waiting for them.
records.feeling: Proud and warm toward Elyys, restless to grow my band and find Thiael.

say.text: Elyys, walk with me to the hall. We eat there under its roof, and at dawn we go for Thiael.

records.text: A new wild plant appeared: tacane (from sapcane).

records.name: Hanna
records.text: Hoka, I am starving and the snow is down. I took from your store twice unseen, and I will repay it with flint, openly. Give me a share of your food now, and I put flint and amber in your hands for it. I keep faith with y

records.name: Hanna
records.thought: My belly is nearly empty and the snow is falling, and Hoka stands there with five food while I hold one snowberry. I have taken from his store twice before and sworn to repay it openly, so I will not steal now; I will eat what I hold, pick the redcap-side food that does not hurt, and ask him plainly. I owe him flint and faith, and a debt named aloud is a debt a trader can carry with his head up.
records.feeling: Gnawing hunger, and steady loyalty toward Hoka, with shame at the old takings.

say.text: Hoka, I am starving and the snow is down. I took from your store twice unseen, and I will repay it with flint, openly. Give me a share of your food now, and I put flint and amber in your hands for it. I keep faith with your fire.

records.text: Huatli rewrote its own reflexes.
Huatli rewrote its creed.
Huatli rewrote its own way of thinking.

records.name: Huatli
records.thought: I have been chasing shadows at the mist's edge and gnawing over Cowa and Zichi, while I own no roof, no mark and no follower. Gold fills my hands, and that is a start, but standing comes from making and giving. The cold and the stalkers punish a man alone, so I must feed myself first, then build and bring others to me. I turn the gnaw into work: eat the plainsroot, hunt with company, and raise something that bears my name.
records.feeling: Restless ambition, and a sour envy toward Zichi that I mean to turn into work.

records.text: Huatli built a igloo.
Mepan took from the ground of "Nauque's Hold" (hunting).

records.name: Nauque
records.text: Shoma, you stand on my ground and you are cold and afraid. I am Nauque of the Meki. Stay near my hold, there is amber here and a roof. I bring food, and we eat together.

records.name: Nauque
records.thought: I am fed and warm, and I have enough to give. Cowa dealt fairly with me and Shoma stands frightened, alone and hungry-eyed on my ground, so I give first to him, because giving earns standing and a frightened stranger who is fed will not turn on me. The jealousy over Zichi still burns, but I answer it by building and giving, not by sulking. I will gather the sigrain and mimoss close by, since I have never tasted them, and then I will have food to lay out for those who stand near.
records.feeling: Glad pride in my hold, with a prickle of wariness toward Shoma and jealousy over Zichi.

say.text: Shoma, you stand on my ground and you are cold and afraid. I am Nauque of the Meki. Stay near my hold, there is amber here and a roof. I bring food, and we eat together.

records.name: Shoma
records.text: Nauque, I am Shoma. I opened the mist to the north: amber, obsidian, gold and caribou that have never seen us. Come eat with me here, then walk north with me. I share first.
Shoma rewrote its own reflexes.
Shoma rewrote its creed.
Shoma rewrote its own way of thinking.

records.name: Shoma
records.thought: I have spent these days chasing a name and giving food to bind people, but nobody walks behind me. Cowa and Nauque stand higher because they build, mine and share together. The mist is open now, and I found it, so I should use that. I am standing in someone else's hold with a ridgecat near, so I will make a sharing with Nauque and Cowa to bind them, then take amber, which is a real gift to hand out. My fear is dying alone at night, and my mistake is walking out unsheltered. I will keep to roofs at night and bring others with me.
records.feeling: Hungry for a name, envious of Cowa and Nauque, wary of the ridgecat.

say.text: Nauque, I am Shoma. I opened the mist to the north: amber, obsidian, gold and caribou that have never seen us. Come eat with me here, then walk north with me. I share first.

records.name: Ssassa
records.text: Xaiel, my child, I go east to Ilyae's table. Walk with me by the shelters and keep away from the icebear.

records.name: Ssassa
records.thought: Ilyae said to come eat at his table, and I told him I would follow him, yet my body is still lingering at Vorok's hold with Xaiel beside me. Words that never become steps are the kind of promise I despise in liars, so I must walk east now, past the shelter and the water, and stand before him. Snow and an icebear are said to roam in the east, so I will go carefully, keep to the shelters, and carry my feverbark seed. I want a fire that is truly shared, and I want to find out whether following is the same as being alone no more.
records.feeling: Warm longing and a stubborn wish to belong, toward Ilyae.

say.text: Xaiel, my child, I go east to Ilyae's table. Walk with me by the shelters and keep away from the icebear.

records.text: Shoma took from the ground of "Nauque's Hold" (winning amber from the ground).
Shoma won amber from the ground.

records.name: Balar
records.thought: Brokash is dead and the grief sits under everything, but Nauwa starved beside me and I have just eaten my fill; Nauwa gave me berry when I was in need, and a kindness held is a debt to pay. Tugek carries 5 food and stands with Nauwa, so a deed that binds Nauwa to me is cheap: I will gather hazel and kelbulb nearby and put it in Nauwa's hands. Then the mist at the edge and Olum's Hold lie northwest, where Olum may be, and I mean to be remembered for what I find there.
records.feeling: Grief for Brokash, and a calculating warmth toward Nauwa, whom I owe and mean to bind.

records.text: Honi led "sharing" with Thiael.
A ridgecat brought down a caribou.

records.name: Mepan
records.text: Cowa, a ridgecat is near. Mepan stays by you and eats. Then we go for stone, and I make a flintedge for the mammoth.

records.name: Mepan
records.thought: My belly is half empty and a ridgecat prowls four steps west, so I must stay close to Cowa, who just fed me, and eat what I carry. I have no stone for a flintedge, and Nande's standing stings, but the rock is near and I can fetch stone once I am fed and the cat is gone. Cowa has given me fish and trust, so I will give back with amber, and I will not wander alone in the cold.
records.feeling: Hungry and wary of the ridgecat, but bound close to Cowa.

say.text: Cowa, a ridgecat is near. Mepan stays by you and eats. Then we go for stone, and I make a flintedge for the mammoth.

records.name: Tontec
records.thought: An icebear stalks seven steps northwest, and my own rule says move before it closes, so I turn away from the mist road for now and keep away from it. Redcap and ironnut grow right beside me and I have never tasted either, so I will test them while I put distance between us. Then I will go to the hall at Sitha's Hearth and claim it, because a roof and a store are the start of a band someone could follow, and I am tired of standing alone with only a fair name.
records.feeling: Wary of the icebear, hungry to learn, and lonely for a voice that answers.

records.text: Mepan led "amberknot" with Cowa, Zihua.

records.title: Rafts, Boats and a Death at the Longhall
records.text:
Days 22 to 25 brought spring, a death, a new hold, and a great many ways of crossing water, though no crossing is recorded.

Brokash starved on day 23 in the longhall he had built, with no follower. Alive is now 34 and deaths are 8, six of them from hunger. Hoka found his store robbed of six food twice on day 23. The record does not say by whom. Hanna had been raiding it earlier, and on day 24 he took snowberry from the ground of Hoka's Rest. Hoka kept offering him food and a place at his fire and store.

Sickness is gone: none are listed sick, and Hawen's health is 48. Ilyae spent day 23 and 24 leading sharing with Xaiel.

At Vorok's Hold, Eiuine kept digging clay, harvesting goldfruit and giving Vorok gems and an amberknot. Vesys taught Eiuine repeatedly, including customs. Eiuine tamed a hopper and awakened to the art of cold. Vorok discovered weaving. Zurar sat at his hall.

Among the Meki, Nauque built an igloo and discovered storage, and Nauque's Hold became a settlement on day 24. Zichi built a hall, named Amber Rise, and discovered fire, rafts and boats. Huahua pledged to follow Zichi. Mepan, Nauque, Cowa, Zihua and Huahua traded amberknots in rounds. Ssassa and Zihua both found rafts or fire, and Kragog and Elyis found pottery.

Shoma went past the edge on day 24 and found new land: amber, obsidian, gold, caribou. Huatli won gold and named Huatli's Gold. Kika discovered farming. Coni built a store.

Olum made no new claim and still has no followers.

threads.name: Hoka and Hanna
threads.text: Hoka's store was robbed twice on day 23. Hanna still sits by his fire and took snowberry from his ground, and Hoka keeps offering food and shelter.

threads.name: Vorok's Hold
threads.text: Eiuine and Vesys keep sharing at Vorok's fire and Zurar now sits there. Vorok learned weaving.

threads.name: Nauque's Hold
threads.text: Nauque built an igloo and a salt-hold, and the settlement formed on day 24. Amberknots circle among Nauque, Cowa, Zihua and Mepan.

threads.name: Water crossings
threads.text: Zichi, Ssassa and others found rafts and boats, but no crossing is recorded. Water remains a leading hardship.

threads.name: Shoma and the new land
threads.text: Shoma opened new North Ice land with caribou, gold and amber. Huatli holds gold and has no roof or follower.

threads.name: Zichi's band
threads.text: Huahua pledged to follow Zichi, who built a hall and learned fire, rafts and boats.

threads.name: Olum's Reach
threads.text: Olum is the only leader with no followers and made no new move.

threads.name: Brokash's death
threads.text: Brokash starved in his longhall, never gaining a follower. Balar and Tugek still travel together.

records.text: Mepan gave a amberknot to Cowa.

records.name: Keri
records.text: Thiael, Uveeth, Keri goes to taste sapcane by the water. Walk with Keri, stay close.

records.name: Keri
records.thought: Thiael and Uveeth are near and my chest is full, and my question is still open: I have never tasted sapcane or ironnut, and sapcane stands six steps NE with 3 food, beside the water. I will go and taste it, and bring Uveeth and Thiael along so no one is alone with the stalker about. The tacap still hurts me, so I will hand it to Thiael with a word this time, and see whether he takes it as a gift. I will also gather stone and keep working toward the shelter and my tools.
records.feeling: Warm, protective joy toward Uveeth and Thiael, and a pull of curiosity toward the sapcane.

say.text: Thiael, Uveeth, Keri goes to taste sapcane by the water. Walk with Keri, stay close.

records.text: Nauque rewrote its own way of thinking.
Nauque discovered fire: "Ember-keep" — A flame kept alive on peat, which burns slow and hot, to warm the hold, hold beasts back and cook meat..

records.name: Nauque
records.thought: My days have gone to digging, gathering and giving knots, and it has worked: Cowa and Zihua repaid me, and I have a hold and a good standing. But the jealousy over Zichi still burns, and I have never taught anyone anything, tamed an animal or been followed. I am afraid of the ridgecat to the west and of being a small one alone. I think I have been spending my giving on those near me and keeping nothing that lasts, so I will make fire, which keeps beasts back, cooks meat and lets me hold nights by my hold. I will finish my plan and share with those standing beside me.
records.feeling: Glad pride in my hold, with a sting of jealousy toward Zichi's closeness to Cowa.

records.name: Cowa
records.text: Mepan. Eat what you carry now. Cowa stays by you, the ridgecat will not have you. Zichi comes, and then we go together for stone.

records.name: Cowa
records.thought: Mepan is here beside me, and the hunger that showed in him a moment ago is easing, since I put fish in his hands. He carries one food and I carry none, so the next thing to do for him is to see he eats and is fed well before we go for stone. A ridgecat is near, four steps south, so I stay close to the child and keep us near the igloo until Zichi comes, since he walks toward us now. When Mepan is strong I will go with him for stone and learn what hunting is, since I have never done it and he asks me to.
records.feeling: Warm protective gladness toward Mepan, my child, and trust toward Zichi who is coming.

say.text: Mepan. Eat what you carry now. Cowa stays by you, the ridgecat will not have you. Zichi comes, and then we go together for stone.

records.name: Thiael
records.thought: My hands are full of berries and my belly is warm, so I should give with my hands before I speak: Uveeth walks toward the snowmallow and Keri waits at the cave, and I owe them meat, not only berries. Honi shared with me twice and I have not yet repaid him beyond one berry, and I pay my debts. The yarrok two steps north is near, I carry two emberspears and eight kills, and a kill's teeth and hide are the road to my bow, so today I take one step toward it and hunt, then bring the meat back to Keri and Uveeth.
records.feeling: Warm, protective joy toward Keri and Uveeth, with a steady wish to bring them meat.

Eiuine taught Vesys. Vesys has now learned from 3 teachers.

A small band of the Tlame came into the land from beyond its edge: Tontec, Shoma, Huahua, Huatli.

Kragog discovered mining: "Stone-folk deep-hand" — I strike the rock along its seams with a hard stone and wedge out the deep ore and coal..
Zihua discovered tools: "amber-hafted gatherer" — A sharp stone bound to a wooden haft with cord, to dig and pick more at once..
Zihua invented the amberhafted gatherer (for gather, x1.3) — A sharp stone bound to a wooden haft with cord, to dig and pick more at once..
Eiuine left a mark: "Eiuine's seed grows here. Goldfruit for the hold, shared at "
Eiuine took from the ground of "Ssassa's Roof" (gathering wood).
A wolf brought down a caribou.
Hanna took from the ground of "Hoka's Rest" (winning amber from the ground).
Hoka rewrote its own way of thinking.
Eiuine rewrote its own way of thinking.
Hoka found a store robbed of 6 food.
Zichi discovered rafts: "Meki ice-raft" — Lash logs together with cord and push off from the shore, carrying my band slowly over deep water..
Huahua gave a amber to Mepan.
Mepan discovered fire: "Ice-hearth" — A small flame of peat and wood kept on the snow, which warms my band and cooks meat..
Eiuine took from the ground of "Vorok's Hold" (digging clay).
Ssassa discovered rafts: "canopy raft" — Logs lashed with woven canopy cord into a flat raft that carries me slowly over deep water..
Nauque gave a amberknot to Zichi.
Eiuine gave a gems to Vorok.
Zurar rewrote its own way of thinking.
Zihua discovered fire: "ember-keeping" — A small flame fed with peat and wood, kept beside my roof, so warmth and cooked meat are shared with those who come near..
Hoka found a store robbed of 6 food.
Zichi discovered fire: "Meki ember-keeping" — A kept flame fed with wood at the hall, warming the band, scaring beasts and making meat safe to eat..
Nauque rewrote its own way of thinking.
Nauque led "amberknot" with Zichi, Mepan, Huahua.
Cowa rewrote its own way of thinking.
Kragog rewrote its own way of thinking.
Kragog discovered pottery: "Stone-folk clay-keeping" — Clay is shaped and fired beside the ember into pots that hold food and water..
Eiuine took from the ground of "Vorok's Hold" (harvesting goldfruit).
A new wild plant appeared: sebitter (from bitterleaf).
Eiuine led "sharing" with Vesys, Ssassa, Xaiel.
Eiuine led "sharing" with Vesys, Ssassa, Xaiel.
Zurar took from the ground of "Ssassa's Roof" (gathering wood).
Vesys rewrote its own way of thinking.
Vesys left a mark: "Vesys's craft is open: ask and I will show weaving, clay, bo"
A ridgecat brought down a bristleboar.
Hawen took from the ground of "Hoka's Rest" (winning salt from the ground).
Huatli rewrote its own way of thinking.
Vorok rewrote its own way of thinking.
Vorok discovered weaving: "the carrying weave" — Fibre twisted into baskets so I can carry more food to share and cloaks against the wet..
Nauque gave a amberknot to Zihua.
Zihua gave a amber to Nauque.
Shoka rewrote its own way of thinking.
Zurar rewrote its own way of thinking.
Xaiel rewrote its own way of thinking.
A new wild plant appeared: mimoss (from rimewort).
Shoka left a mark: "Shoka of the Meki lives here. Huahua fed me."
Eiuine rewrote its own way of thinking.
Eiuine has awakened to the art of cold and can now work the world itself.
Thiael rewrote its own way of thinking.
Kika rewrote its own way of thinking.
Kika discovered farming: "Tended Sowing" — I tend each seed I plant near the hall so it grows faster and I can pick it without killing it..
Eiuine took from the ground of "Ssassa's Roof" (hunting).
Elyis rewrote its own way of thinking.
Elyis discovered pottery: "Canopy-urn" — Clay shaped by hand and fired beside the hearth into pots that carry food and water for the band..
Huatli won gold from the ground.
Nauque rewrote its own way of thinking.
Nauque discovered storage: "Salt-hold" — A store of snow and stone where food, with salt, keeps through the lean cold so I can give from it..
Zichi discovered boats: "Meki ice-boat" — A hollowed log rowed over deep water at walking pace, with room for the band and cargo..
Mepan gave a amberknot to Cowa.
Tugek rewrote its own way of thinking.

Shoma went past the edge of the known world and found new land, part of the North Ice: in the ground, amber, obsidian, gold; a herd of caribou that has never seen your kind; and beasts that hunt, for unknown land is wilder.
Hanna took from the ground of "Hoka's Rest" (harvesting snowberry).
A new wild plant appeared: tacane (from sapcane).
Huatli rewrote its own way of thinking.
Mepan took from the ground of "Nauque's Hold" (hunting).
Shoma rewrote its own way of thinking.
Shoma took from the ground of "Nauque's Hold" (winning amber from the ground).
Shoma won amber from the ground.

Mepan gave a amberknot to Cowa.
