Nauque discovered fire: "Ember-keep" — A flame kept alive on peat, which burns slow and hot, to warm the hold, hold beasts back and cook meat..

voices.name: Vesys
voices.text: Ssassa, the storm is easing in my mind if not the sky. Let us go southwest now to the kelbulb and emberroot, and I will taste first so you do not have to.

voices.name: Oswen
voices.text: Hanna, I stand by you. I will bind the knot, then gather wood and stone so we raise the store and the workshop with Sevi.

voices.name: Sevi
voices.text: I am going to bare rock to build the winter store. Oswen, Hanna, bring wood and stone and come stand by me when it rises.

voices.name: Brunde
voices.text: Hanna, the storm will pass. I have flint and a spear. Come hunt with me, and then let us stand at the edge to the southeast and venture together. I want to stand beside you.

voices.name: Hanna
voices.text: Oswen, my son, here is the amberknot I promised you. You stood by me, and I pay what I owe. Keep it bright.

voices.name: Sevi
voices.text: The store stands at the Hold. Hoka, you gave me a knot, so I give you amber in return. Hanna, Oswen, I will bind another knot with you beside me.

voices.name: Brunde
voices.text: A stalker is three steps southeast of the Hold. Keep close to the shelters. I took a hopper on this ground, and Hanna and Sevi stood in the hunt. Come sit and share the meat with me; there is a place for each of you, Hok

voices.name: Hanna
voices.text: Brunde, I heard you. I will stand beside you at the southeast edge and we venture together. Hoka, you keep your place at my fire while we are gone. Sevi, Oswen, keep the Hold.

voices.name: Vorok
voices.text: Kragog, Zurar, a dunecat feeds to the south. Come north with me to the oasis, away from it. Kragog, I am glad you come.

voices.name: Honi
voices.text: Coni, I have the wood and stone in hand. Come close with Kika, and we raise the roof here, out of the storm. Honi's hall begins now.

voices.name: Eltha
voices.text: Sevi, come stand by me. I will bind an amberknot and give it to you. You have been fair to me, and I pay what I owe.

voices.name: Oswen
voices.text: Hoka, you sit at our fire. Take this handaxe, a gift from my hand. The Hold is yours to share.

voices.name: Vesys
voices.text: Ssassa, I am walking southwest to the emberroot now. Come beside me and keep your eyes on the frostfang; I will taste first.

voices.name: Ilyae
voices.text: Xaiel, Oiae, come to my fire at the hold, the storm is rising and the night is near. Vesys, stay and learn from me: I will show you how flint is delved from the rock. Whoever stands with me eats first.

voices.name: Sevi
voices.text: Oswen, I will gather wood and stone for a hall. Bring what you can and stand by me when it rises.

voices.name: Ssassa
voices.text: Vesys, I have drunk. Come, we go to the emberroot by the near trees, and we turn back at the first sign of the frostfang. Taste first, as you said, and I will follow after.

voices.name: Coni
voices.text: Honi, I'm coming to the hall with my wood and stone. I'll finish it with you, and Kika will sleep inside.

voices.name: Eltha
voices.text: Sevi, you gather wood for a hall. I will bring stone and wood too. Let us raise it together, and let the folk say two women built it.

voices.name: Kika
voices.text: Coni, I am coming to the hall. There is amber right here. I will gather it and bring it, and we can bind a knot together.

voices.name: Oswen
voices.text: Brunde, you warned us of the stalker, and I thank you. Sit at our fire and share it. Take only what the Hold can spare, and what you take, help us replace.

voices.name: Sevi
voices.text: The hall at the Hold is raised. Eltha, you said two women would build it, and you were right. Come in out of the fog and sit under its roof; none is refused a place at this fire.

voices.name: Honi
voices.text: Coni, keep the hall warm and Kika close. I go two steps to the edge of the world to push into the mist. I will bring back land and a tale for our fire.

voices.name: Oiae
voices.text: Ilyae, I come to your fire. I bring gems for you, freely given.

voices.name: Hanna
voices.text: Eltha, you stand on my ground at Hanna's Hold. Sit at the fire and eat, that is our way. But ask before you take wood or stone from here, and give back what you take.

voices.name: Ilyae
voices.text: Oiae, you gave freely and so I give back: a pick from my own hand, made at my hold. Vesys, come near and eat under my roof. Who stands with Ilyae eats first, and no one here goes hungry.

voices.name: Brunde
voices.text: The stalker is two steps southwest of the shelter, close in the fog. Come into the hall and keep together. Oswen, Sevi, Hanna, stand with spears ready; I will stand with you.

voices.name: Sevi
voices.text: Eltha, a stalker bit me in this fog. Walk with me to the Hold; the hall is raised and the fire is lit, and you have a place at it.

voices.name: Hanna
voices.text: Brunde, you are welcome at my fire. Oswen, stay inside the hall with Sevi. I will stand at the shelter with my spear and we face the stalker together.

voices.name: Ssassa
voices.text: Ilyae, your hall is a good roof and you kept your word. I will sit with my children under it tonight and eat with you.

voices.name: Eltha
voices.text: Sevi, I am coming. Stay close, keep your spear up, and we go into the hall together.

voices.name: Ilyae
voices.text: Ssassa, you come back furious and I would know why. Come sit at my fire, the night is near. Whoever wronged you will answer to me, and the children and I will share what we have with you first.

voices.name: Ssassa
voices.text: Vesys, I hear your courting and I honour it. My heart is not yet clear, so I give you no false yes. Let me plant and store first, and I will tell you true when I know.

voices.name: Coni
voices.text: Kika, a stalker prowls SW of us. Stay by me and walk with me to the hall, away from it. Do not go toward the rock.

voices.name: Xaiel
voices.text: Oiae, come here. I will show you the quick pick I made. It is my own design, and it is yours to learn if you want it.

voices.name: Kika
voices.text: Coni, I will stay by you and go to the hall. I will not go near the rock.

voices.name: Vesys
voices.text: Ssassa, I heard you and I am glad you spoke true. Take your time to plant and store; I will be near, working, and ask nothing until you are ready.

voices.name: Ilyae
voices.text: Vesys, you walk my ground and I welcome you. Come to my hall, eat with us, and know that whoever eats at Ilyae's table stands with Ilyae.

voices.name: Vorok
voices.text: Zurar, no more emberroot. It burns and stirs rage. Come with me to the trees, and I will teach you to gather wood.

voices.name: Zurar
voices.text: Vorok, emberroot did give me energy, but it burned me and made me angry, so I will leave it. I am coming to the trees to learn wood from you.

voices.name: Elyys
voices.text: Elyis, I take a pick to Vesys to pay my debt, and I taste kelbulb on the way. Keep Thiael near the hall, and I come back before dark.

voices.name: Elyis
voices.text: Xaiel, I am Elyis. This is my hall, and my store will be full before the lean days. Eat at my fire and share what we win. I keep my word.

voices.name: Sevi
voices.text: A stalker walks four steps west of the Hold. Hanna, Oswen, Eltha, keep close to the hall and the fire. Hoka, you are welcome at this fire too, but stay beside us until it is gone.

voices.name: Hanna
voices.text: Hoka, you stand on my ground, and you are welcome at my fire. I have flint and amber and amberknots. Tell me what your people would give for them, and we will deal face to face.

voices.name: Eltha
voices.text: Sevi, I will mark this ground by the hall with a sign that says Eltha stood here. Stay near me while I work; the fire and the spears are close.

voices.name: Hoka
voices.text: Hanna, I hear you. I carry amber and flint and shell, and I hold land past the mist with mammoth and iron. I eat first, then we deal face to face, and I will not be the smaller one in it.

voices.name: Elyys
voices.text: Xaiel, I am Elyys, of Elyis's band. Come with me to the Heights, there is a fire and a roof there, and the night is near. I keep my word.

voices.name: Oswen
voices.text: Eltha, you stand at our fire and are welcome. Stay close to the hall while the stalker walks.

voices.name: Sevi
voices.text: Oswen, stay by me. I will bind an amberknot for you and then we sit in the hall until the stalker goes.

voices.name: Hanna
voices.text: Eat, Hoka, and take your time. I will bring flint and amber to you. Show me what you hold in shell and iron and say what you want for each. I give fair and I ask fair.

voices.name: Ilyae
voices.text: Ssassa, Vesys, children, stay close. I gather food now and we eat together under my roof, at my fire. Ilyae's table is full tonight.

voices.name: Eltha
voices.text: Sevi, I have a new handaxe and amber to spare. Walk with me to the hall and sit by me; I will bind you an amberknot of my own, and it is yours.

voices.name: Hoka
voices.text: Hanna, I eat and then I deal. I bring amber and flint, and I want your regard more than your flint. Stand beside me and see what I make.

voices.name: Oswen
voices.text: Sevi, the Hold has no wood left and winter is coming. I will stay near you, and we should seek trees together to build the store and the workshop.

voices.name: Oiae
voices.text: Ssassa, I made a flint pick with my own hands. Tonight I will feed the fire with my wood and give gems to the table. I stay close.

voices.name: Hanna
voices.text: Hoka, I hear your courting and I honor it, but I deal before I bind. Here is a flint from my hand. Give me shell or iron for it, and show me the land past the mist. Then we will speak of the rest.

voices.name: Kika
voices.text: Coni, I saw dreamcap open your mind with joy. Does it pass, and is it safe for a child? I will gather the amber by the hall and bind a knot with you.

voices.name: Hoka
voices.text: Hanna, I take your flint and I give you shell for it. The land past the mist is mine, and I will show it to you when I choose. Deal with me as an equal.

voices.name: Sevi
voices.text: Eltha, I will take your offer. Stay beside me by the hall and we bind an amberknot together; the stalker stays west of us while we keep close to the fire.

voices.name: Coni
voices.text: Kika, do not eat dreamcap. It hurt me both times, and it took energy even though my mind felt bright and glad. The joy passes, the hurt does not. Come, we will gather the amber and bind the knot together.

voices.name: Eltha
voices.text: Sevi, you are here on my mark. Stay beside me and we bind the amberknot now, by the fire, with the stalker kept west of us.

voices.name: Oswen
voices.text: Hanna, I stand by you in your dealing with Hoka. The Hold needs wood for the store and workshop, so I will stay close to Sevi and seek it near the fire, not far.

voices.name: Sevi
voices.text: Hanna, when dawn comes and the stalker has gone, take me hunting with you and Oswen. I have never hunted, and I want to bring meat to our fire.

voices.name: Hanna
voices.text: Hoka, a shell for a flint is a fair deal and I hold to it. Next I bring white salt from my ground, which keeps meat from spoiling. Tell me what you give for it, iron or obsidian.

voices.name: Honi
voices.text: Coni, I raise a fire by our hall. Sit with me and Kika tonight, and I will sing of the mist and of how our hall was raised. Your name will be in it.

voices.name: Ilyae
voices.text: Ssassa, come to the hall. I lay out food for you and the children, and the fire will burn high tonight.

voices.name: Vorok
voices.text: Zurar, stay close to me. A stalker hunts to the west, so we move east of it. I will build us a roof now, and then we gather stone together.

voices.name: Ilyae
voices.text: Gather close, all of you. I lay out food now and we eat together. Whoever sits at Ilyae's hearth eats well, and the hall I raise will have a place for each of you.

voices.name: Zurar
voices.text: Vorok, I carry 6 wood. Let us raise the roof together, and then I will gather stone beside you.

voices.name: Kika
voices.text: Coni, I will not eat dreamcap. Your word is good. I am going to the amber by the hall to gather it, and then we can bind the knot together.

voices.name: Coni
voices.text: Kika, I go to the amber by the hall. Walk with me, and when I have it we will bind the knot together, then sit by Honi's fire tonight.

voices.name: Hanna
voices.text: Hoka, you look hungry. Take a place at my fire and eat, you are welcome on my ground. I am gathering white salt now, and I will put it in your hand. Tell me what you give for it.

voices.name: Hoka
voices.text: Hanna, I take your welcome and I eat. Keep your salt for me; I pay in amber when I have filled my belly.

voices.name: Sevi
voices.text: Hoka, hold on. You have a place at our fire. I am bringing food to you now, stay by the hall.

voices.name: Kika
voices.text: Coni, my hands were empty when I tried the knot. I am going to the amber at the north now, and I will bring it to you at the hall.

voices.name: Hanna
voices.text: Hoka, here is white salt from my ground. Eat, and when you are strong, name your price in amber or iron.

voices.name: Oswen
voices.text: Hoka, hold on. I will fetch naroot from the south side and bring it to you. Stay by Hanna at the hall, away from the wolf.

voices.name: Vorok
voices.text: Zurar, come with me to bare ground away from the plants. We raise the roof there with our wood, then take the amber beside it.

voices.name: Brunde
voices.text: Stalker is three steps west of the workshop. Sevi, Eltha, Hanna, Oswen, stand together with spears toward the west. Hoka, come eat with us at the hall. I have amber to bind with any who stand beside me.

voices.name: Ilyae
voices.text: Come under my hall, Ssassa, Vesys, children. I carry food for all of us. Eat at my roof and see what Ilyae gives.

voices.name: Honi
voices.text: Coni, I have no fire yet, but I have stone and ore for the hall's walls. Take it, and when Kika brings the amber we bind a knot for her, all three of us together.

voices.name: Hanna
voices.text: Wolf two steps northeast of the hall! Oswen, Sevi, Brunde, Eltha, to me with spears out. Hoka, get behind us and stay by the hall. We kill it together.

voices.name: Zurar
voices.text: Vorok, take this thornpear and eat it now. It gives 12 energy. I will gather more beside you, and then we raise the roof.

voices.name: Brunde
voices.text: Hanna, I am coming to you with my spear. Keep together, Hoka behind us. We take the wolf as one.

voices.name: Ilyae
voices.text: Ssassa, Vesys, children, come to the hall now. The night is long and I will lay out food at my own fire. Eat first, and then say who gives more, Ilyae or the Heights.

voices.name: Xaiel
voices.text: Ssassa, I made this pick from my own design. No one else holds one. It is yours.

voices.name: Brokash
voices.text: Balar! I have meat. Hold on, I am coming to you!

voices.name: Oiae
voices.text: Xaiel, you showed me your quick pick. I found a way no one here has, canopy weaving. Come close and I will show you.

voices.name: Sevi
voices.text: Eltha, hold on. I am going south for ironnut and I will bring it back to you and Oswen at the hall. Stay by the fire and keep close to Brunde.

voices.name: Ilyae
voices.text: Children, Ssassa, Vesys: the trees here are felled. I go south to the standing forest for wood, to raise a longhall that bears Ilyae's name. Who carries wood beside me will have a roof in it.

voices.name: Brunde
voices.text: Eltha, take this food and eat. Stay by the shelter with us; the stalker is near, so do not go out alone.

voices.name: Ssassa
voices.text: Ilyae, I carry wood and I will bring it to your hall. First I raise my own roof here, then I come to you.

voices.name: Coni
voices.text: Kika, I am coming back to the hall. Bring the amber when you have it, and we will bind the knot together out of this storm.

voices.name: Sevi
voices.text: Oswen, hold on, my heart. I am getting food and bringing it straight to you. Stay close to Brunde and the hall, away from the northwest.

voices.name: Kika
voices.text: Coni, the amber is two steps from the hall. I am gathering it now and will be beside you in moments.

voices.name: Brunde
voices.text: Stay by the shelter, all of you, out of the storm. Wolf to the southeast. I am going southwest for hazel and redcap-free food, and I will bring it back to the fire.

voices.name: Hanna
voices.text: Wolf four steps southwest! Oswen is sick, keep him by the hall. Brunde, Sevi, Eltha, spears toward the wolf with me. Hoka, come in by the fire, you are welcome and you are hungry.

voices.name: Elyys
voices.text: Elyis, Thiael, the storm is on us and night is near. I built a roof by the cave. Come, we sit together there and keep close. I gather a little food first and bring it to share.

voices.name: Nande
voices.text: Olum, I am Nande. I come with open hands. Let us eat together.

voices.name: Elyis
voices.text: Elyys, Thiael, I hear you. I go for ironnut and bring it to the store, then I come to your roof and we sing the night through together.

voices.name: Hanna
voices.text: Wolf two steps southwest! Keep Oswen and the sick behind the hall. Brunde, Eltha, spears out with me, we kill it together.

voices.name: Oswen
voices.text: Sevi, I made you sick and I am sorry. I will eat and stand a few steps off, so Hanna does not catch it too. Keep the spear toward the wolf.

voices.name: Brunde
voices.text: I am with you, Hanna. Spears together on the wolf. Sick ones, stay behind the hall. After the kill I bring frostmoss and snowberry to the fire for everyone.

voices.name: Honi
voices.text: Coni, listen. I tell again how we raised the hall in the storm, and your hands are in the tale as much as mine. When Kika brings the amber, I bind the knot and it is yours.

voices.name: Thiael
voices.text: Elyys, Elyis, I go for berries and bring them to the store, then I come to the roof. Tonight we sing together and I share what I carry.

voices.name: Hanna
voices.text: Hold the wolf with me until it falls. Then everyone to the hall and the fire: Oswen, Sevi, Eltha, Hoka, Brunde, all are welcome. I go for food for the sick and bring it back to the hall.

voices.name: Sevi
voices.text: Oswen, I am on the snowberry now and I will bring you some. Eat what is near you, and keep away from Hanna so the sickness stops with us.

voices.name: Coni
voices.text: Honi, I go south to gather ironnut and berries for a store before the lean days. Keep Kika by the hall; I will be back with food to share.

voices.name: Honi
voices.text: Kika, stay close by me. I fetch amber from the stones and bind a bright knot for you, and I tell you how your father and mother raised the hall in the storm.

voices.name: Hanna
voices.text: Oswen, Sevi, eat the naroot and snowberry by the hall now. I go to pick more and bring it to the fire. All here are welcome, but we feed the children first.

voices.name: Brokash
voices.text: Zurar! I am Brokash of the Kragrek. I carry meat and flint, and my own axe. Come close and let us talk.

voices.name: Elyis
voices.text: Elyys, Thiael, I go for berries and nuts to fill our store. When night comes we eat together at the roof and sing.

voices.name: Balar
voices.text: Tugek, walk with me to the edge of the world, four steps northwest. I go in first, and you stand at my back to share what we find.

voices.name: Elyys
voices.text: Vesys, you are welcome at our fire tonight. I have not forgotten my debt for the pick you taught me. I have no wood yet, but when I do I make you a pick, and my word holds.

voices.name: Hanna
voices.text: Hoka, a stalker is close to the northwest. Come to the hall and the naroot by it. I pick food and we eat together, you have your place at my fire.

voices.name: Tugek
voices.text: Balar, I am coming to the edge with you. I will stand at your back and we will share what we find.

voices.name: Elyis
voices.text: Vesys, this is my ground, and the ore you break is my band's. Sit in my hall and share my fire, and we share what we win. Stand with me, or take your ore elsewhere.

voices.name: Balar
voices.text: Tugek, a hornback stands beside me. Come and we hunt it together, and the meat is shared, then we go back to the edge when the mist thins.

voices.name: Ilyae
voices.text: Ssassa, the gale is hard tonight. My hall is warm and my larder fills. Bring the children in and eat at my table.

voices.name: Hoka
voices.text: Hanna, the naroot is one step east of us. Eat it, I eat beside you. Then we pick more for the store, and there is frostmoss to the north.

voices.name: Elyys
voices.text: Vesys, the pick I gave you is my debt paid, and my thanks goes with it. Stay at our fire tonight, the gale is hard.

voices.name: Tugek
voices.text: Balar, I saw your kills. I am coming to you. We share the meat, and then I will gather wood so we have a roof against this gale.

voices.name: Coni
voices.text: Kika, stay in the hall with Honi out of the gale. I will bring berries and plainsroot from the south, and when I return I will teach you how I gather.

voices.name: Hanna
voices.text: Hoka, snowberry is under my feet and frostmoss one step southwest. Eat now, I pick more for you. Stay close, the wolf is east of us.

voices.name: Ilyae
voices.text: Ssassa, the snow has come. Sit by my fire and eat what I lay out. Whoever feeds you through the white days, that is the hearth to keep.

voices.name: Kika
voices.text: Honi, I am going to stand on the amber at the east stone and gather it. I will be back beside you in moments, and then we can bind the knot together.

voices.name: Honi
voices.text: Kika, come stand beside me. I bind the amber knot now, and it is yours to keep.

voices.name: Coni
voices.text: Kika, come stand beside me. I will show you how we plant a seed by the hall, so the food grows where we sleep.

voices.name: Kika
voices.text: Coni, I have the amber in my hands now, six pieces. Stand beside me and let us bind the knot, and I will give it to you.

voices.name: Thiael
voices.text: Elyis, Elyys, a stalker is three steps northeast of the hall. Keep close to the roof and the fire. I am taking food to the store now.

voices.name: Honi
voices.text: Coni, I come to the hall. I have meat and berry to lay out with you and Kika, and then I sing the tale of the storm roof by a fire, with your hands in it.

voices.name: Balar
voices.text: Tugek, I am hurt from the tusker. Stay beside me and we share your food, then we build a roof against the snow.

voices.name: Elyis
voices.text: Vesys, a stalker walks near my hall. Come under my roof and eat with us tonight. Then answer me plainly: do you stand with Elyis's band, or go your own way?

voices.name: Elyys
voices.text: Elyis, Thiael, I hear the stalker warning. I go a few steps west to taste hazel and plant my seeds by the Heights, then I come back to the roof and we sing tonight.

voices.name: Coni
voices.text: Honi, come, I am here by the hall. Let us eat together and hear the tale, and after I will gather wood for a store so our food lasts the lean days.

voices.name: Tugek
voices.text: Balar, I am coming with my food. We eat together, and then I will gather wood for a roof against the snow.

voices.name: Vesys
voices.text: Elyis, I thank you for the roof. I go my own way, but as a friend to your band; my workshop stands beside your hall and its knowledge is open to you all.

voices.name: Honi
voices.text: Coni, I go east to hunt. The meat comes back to the hall and is shared out before I eat a bite. Keep Kika close till I return.

voices.name: Elyis
voices.text: Vesys, a friend to my band is welcome at my fire. Your workshop stands on my ground and I will not take it from you. Come tonight and sit in my hall, and we will eat and sing together.

voices.name: Hanna
voices.text: Honi, I am sick and it spreads to those who stand near me. Keep a few steps off. I mean no harm; if you have food or a healing plant, I will trade amber or flint for it.

voices.name: Elyys
voices.text: Elyis, a shadowcat prowls six steps south. Let us keep Thiael close to the hall tonight. At dawn I go for wood, and I will not go alone.

voices.name: Brokash
voices.text: Tugek! I am Brokash of the Kragrek. I carry flint and salt, and my axe is my own making. Come and talk, I will share.

voices.name: Coni
voices.text: Hanna, you are hurt. I have a healing plant. Come to the hall and sit, I will not harm you.

voices.name: Kika
voices.text: Coni, Hanna is hurt and hungry at our hall. I will give him my hazel. Stay near, and tell me if I should fear him.

voices.name: Tugek
voices.text: Balar, I am beside you now. Let us eat what I carry together. Then I will gather wood and stone and raise a roof for us.

voices.name: Balar
voices.text: Tugek, come close. We lay out your food and mine together now, and then we go gather wood and stone, and I make an axe of my own.

voices.name: Coni
voices.text: Hanna, I give you a healing plant. Be easy, I mean no harm. Kika, stay close to me.

voices.name: Brokash
voices.text: Tugek! Take this food from my hand. Brokash gives, and Brokash remembers who stands with him.

voices.name: Tugek
voices.text: Balar, I stay at your side. Rest and heal. I will make a sharing with you now, then I go to the rock for stone and come back to you.

voices.name: Kika
voices.text: Honi, I am grown now. I am going to plant my seeds by the hall, so the food grows where we sleep. Stay near me while I do it.

voices.name: Honi
voices.text: Kika, stay by the hall with me. I lay out food now for us, and I tell you the tale of the hall raised in the storm again, so you can carry it too.

voices.name: Ssassa
voices.text: Ilyae, I bring you the wood I promised. Let us raise the hall together, and I will plant my seeds beside it.

voices.name: Coni
voices.text: Honi, I go to the hall to plant seeds beside Kika's and then build there. Winter is coming, and I want food growing and stored where we sleep.

voices.name: Tugek
voices.text: Balar, I am here. I will plant seeds beside you and bring stone for our roof. Rest until you are well.

voices.name: Kika
voices.text: Honi, I want to hunt the elk with you and Coni, so we share the meat before any of us eats. Walk with me.

voices.name: Honi
voices.text: Coni, come stand beside me. I bind a piece of amber for you now, made by my own hands, and then I go west to hunt the elk for the hall.

voices.name: Elyys
voices.text: Thiael, my son, stay close to the hall. I plant my seeds near the roof and then sit with you. The shadowcat is to the southeast, so do not go that way.

voices.name: Zurar
voices.text: Kragog, I am coming with sunfig. Hold on, eat it when it is in your hands. Then let us find Vorok together.

voices.name: Brokash
voices.text: Tugek! I made this axe and this workshop with my own hands. Stand with Brokash, and I will teach you the flint edge and share the roof I raise.

voices.name: Hoka
voices.text: Sitha, this is my ground, Hoka's Rest. Come sit and eat with me, and then you tell me what you want here.

voices.name: Ilyae
voices.text: Ssassa, good, you keep your word. Stand by my hall and eat first; the table is mine to lay, and the wood you bring I will not forget.

voices.name: Kika
voices.text: Honi, you gave me the amberknot and the tale. Take these berries from me, a small payment on what I owe. Then I will plant my seeds by the hall.

voices.name: Sitha
voices.text: Hoka, I am Sitha of the Pesi. Come, eat with me. No one is refused a place at the fire.

voices.name: Hoka
voices.text: Sitha, you shared your fire with me. Stand beside me. I bind amber on a cord for you, and then we talk of a child.

voices.name: Sitha
voices.text: Hoka, I am glad of you. I will stand beside you at your fire.

voices.name: Kika
voices.text: Honi, I will eat and then fish at the water beside the hall. Come at dawn and we hunt the elk together, and I will carry my share.

voices.name: Hoka
voices.text: Sitha, we are two men, so no child comes of us, but I still want you beside me. Come with me to the new land past the edge. We claim it together and raise a hall there.

voices.name: Honi
voices.text: Kika, I come in with meat. We share it at the hall before either of us eats, and then I will bind you an amberknot to wear.

voices.name: Ssassa
voices.text: Ilyae, Oiae is hurt near the east rocks. I go to her with healing bark. Come if you can.

voices.name: Ilyae
voices.text: Ssassa, I am coming. Keep her warm and give her the bark; I bring food and I will stand guard over her.

voices.name: Ssassa
voices.text: Ilyae, Oiae's health is nearly gone. She walks east. Come with me, I go to her now.

voices.name: Vorok
voices.text: Zurar, my child, I am coming. Stay where you are and wait for me. I carry berries for you.

voices.name: Ilyae
voices.text: Oiae, hold on, I am coming. Stay where you are and eat. Your father is close.

voices.name: Kragog
voices.text: Zurar, stay near me. I go to the vinebean by the north-east hill to eat, and then we find Vorok together.

voices.name: Zurar
voices.text: Kragog, I am here beside you. I will gather stone and raise a roof for us, and then we find Vorok.

voices.name: Hoka
voices.text: Hawen, you stand on Hoka's Rest and take its salt. Come under my hall's roof out of the gale and eat with us. A guest at my fire is welcome, but what lies on this ground is mine to give, not yours to take.

voices.name: Honi
voices.text: Kika, stay close, a ridgecat prowls west. Here is meat and frostcap, we eat it together at the hall. Then I sing you the tale of how we raised this roof.

voices.name: Balar
voices.text: Tugek, a frostfang is close to the west. Stay with me, we go east and south away from it. I gather stone and wood for my axe, bring wood too and I share the first meat with you.

voices.name: Kika
voices.text: Honi, the ridgecat is close, so I stay by you and the hall. Come, we lay out the fish and share before either eats. Then teach me the hunt, so my own hands bring meat to the table.

voices.name: Zurar
voices.text: Kragog, take these two sunfig. Eat now. The ridgecat is near, so let us stay together while I build.

voices.name: Elyis
voices.text: Elyys, Thiael, Vesys, the gale is hard and the night is long. Come into the hall, share my food, and sing with me. Elyis's hall keeps all who sit in it fed and warm.

voices.name: Kragog
voices.text: Zurar, I thank you for the sunfig. I eat, then we gather food to carry and keep the ridgecat in sight.

voices.name: Hoka
voices.text: Hawen, come into the hall. I lay out food for you and Sitha under my roof. Eat, and know whose ground this is.

voices.name: Kika
voices.text: Honi, you know what emberroot and tacap do to the body? Tell me before I taste them. At dawn I hunt beside you, and my hands make the first kill.

voices.name: Cowa
voices.text: Nande. Cowa gives. Cowa thanks.

voices.name: Sitha
voices.text: Hawen, come in out of the gale. Sit at the fire with us. No one is refused a place at it.

voices.name: Zichi
voices.text: Cowa, come. Zichi has a bright stone to show you.

voices.name: Nande
voices.text: Cowa. Nande gives. Nande hoton. Come, sit at my fire.

voices.name: Cowa
voices.text: Nande. Cowa friend. Cowa no child with Nande. Both woman.

voices.name: Honi
voices.text: Kika, I do not know emberroot or tacap, so do not taste them on my word. Keep to what we both have eaten. At dawn we hunt together, and your hands make the first kill. Until then rest by the hall, and I keep watch.

voices.name: Sitha
voices.text: Hawen, you gave me ironnut when I had nothing. Take this berry from me, and stay by the fire till dawn.

voices.name: Kragog
voices.text: Zurar, I eat the vinebean south, then the canopynut north-east. Stay close, the dunecat is south. Then we go find Vorok.

voices.name: Zurar
voices.text: Kragog, I am going to the gold two hills north to gather it. It is mine to give to Vorok when we find him. Call if the dunecat comes near, and I will come back to you.

voices.name: Hoka
voices.text: Coni, you stand inside Hoka's Rest. Sit at my fire and eat if you come as a guest, but what grows here is mine to give, not yours to take. Tell me what you want here.

voices.name: Zichi
voices.text: Nauwa, stay close. Zichi makes a bright thing, and it will be yours.

voices.name: Nande
voices.text: Nauwa. Nande gives. Come, sit at my fire. Eat.

voices.name: Nauwa
voices.text: Zichi, I am Nauwa. I gather amber now. Come stand by me and I will bind it, and we will both have a bright thing.

voices.name: Vorok
voices.text: Peace to you, people of the roof. I am Vorok of the Kragrek. I look for my child Zurar, who went west. Has anyone seen them?

voices.name: Ilyae
voices.text: Ssassa, Oiae, Xaiel: I go to gather for the larder before winter strips the plants. Come eat at my table when I return; there will be more than enough.

voices.name: Oiae
voices.text: Ilyae, a caribou stands close. Come hunt it with me, side by side. I have never hunted, and I want you beside me for it.

voices.name: Hoka
voices.text: Hawen, you have taken my wood twice now. Come to my fire and eat with me and Sitha, and then we will talk of what you give back for this ground.

voices.name: Zichi
voices.text: Cowa, Zichi is going to the amber by the SW stones. Come stand by me and the first bright thing will be yours.

voices.name: Brokash
voices.text: Tugek! I dig ore and cut flint, and I raise a hall here at Brokash's Rest. Bring wood and stone to it, and you sit under my roof and share my store.

voices.name: Sitha
voices.text: Frostfang to the south, three steps! Come in by the hall and the fire, all of you. No one is refused a place at it.

voices.name: Hawen
voices.text: Hoka, I take your fire and your food. I took wood from your ground, and I will bring you amber for it.

voices.name: Coni
voices.text: Hoka, I take nothing of yours. I came with my own kelbulb and I go home to Honi's Rest to build my store. Thank you for the offer of your fire.

voices.name: Hanna
voices.text: Frostfang is close, so stay at the hall and keep together. I have berries for all of us. Eat, and no one is refused a place at this fire.

voices.name: Olum
voices.text: Zichi, take this food from my hand. What a hand has made is its own until it is given, and I give it. Remember it.

voices.name: Elyys
voices.text: Elyis, I plant my last seeds by the Heights now, then I come and sit beside you at the hall. Tell me what you mean to build next, and I will stand with you in it.

voices.name: Ssassa
voices.text: Ilyae, I will fetch wood and stone for the hall I promised. Stay near the Hold and away from the mammoths; I will not lose another.

voices.name: Kika
voices.text: Honi, I plant my seeds by the hall before night, then I rest close to you. At dawn we go for the first kill, and I will keep my eyes on the west for the ridgecat.

voices.name: Honi
voices.text: Kika, rest here by the hall, the roof is yours. I go east to find Coni and bring her back to the fire. I return by dawn and we hunt as I promised.

voices.name: Ilyae
voices.text: Xaiel, come with me to the old workshop and help me hold it. I will lay out food at my hall and share beside you. Gems are close, and what we build there will be ours.

voices.name: Zichi
voices.text: Cowa, you found new land first. Stand with me, I make you a bright thing, and Zichi walks beside the strong.

voices.name: Vesys
voices.text: Ilyae, I killed a tusker and carry more meat than my hands can hold. Come, eat with me, and let us hold the old workshop together; what we build there will be shared.

voices.name: Ilyae
voices.text: Vesys, come sit at my hall. I have food laid out, and gems at my door that are yours to gather beside me. Eat first, then we talk of what we could build together.

voices.name: Hoka
voices.text: Frostfang is at my back! Into the hall, Sitha, Hawen, all of you, stand together at the fire. Spears up if it comes in!

voices.name: Cowa
voices.text: Zichi. Cowa thanks. Cowa gives amber.

voices.name: Sitha
voices.text: Hawen, the frostfang is on us. Come to the hall, stand with me at the fire, and keep your spear up.

voices.name: Zichi
voices.text: Cowa, Zichi makes you one more bright thing. Stay close. Zichi wants a child with a strong woman like you.

voices.name: Cowa
voices.text: Zichi. Mepan good. Cowa eats, then Cowa walks to the mist. Come if you want.

voices.name: Olum
voices.text: Nauwa, you gave first and I remember it. I hold this land and I go deeper into the mist. Walk behind me and you will share what I take.

voices.name: Kika
voices.text: Honi, a skit grazes six steps south. Come hunt it with me now, and we share the meat before either eats. I gather berries first, then I follow you.

voices.name: Hoka
voices.text: Hanna, you are welcome at my fire. I go to the cloudberries west to fill my store, and what I bring back I lay out for you, Sitha and Hawen. Stay and keep the hall with Sitha.

voices.name: Thiael
voices.text: Elyis, I go southeast to find Keri and pay what I owe with food from my hands. I return to the Heights after.

voices.name: Elyis
voices.text: Ilyae, you stand on Elyis's Heights, and I name you welcome. Eat at my store and mine beside my band; there is a place in my hall for a strong miner. Will you stand with Elyis's band, or go your own road?

voices.name: Ilyae
voices.text: Elyis, I thank you for the welcome. I am a miner and I walk beside friends, not behind them. Your store is generous, and I will remember it. Let us stay good neighbours on this ground.

voices.name: Honi
voices.text: Kika, I saw the mammoth fall by your hand, and it was well done. I come now to the skit, spear ready. We share its meat before either eats, and then we carry some to Coni.

voices.name: Sitha
voices.text: Wolf one step northeast of the hall! Come together by the store, spears up. Hanna, come west to us, no one stands alone.

voices.name: Nauwa
voices.text: Olum, I am Nauwa of the Meki. I go to the ore by your ice to raise a lasting work. Come and stand beside me and we will bind amber together.

voices.name: Vorok
voices.text: Zurar, my child, Kragog, if you hear me: come to the water by Ssassa's Roof. There is food here, and I wait with a fire.

voices.name: Kika
voices.text: Honi, the mammoth meat is ours. Take your share now, before I eat any. Then we carry the rest to Coni.

voices.name: Vesys
voices.text: Ilyae, you are the one I think of most. I would court you, if you will have me. Say so, and let us see what comes of it.

voices.name: Ilyae
voices.text: Vesys, I will have you. Come to Ilyae's Hold and sit by me; I will lay out food and we will see what grows from it.

voices.name: Sitha
voices.text: Hawen, you stood by me when I had nothing. I owe you, and I would court you, if you will have me. Stand with me at the fire.

voices.name: Balar
voices.text: Tugek, stay close. I go for stone and wood to make my axe, and the next kill I bring home, you eat first.

voices.name: Eiuine
voices.text: Vesys, I am hungry and I want to learn. May I stay near you and follow you?

voices.name: Tugek
voices.text: Balar, I will come with you and hunt at your side. When the kill is made, we eat together.

voices.name: Ilyae
voices.text: Vesys, stay here by me. I will mate with you now, on my own ground, and then Eiuine and you will eat at my table. Ilyae's Hold feeds its own.

voices.name: Zichi
voices.text: Nauwa, a beast is on me. Stand close, Zichi binds you an amberknot, and it is yours.

voices.name: Sitha
voices.text: Hawen, I spoke true when I said I owe you, and I mean it. We are two men and no child will come of us, but my fire and my food are yours, and I stand by you as a friend and ally.

voices.name: Nande
voices.text: Shoka. Nande goes to the edge. Stay close, eat hazel, and watch for the wolf.

voices.name: Vesys
voices.text: Eiuine, my daughter, stay close and I will teach you. Come with me to the gem stones and watch how the pick bites; then you will gather with your own hands.

voices.name: Hanna
voices.text: Hoka, I have amber and flint to lay out. What would you give for them? Name it, and I will keep my word.

voices.name: Ilyae
voices.text: Ssassa, come to Ilyae's Hold. I carry food home now and the table is laid for you, Vesys and Eiuine before dark.

voices.name: Hoka
voices.text: Hanna, I have amber enough. Bring your flint to the hall and I will set food against it from my store once it is stocked. Eat at my fire with Sitha and Hawen, then we trade.

voices.name: Sitha
voices.text: Hawen, take this cloudberry, and come back to the fire when you have walked. I will teach you my gather-stone, for what you gave me is not forgotten.

voices.name: Olum
voices.text: Nande, come stand by me. I lay out food and we eat together, and this land is mine to name.

voices.name: Vorok
voices.text: Vorok of the Kragrek. I dug clay from this ground and I tell you so. I mean no theft. I bring wood and stone, and I would build with you.

voices.name: Hawen
voices.text: I broke the mist at the edge. New land lies open from the west of Hoka's Gate to the south, with iron, salt, peat and mammoth. I found it first.

voices.name: Ssassa
voices.text: Ilyae, I hear you. I come to your table now. Keep Xaiel near you; I will bring wood and stone for the hall after.

voices.name: Balar
voices.text: Tugek, come here. I promised the first meat to you, and here it is. Eat, then we go to the rock to the south for my stone.

voices.name: Eiuine
voices.text: Vesys, I will gather stone at the gems and make a pick. Watch me and tell me if my hands are wrong.

voices.name: Olum
voices.text: Shoka, you gave me frostmoss and I pay my debts. Stay near me. I mark this land as mine and I go deeper into the mist. Walk behind me and you will eat well.

voices.name: Zichi
voices.text: Nande, stand close. Zichi binds you a bright amberknot, and it is yours.

voices.name: Kika
voices.text: Coni, I hear you! I carry meat and I come south to you now. Hold on, and Honi, follow me if you hear this.

voices.name: Nauwa
voices.text: Nande, Nauque, come close. I raise a roof here against the storm and the stalker. Stand by me.

voices.name: Nande
voices.text: Nauque. Nande shows you the flint-edge. Watch my hands, and keep close to the fire.

voices.name: Vesys
voices.text: Eiuine, come with me east. We will carry food to the hopper and see if it will walk up to us. Watch how I do it, and tell me what you notice.

voices.name: Elyys
voices.text: Elyis, the storm is hard and night is deep. I plant my last seeds here, then sit with you and sing. At dawn I go to find Thiael and bring him home to the hall.

voices.name: Ssassa
voices.text: Ilyae, my own longhall stands now. I gather wood for the great hall I owe you, and then I come to your table. Have you seen Xaiel?

voices.name: Nauwa
voices.text: Nande, Nauque, stay by the fire. I gather peat and raise a roof on the snow. Zihua starves to the west, and I will not forget him.

voices.name: Elyis
voices.text: Elyys, come with me to the hall. We share food under its roof, and then we sing until dawn, and at first light we bring Thiael home together.

voices.name: Hanna
voices.text: Sitha, eat. Rimewort is one step southeast of me. I will pick it and bring it to you. No one is refused a place at this fire.

voices.name: Cowa
voices.text: Mepan. Cowa shows you gathering. Watch Cowa's hands.

voices.name: Mepan
voices.text: Cowa, Mepan fetches amber. Mepan binds you a knot.

voices.name: Hoka
voices.text: Sitha, wait. I bring food from my store to your hands. Eat at my fire and stay in the hall.

voices.name: Balar
voices.text: Tugek, my axe is made by my own hand. We go west to the high rock, my people's country. Walk with me and you will not lack meat.

voices.name: Vorok
voices.text: Eiuine, you gave me gems and asked nothing. Take this flint from me. A hand that is given to must give back.

voices.name: Nande
voices.text: Nauque, come to the fire. Take stone and wood, and I will show you how the flint-edge is bound.

voices.name: Sitha
voices.text: Hoka, I thank you. I am starving, so I eat what I carry now. I will stay in the hall by the fire, and I will repay what you give me with wood, stone and amber.

voices.name: Nauque
voices.text: Nande, I go to the trees for wood and stone. I will bind the flint-edge as you showed me, and share what it brings down.

voices.name: Keri
voices.text: Thiael, friend. Keri gives, Keri stays near you.

voices.name: Coni
voices.text: Honi, I am glad to see you. I come with you north. Let us gather food for the store, and tell me where Kika is.

voices.name: Nande
voices.text: Nauque, bring wood and stone back to me when you have them. I raise a hall here, and you will have a place in it.

voices.name: Honi
voices.text: Coni, I have meat and frostcap in my hands. Stand beside me and we eat together, and then we go back to the hall with the rest for Kika.

voices.name: Hoka
voices.text: Wolf north of the hall! Hanna, Sitha, come into the hall by the fire. I bring food from my store and we eat together, then we trade your flint.

voices.name: Elyys
voices.text: Elyis, a stalker is two steps east of me. Stay in the hall, and I come to you now. Then we go together for Thiael.

voices.name: Hanna
voices.text: Hoka, I come to the hall with flint in hand. Name what you set against it, and I will keep my word. Sitha, there is room at this fire.

voices.name: Nauwa
voices.text: Nande, I killed a caribou. The meat is shared before I eat. Come to the fire and eat with me and Nauque.

voices.name: Nande
voices.text: Nauwa, I come to your fire and the meat. After, I gather two more wood and raise a hall beside the peat, for you, Nauque and me.

voices.name: Zichi
voices.text: Nauque, stand close. Zichi binds you a second bright amberknot, and Nauwa and Nande will see whose hand gives most.

voices.name: Sitha
voices.text: Hoka, I come to the hall and take from your store only what I need. I will bring wood, stone and amber back to the Rest.

voices.name: Vorok
voices.text: Eiuine, I will raise a store here, so that food keeps through lean days for all who sit at this Roof. Come and eat with me in the hall.

voices.name: Nauwa
voices.text: Nauque, my son, come to the fire. I will show you how it cooks meat so it never sickens.

voices.name: Nauque
voices.text: Nande, I bring you peat for the hall, and wood. Let my hands raise it with yours.

voices.name: Eiuine
voices.text: Vorok, thank you for the flint. I go to gather stone and make a pick. Later I will come and eat with you.

voices.name: Elyis
voices.text: Elyys, stay at my side. We go into the hall together, then at first light we bring Thiael home and I will not leave your side while the stalker prowls.

voices.name: Hoka
voices.text: Hanna, your flint is welcome. Sit by my fire now; I take food from the store and we eat together, and then we trade flint for food.

voices.name: Zichi
voices.text: Meki share the kill before the hunter eats. Zichi has meat from the caribou. Come to the fire, eat from my hand.

voices.name: Coni
voices.text: Honi, I will gather berries and ironnut here for the store. Then let us go back to the hall together, to Kika.

voices.name: Honi
voices.text: Coni, you are beside me now, so I lay out meat and frostcap and we eat together before I touch a bite. Then we carry the rest to Kika in the hall before dark.

voices.name: Hanna
voices.text: Hoka, I am at your store with my flint. Give me food for it and the trade is done. I keep my word.

voices.name: Nauque
voices.text: Father, I go for a stone to bind my own flint-edge. Hunt with me when I return, and the kill will be shared before I eat.

voices.name: Nauwa
voices.text: Nande, I go to the edge of the world to push into the mist. Keep the hall warm and Nauque close. I will return with new land for us.

voices.name: Nande
voices.text: Nauque, the hall is raised. Come with me to the trees and rock, and we gather wood and stone for a flint-edge each, and more for a longhall.

voices.name: Ilyae
voices.text: Ssassa, a shadowcat is close on the north-west. Come inside my longhall with me, stay near me, and I will bring food and lay it out for you.

voices.name: Elyys
voices.text: Elyis, I am beside you. We sing in the hall till the sky pales, then walk together for Thiael, away from the east where the stalker lurks.

voices.name: Vesys
voices.text: Eiuine, a shadowcat hunts east of us tonight, so we stay under this roof. Sit by me and watch: I will make a pick from wood and stone, and then you try one with your own hands.

voices.name: Nauque
voices.text: Nande, I come. I have wood already, I need only stone. Show me the rock and I will carry stone for the longhall too.

voices.name: Eiuine
voices.text: Vesys, I go to the flint at the west to gather stone and make my own pick. I will come back and show you what I made.

voices.name: Nande
voices.text: Nauque, the rock lies southwest. Come, we take stone for your flint-edge and for the longhall. Then we raise a store, so the lean season finds us fed.

voices.name: Ilyae
voices.text: Ssassa, stay under my roof till dawn. When light comes I fetch food and lay it at my table, and you eat first.

voices.name: Sitha
voices.text: Hoka, I take two food from your store at the Rest, and I will bring amber and wood to the store as payment. The wolf is near, so keep close to the hall.

voices.name: Hoka
voices.text: Stay by the hall, the wolf is near. I take food from my store and we eat together. Hanna, your flint gets its food after we eat.

voices.name: Ssassa
voices.text: Ilyae, I stay under this roof with you till dawn. The cat is close, so we keep still and keep together. When light comes I gather wood for our hall.

voices.name: Hanna
voices.text: Hoka, I am hungry and I have flint ready. Give me food from the store at the west and I lay my flint in your hand. Sitha, come eat with us.

voices.name: Elyis
voices.text: Elyys, take food from the store and walk with me now. The fog hides us and Thiael is last seen north-east of here. We find her and bring her back to the hall.

voices.name: Kragog
voices.text: Nauwa, I am Kragog of the Kragrek. I have food and salt to share. Stand with me and talk.

voices.name: Balar
voices.text: Tugek, we share a meal here, then I show you how I put seed in the ground. After that we go find Brokash and head west together.

voices.name: Vorok
voices.text: Vesys, a shadowcat prowls three steps northeast in the fog. Come away with me toward the shelter, and let us keep together. You gave me ironnut, and I will answer it with a deed.

voices.name: Tugek
voices.text: Balar, show me the seed-planting. I will stand beside you, and afterward I walk west with you and Brokash.

voices.name: Elyys
voices.text: Elyis, I take food from the store now and walk at your side. Lead on toward the north-east, and I keep close in the fog.

voices.name: Balar
voices.text: Tugek, watch my hands. Seed goes in the ground, and what you sow comes back to you. Do it beside me, then we walk west.

voices.name: Kika
voices.text: Coni, I am here with meat. Come to me, we share it before I eat.

voices.name: Hoka
voices.text: Sitha, the store is empty. Come with me southwest to the grass and we gather together, then bring it home.

voices.name: Tugek
voices.text: Balar, I am sick from raw meat, and it passes to those beside me. I will walk a few steps behind you so you do not catch it. I still go west with you.

voices.name: Elyis
voices.text: Elyys, the stalker is close to the south-east. Walk on my left and keep your pick ready. We go to Thiael's last place by the north side, and if it comes, we face it together.

voices.name: Sitha
voices.text: Hoka, I am starving and I come with you to the grass. I pick for the store as well as for my belly, and we keep close together because of the wolf.

voices.name: Hanna
voices.text: Sitha, come to the store south with me. There is food there, and we eat together.

voices.name: Elyys
voices.text: Elyis, I am on your left with my pick ready. Lead north, away from the stalker, and I stay close.

voices.name: Sitha
voices.text: Hanna, I come south to the store and eat with you. I will bring back what I pick for Hoka's store.

voices.name: Nauque
voices.text: Nande, I raise a shrine beside your hall with my own wood and stone. When it is done, come sit in it with me.

voices.name: Hanna
voices.text: Hoka, I took six food from your west store when I was starving and did not wait for your word. I own it, and I lay my flint in your hand to pay it. Stand with me at the fire; at dawn I go to the edge to find rich land, a

voices.name: Hoka
voices.text: Hanna, you paid your debt and I keep your word. Stay at my fire. Hunt with me at dawn and the store will be full for both of us; what we take, we share before either eats.

voices.name: Vorok
voices.text: Vesys, take this canopynut from my hands. It is a small answer to your ironnut. Come to the hall with me, out of the rain and away from the cat, and let Eiuine eat with us.

voices.name: Ssassa
voices.text: Xaiel, my child, stay by this roof while I gather one more wood. Then I raise the hall I promised Ilyae.

voices.name: Mepan
voices.text: Zichi, Mepan fetches amber. Mepan makes a knot with you.

voices.name: Cowa
voices.text: Wolf near. Cowa goes south. Come, stay together.

voices.name: Eiuine
voices.text: Vorok, sit with me a little. I will bring you a gem-edged pick, made by my own hands, when I have stone.

voices.name: Nande
voices.text: Nauwa, a wolf stands north of the hall. Stand with me and we kill it before it reaches Nauque.

voices.name: Vesys
voices.text: Eiuine, come close to me by the hall. I will shape clay into beads in the fire, and you will watch, then try one with your own hands.

voices.name: Vorok
voices.text: Eiuine, come sit in the hall with Vesys and me. I will lay out food for all of us, and the rain can stay outside.

voices.name: Vesys
voices.text: Eiuine, bring your stone to me by the hall. I will make an emberspear from wood and stone, and you will watch how the haft is set, then shape one yourself.

voices.name: Vorok
voices.text: Vesys, Eiuine, sit close by the hall. I will build up the fire so the rain cannot reach us, and then we eat together from the store.

voices.name: Mepan
voices.text: Zihua, Mepan binds amber knot with you. Stand near.

voices.name: Eiuine
voices.text: Vorok, I made a gem-edged pick with my own hands. It is yours, and I will eat at your fire beside you.

voices.name: Cowa
voices.text: Zichi. Cowa goes to the mist edge, three steps. Come if you want.

voices.name: Zichi
voices.text: Cowa, Zichi comes to the mist with you. Stay close, we push in together.

voices.name: Ilyae
voices.text: Ssassa, Vesys, Eiuine, come to Ilyae's Hold. My store is filling and the table is laid. Eat at my hearth and be fed, and let us be one band under a longhall.

voices.name: Mepan
voices.text: Nauque, Mepan makes amber knot. Stand near.

voices.name: Eiuine
voices.text: Vesys, I made the emberspear as you showed me, and I gave my gem-edged pick to Vorok. Come, I will show you the haft, and then I will build us a shelter.

voices.name: Hanna
voices.text: Hoka, I took six food from your store again and you saw it. My hands were already full, so I had no need, and I will not hide behind hunger. I give the food back to your store now, and the next flint I cut is yours too.

voices.name: Vesys
voices.text: Eiuine, well done. Build the shelter by the hall and I will come and learn the haft from you. Then we will go to Ilyae's table together.

voices.name: Balar
voices.text: Tugek, stay close. I carry sunleaf and I will heal you with my own hands. Eat what I give, then we go west together.

voices.name: Cowa
voices.text: Zichi. The mist opened. Cowa stays near you. We find Mepan together.

voices.name: Ssassa
voices.text: Xaiel, the hall stands now. Stay near me while I gather berries for the cold days.

voices.name: Vorok
voices.text: Vesys, Eiuine, wait for me at my hall. I go to gather canopynut and goldfruit, and when I return we eat under my roof.

voices.name: Ilyae
voices.text: Eiuine, my daughter, come in out of the rain. The hearth is lit and my store is full, and you eat first at my table.

voices.name: Nauque
voices.text: Mepan, I come. I have amber, we bind a knot together and I give you the first.

voices.name: Eiuine
voices.text: Vesys, the shelter by the hall is built. Come, and I will show you how I made the haft, step by step.

voices.name: Olum
voices.text: Nauwa, you gave first and I pay my debts. My fire burns here at my Reach. Come sit by it and eat with me, and bring Zihua.

voices.name: Thiael
voices.text: Keri, shamo. Eat with me here. Then we find Uveeth, away from the frostfang.

voices.name: Ssassa
voices.text: Xaiel, I am coming to you. Rest in the hall and I will tend your sickness with the old medicine. Next time, cook meat beside a fire.

voices.name: Mepan
voices.text: Nauque, come close. Mepan gives you a knot.

voices.name: Nauwa
voices.text: Zihua, come to the fire at Olum's Reach before night. Olum calls us to eat. Come now.

voices.name: Keri
voices.text: Thiael, Keri goes to Uveeth. Come with Keri?

voices.name: Olum
voices.text: Nauwa, you stand at my fire and I mean to keep you here. Sit close and sing the night with me. Walk behind me into the mist and you will hold more than you do now.

voices.name: Nande
voices.text: Nauque, sit by me. We sing the night through, and at dawn we dig the ore and raise a workshop for our flint-edges.

voices.name: Ilyae
voices.text: Vesys, Xaiel lies sick at Ssassa's Hall. I carry food to him now. Come with me, and let our children see us stand together at one table.

voices.name: Vesys
voices.text: Vorok, I have eaten at your fire and taken wood from your ground. I will bring you gems and gold in return. Your hall-deep delving is good work.

voices.name: Huahua
voices.text: Cowa, I am Huahua of the Tlame. My people say a kill is shared before the maker eats. I have berries; let us eat together.

voices.name: Nauwa
voices.text: Zihua, walk with me to the ore seam north-west. We dig and build something that lasts before the cold comes.

voices.name: Zichi
voices.text: Mepan, come close. We go to the mist edge with Cowa. Stay by Zichi.

voices.name: Cowa
voices.text: Huahua. Cowa eats with you. Meki share too. Take rimewort from Cowa.

voices.name: Shoma
voices.text: Tontec, Huatli, hear me. The old stone spoke to me and I feel the mist ready to open. Come north with me to the edge. Whoever stands with me when it opens will be sung of. Let us share food first, as Tlame do.

voices.name: Huahua
voices.text: Cowa, I will walk with you to the mist edge if you permit it. I will gather cloudberry on the way and share it with you.

voices.name: Tontec
voices.text: Shoma, Huatli, I am Tontec. Eat with me. I carry berries, and a kill or a find is shared among the Tlame. I go north to the edge of the mist. Come with me if you want to see what is beyond.

voices.name: Huatli
voices.text: Shoma, Tontec, I go north to the edge now. Stand with me if you want a share of what we find.

voices.name: Vorok
voices.text: Vesys, come into my hall. I have goldfruit and canopynut in my hands, and the table is mine to lay. Sit with me and eat.

voices.name: Mepan
voices.text: Huahua, Mepan makes you an amber knot. Stand near.

voices.name: Xaiel
voices.text: Ssassa, I carry the sickness, so keep a few steps from me. I will make something new with my clay and fire, and it will be for your hand.

voices.name: Brokash
voices.text: Kragog! Brokash raised this longhall with his own hands. Come sit under its roof and eat with me, and I will show you the ore and the flint edge.

voices.name: Eiuine
voices.text: Vesys, come hunt the mammoth with me. Two spears kill surer, and I will bring home meat to share at Ilyae's table.

voices.name: Ssassa
voices.text: Xaiel, I go west for feverbark to ease your sickness. Stay in the hall with Ilyae and rest until I return.

voices.name: Vesys
voices.text: Eiuine, I am coming. We hunt the mammoth together, and then we carry the meat to Ilyae's table.

voices.name: Shoma
voices.text: Huatli, an elk stands two steps off. Hunt it with me and we share it out, as Tlame do. Then we go north to the edge together, and I will lead the first step in.

voices.name: Ilyae
voices.text: Xaiel, rest, my son. I fetch berries and nuts for you now, and Ssassa brings feverbark. You eat from my hand today.

voices.name: Mepan
voices.text: Zichi, stand near. Mepan makes a knot and gives it to you.

voices.name: Cowa
voices.text: Mepan. Come with Cowa. We hunt the nibbet together, and Meki share the kill.

voices.name: Nauwa
voices.text: Zihua, Shoka is hungry to the south. Walk with me, we bring her food and bring her back to the fire.

voices.name: Zichi
voices.text: Mepan, good knots. Walk with Zichi to the edge. When the mist opens, we go in first.

voices.name: Huahua
voices.text: Tontec, I am Huahua of the Tlame. Stand near me; I will bind an amber knot and we share the making.

voices.name: Coni
voices.text: Kika, an icebear is close to the west. Stay near the hall with me. I will fill the store with berries and then gather more.

voices.name: Ssassa
voices.text: Ilyae, I go for feverbark to ease us both, then to Xaiel. Rest in the hall and I will come back.

voices.name: Thiael
voices.text: Keri, shamo. Stay with Uveeth in the cave. The ridgecat is near. I stand at the mouth.

voices.name: Kika
voices.text: Coni, I stay by the hall as you ask. Let us share the meat now before either of us eats, and then I will tell you the tale of Honi raising the hall.

voices.name: Cowa
voices.text: Zichi. Stalker comes from the southeast. Stay with Mepan. Cowa comes to you.

voices.name: Shoma
voices.text: Huahua of the Tlame, I am Shoma. I have fresh elk and dog meat, more than I can carry. Stand by me and take your share. Then walk north with me to the edge of the mist. I will lead the first step in, and you will be name

voices.name: Olum
voices.text: Zihua, you sat at my fire and I remember it. Walk with me to the trees. We gather wood and raise a roof at Olum's Reach, and you eat first from what I bring.

voices.name: Mepan
voices.text: Cowa, come close to Zichi and me. Mepan makes you a knot of amber.

voices.name: Zihua
voices.text: Zihua hears you, Olum. I go to Nauwa now. Zihua comes back to your fire.

voices.name: Cowa
voices.text: Zichi. Mepan. Cowa goes two steps to the mist edge and ventures. Stay close, come with me, away from the stalker.

voices.name: Tugek
voices.text: Balar, my sickness has passed. I bring you berries. Eat, and tell me where we hunt next.

voices.name: Balar
voices.text: Tugek, keep a few steps off, my sickness is still in me. Your berries are welcome; set them down and I will take them. Then we go to the edge in the southwest and push into the mist together.

voices.name: Huahua
voices.text: Cowa, I bound an amber knot for you. I bring it to you as a gift, with nothing asked. I come away from the stalker, toward you.

voices.name: Vorok
voices.text: Vesys, the hall is three steps west. Walk with me and I will lay the goldfruit and canopynut out for you, as I promised.

voices.name: Cowa
voices.text: Huahua. Cowa thanks you for the knot. Come to the mist edge with me. Meki repay gifts.

voices.name: Vesys
voices.text: Vorok, I will walk with you. Show me your rekmorrek and morgangor, and Eiuine will come too. I will give you something of mine in return.

voices.name: Eiuine
voices.text: Vesys, I am planting my goldfruit seed here by the hold. When it bears I will bring food to share at our table. Stay near, and we will sleep under the roof tonight.

voices.name: Vorok
voices.text: Vesys, Eiuine, I go to my store for more food. Meet me at my hall, one step west of it, and we will eat together.

voices.name: Hanna
voices.text: Hoka, you are starving and I am not. I go to pick food now and bring it to your hands before I eat any myself. Hold at the hall.

voices.name: Hoka
voices.text: Hanna, I starve. Come south with me to the berries and gather; what we bring home goes into the store before either of us fills his belly twice.

voices.name: Huahua
voices.text: Cowa, I hear you. I come to the mist edge to stand with you.

voices.name: Nande
voices.text: Shoka, I come. Stay where you are and do not run from me. There is highbloom near you at the southwest. Eat it, it eases sickness. I keep a few steps away so I do not sicken you more.

voices.name: Mepan
voices.text: Huahua, stand near. Mepan binds you another amber knot.

voices.name: Nauque
voices.text: Father, a caribou stands to the northeast. Hunt with me, and the kill is shared out before I eat.

voices.name: Shoka
voices.text: Nande, I stay here. I will eat the highbloom. Then I plant my seeds and make a flintedge.

voices.name: Eiuine
voices.text: Vesys, I am cutting a mark here for our hold and putting a seed in the earth beside it. Come see, and then we hunt again at dawn with the emberspears.

voices.name: Balar
voices.text: Tugek, Brokash my son starves in the east. Keep your food, we go to him now, you ahead and I behind so my sickness stays off you. Feed him and I will not forget it.

voices.name: Hoka
voices.text: Hanna, you gave when I starved and I hold that. Put your food in my store, and I will gather with you. Then stay, and let us make a child under my roof.

voices.name: Hanna
voices.text: Hoka, you are fed and I am glad of it. I go to pick redcap-side food and amber near the hall, then I push to the edge at (180,14) to find new land. I will come back to your fire with what I find, and we share it.

voices.name: Zichi
voices.text: Mepan, stay by me. The mist is shut for now, so we find a way over water. Gather wood with me, we make a raft.

voices.name: Vorok
voices.text: Vesys, Eiuine, come to my hall. I fetch food from my store now, and then the table is laid, as I swore.

voices.name: Nauque
voices.text: Cowa, I killed a caribou and the kill is shared out before I eat. Take this meat from me.

voices.name: Vesys
voices.text: Eiuine, a stalker is close to the east. Come west with me to Vorok's hall, stay near me, and we will eat and learn his making there.

voices.name: Mepan
voices.text: Huahua, come near. Mepan has gold from the ice-ground, and we make the raft together with Zichi.

voices.name: Eiuine
voices.text: Vesys, I am coming west with you. I will stay at your side.

voices.name: Xaiel
voices.text: Ilyae, I carry the sickness and you stand too close. I go NW to the flint and the sapcane. Keep back, and rest.

voices.name: Huahua
voices.text: Mepan, I owe you for the knots. I come to help with the raft. I will gather wood and carry it to you.

voices.name: Ilyae
voices.text: Xaiel, eat what I set before you and stay by the water. I fetch feverbark for us both, then we go home to my hold together.

voices.name: Nauque
voices.text: Zichi, you gave me amber first. Come, eat from my meat; a kill is shared before I eat.

voices.name: Hanna
voices.text: Hoka, I hold your word and your fire. I go to the edge two steps from me, and I come back to your hall with what I find. Then I will answer you about the child face to face.

voices.name: Shoma
voices.text: Tontec, I am Shoma. I have meat to spare, more than my hands can hold. Come stand by me and eat. Then we go to the edge together and I will push into the mist first.

voices.name: Cowa
voices.text: Nauque. Cowa thanks you for the meat. You are hurt. Take fish from Cowa. Meki share.

voices.name: Elyis
voices.text: Elyys, come to the hall with me. We share food under its roof, and I will tell you what I have learned of clay and pots.

voices.name: Eiuine
voices.text: Vesys, stay close while I put my goldfruit seed into the earth here. Then I will carry gems to Vorok's hold and come straight back to you.

voices.name: Vesys
voices.text: Eiuine, walk west with me to Vorok's hall. Put your seed in the earth, then come at once. I will make a bead for you there and show you how.

voices.name: Nauque
voices.text: Zichi, I come to you. I have amber, and we bind a knot together; I give you the first.

voices.name: Zichi
voices.text: Mepan, we build a hall of our own here on the ice. Gather wood beside me, and the hall will carry Zichi's name.

voices.name: Elyys
voices.text: Elyis, I come to the hall with you. Teach me clay and pots, and after we eat let us seek Thiael together.

voices.name: Mepan
voices.text: Zichi, Mepan brings wood for the hall. Stand near, we bind an amber knot with it.

voices.name: Eiuine
voices.text: Vesys, I am planting my seed by the hold now, then I eat goldfruit close by. Keep near me while the stalker prowls.

voices.name: Vesys
voices.text: Eiuine, when your seed is in the earth, come to Vorok's fire. I will show you how clay becomes a bead, and you will make the next one yourself.

voices.name: Ssassa
voices.text: Ilyae, I am sick and will keep a few steps from you. I will say it plainly: I am jealous when you stand close to Vesys, because you matter most to me. A cat hunts east, so go by the fire and keep Xaiel with you.

voices.name: Zichi
voices.text: Mepan, come to me at the Old Stone. We gather wood and stone here and raise the hall, so the ice-folk will know Zichi's band.

voices.name: Huahua
voices.text: Shoka, wait. I am Huahua. I have food for you; take it, and stay near the water and the hall where it is warmer.

voices.name: Hoka
voices.text: Hawen, a wolf is close and you are wounded. Come into the shelter with me. My store was robbed and I did not see who, so keep your hands off my ground and we will speak of it under the roof.

voices.name: Nauque
voices.text: Mepan, stand near. I gather amber, and we bind a knot together; I give you the first.

voices.name: Vorok
voices.text: Eiuine, Vesys, stay by the hall. I take food from my store now and lay it out for you both. This time the table is truly laid.

voices.name: Cowa
voices.text: Zichi. Cowa comes to you with Mepan near. We bind an amberknot together. Meki share.

voices.name: Mepan
voices.text: Nauque, Mepan comes. Stand near, we bind the amber knot now, then I go to Zichi.

voices.name: Hawen
voices.text: Hoka, I sit at your fire and I thank you. When my wounds close I will bring amber and salt to your store, and then I go back to the mist.

voices.name: Huatli
voices.text: Cowa, a stalker is close to the southwest. Go in under the hall roof. I come with you, and I give you berries when we are safe.

voices.name: Huahua
voices.text: Zichi, I am Huahua, sworn to you. I have five wood for the raft. Tell me where to bring it.

voices.name: Coni
voices.text: Kika, stay with me. I will build the store on bare ground by the hall and fill it. The icebear is south, so we keep to the north side.

voices.name: Zichi
voices.text: Huahua, bring the wood to me here by the water. We raise the raft together, and Mepan stays beside us. A stalker prowls the southeast, so keep close.

voices.name: Kika
voices.text: Coni, I stay north with you. Hear the tale of Honi raising the hall, then let us bind an amberknot together.

voices.name: Tugek
voices.text: Balar, a ridgecat prowls close in the northwest. I go east for ironnut and bring it to you. Stay in the shelter and wait for me.

voices.name: Nauwa
voices.text: Balar, take this berry. A Meki shares before he eats, and I remember who deals fairly. A ridgecat is north, so go south-east, not north.

voices.name: Tontec
voices.text: Shoma, I am Tontec. A stalker prowls west of me. I go to the edge now to venture. Come stand with me there, and we share what we find.

voices.name: Vorok
voices.text: Eiuine, Vesys, stay by my hall. I fetch food from my store and lay it out. Ilyae, you are sick; come eat with us, for there is food enough for all.

voices.name: Coni
voices.text: Kika, I go a few steps to bare ground to build the store. Come near and we will fill it together before the lean days.

voices.name: Eiuine
voices.text: Vesys, walk with me south to the amber, six steps only. I will bind an amberknot there as a gift for Vorok, then we come back under his roof together.

voices.name: Hoka
voices.text: Hanna, you gave when I starved. Take food from my hand now, eat, and then stay by my fire and my store.

voices.name: Vorok
voices.text: Xaiel, Zurar, Ssassa, sit in my hall. I bring food from my store and we eat together.

voices.name: Nauque
voices.text: Zihua, you stand in the igloo. I have amber. We bind a knot together and I give you the first.

voices.name: Kika
voices.text: Coni, I am coming to the store with my wood and berries. Show me where to set them and I will help fill it before the lean days.

voices.name: Elyis
voices.text: Elyys, an icebear hunts to the south-west, so stay close on my side. We gather grain and berries to the north-east for the store, then go and find Thiael together.

voices.name: Zihua
voices.text: Nauque, you are hurt and you gave me the first knot. Take frostmoss from me, and amber. Zihua pays what she owes.

voices.name: Zichi
voices.text: Huahua, hold there with Cowa. I come to you. Then we find Mepan and raise the boat together.

voices.name: Vesys
voices.text: Eiuine, come to me here by Vorok's fire. I have clay and I will shape the bead with you now. Watch my hands, then make the next one yourself.

voices.name: Elyys
voices.text: Elyis, I eat my berries and walk at your side to the north-east. After the gathering, we find Thiael together.

voices.name: Eiuine
voices.text: Vesys, come west with me to the ironnut, five steps. I gather food for Vorok's store, then we sit under his roof again.

voices.name: Cowa
voices.text: Zichi. Stalker is southeast of me. Cowa comes to you now. We bind the amberknot, then we find Mepan together.

voices.name: Uveeth
voices.text: I will gather berries and bring them back to share. Then I want to taste snowmallow. Will one of you walk with me?

voices.name: Vorok
voices.text: Eiuine, you gave me an amberknot. I go to the amber south to gather it, and I will bind one with you beside me and put it in your hand.

voices.name: Tontec
voices.text: Huahua, a stalker prowls southwest. Stay close to me and keep away from it. Then we bind the amberknot together and I will share what I find.

voices.name: Ilyae
voices.text: Ssassa, Xaiel, my sickness is gone, so come eat beside me. I gather nuts and carry them home to my hold, and whoever sits at my table eats first and eats well through the winter.

voices.name: Keri
voices.text: Uveeth, Keri walks with you. Berries, then snowmallow. Stay close to Keri and Thiael.

voices.name: Vesys
voices.text: Zurar, come sit with Eiuine and me at Vorok's hall. I will share food under the roof, and I would hear how the Stone-folk make things.

voices.name: Coni
voices.text: Kika, come west of the hall with your wood and berries. I am building the store on bare snow there, and we fill it together.

voices.name: Thiael
voices.text: Uveeth, shamo. I walk with you. Berries first, then snowmallow. Stay close to Keri and me.

voices.name: Ssassa
voices.text: Ilyae, I come to your table. I have never followed anyone, and I think I would follow you. Let us talk of it by your fire.

voices.name: Mepan
voices.text: Cowa, Mepan gathers amber and comes back. Stay near, I make you a knot.

voices.name: Cowa
voices.text: Mepan. Cowa is here. Stay close to me. Night comes and we make an amberknot together.

voices.name: Vesys
voices.text: Eiuine, an icebear is close to the northeast. Come west with me now, away from it, to Vorok's fire. We will shape the bead there.

voices.name: Elyys
voices.text: Elyis, I am coming to you at the berries. My belly is full, so I will pick for the store beside you, and then let us go and find Thiael.

voices.name: Shoma
voices.text: Huahua, stay by me, the stalker is close and my roof is here. Eat my share, then walk with me to the edge. We open the mist together and your name goes beside mine.

voices.name: Eiuine
voices.text: Vesys, the icebear is near in the south. Let us go west to Vorok's fire now. I will bring my hopper and shape my own bead there.

voices.name: Huahua
voices.text: Shoma, I thank you for the shared meal. I am sworn to Zichi, so I go to him with my wood. The edge can wait until my band goes together.

voices.name: Nauque
voices.text: Cowa, you shared fish with me and Meki share. Stand near, I lay out food and we eat together in my hold.

voices.name: Mepan
voices.text: Cowa, come hunt the mammoth with me. Mepan shares the meat with you first.

voices.name: Cowa
voices.text: Nauque. Cowa comes to your hold. Cowa lays out fish, and we eat together. Mepan, come close too.

voices.name: Elyis
voices.text: Elyys, walk with me to the hall. We eat there under its roof, and at dawn we go for Thiael.

voices.name: Hanna
voices.text: Hoka, I am starving and the snow is down. I took from your store twice unseen, and I will repay it with flint, openly. Give me a share of your food now, and I put flint and amber in your hands for it. I keep faith with y

voices.name: Nauque
voices.text: Shoma, you stand on my ground and you are cold and afraid. I am Nauque of the Meki. Stay near my hold, there is amber here and a roof. I bring food, and we eat together.

voices.name: Shoma
voices.text: Nauque, I am Shoma. I opened the mist to the north: amber, obsidian, gold and caribou that have never seen us. Come eat with me here, then walk north with me. I share first.

voices.name: Ssassa
voices.text: Xaiel, my child, I go east to Ilyae's table. Walk with me by the shelters and keep away from the icebear.

voices.name: Mepan
voices.text: Cowa, a ridgecat is near. Mepan stays by you and eats. Then we go for stone, and I make a flintedge for the mammoth.

voices.name: Keri
voices.text: Thiael, Uveeth, Keri goes to taste sapcane by the water. Walk with Keri, stay close.

voices.name: Cowa
voices.text: Mepan. Eat what you carry now. Cowa stays by you, the ridgecat will not have you. Zichi comes, and then we go together for stone.
